`lint/restricted-syntax.mjs`:

```mjs
// @ts-check
// Our own oxlint JS plugin. oxlint has no `no-restricted-syntax`, so each rule here turns ESQuery
// selectors into reports; oxlint does the matching. Lint configuration only: run by Node at lint
// time, never bundled.

/**
 * @typedef {object} RuleContext
 * @property {(descriptor: { readonly node: unknown, readonly message: string }) => void} report
 */

/** A string literal with content, or a template literal. */
const LITERAL = ":matches(Literal[value=/./], TemplateLiteral)";

/** DOM properties and attributes that users see or hear. */
const COPY_PROPERTIES = [
  "textContent",
  "innerText",
  "outerText",
  "innerHTML",
  "outerHTML",
  "title",
  "placeholder",
  "alt",
  "label",
  "ariaLabel",
  "ariaDescription",
  "ariaPlaceholder",
  "ariaRoleDescription",
  "ariaValueText",
].join("|");
const COPY_ATTRIBUTES = "^(aria-|title$|placeholder$|alt$|label$)";
const SET_COPY_ATTRIBUTE = "CallExpression[callee.property.name='setAttribute']"
  + `[arguments.0.value=/${COPY_ATTRIBUTES}/] > ${LITERAL}.arguments:nth-child(2)`;

const COPY = "Copy comes from the message catalog (rule 9): use t(key), not a string literal.";
const LOG = "Log through the logger with a catalog key (rule 9), not a string literal.";
const ERROR = "Errors carry a catalog key, new SarError(key, params), not prose (rule 9).";
const JSON_PARSE_CALL = "CallExpression[callee.object.name='JSON'][callee.property.name='parse']";
const JSON_PARSE = "Use parseJson from src/core/json.ts (returns unknown) instead of JSON.parse.";

/**
 * A rule that reports every node matching one of the selectors with its message.
 * @param {Readonly<Record<string, string>>} restrictions selector to message
 */
const restrict = (restrictions) => ({
  /**
   * @param {RuleContext} context
   * @returns {Readonly<Record<string, (node: unknown) => void>>}
   */
  create(context) {
    /** @type {Record<string, (node: unknown) => void>} */
    const visitors = {};
    for (const [selector, message] of Object.entries(restrictions)) {
      visitors[selector] = (node) => {
        context.report({ node, message });
      };
    }
    return visitors;
  },
});

export default {
  meta: { name: "sar" },
  rules: {
    // Rule 9: string literals must not flow into user-visible or logged text.
    "no-hardcoded-copy": restrict({
      [`AssignmentExpression[left.property.name=/^(${COPY_PROPERTIES})$/] > ${LITERAL}.right`]:
        COPY,
      [SET_COPY_ATTRIBUTE]: COPY,
      [`CallExpression[callee.name=/^(alert|confirm|prompt)$/] > ${LITERAL}`]: COPY,
      [`CallExpression[callee.object.name='console'] > ${LITERAL}`]: LOG,
      // SarError takes a typed catalog key, so only the other error classes are checked.
      [`NewExpression[callee.name=/Error$/][callee.name!='SarError'] > ${LITERAL}`]: ERROR,
    }),
    // Untrusted JSON stays unknown: JSON.parse is wrapped once, in src/core/json.ts.
    "no-json-parse": restrict({
      [JSON_PARSE_CALL]: JSON_PARSE,
    }),
  },
};

```

`mise.local.toml.example`:

```example
# Machine-specific settings for the development tasks. Copy this file to mise.local.toml (which Git
# ignores) and fill in the paths for this machine. mise loads it on top of mise.toml.

[env]
# Firefox Nightly only, used by `mise run run-gecko` and checked by `mise run setup`. Never point
# this at the regular Firefox: run_browser.py refuses a binary whose update channel is not
# "nightly", and there is no fallback to a Firefox on PATH.
SAR_GECKO_BIN = "C:/Program Files/Firefox Nightly/firefox.exe"
# A profile directory dedicated to this project, outside the repo, so the Steam login survives
# restarts. An absolute path; it is created on first run. A profile last used by another Firefox
# install is refused.
SAR_GECKO_PROFILE = "C:/Users/you/dev-profiles/steam-ai-reporter-nightly"

# Chromium and a profile directory dedicated to this project, used by `mise run run-chromium`.
SAR_CHROMIUM_BIN = "C:/Users/you/AppData/Local/Chromium/Application/chrome.exe"
SAR_CHROMIUM_PROFILE = "C:/Users/you/dev-profiles/steam-ai-reporter-chromium"

# Windows only. From PowerShell or cmd, `bash` is WSL's bash.exe, which cannot run the tasks'
# shell scripts. Put Git for Windows' bin folder first on PATH so tasks find Git Bash. Git hooks
# already run under Git Bash and do not need this.
# _.path = ["C:/Program Files/Git/bin"]

```

`mise.toml`:

```toml
# :schema https://mise.jdx.dev/schema/mise.json
# Toolchain and task runner for local development, Git hooks and CI (AGENTS.md rule 14).
# Programs are pinned here; JavaScript libraries are pinned in package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml.
# Machine-specific values (browser paths, Git Bash on Windows) go in mise.local.toml; see
# mise.local.toml.example.

min_version = "2026.10.15"

[tools]
node = "24.14.0"
pnpm = "12.14.0"
python = "3.14.8"
uv = "0.13.1"
changie = "1.26.0"
"npm:web-ext" = "10.8.0"
dprint = "0.64.0"
ruff = "0.17.1"
"pypi:mypy" = "2.4.0"
shellcheck = "0.11.0"
shfmt = "3.14.1"
actionlint = "1.7.12"
zizmor = "1.31.1"
gh = "2.102.0"

[settings]
locked = true

[env]
_.path = ["{{config_root}}/node_modules/.bin"]

# Setup

[tasks.setup]
description = "Install tools and dependencies, write the Git hooks, check the browser paths"
run = [
  "mise install",
  "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile",
  "mise run hooks",
  "python scripts/run_browser.py gecko --check",
]

[tasks.hooks]
description = "Write the pre-commit and pre-push Git hooks"
run = [
  "mise generate git-pre-commit --write --task=precommit",
  "mise generate git-pre-commit --write --hook=pre-push --task=prepush",
]

[tasks.gen]
description = "Generate the typed message keys, the shipped catalogs and the stylesheet constants"
hide = true
sources = [
  "src/locales/*/messages.json",
  "tests/locales/en/messages.json",
  "docs/design/tokens.css",
  "src/core/ui/*.css",
  "scripts/*.py",
]
outputs = [
  "src/core/i18n/keys.gen.ts",
  "src/core/i18n/shipped.gen.ts",
  "tests/locales/keys.gen.ts",
  "src/core/ui/styles.gen.ts",
]
run = [
  "python scripts/gen_i18n_keys.py",
  "python scripts/gen_catalogs.py",
  "python scripts/gen_styles.py",
]

[tasks.deps]
description = "Install JavaScript dependencies from the lockfile"
hide = true
sources = ["package.json", "pnpm-lock.yaml", "pnpm-workspace.yaml"]
outputs = ["node_modules/.modules.yaml"]
run = "pnpm install --frozen-lockfile"

# Formatting

[tasks.fmt]
description = "Format every file we own"
run = [
  "dprint fmt",
  "ruff format",
  "shfmt --indent 2 --case-indent --write scripts",
]

[tasks.fmt-check]
description = "Fail on any unformatted file"
run = [
  "dprint check",
  "ruff format --check",
  "shfmt --indent 2 --case-indent --diff scripts",
]

# Static checks

[tasks.lint]
description = "Lint TypeScript, Python, shell scripts and workflows"
depends = ["deps", "gen"]
run = [
  "oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings",
  "ruff check",
  "mypy --strict scripts posting/scripts",
  "python scripts/lint_shell.py",
  "actionlint",
  "zizmor --offline .github/workflows",
]

[tasks.typecheck]
description = "Type-check the project and the core with TypeScript 7"
depends = ["deps", "gen"]
run = ["tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json", "tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.core.json"]

[tasks.test]
description = "Run the unit tests"
depends = ["deps", "gen"]
run = "vitest run"

[tasks.check]
description = "Check text hygiene, versions, message catalogs and the built bundles"
depends = ["build"]
run = [
  "python scripts/check_text.py",
  "python scripts/check_versions.py",
  "python scripts/check_i18n.py",
  "python scripts/check_bundle.py",
]

[tasks.check-branch]
description = "Check that the branch name is <type>/<slug>"
run = "python scripts/check_branch.py"

[tasks.check-reproducible]
description = "Build twice and compare the outputs byte for byte"
depends = ["deps", "gen"]
run = "bash scripts/check_reproducible.sh"

[tasks.changelog-gate]
description = "Fail a pull request that changes src/ without a changie fragment"
run = "python scripts/changelog_gate.py"

# Build and run

[tasks.build]
description = "Build the Chromium and Gecko extensions, the userscript and the dev bundle"
depends = ["deps", "gen"]
run = "python scripts/build.py"

[tasks.dev]
description = "Rebuild every target on change"
depends = ["deps", "gen"]
run = "python scripts/build.py --watch"

[tasks.icons]
description = "Render the extension icon PNGs from the purple mark with headless Chromium"
run = "python scripts/render_icons.py"

[tasks.lint-gecko]
description = "Run web-ext lint on the Gecko build"
depends = ["build"]
run = "web-ext lint --source-dir dist/gecko --warnings-as-errors"

[tasks.run-gecko]
description = "Run the Gecko build in Firefox Nightly ($SAR_GECKO_BIN) with auto-reload"
depends = ["build"]
run = "python scripts/run_browser.py gecko"

[tasks.run-chromium]
description = "Run the Chromium build in Chromium ($SAR_CHROMIUM_BIN) with auto-reload"
depends = ["build"]
run = "python scripts/run_browser.py chromium"

[tasks.package]
description = "Write the store zips, the userscript and the AMO source archive to artifacts/"
depends = ["build"]
run = ["bash scripts/package.sh", "python scripts/check_bundle.py"]

[tasks.canary]
description = "Check live Steam still has the shape the detectors expect (four requests; not in ci)"
run = "python scripts/canary.py"

[tasks.capture-fixtures]
description = "Refresh the public test fixtures from the live store (cookie-less)"
run = "python scripts/capture_fixtures.py"

# Changelog

[tasks.change-new]
description = "Add a changie fragment for this change"
run = "changie new"

# Release (ADR 0005; logic in scripts/calver.py and scripts/release.py)

[tasks."release:test"]
description = "Run the unit tests of the release scripts"
run = "python -m unittest discover --start-directory scripts --pattern test_*.py"

[tasks."release:train"]
description = "Open the release batch PR from the newest green main (DRY_RUN=true only reports)"
run = "python scripts/release.py train"

[tasks."release:tag"]
description = "Tag a merged release batch commit ($RELEASE_SHA) and dispatch the nightly"
run = "python scripts/release.py tag"

[tasks."release:nightly"]
description = "Validate $RELEASE_TAG, build, check, package, and create the GitHub prerelease"
run = [
  "python scripts/release.py validate",
  { task = "check-reproducible" },
  { task = "package" },
  "python scripts/release.py publish-nightly",
]

[tasks."release:validate"]
description = "Re-validate $RELEASE_TAG and its prerelease assets before a store promotion"
run = "python scripts/release.py validate --release"

[tasks."release:chrome"]
description = "Promote the $RELEASE_TAG prerelease's Chromium zip to the Chrome Web Store"
run = "python scripts/release.py chrome"

[tasks."release:amo"]
description = "Promote the $RELEASE_TAG prerelease's Gecko and source zips to AMO (listed)"
run = "python scripts/release.py amo"

[tasks."release:latest"]
description = "Mark the $RELEASE_TAG release as latest, which updates userscript installs"
run = "python scripts/release.py latest"

# Hooks and CI

[tasks.precommit]
description = "Format staged files we own, re-stage them, and check their text"
run = [
  "bash scripts/precommit_format.sh",
  "python scripts/check_text.py --staged",
  "python scripts/check_i18n.py",
]

[tasks.prepush]
description = "Everything a push must pass"
run = [
  { task = "check-branch" },
  { task = "fmt-check" },
  { tasks = ["lint", "typecheck", "test", "release:test"] },
  { task = "check" },
]

[tasks.ci]
description = "Everything CI runs: prepush plus reproducibility and web-ext lint"
run = [
  { task = "prepush" },
  { task = "check-reproducible" },
  { task = "lint-gecko" },
]

```

`posting/README.md`:

```md
# posting collection

Saved requests for [posting](https://posting.sh), used by spike S3 (CORS headers) and for manual checks of the endpoints the extension calls. Every request is keyless and cookie-less (`attach_cookies: false`).

- `getitems/`: `IStoreBrowseService/GetItems` for three app IDs, sent with the store origin, a foreign origin, a `moz-extension://` origin, a `chrome-extension://` origin, no origin, and a German context.
- `app-page/`: an English app page fetch and an adult-only app fetch, with redirects not followed.
- `scripts/record_headers.py`: an `on_response` hook that prints the CORS, `vary`, `location` and `retry-after` headers and saves all response headers as JSON under `<system temp>/steam-ai-reporter-posting/`. Cookie values are replaced by `<redacted>`.

## Run

From the repository root:

```bash
posting --collection posting
```

Pick a request in the collection tree on the left and press `Ctrl+J` to send it. The hook output shows in the response area's Scripts tab.

Do not send these requests in a loop. Steam rate limits per IP.

```

`posting/scripts/record_headers.py`:

```py
"""Posting on_response hook: print the response headers and save them for the spike notes.

Each response is written as JSON to <system temp>/steam-ai-reporter-posting/, one file per
request origin and path. Cookie values are never written; only the cookie names are kept.
"""

import json
import re
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Protocol


class _Headers(Protocol):
    def multi_items(self) -> list[tuple[str, str]]: ...

    def get(self, key: str, default: str) -> str: ...


class _Url(Protocol):
    @property
    def path(self) -> str: ...


class _Request(Protocol):
    @property
    def method(self) -> str: ...

    @property
    def url(self) -> _Url: ...

    @property
    def headers(self) -> _Headers: ...


class _Response(Protocol):
    @property
    def status_code(self) -> int: ...

    @property
    def headers(self) -> _Headers: ...

    @property
    def request(self) -> _Request: ...


OUT_DIR = Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / "steam-ai-reporter-posting"


def on_response(response: _Response) -> None:
    request = response.request
    origin = request.headers.get("origin", "no-origin")
    headers: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for name, value in response.headers.multi_items():
        shown = value.split("=", 1)[0] + "=<redacted>" if name.lower() == "set-cookie" else value
        headers.append((name.lower(), shown))
    record = {
        "method": request.method,
        "path": request.url.path,
        "origin": origin,
        "status": response.status_code,
        "headers": headers,
    }
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", f"{request.url.path} {origin}".lower()).strip("-")
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (OUT_DIR / f"{slug}.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    for name, value in headers:
        if name.startswith("access-control-") or name in ("vary", "location", "retry-after"):
            print(f"{name}: {value}")
    print(f"saved {OUT_DIR / (slug + '.json')}")

```

`scripts/build.py`:

```py
"""Build every target into dist/ with one esbuild call each.

Targets: the Chromium and Gecko extensions (dist/chromium, dist/gecko: the manifest, the content
script and its stylesheet, the options page, the catalogs, the icons and the third-party notices),
the userscript (dist/userscript) and the dev-only injection bundle (dist/dev, never packaged). The
userscript header goes in through `--banner:js` on the userscript call only. Bundles are never
minified.

Usage: build.py [--watch]
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from gen_styles import stylesheet
from repo import (
    DIST,
    EXTENSION_TARGETS,
    ICON_SIZES,
    ICONS_DIR,
    ROOT,
    SLUG,
    fail,
    json_object,
    json_string,
    package_version,
    read_json,
    valibot_notice,
)

ESBUILD = ROOT / "node_modules" / "esbuild" / "bin" / "esbuild"
EXTENSION_DIR = ROOT / "src" / "platform" / "extension"
LOCALES_DIR = ROOT / "src" / "locales"
NOTICES = ROOT / "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md"
DEFAULT_LOCALE = "en"
# The store page stylesheet, loaded by the manifest so the content script need not adopt it.
CONTENT_CSS = ("TOKENS_CSS", "PAGE_CSS")

USERSCRIPT_MATCH = "https://store.steampowered.com/*"
# The userscript @name comes from this catalog file and key. Set them to messages.json and ext_name,
# then delete the userscript.json files, to follow the product name.
USERSCRIPT_NAME = ("userscript.json", "userscript_name")
USERSCRIPT_NAMESPACE = "https://github.com/jrv97/steam-ai-reporter"
USERSCRIPT_UPDATE_BASE = f"{USERSCRIPT_NAMESPACE}/releases/latest/download"
USERSCRIPT_GRANTS = (
    "GM.getValue",
    "GM.setValue",
    "GM.deleteValue",
    "GM.listValues",
    "GM_addStyle",
    "GM.registerMenuCommand",
    "GM_addValueChangeListener",
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Bundle:
    entry: str
    outfile: Path
    banner: str | None = None


def esbuild_command(bundle: Bundle, watch: bool) -> list[str]:
    command = [
        "node",
        str(ESBUILD),
        bundle.entry,
        "--bundle",
        "--format=iife",
        "--platform=browser",
        "--target=es2022",
        "--charset=utf8",
        "--log-level=warning",
        f"--outfile={bundle.outfile}",
    ]
    if bundle.banner is not None:
        command.append(f"--banner:js={bundle.banner}")
    if watch:
        command.append("--watch=forever")
    return command


def load_catalogs(filename: str = "messages.json") -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
    catalogs: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for path in sorted(LOCALES_DIR.glob(f"*/{filename}")):
        catalogs[path.parent.name] = json_object(read_json(path), str(path))
    if DEFAULT_LOCALE not in catalogs:
        fail(f"missing the {DEFAULT_LOCALE} catalog in {LOCALES_DIR}")
    return catalogs


def message(catalog: dict[str, object], key: str, where: str) -> str:
    entry = json_object(catalog.get(key), f"{where} {key}")
    return json_string(entry.get("message"), f"{where} {key}.message")


def manifest_catalog(catalog: dict[str, object], locale: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """The catalog as `_locales` needs it: each message and its placeholders, no descriptions."""
    result: dict[str, object] = {}
    for key, value in catalog.items():
        entry = json_object(value, f"{locale} {key}")
        result[key] = {name: entry[name] for name in ("message", "placeholders") if name in entry}
    return result


def merge(base: dict[str, object], overlay: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Deep-merge two manifest objects; overlay values win, nested objects merge."""
    result = dict(base)
    for key, value in overlay.items():
        current = result.get(key)
        if isinstance(current, dict) and isinstance(value, dict):
            result[key] = merge(json_object(current, key), json_object(value, key))
        else:
            result[key] = value
    return result


def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def write_extension(target: str, version: str) -> None:
    out = DIST / target
    base = json_object(read_json(EXTENSION_DIR / "manifest.base.json"), "manifest.base.json")
    overlay_path = EXTENSION_DIR / f"manifest.{target}.json"
    overlay = json_object(read_json(overlay_path), overlay_path.name)
    manifest = merge(base, overlay) | {"version": version}
    write_text(out / "manifest.json", json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    write_text(out / "content.css", "".join(stylesheet(name) for name in CONTENT_CSS))
    shutil.copyfile(EXTENSION_DIR / "options.html", out / "options.html")
    shutil.copyfile(NOTICES, out / NOTICES.name)
    for locale, catalog in load_catalogs().items():
        write_text(
            out / "_locales" / locale / "messages.json",
            json.dumps(manifest_catalog(catalog, locale), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n",
        )
    for size in ICON_SIZES:
        icon = out / "icons" / f"icon-{size}.png"
        icon.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copyfile(ICONS_DIR / f"icon-{size}.png", icon)


def userscript_header(version: str, catalogs: dict[str, dict[str, object]]) -> str:
    english = catalogs[DEFAULT_LOCALE]
    name_file, name_key = USERSCRIPT_NAME
    names = load_catalogs(name_file)
    fields: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
        ("@name", message(names[DEFAULT_LOCALE], name_key, DEFAULT_LOCALE)),
    ]
    for locale, catalog in names.items():
        if locale != DEFAULT_LOCALE:
            fields.append((f"@name:{locale}", message(catalog, name_key, locale)))
    fields += [
        ("@namespace", USERSCRIPT_NAMESPACE),
        ("@version", version),
        ("@description", message(english, "ext_description", DEFAULT_LOCALE)),
    ]
    for locale, catalog in catalogs.items():
        if locale != DEFAULT_LOCALE:
            fields.append((f"@description:{locale}", message(catalog, "ext_description", locale)))
    fields += [
        ("@license", "MIT"),
        ("@match", USERSCRIPT_MATCH),
        ("@noframes", ""),
        ("@run-at", "document-idle"),
        ("@updateURL", f"{USERSCRIPT_UPDATE_BASE}/{SLUG}.meta.js"),
        ("@downloadURL", f"{USERSCRIPT_UPDATE_BASE}/{SLUG}.user.js"),
    ]
    fields += [("@grant", grant) for grant in USERSCRIPT_GRANTS]
    width = max(len(key) for key, _ in fields) + 1
    lines = ["// ==UserScript=="]
    lines += [f"// {key.ljust(width)}{value}".rstrip() for key, value in fields]
    lines.append("// ==/UserScript==")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def bundles(header: str) -> list[Bundle]:
    result = [
        Bundle(f"src/platform/extension/{entry}.ts", DIST / target / f"{entry}.js")
        for target in EXTENSION_TARGETS
        for entry in ("content", "options")
    ]
    result.append(
        Bundle(
            "src/platform/userscript/main.ts",
            DIST / "userscript" / f"{SLUG}.user.js",
            banner=f"{header}\n{valibot_notice()}",
        )
    )
    result.append(Bundle("src/platform/dev/inject.ts", DIST / "dev" / "inject.js"))
    return result


def run_esbuild(all_bundles: list[Bundle], watch: bool) -> None:
    processes = [
        subprocess.Popen(esbuild_command(bundle, watch), cwd=ROOT) for bundle in all_bundles
    ]
    failed = sum(1 for proc in processes if proc.wait() != 0)
    if failed:
        fail(f"esbuild failed for {failed} target(s)")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--watch", action="store_true", help="rebuild the bundles on change")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    version = package_version()
    catalogs = load_catalogs()
    header = userscript_header(version, catalogs)

    shutil.rmtree(DIST, ignore_errors=True)
    for target in EXTENSION_TARGETS:
        write_extension(target, version)
    write_text(DIST / "userscript" / f"{SLUG}.meta.js", header + "\n")
    run_esbuild(bundles(header), watch=False)
    if args.watch:
        print("watching src/ (manifests and catalogs are copied on the next full build)")
        try:
            run_esbuild(bundles(header), watch=True)
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            sys.exit(0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/calver.py`:

```py
"""Unpadded CalVer release versions (ADR 0005).

The first release of a UTC day is `YYYY.M.D`, and a same-day recut adds `.N` from 1.
Examples: `2026.10.5`, `2026.10.5.1`. The Git tag, manifest and userscript all use this string.
Chrome and AMO accept one to four integers without leading zeros. Chrome caps each at 65535.

Usage:
  calver.py next              print the next version from today's UTC date and the Git tags
  calver.py check <version>   fail unless <version> is a valid CalVer release version
"""

import argparse
import re
from collections.abc import Iterable
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime

from repo import fail, git

MAX_SEGMENT = 65535
CALVER = re.compile(r"^(?P<y>[1-9]\d{3})\.(?P<m>[1-9]\d?)\.(?P<d>[1-9]\d?)(?:\.(?P<n>[1-9]\d*))?$")

type Version = tuple[int, int, int, int]


def parse(text: str) -> Version | None:
    """Return (year, month, day, recut) for a valid version, with recut 0 for none, else None."""
    match = CALVER.match(text)
    if match is None:
        return None
    year, month, day = int(match["y"]), int(match["m"]), int(match["d"])
    recut = int(match["n"] or 0)
    if recut > MAX_SEGMENT:
        return None
    try:
        date(year, month, day)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    return year, month, day, recut


def render(version: Version) -> str:
    year, month, day, recut = version
    base = f"{year}.{month}.{day}"
    return f"{base}.{recut}" if recut else base


def next_version(today: date, tags: Iterable[str]) -> str:
    """Return the first version for `today`, or the next recut when `today` has releases.

    Raise ValueError when a tag is newer than today or the recut would pass 65535.
    """
    versions = [version for version in map(parse, tags) if version is not None]
    day = (today.year, today.month, today.day)
    if any(version[:3] > day for version in versions):
        newest = render(max(versions))
        raise ValueError(f"tag {newest} is newer than today ({today.isoformat()} UTC)")
    recuts = [version[3] for version in versions if version[:3] == day]
    if not recuts:
        return render((*day, 0))
    recut = max(recuts) + 1
    if recut > MAX_SEGMENT:
        raise ValueError(f"{render((*day, 0))} has used every recut up to {MAX_SEGMENT}")
    return render((*day, recut))


def release_tags() -> list[str]:
    """Every Git tag that is a CalVer release version, oldest first."""
    tags = [tag for tag in git("tag", "--list").split() if parse(tag) is not None]
    return sorted(tags, key=lambda tag: parse(tag) or (0, 0, 0, 0))


def utc_today() -> date:
    return datetime.now(UTC).date()


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Unpadded CalVer release versions.")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    commands.add_parser("next", help="print the next version")
    check = commands.add_parser("check", help="fail unless the argument is a valid version")
    check.add_argument("version")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.command == "check":
        if parse(args.version) is None:
            fail(f"{args.version!r} is not an unpadded CalVer version (YYYY.M.D or YYYY.M.D.N)")
        return
    try:
        print(next_version(utc_today(), release_tags()))
    except ValueError as error:
        fail(str(error))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/canary.py`:

```py
"""Check that Steam still answers in the shape the detectors rely on (live, keyless).

One GetItems call for a sample of apps, then three `?l=english` app pages, one for each structural
hook: the anti-cheat name line, the DRM notice with a line break and the non-kernel notice. Four
requests in total, all without cookies, to the two Valve hosts the extension itself uses. Each
field has the type the schemas expect when it is present, and across the sample some app shows
each kind of declaration. A page comes from an app the sample shows that declaration for, and is
checked against what GetItems says about its own app. Exits non-zero, listing what changed, when
an answer no longer has the expected shape. Not part of `ci`: it needs the network and Steam's
mood. Run it before a release.
"""

import json
import re
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from html.parser import HTMLParser

from repo import fail

GETITEMS_URL = "https://api.steampowered.com/IStoreBrowseService/GetItems/v1"
APP_PAGE_URL = "https://store.steampowered.com/app/{appid}/?l=english"
USER_AGENT = "steam-ai-reporter-canary (+https://github.com/jrv97/steam-ai-reporter)"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30
HEADING = "AI Generated Content Disclosure"
# Apps that between them declare every kind. A page hook takes the first app that shows its
# declaration, so only the order matters.
SAMPLE = (1808500, 5072580, 413150, 3751950, 2807960, 730, 105600, 1245620)
# Steam's category IDs for PvP, Online PvP, LAN PvP and Shared/Split Screen PvP.
PVP_CATEGORY_IDS = frozenset({49, 36, 47, 37})
EULA_URL = re.compile(r"^https://store\.steampowered\.com/+eula/")
APP_PATH = re.compile(r"^/app/(\d+)(?:/|$)")

STRING_FIELDS = (
    "content_survey_ai_notes",
    "drm_third_party_type",
    "drm_activation_limit",
    "user_account_third_party",
)
ANTICHEAT_BOOLS = ("kernel_mode", "uninstall_completely", "boot_protection")
ANTICHEAT_STRINGS = ("name", "name_loc", "boot_protection_name")
# What some app in the sample must show. A declaration that nobody makes any more is a change.
REQUIRED_FACTS = {
    "ai": "content_survey_ai_notes with text",
    "kernel": "anticheat.kernel_mode true",
    "nonkernel": "an anticheat object without kernel_mode",
    "drm": "drm_third_party_type with text",
    "account": "user_account_third_party with text",
    "eula": "a non-empty eula list",
    "pvp": "categories.supported_player_categoryids with a PvP category",
}


class Response:
    def __init__(self, status: int, url: str, headers: dict[str, str], body: str) -> None:
        self.status = status
        self.url = url
        self.headers = headers
        self.body = body


def get(url: str) -> Response:
    """A GET with no cookies and no credentials (the default opener has no cookie jar)."""
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT})  # noqa: S310
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as response:  # noqa: S310
            body = response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            headers = {key.lower(): value for key, value in response.headers.items()}
            return Response(response.status, response.url, headers, body)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return Response(error.code, url, {}, "")
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError) as error:
        fail(f"{url}: request failed: {error}")


def getitems_url(ids: tuple[int, ...]) -> str:
    request = {
        "ids": [{"appid": appid} for appid in ids],
        "context": {"language": "english", "country_code": "US"},
        "data_request": {"include_extra_details": True},
    }
    return f"{GETITEMS_URL}?input_json={urllib.parse.quote(json.dumps(request), safe='')}"


def as_object(value: object) -> dict[str, object] | None:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return None
    return {str(key): item for key, item in value.items()}


def has_text(value: object) -> bool:
    return isinstance(value, str) and bool(value.strip())


def type_problems(
    where: str, object_: dict[str, object], names: tuple[str, ...], kind: type
) -> list[str]:
    """Each of `names` that is present must have the type `kind`."""
    return [
        f"{where}: {name} is not a {kind.__name__}"
        for name in names
        if name in object_ and not isinstance(object_[name], kind)
    ]


def eula_problems(where: str, eula: object) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(eula, list):
        return [f"{where}: eula is not a list"]
    problems: list[str] = []
    for entry in eula:
        link = as_object(entry)
        name = link.get("name") if link else None
        url = link.get("url") if link else None
        if not (isinstance(name, str) and isinstance(url, str)):
            problems.append(f"{where}: an eula entry is not name and url strings")
        elif not EULA_URL.match(url):
            problems.append(f"{where}: an eula url is not an https store /eula/ link")
    return problems


def anticheat_problems(where: str, anticheat: object) -> list[str]:
    fields = as_object(anticheat)
    if fields is None:
        return [f"{where}: anticheat is not an object"]
    return [
        *type_problems(f"{where} anticheat", fields, ANTICHEAT_BOOLS, bool),
        *type_problems(f"{where} anticheat", fields, ANTICHEAT_STRINGS, str),
    ]


def service_problems(where: str, service: object) -> list[str]:
    fields = as_object(service)
    if fields is None or not isinstance(fields.get("name", ""), str):
        return [f"{where}: ai_generation_service is not an object with a name string"]
    return []


def details_problems(where: str, details: dict[str, object]) -> list[str]:
    problems = type_problems(where, details, STRING_FIELDS, str)
    problems += type_problems(where, details, ("user_account_third_party_link_to_steam",), bool)
    if "anticheat" in details:
        problems += anticheat_problems(where, details["anticheat"])
    if "eula" in details:
        problems += eula_problems(where, details["eula"])
    if "ai_generation_service" in details:
        problems += service_problems(where, details["ai_generation_service"])
    return problems


def category_ids(item: dict[str, object]) -> list[int] | None:
    categories = as_object(item.get("categories"))
    ids = categories.get("supported_player_categoryids") if categories else None
    if not isinstance(ids, list):
        return None
    return [entry for entry in ids if isinstance(entry, int)]


def item_problems(appid: int, item: dict[str, object] | None) -> list[str]:
    where = f"GetItems app {appid}"
    if item is None:
        return [f"{where}: no item with this id in the answer"]
    if item.get("success") != 1:
        return [f"{where}: success is {item.get('success')!r}, expected 1"]
    details = as_object(item.get("extra_details"))
    if details is None:
        return [f"{where}: extra_details is missing"]
    problems = details_problems(where, details)
    if "categories" in item and category_ids(item) is None:
        problems.append(f"{where}: categories.supported_player_categoryids is not a list")
    return problems


def facts_of(item: dict[str, object]) -> set[str]:
    """Which declarations an item shows, by the keys of `REQUIRED_FACTS`."""
    details = as_object(item.get("extra_details")) or {}
    anticheat = as_object(details.get("anticheat"))
    eula = details.get("eula")
    return {
        fact
        for fact, shown in (
            ("ai", has_text(details.get("content_survey_ai_notes"))),
            ("kernel", anticheat is not None and anticheat.get("kernel_mode") is True),
            ("nonkernel", anticheat is not None and anticheat.get("kernel_mode") is not True),
            ("drm", has_text(details.get("drm_third_party_type"))),
            ("account", has_text(details.get("user_account_third_party"))),
            ("eula", isinstance(eula, list) and bool(eula)),
            ("pvp", bool(PVP_CATEGORY_IDS.intersection(category_ids(item) or []))),
        )
        if shown
    }


def parse_items(response: Response) -> tuple[list[str], dict[int, dict[str, object]]]:
    where = "GetItems"
    if response.status != 200:
        return [f"{where}: HTTP {response.status}, expected 200"], {}
    problems: list[str] = []
    if response.headers.get("x-eresult", "").strip() != "1":
        problems.append(f"{where}: x-eresult is {response.headers.get('x-eresult')!r}, expected 1")
    try:
        envelope = as_object(json.loads(response.body))
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        return [*problems, f"{where}: the body is not JSON"], {}
    inner = as_object(envelope.get("response")) if envelope else None
    items = inner.get("store_items") if inner else None
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        return [*problems, f"{where}: response.store_items is missing or not a list"], {}
    by_id: dict[int, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for entry in items:
        item = as_object(entry)
        item_id = item.get("id") if item else None
        if item is not None and isinstance(item_id, int):
            by_id[item_id] = item
    return problems, by_id


def getitems_problems(by_id: dict[int, dict[str, object]]) -> list[str]:
    problems: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for appid in SAMPLE:
        item = by_id.get(appid)
        problems += item_problems(appid, item)
        seen |= facts_of(item) if item is not None else set()
    problems += [
        f"GetItems: no app in the sample shows {shown}"
        for fact, shown in REQUIRED_FACTS.items()
        if fact not in seen
    ]
    return problems


# The structural hooks, each with the declarations of the app whose page shows it, best first.
# The name line page also carries the AI heading when the sample has an app with both.
PAGE_HOOKS = (
    ("name line", ({"kernel", "ai"}, {"kernel"})),
    ("line break", ({"drm"},)),
    ("non-kernel notice", ({"nonkernel"},)),
)


def pick_page_app(by_id: dict[int, dict[str, object]], options: tuple[set[str], ...]) -> int | None:
    """The first app of the sample whose declarations include the best option that has one."""
    for wanted in options:
        for appid in SAMPLE:
            item = by_id.get(appid)
            if item is not None and wanted <= facts_of(item):
                return appid
    return None


class PageScan(HTMLParser):
    """Collects `#appHubAppName`, the `h2` texts of every disclosure block and the notice hooks."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.has_app_name = False
        self.headings: list[str] = []
        self.kernel_sections = 0
        self.nonkernel_notices = 0
        self.name_lines: list[str] = []
        self.eula_links = 0
        self.plain_notices = 0
        self.break_notices = 0
        self.break_notices_with_markup = 0
        self._block_depth = 0
        self._in_h2 = False
        self._text = ""
        self._notice_depth = 0
        self._notice_tags: list[str] = []
        self._in_name_line = False
        self._in_removal_note = False
        self._line = ""

    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:
        ids = {value for key, value in attrs if key == "id"}
        classes = {name for key, value in attrs if key == "class" for name in (value or "").split()}
        roles = {value for key, value in attrs if key == "role"}
        self.has_app_name = self.has_app_name or "appHubAppName" in ids
        self.kernel_sections += {"anticheat_section", "DRM_notice"} <= classes
        self.nonkernel_notices += "anticheat_nonkernel_notice" in classes
        self._scan_name_line(classes)
        self.eula_links += tag == "a" and any(
            key == "href" and "/eula/" in (value or "") for key, value in attrs
        )
        self._scan_notice(tag, classes, bool(roles))
        self._scan_block(tag, ids)

    def _scan_name_line(self, classes: set[str]) -> None:
        if "anticheat_name" in classes:
            self._in_name_line, self._line = True, ""
        elif self._in_name_line and "anticheat_uninstalls" in classes:
            self._in_removal_note = True

    def _scan_notice(self, tag: str, classes: set[str], has_role: bool) -> None:
        if self._notice_depth:
            self._notice_depth += tag == "div"
            self._notice_tags.append(tag)
        elif tag == "div" and "DRM_notice" in classes and not has_role:
            if "anticheat_section" not in classes:
                self.plain_notices += 1
                self._notice_depth = 1
                self._notice_tags = []

    def _scan_block(self, tag: str, ids: set[str | None]) -> None:
        if self._block_depth:
            if tag == "div":
                self._block_depth += 1
            elif tag == "h2":
                self._in_h2, self._text = True, ""
        elif tag == "div" and "game_area_content_descriptors" in ids:
            self._block_depth = 1

    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:
        if self._notice_depth and tag == "div":
            self._notice_depth -= 1
            if not self._notice_depth and "br" in self._notice_tags:
                if self._notice_tags == ["br"]:
                    self.break_notices += 1
                else:
                    self.break_notices_with_markup += 1
        if tag == "span" and self._in_removal_note:
            self._in_removal_note = False
        elif tag == "div" and self._in_name_line:
            self._in_name_line = False
            self.name_lines.append(self._line.strip())
        if self._in_h2 and tag == "h2":
            self._in_h2 = False
            self.headings.append(self._text.strip())
        elif self._block_depth and tag == "div":
            self._block_depth -= 1

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        if self._in_h2:
            self._text += data
        if self._in_name_line and not self._in_removal_note:
            self._line += data


def hook_problems(where: str, scan: PageScan, hook: str, item: dict[str, object]) -> list[str]:
    """What the page must show for the hook it was picked for, given the item of the same app."""
    details = as_object(item.get("extra_details")) or {}
    anticheat = as_object(details.get("anticheat")) or {}
    if hook == "name line":
        name = anticheat.get("name")
        lines = [line for line in scan.name_lines if line]
        if scan.kernel_sections == 0 or not lines:
            return [f"{where}: no .anticheat_section.DRM_notice with a named .anticheat_name"]
        if isinstance(name, str) and name.strip() and lines[0] != name.strip():
            return [f"{where}: the first .anticheat_name differs from anticheat.name"]
    elif hook == "line break" and scan.break_notices == 0:
        return [f"{where}: no .DRM_notice made of a text, a <br> and a text"]
    elif hook == "non-kernel notice" and (scan.nonkernel_notices == 0 or not scan.name_lines):
        return [f"{where}: no .anticheat_nonkernel_notice with an .anticheat_name"]
    return []


def page_problems(where: str, scan: PageScan, hook: str, item: dict[str, object]) -> list[str]:
    """What the page must show for the declarations GetItems gave for the same app."""
    facts = facts_of(item)
    problems = hook_problems(where, scan, hook, item)
    if not scan.has_app_name:
        problems.append(f"{where}: #appHubAppName is missing")
    if "ai" in facts and HEADING not in scan.headings:
        problems.append(
            f"{where}: no #game_area_content_descriptors block with the h2 {HEADING!r}"
            f" (found {scan.headings!r})"
        )
    if "eula" in facts and scan.eula_links == 0:
        problems.append(f"{where}: no link to /eula/")
    if "drm" in facts and scan.plain_notices == 0:
        problems.append(f"{where}: no plain .DRM_notice")
    if scan.break_notices_with_markup:
        problems.append(
            f"{where}: a .DRM_notice with a <br> holds more than a text, a <br>, a text"
        )
    return problems


def app_page_problems(
    response: Response, appid: int, hook: str, item: dict[str, object]
) -> list[str]:
    where = f"app page {appid} ({hook})"
    if response.status != 200:
        return [f"{where}: HTTP {response.status}, expected 200"]
    match = APP_PATH.match(urllib.parse.urlparse(response.url).path)
    if match is None or int(match.group(1)) != appid:
        return [f"{where}: redirected to {response.url}, expected the app page"]
    scan = PageScan()
    scan.feed(response.body)
    return page_problems(where, scan, hook, item)


def main() -> None:
    problems, by_id = parse_items(get(getitems_url(SAMPLE)))
    problems += getitems_problems(by_id)
    for hook, options in PAGE_HOOKS:
        appid = pick_page_app(by_id, options)
        item = by_id.get(appid) if appid is not None else None
        if appid is None or item is None:
            problems.append(f"app page ({hook}): no app in the sample shows its declaration")
            continue
        problems += app_page_problems(get(APP_PAGE_URL.format(appid=appid)), appid, hook, item)
    if problems:
        print("\n".join(problems))
        fail(f"{len(problems)} canary problem(s): Steam's shape may have changed")
    print("canary: GetItems and the app pages still have the expected shape")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`scripts/capture_fixtures.py`:

```py
"""Refresh the public fixtures in tests/fixtures/ from the live store (cookie-less, keyless).

Captures the GetItems fixtures (`mixed-states`, `german-context`, `empty-response`, `kinds`)
and the server-rendered app pages, sanitizes them the way tests/fixtures/README.md describes, and
writes them in place. It never signs in and never captures a logged-in page. Fixtures that need a
rendered DOM or an account (`surfaces/`, `app-page/*-live-dom.html`, `search-roguelike-50`,
the `synthetic-*` files) are not touched; refresh those by hand.

Without --out the files in tests/fixtures/ are overwritten and the capture date in
tests/fixtures/README.md is updated; review the diff before committing. Use --out to write to
another folder first, or --only kinds to refresh just the tag-kind fixtures (their capture date
is in the README tables). About twenty requests are made, one second apart.
"""

import argparse
import html
import json
import re
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path

from repo import ROOT, fail

FIXTURES = ROOT / "tests" / "fixtures"
GETITEMS_URL = "https://api.steampowered.com/IStoreBrowseService/GetItems/v1"
USER_AGENT = "steam-ai-reporter-fixtures (+https://github.com/jrv97/steam-ai-reporter)"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30
SPACING_SECONDS = 1.0

ITEM_REMOVED = ("related_items", "best_purchase_option")
KINDS_DETAILS_REMOVED = (
    "system_requirements",
    "early_access",
    "partner_awards_bbcode",
    "links_and_info",
    "press_review",
    "legal_notice_bbcode",
    "section",
)
# The AI fixtures drop the EULA links; the kinds fixture keeps them.
DETAILS_REMOVED = (*KINDS_DETAILS_REMOVED, "eula")

VOID_TAGS = frozenset(
    [
        "area",
        "base",
        "br",
        "col",
        "embed",
        "hr",
        "img",
        "input",
        "link",
        "meta",
        "param",
        "source",
        "track",
        "wbr",
    ]
)
DROPPED_TAGS = frozenset(
    ["script", "style", "link", "noscript", "iframe", "svg", "template", "video", "object", "embed"]
)
# Page chrome and bulky blocks cut from app pages (ids and classes).
DROPPED_IDS = frozenset(
    {
        "global_header",
        "footer",
        "footer_spacer",
        "application_config",
        "game_highlights",
        "Reviews_summary",
        "app_reviews_hash",
        "review_histogram_rollup_section",
        "recommended_block_content",
        "ReportAppBtn",
    }
)
DROPPED_CLASSES = frozenset({"sys_req", "responsive_page_menu_ctn", "home_page_content"})
ALLOWED_DS = frozenset(
    {"data-ds-appid", "data-ds-packageid", "data-ds-bundleid", "data-ds-itemkey"}
)
DROPPED_ATTRS = frozenset({"srcset", "data-props", "data-panel"})
KEEP_WHITESPACE_ID = "game_area_content_descriptors"
# Redirect captures keep only this many levels below <body>.
SHALLOW_DEPTH = 3
TAB = "&#9;"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AppPage:
    file: str
    appid: int
    shallow: bool = False
    # Keep only the name and the features list (#category_block) in a minimal document.
    features_only: bool = False


APP_PAGES = (
    AppPage("5072580-ai-first.html", 5072580),
    AppPage("1808500-ai-only.html", 1808500),
    AppPage("413150-no-block.html", 413150),
    AppPage("4618750-ai-line-breaks.html", 4618750),
    AppPage("339800-login-redirect.html", 339800, shallow=True),
    AppPage("99999999-home-redirect.html", 99999999, shallow=True),
)

# The tag kinds: apps that show each declaration, a package and a bundle without `extra_details`,
# and an ID that does not exist.
KIND_APPS = (3751950, 2807960, 1808500, 813230, 730, 570, 105600, 1245620, 1172470, 271590)
# Games that declare nothing of any kind, from 2004 to 2024.
KIND_NOTHING = (1145360, 413150, 504230, 367520, 2379780, 620)
KIND_PACKAGE = 320795
KIND_BUNDLE = 1
KIND_MISSING = 99999999
KIND_PAGES = (
    AppPage("3751950-drm-account-eula.html", 3751950, features_only=True),
    AppPage("2807960-kernel-boot-protection.html", 2807960, features_only=True),
    AppPage("730-anticheat-nonkernel.html", 730, features_only=True),
    AppPage("1172470-kernel-easyac.html", 1172470, features_only=True),
)


def fetch(url: str) -> str:
    """GET without cookies (the default opener has no cookie jar); returns the body."""
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT})  # noqa: S310
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as response:  # noqa: S310
            body: str = response.read().decode("utf-8")
            return body
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError) as error:
        fail(f"{url}: {error}")


def ascii_refs(text: str) -> str:
    return "".join(char if ord(char) < 128 else f"&#{ord(char)};" for char in text)


class Sanitizer(HTMLParser):
    """Streams a page back out, dropping what tests/fixtures/README.md lists as removed."""

    def __init__(self, shallow: bool) -> None:
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self.shallow = shallow
        self.out: list[str] = []
        self._stack: list[str] = []
        self._skip_from: int | None = None
        self._keep_ws_from: int | None = None
        self._body_level: int | None = None

    def _drops(self, tag: str, attrs: dict[str, str | None]) -> bool:
        classes = (attrs.get("class") or "").split()
        if tag in DROPPED_TAGS or attrs.get("id") in DROPPED_IDS:
            return True
        if any(name in DROPPED_CLASSES or "avatar" in name for name in classes):
            return True
        if "data-miniprofile" in attrs:
            return True
        if tag == "input" and attrs.get("name") == "sessionid":
            return True
        if self.shallow and self._body_level is not None:
            return len(self._stack) - self._body_level >= SHALLOW_DEPTH
        return False

    def _render(self, tag: str, attrs: dict[str, str | None]) -> str:
        parts = [tag]
        for key, value in attrs.items():
            if key.startswith(("on", "data-miniprofile")) or key in DROPPED_ATTRS:
                continue
            if key.startswith("data-ds-") and key not in ALLOWED_DS:
                continue
            if value is None:
                parts.append(key)
            else:
                escaped = ascii_refs(html.escape(value, quote=True)).replace("\t", TAB)
                parts.append(f'{key}="{escaped}"')
        return "<" + " ".join(parts) + ">"

    def handle_decl(self, decl: str) -> None:
        self.out.append(f"<!{decl}>\n")

    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:
        mapping = dict(attrs)
        if self._skip_from is not None:
            if tag not in VOID_TAGS:
                self._stack.append(tag)
            return
        if tag == "body":
            self._body_level = len(self._stack) + 1
        if self._drops(tag, mapping):
            if tag not in VOID_TAGS:
                self._skip_from = len(self._stack)
                self._stack.append(tag)
            return
        self.out.append(self._render(tag, mapping))
        if tag not in VOID_TAGS:
            if mapping.get("id") == KEEP_WHITESPACE_ID:
                self._keep_ws_from = len(self._stack)
            self._stack.append(tag)

    def handle_startendtag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:
        mapping = dict(attrs)
        if self._skip_from is None and not self._drops(tag, mapping):
            self.out.append(self._render(tag, mapping))

    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:
        if tag in VOID_TAGS or tag not in self._stack:
            return
        while self._stack:
            popped = self._stack.pop()
            level = len(self._stack)
            if self._skip_from is None:
                self.out.append(f"</{popped}>")
            elif level <= self._skip_from:
                self._skip_from = None
            if self._keep_ws_from is not None and level <= self._keep_ws_from:
                self._keep_ws_from = None
            if popped == tag:
                break

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        if self._skip_from is not None:
            return
        if not data.strip():
            self.out.append("\n")
        elif self._keep_ws_from is not None:
            self.out.append(ascii_refs(html.escape(data, quote=False)).replace("\t", TAB))
        else:
            collapsed = re.sub(r"[ \t]+", " ", data)
            self.out.append(ascii_refs(html.escape(collapsed, quote=False)))

    # Comments and processing instructions are dropped by not overriding their handlers.


def sanitize_page(text: str, shallow: bool) -> str:
    parser = Sanitizer(shallow)
    parser.feed(text)
    parser.close()
    return re.sub(r"\n{2,}", "\n", "".join(parser.out)).strip() + "\n"


def element_html(text: str, element_id: str) -> str:
    """The sanitized div with this id, found by counting the divs inside it."""
    marker = text.find(f'id="{element_id}"')
    start = text.rfind("<div", 0, marker)
    if marker < 0 or start < 0:
        fail(f"no div with the id {element_id} in the page")
    depth = 0
    end = -1
    for tag in re.finditer(r"<(/?)div\b", text[start:]):
        depth += -1 if tag.group(1) else 1
        if depth == 0:
            end = text.index(">", start + tag.end()) + 1
            break
    if end < 0:
        fail(f"the div with the id {element_id} never closes")
    return text[start:end]


def features_page(text: str) -> str:
    """A minimal document with the page title, the app name and the features list."""
    title = re.search(r"<title>(.*?)</title>", text, re.DOTALL)
    if title is None:
        fail("no title in the page")
    return (
        '<!DOCTYPE html>\n<html lang="en">\n<head>\n<meta charset="utf-8">\n'
        f"<title>{title.group(1)}</title>\n</head>\n<body>\n"
        f"{element_html(text, 'appHubAppName')}\n{element_html(text, 'category_block')}\n"
        "</body>\n</html>\n"
    )


def getitems_url(ids: list[dict[str, int]], language: str, country: str) -> str:
    request = {
        "ids": ids,
        "context": {"language": language, "country_code": country},
        "data_request": {"include_extra_details": True},
    }
    return f"{GETITEMS_URL}?input_json={urllib.parse.quote(json.dumps(request), safe='')}"


def trim_item(entry: object, removed: tuple[str, ...]) -> object:
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        return entry
    item = {key: value for key, value in entry.items() if key not in ITEM_REMOVED}
    details = item.get("extra_details")
    if isinstance(details, dict):
        item["extra_details"] = {k: v for k, v in details.items() if k not in removed}
    return item


def app_ids(appids: list[int]) -> list[dict[str, int]]:
    return [{"appid": appid} for appid in appids]


def getitems_fixture(
    ids: list[dict[str, int]],
    language: str,
    country: str,
    removed: tuple[str, ...] = DETAILS_REMOVED,
) -> str:
    envelope = json.loads(fetch(getitems_url(ids, language, country)))
    response = envelope.get("response") if isinstance(envelope, dict) else None
    items = response.get("store_items") if isinstance(response, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        fail(f"GetItems {ids}: no response.store_items in the answer")
    rows = ",\n".join(json.dumps(trim_item(item, removed), separators=(",", ":")) for item in items)
    return '{"response":{"store_items":[\n' + rows + "\n]}}\n"


def write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    print(f"wrote {path}")


def capture_getitems(out: Path) -> None:
    mixed = [5072580, 1808500, 1938090, 413150, 339800, 99999999, 50300]
    write(out / "getitems" / "mixed-states.json", getitems_fixture(app_ids(mixed), "english", "US"))
    time.sleep(SPACING_SECONDS)
    write(
        out / "getitems" / "german-context.json",
        getitems_fixture(app_ids([1938090, 5072580]), "german", "DE"),
    )
    time.sleep(SPACING_SECONDS)
    write(out / "getitems" / "empty-response.json", fetch(getitems_url([], "english", "US")))
    time.sleep(SPACING_SECONDS)


def capture_kinds_getitems(out: Path) -> None:
    ids = [
        *app_ids([*KIND_APPS, *KIND_NOTHING]),
        {"packageid": KIND_PACKAGE},
        {"bundleid": KIND_BUNDLE},
        *app_ids([KIND_MISSING]),
    ]
    write(
        out / "getitems" / "kinds.json",
        getitems_fixture(ids, "english", "US", KINDS_DETAILS_REMOVED),
    )
    time.sleep(SPACING_SECONDS)


def capture_app_pages(out: Path, pages: tuple[AppPage, ...] = APP_PAGES) -> None:
    for page in pages:
        body = fetch(f"https://store.steampowered.com/app/{page.appid}/?l=english")
        clean = sanitize_page(body, page.shallow)
        write(out / "app-page" / page.file, features_page(clean) if page.features_only else clean)
        time.sleep(SPACING_SECONDS)


def update_readme_date() -> None:
    readme = FIXTURES / "README.md"
    today = datetime.now(UTC).date().isoformat()
    text = readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    updated = re.sub(r"(Captured from the live store on )\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", rf"\g<1>{today}", text)
    readme.write_text(updated, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=FIXTURES, help="output folder")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--only", choices=("getitems", "app-page", "kinds"), help="capture one group"
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.only in (None, "getitems"):
        capture_getitems(args.out)
    if args.only in (None, "app-page"):
        capture_app_pages(args.out)
    if args.only in (None, "kinds"):
        capture_kinds_getitems(args.out)
        capture_app_pages(args.out, KIND_PAGES)
    if args.out.resolve() == FIXTURES and args.only != "kinds":
        update_readme_date()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`scripts/catalogs.py`:

```py
"""Read Chrome messages.json catalogs: entries, placeholders and plural forms.

Shared by gen_i18n_keys.py and check_i18n.py, so both read catalogs the same way as the core
runtime (src/core/i18n/catalog.ts).
"""

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from repo import json_object, json_string, read_json

DEFAULT_LOCALE = "en"
PLURAL_CATEGORIES = ("zero", "one", "two", "few", "many", "other")
PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"\$([A-Za-z0-9_@]+)\$")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Entry:
    key: str
    message: str
    description: str | None
    placeholders: tuple[str, ...]


Catalog = dict[str, Entry]


def load(path: Path) -> Catalog:
    raw = json_object(read_json(path), str(path))
    catalog: Catalog = {}
    for key, value in raw.items():
        where = f"{path} {key}"
        entry = json_object(value, where)
        description = entry.get("description")
        declared = json_object(entry.get("placeholders", {}), f"{where}.placeholders")
        catalog[key] = Entry(
            key=key,
            message=json_string(entry.get("message"), f"{where}.message"),
            description=description if isinstance(description, str) else None,
            placeholders=tuple(sorted(name.lower() for name in declared)),
        )
    return catalog


def used_placeholders(message: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(sorted({name.lower() for name in PLACEHOLDER.findall(message)}))


def static_parts(message: str) -> list[str]:
    """The text between the `$name$` placeholders of a message, untrimmed."""
    return PLACEHOLDER.sub("\0", message).split("\0")


def plural_base(key: str) -> str | None:
    """The base key if `key` is a plural form such as `items_one`, else None."""
    base, _, category = key.rpartition("_")
    return base if base and category in PLURAL_CATEGORIES else None


def plural_bases(catalog: Catalog) -> set[str]:
    """Bases with an `_other` form; their `_<category>` keys are plural forms, not messages."""
    return {key.removesuffix("_other") for key in catalog if key.endswith("_other")}
