`scripts/changelog_gate.py`:

```py
"""Fail a pull request that changes src/ without adding a changie fragment.

A fragment is a new `.changes/unreleased/*.yaml` file (`mise run change-new`). The gate is skipped
when the pull request carries the `no-changelog-fragment` label, for changes users do not see.
Every added fragment must name a kind from .changie.yaml and have a body.

In CI the diff base, head and labels come from the pull_request event (GITHUB_EVENT_PATH).
Locally the diff runs from the merge base with origin/main to HEAD, with no labels.
"""

import os
import re
from pathlib import Path

from repo import ROOT, fail, git, git_paths, json_object, json_string, read_json

LABEL = "no-changelog-fragment"
FRAGMENTS = re.compile(r"^\.changes/unreleased/[^/]+\.yaml$")
KIND_LABEL = re.compile(r"^\s*-\s*label:\s*(\S.*?)\s*$", re.MULTILINE)
FIELD = re.compile(r"^(kind|body):[ \t]*(.*)$", re.MULTILINE)


def event_range() -> tuple[str, str, set[str]]:
    event_path = os.environ.get("GITHUB_EVENT_PATH", "")
    if not event_path:
        base = git("merge-base", "origin/main", "HEAD").strip()
        return base, "HEAD", set()
    event = json_object(read_json(Path(event_path)), "event")
    pull = json_object(event.get("pull_request"), "event pull_request")
    base = json_string(json_object(pull.get("base"), "base").get("sha"), "base sha")
    head = json_string(json_object(pull.get("head"), "head").get("sha"), "head sha")
    labels_value = pull.get("labels")
    labels = labels_value if isinstance(labels_value, list) else []
    names = {json_string(json_object(label, "label").get("name"), "label name") for label in labels}
    return base, head, names


def fragment_problems(path: str, head: str, kinds: set[str]) -> list[str]:
    fields = dict(FIELD.findall(git("show", f"{head}:{path}")))
    problems: list[str] = []
    if fields.get("kind", "").strip("'\"") not in kinds:
        problems.append(f"{path}: kind must be one of {', '.join(sorted(kinds))}")
    if not fields.get("body", "").strip("'\" "):
        problems.append(f"{path}: body is empty")
    return problems


def main() -> None:
    base, head, labels = event_range()
    changed = git_paths("diff", "--name-only", "-z", f"{base}...{head}")
    added = git_paths("diff", "--name-only", "-z", "--diff-filter=A", f"{base}...{head}")
    fragments = [path for path in added if FRAGMENTS.match(path)]
    kinds = set(KIND_LABEL.findall((ROOT / ".changie.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")))

    problems = [problem for path in fragments for problem in fragment_problems(path, head, kinds)]
    if problems:
        print("\n".join(problems))
        fail(f"{len(problems)} fragment problem(s)")
    touches_src = any(path.startswith("src/") for path in changed)
    if not touches_src:
        print("changelog gate: no change under src/")
    elif fragments:
        print(f"changelog gate: {len(fragments)} new fragment(s)")
    elif LABEL in labels:
        print(f"changelog gate: skipped by the {LABEL} label")
    else:
        fail(
            "this change touches src/ but adds no .changes/unreleased/*.yaml fragment; run "
            f"`mise run change-new`, or label the pull request {LABEL} if users see no change"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/check_branch.py`:

```py
"""Check the branch name: `<type>/<kebab-slug>`, `release/<version>` or `hotfix/<slug>`.

No `claude/` prefix and no generated id or hash at the end (`-562077`, `-4b0097`). In CI the
name comes from GITHUB_HEAD_REF (pull requests) or GITHUB_REF_NAME (pushes); `main` passes.
A detached HEAD outside CI is skipped.
"""

import os
import re

from repo import fail, git

TYPES = ("feat", "fix", "chore", "docs", "refactor", "test", "perf", "build", "ci", "style", "ops")
SLUG = r"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*"
PATTERN = re.compile(
    rf"^(?:main|(?:{'|'.join(TYPES)})/{SLUG}|release/[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)*|hotfix/{SLUG})$"
)
HASH_SUFFIX = re.compile(r"-(?=[0-9a-f]*[0-9])[0-9a-f]{6,}$")


def branch_name() -> str:
    if os.environ.get("GITHUB_ACTIONS") == "true":
        head = os.environ.get("GITHUB_HEAD_REF", "")
        return head or os.environ.get("GITHUB_REF_NAME", "")
    return git("branch", "--show-current").strip()


def main() -> None:
    name = branch_name()
    if not name:
        print("check_branch: detached HEAD, skipped")
        return
    if PATTERN.fullmatch(name) is None or HASH_SUFFIX.search(name) is not None:
        fail(
            f'branch "{name}" must be <type>/<kebab-slug> with a type from {", ".join(TYPES)}, '
            "release/<version> or hotfix/<slug>, without a generated id at the end"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/check_bundle.py`:

```py
"""Check the built bundles in dist/ (and artifacts/ when present) against the project rules.

- Manifests: permissions exactly ["storage"], no host permissions and no background (rule 3);
  content scripts match the store only; Gecko settings only in the Gecko build; every __MSG_*__
  resolves; every file the manifest names exists, and each icon is a PNG of the size its key
  declares.
- THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is in each extension build, extension zip and the source archive, and its
  valibot text equals node_modules/valibot/LICENSE.md once whitespace is normalized.
- Extension pages carry no copy (rule 9): only whitespace text, and `data-i18n` keys that resolve.
  Each page links an icon that exists, or its browser tab shows a puzzle piece.
- Userscript: header present, no @connect, exact @match, @updateURL and @downloadURL; every `GM`
  name in the bundle has an @grant and every @grant is used; valibot's license block is in the
  body; no userscript header in any other bundle.
- No eval( or new Function in any bundle (rule 2); no URL outside the two Valve hosts.
- Size budgets: content.js at most 183 KB, options.js at most 126 KB and the userscript at most
  236 KB, unminified (rule 13). Each is the measured size plus about 15% headroom; raise one only
  with a measurement. Every shipped catalog is inlined, so each added locale costs about 5 KB in
  each of them.
- The STEAM_API_KEY value, when set, appears nowhere in dist/ or artifacts/ (rule 16).
- The dev injection bundle is never packaged into artifacts/, and when artifacts/ exists it holds
  exactly the five release artifacts, with a manifest at the root of each extension zip. The source
  archive holds no dist/, artifacts/ or node_modules/, and from docs/ only the design tokens.
"""

import os
import re
import zipfile
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path

from repo import (
    ARTIFACTS,
    DIST,
    EXTENSION_TARGETS,
    SLUG,
    VALIBOT_LICENSE,
    fail,
    json_object,
    json_string,
    package_version,
    png_size,
    read_json,
    valibot_notice,
)

KIB = 1024
BUDGETS = {
    **{DIST / target / "content.js": 183 * KIB for target in EXTENSION_TARGETS},
    **{DIST / target / "options.js": 126 * KIB for target in EXTENSION_TARGETS},
    DIST / "userscript" / f"{SLUG}.user.js": 236 * KIB,
}
STORE_MATCH = ["https://store.steampowered.com/*"]
RELEASE_BASE = "https://github.com/jrv97/steam-ai-reporter/releases/latest/download"
ALLOWED_HOSTS = {"api.steampowered.com", "store.steampowered.com"}
HEADER_START = "// ==UserScript=="
HEADER_END = "// ==/UserScript=="
REMOTE_CODE = re.compile(r"\beval\s*\(|\bnew\s+Function\b")
URL = re.compile(r"https?://([A-Za-z0-9.-]+)")
GM_NAME = re.compile(r"\bGM(?:\.[A-Za-z_]\w*|_[A-Za-z]\w*)")
HEADER_FIELD = re.compile(r"^//\s+(@[\w:-]+)[ \t]*(.*?)\s*$", re.MULTILINE)
MSG = re.compile(r"__MSG_([A-Za-z0-9_@]+)__")
# The only file of docs/ that the source archive keeps: scripts/gen_styles.py reads it to build.
SOURCE_DOCS = {"docs/design/tokens.css"}
NOTICES = "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md"


def paths(value: object, where: str) -> list[str]:
    """The file paths in a manifest value: a path, a list of paths or an object of them."""
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [json_string(item, where) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return [json_string(item, where) for item in value.values()]
    return [json_string(value, where).split("?", 1)[0]]


def manifest_files(manifest: dict[str, object], where: str) -> list[str]:
    """Every packaged file the manifest names: icons, scripts, styles and pages."""
    files = paths(manifest.get("icons"), where)
    scripts = manifest.get("content_scripts")
    for script in scripts if isinstance(scripts, list) else []:
        entry = json_object(script, where)
        files += paths(entry.get("js"), where) + paths(entry.get("css"), where)
    action = json_object(manifest.get("action", {}), where)
    files += paths(action.get("default_icon"), where) + paths(action.get("default_popup"), where)
    files += paths(json_object(manifest.get("options_ui", {}), where).get("page"), where)
    return files


class PageText(HTMLParser):
    """Collects the text, the `data-i18n` keys and the icon links of an extension page."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.text: list[str] = []
        self.keys: list[str] = []
        self.icons: list[str] = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:
        self.keys += [value for name, value in attrs if name == "data-i18n" and value is not None]
        if tag == "link" and ("rel", "icon") in attrs:
            self.icons += [value for name, value in attrs if name == "href" and value is not None]

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        if data.strip():
            self.text.append(data.strip())


def page_problems(path: Path, catalog: dict[str, object]) -> list[str]:
    where = path.relative_to(DIST.parent).as_posix()
    parser = PageText()
    parser.feed(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    problems = [f"{where}: copy belongs in the catalog, found {text!r}" for text in parser.text]
    problems += [
        f"{where}: data-i18n key {key} has no message" for key in parser.keys if key not in catalog
    ]
    if not parser.icons:
        problems.append(f'{where}: no <link rel="icon">')
    problems += [
        f"{where}: icon {href} is missing"
        for href in parser.icons
        if not (path.parent / href).is_file()
    ]
    return problems


def packaged_problems(
    target: str, manifest: dict[str, object], catalog: dict[str, object]
) -> list[str]:
    """The files the manifest names exist, and its pages carry no copy."""
    root = DIST / target
    problems: list[str] = []
    for name in sorted(set(manifest_files(manifest, f"dist/{target}/manifest.json"))):
        if not (root / name).is_file():
            problems.append(f"dist/{target}/manifest.json: names {name}, which is missing")
        elif name.endswith(".html"):
            problems += page_problems(root / name, catalog)
    return problems


def icon_problems(target: str, manifest: dict[str, object]) -> list[str]:
    """Each icon the manifest declares by size is a PNG of exactly that size."""
    where = f"dist/{target}/manifest.json"
    action = json_object(manifest.get("action", {}), where)
    declared = [manifest.get("icons", {}), action.get("default_icon", {})]
    problems: list[str] = []
    for icons in declared:
        for size, name in json_object(icons, where).items():
            path = DIST / target / json_string(name, where)
            if not size.isdigit() or not path.is_file():
                continue
            found = png_size(path)
            if found != (int(size), int(size)):
                problems.append(f"{where}: {name} is {found or 'no PNG'}, declared {size}x{size}")
    return list(dict.fromkeys(problems))


def normalized(text: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(text.split())


def notices_text_problems(where: str, text: str) -> list[str]:
    if normalized(VALIBOT_LICENSE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) in normalized(text):
        return []
    return [f"{where}: the valibot text differs from node_modules/valibot/LICENSE.md"]


def notices_problems(where: str, path: Path) -> list[str]:
    if not path.is_file():
        return [f"{where}: missing"]
    return notices_text_problems(where, path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def manifest_problems(target: str) -> list[str]:
    root = DIST / target
    where = f"dist/{target}/manifest.json"
    manifest = json_object(read_json(root / "manifest.json"), where)
    problems: list[str] = []
    if manifest.get("permissions") != ["storage"]:
        problems.append(f'{where}: permissions must be exactly ["storage"]')
    for key in ("host_permissions", "optional_host_permissions", "optional_permissions"):
        if key in manifest:
            problems.append(f"{where}: {key} is not allowed")
    if "background" in manifest:
        problems.append(f"{where}: background is not allowed")
    scripts = manifest.get("content_scripts")
    if not isinstance(scripts, list) or not scripts:
        problems.append(f"{where}: content_scripts is missing")
    else:
        for script in scripts:
            if json_object(script, where).get("matches") != STORE_MATCH:
                problems.append(f"{where}: content script matches must be {STORE_MATCH}")
    has_gecko = "browser_specific_settings" in manifest
    if has_gecko != (target == "gecko"):
        problems.append(f"{where}: browser_specific_settings belongs in the Gecko build only")
    locale = json_string(manifest.get("default_locale"), f"{where} default_locale")
    catalog = json_object(read_json(root / "_locales" / locale / "messages.json"), locale)
    for key in MSG.findall((root / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
        if key not in catalog:
            problems.append(f"{where}: __MSG_{key}__ has no message in _locales/{locale}")
    return (
        problems
        + packaged_problems(target, manifest, catalog)
        + icon_problems(target, manifest)
        + notices_problems(f"dist/{target}/{NOTICES}", root / NOTICES)
    )


def split_header(text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if not text.startswith(HEADER_START) or HEADER_END not in text:
        return "", text
    end = text.index(HEADER_END) + len(HEADER_END)
    return text[:end], text[end:]


def header_fields(header: str) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    fields: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for key, value in HEADER_FIELD.findall(header):
        fields.setdefault(key, []).append(value)
    return fields


def header_problems(where: str, header: str) -> list[str]:
    fields = header_fields(header)
    problems: list[str] = []
    expected = {
        "@match": STORE_MATCH,
        "@updateURL": [f"{RELEASE_BASE}/{SLUG}.meta.js"],
        "@downloadURL": [f"{RELEASE_BASE}/{SLUG}.user.js"],
    }
    for key, values in expected.items():
        if fields.get(key) != values:
            problems.append(f"{where}: {key} must be {values}")
    if "@noframes" not in fields:
        problems.append(f"{where}: @noframes is missing")
    return problems


def grant_problems(where: str, header: str, body: str) -> list[str]:
    granted = set(header_fields(header).get("@grant", []))
    used = set(GM_NAME.findall(body))
    return [f"{where}: {name} is used without an @grant" for name in sorted(used - granted)] + [
        f"{where}: @grant {name} is never used" for name in sorted(granted - used)
    ]


def notice_problems(where: str, body: str) -> list[str]:
    if valibot_notice() in body:
        return []
    return [f"{where}: valibot's license text is missing from the userscript"]


def script_problems(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    where = path.relative_to(DIST.parent).as_posix()
    problems: list[str] = []
    header, body = split_header(text)
    if path.name.endswith((".user.js", ".meta.js")):
        if not header:
            problems.append(f"{where}: the userscript header is missing")
        if "@connect" in header:
            problems.append(f"{where}: @connect is not allowed")
        if header:
            problems += header_problems(where, header)
            if path.name.endswith(".user.js"):
                problems += grant_problems(where, header, body)
                problems += notice_problems(where, body)
    elif HEADER_START in text:
        problems.append(f"{where}: a userscript header belongs in the userscript only")
    if path.name.endswith(".meta.js"):
        return problems
    if REMOTE_CODE.search(body):
        problems.append(f"{where}: eval( or new Function found")
    for host in sorted(set(URL.findall(body)) - ALLOWED_HOSTS):
        problems.append(f"{where}: URL to a host outside the allowlist: {host}")
    return problems


def secret_problems(roots: list[Path]) -> list[str]:
    secret = os.environ.get("STEAM_API_KEY", "")
    if len(secret) < 8:
        return []
    needle = secret.encode()
    return [
        f"{path}: contains the STEAM_API_KEY value"
        for root in roots
        for path in sorted(root.rglob("*"))
        if path.is_file() and needle in path.read_bytes()
    ]


def zip_member(path: Path, name: str, folder: bool) -> str | None:
    """A member's text: at the zip root, or under the single folder of the source archive."""
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        for entry in archive.namelist():
            if (entry.split("/", 1)[1] if folder and "/" in entry else entry) == name:
                return archive.read(entry).decode("utf-8")
    return None


def zip_notices_problems(where: str, path: Path, folder: bool) -> list[str]:
    text = zip_member(path, NOTICES, folder)
    if text is None:
        return [f"{where}: {NOTICES} is missing"]
    return notices_text_problems(f"{where}: {NOTICES}", text)


def zip_names(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
        return archive.namelist()


def artifact_problems() -> list[str]:
    """The artifacts/ folder holds exactly the five release files, and no dev bundle."""
    version = package_version()
    extensions = [f"{SLUG}-{target}-{version}.zip" for target in EXTENSION_TARGETS]
    source = f"{SLUG}-source-{version}.zip"
    expected = {*extensions, source, f"{SLUG}.user.js", f"{SLUG}.meta.js"}
    present = {path.name for path in ARTIFACTS.iterdir()}
    problems = [f"artifacts/{name}: missing" for name in sorted(expected - present)]
    problems += [f"artifacts/{name}: unexpected" for name in sorted(present - expected)]
    for name in extensions:
        if name not in present:
            continue
        names = zip_names(ARTIFACTS / name)
        if "manifest.json" not in names:
            problems.append(f"artifacts/{name}: manifest.json is not at the zip root")
        problems += zip_notices_problems(f"artifacts/{name}", ARTIFACTS / name, folder=False)
        problems += [
            f"artifacts/{name}: {entry} is a dev bundle file"
            for entry in names
            if entry.startswith("dev/") or entry.endswith("inject.js")
        ]
    if source in present:
        problems += zip_notices_problems(f"artifacts/{source}", ARTIFACTS / source, folder=True)
        names = [entry.split("/", 1)[1] for entry in zip_names(ARTIFACTS / source) if "/" in entry]
        roots = {name.split("/", 1)[0] for name in names if name}
        problems += [
            f"artifacts/{source}: contains {root}/"
            for root in ("dist", "artifacts", "node_modules")
            if root in roots
        ]
        docs = {name for name in names if name.startswith("docs/") and not name.endswith("/")}
        if docs != SOURCE_DOCS:
            problems.append(f"artifacts/{source}: docs/ must hold only {sorted(SOURCE_DOCS)}")
    return problems


def main() -> None:
    if not DIST.is_dir():
        fail("dist/ is missing; run `mise run build` first")
    problems: list[str] = []
    for target in EXTENSION_TARGETS:
        problems += manifest_problems(target)
    for path in sorted(DIST.rglob("*.js")):
        problems += script_problems(path)
    for path, budget in BUDGETS.items():
        if not path.is_file():
            problems.append(f"{path}: missing")
        elif path.stat().st_size > budget:
            problems.append(f"{path}: {path.stat().st_size} bytes, budget {budget}")
    roots = [DIST] + ([ARTIFACTS] if ARTIFACTS.is_dir() else [])
    problems += secret_problems(roots)
    if ARTIFACTS.is_dir():
        problems += artifact_problems()
    if problems:
        print("\n".join(problems))
        fail(f"{len(problems)} bundle problem(s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/check_i18n.py`:

```py
"""Check the message catalogs (AGENTS.md rules 4 and 9).

Shipped catalogs (src/locales/<locale>/messages.json):
- keys are snake_case and start with a known prefix (`kind_` names a tag kind's words);
- every message has a description;
- the `$name$` tokens of a message match its declared placeholders, each `$1`-style content;
- every locale has the same keys and placeholders as English (other locales may add plural
  categories such as `_few` for a base that is plural in English);
- every English key is used: as a string in src/**/*.ts, as `__MSG_<key>__` in a manifest, or in
  scripts/build.py (the userscript header).

src/locales/<locale>/userscript.json holds the userscript name, which only scripts/build.py reads:
it gets the same entry checks and the same parity with English.

Every catalog, shipped or test-only (tests/locales/), must be valid and must not say "uses AI",
"AI-free" or "no AI": the product reports disclosures, it does not judge games.

No string literal under src/ or tests/ may repeat catalog text (rule 9): code and tests read copy
from the catalog. The detection constants (DETECTION_CONSTANTS) are the one exception. A literal is
catalog text when, trimmed, it either
- equals a whole message of any shipped locale, each `$name$` standing for any text; or
- shares MIN_SHARED or more characters with the text between a message's placeholders: it
  contains that text, or is a piece of it.
Shorter shared text is a word that also occurs inside identifiers and header names ("Settings" in
`parseSettings`), so only a whole-message match catches the short messages. A literal that is one of
DETECTION_CONSTANTS, Steam's own page text that a detector matches (rule 9), skips the shared-text
match, so a message may quote it. A message that equals it still matches. tests/locales/ and
tests/fixtures/ hold their own catalogs and captured Steam pages, so they are not scanned.

The literal-flow rules (no hardcoded copy in code sinks) live in lint/restricted-syntax.mjs.

Usage: check_i18n.py
"""

import re
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from catalogs import (
    DEFAULT_LOCALE,
    Catalog,
    load,
    plural_base,
    plural_bases,
    static_parts,
    used_placeholders,
)
from repo import ROOT, fail
from ts_literals import string_literals

SHIPPED = ROOT / "src" / "locales"
TEST_CATALOGS = ROOT / "tests" / "locales"
PREFIXES = (
    "badge_",
    "banner_",
    "kind_",
    "options_",
    "error_",
    "warn_",
    "notice_",
    "ext_",
    "userscript_",
)
KEY = re.compile(r"^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:_[a-z0-9]+)*$")
CONTENT = re.compile(r"^\$[1-9]$")
FORBIDDEN = re.compile(r"\buses AI\b|\bAI-free\b|\bno AI\b", re.IGNORECASE)

# Steam's own words that detection matches on the store page. A catalog message may repeat one, as
# the AI heading does, without making the detection literal a copy of the message.
DETECTION_CONSTANTS = frozenset({"AI Generated Content Disclosure"})

MIN_SHARED = 12
DETECTION_CONSTANTS = frozenset({"AI Generated Content Disclosure"})
MIN_WILDCARD_TEXT = 4
SOURCE_ROOTS = ("src", "tests")
SOURCE_SUFFIXES = {".ts", ".mts", ".js", ".mjs"}
UNSCANNED = ("tests/locales/", "tests/fixtures/")
GENERATED = ".gen.ts"
EXPRESSION = "\0"


@dataclass(frozen=True, order=True)
class Ref:
    """A catalog message: its locale and key."""

    locale: str
    key: str

    def label(self) -> str:
        return self.key if self.locale == DEFAULT_LOCALE else f"{self.key} ({self.locale})"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CopyIndex:
    """Every message of the shipped catalogs, ready to match against a literal."""

    whole: Mapping[str, tuple[Ref, ...]]
    patterns: tuple[tuple[re.Pattern[str], Ref], ...]
    shared: tuple[tuple[str, Ref], ...]

    def matches(self, parts: Sequence[str]) -> list[Ref]:
        """The messages a literal repeats: a string is one part, a template has one per chunk."""
        found: set[Ref] = set()
        for part in parts:
            text = part.strip()
            found.update(self.whole.get(text, ()))
            if len(text) >= MIN_SHARED and text not in DETECTION_CONSTANTS:
                found.update(ref for shared, ref in self.shared if shared in text or text in shared)
        whole = EXPRESSION.join(parts).strip()
        found.update(ref for pattern, ref in self.patterns if pattern.fullmatch(whole))
        return sorted(found)


def copy_index(catalogs: Mapping[str, Catalog]) -> CopyIndex:
    whole: dict[str, list[Ref]] = {}
    patterns: list[tuple[re.Pattern[str], Ref]] = []
    shared: list[tuple[str, Ref]] = []
    for locale, catalog in catalogs.items():
        for key, entry in catalog.items():
            ref = Ref(locale, key)
            message = entry.message.strip()
            parts = static_parts(message)
            if len(parts) == 1:
                whole.setdefault(message, []).append(ref)
            elif len("".join(parts).strip()) >= MIN_WILDCARD_TEXT:
                wildcard = ".+".join(re.escape(part) for part in parts)
                patterns.append((re.compile(wildcard, re.DOTALL), ref))
            shared += [(part.strip(), ref) for part in parts if len(part.strip()) >= MIN_SHARED]
    return CopyIndex(
        {text: tuple(refs) for text, refs in whole.items()}, tuple(patterns), tuple(shared)
    )


def entry_problems(path: Path, catalog: Catalog) -> list[str]:
    problems: list[str] = []
    for key, entry in catalog.items():
        where = f"{path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}: {key}"
        if not entry.description:
            problems.append(f"{where}: missing description")
        if used_placeholders(entry.message) != entry.placeholders:
            problems.append(f"{where}: $name$ tokens do not match the declared placeholders")
        if FORBIDDEN.search(entry.message):
            problems.append(f"{where}: forbidden wording (rule 4)")
    raw = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for content in re.findall(r'"content"\s*:\s*"([^"]*)"', raw):
        if not CONTENT.match(content):
            problems.append(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}: placeholder content {content!r}")
    return problems


def parity_problems(locale: str, catalog: Catalog, english: Catalog) -> list[str]:
    bases = plural_bases(english)
    problems: list[str] = []
    for key in sorted(english.keys() - catalog.keys()):
        problems.append(f"{locale}: missing {key}")
    for key in sorted(catalog.keys() - english.keys()):
        if plural_base(key) not in bases:
            problems.append(f"{locale}: {key} is not in the English catalog")
    for key in sorted(english.keys() & catalog.keys()):
        if english[key].placeholders != catalog[key].placeholders:
            problems.append(f"{locale}: {key} placeholders differ from English")
    return problems


def corpus() -> str:
    sources = [
        path
        for path in sorted((ROOT / "src").rglob("*.ts"))
        if not path.name.endswith((".test.ts", ".gen.ts"))
    ]
    sources += sorted((ROOT / "src" / "platform").rglob("manifest.*.json"))
    sources.append(ROOT / "scripts" / "build.py")
    return "\n".join(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for path in sources)


def unused_problems(english: Catalog) -> list[str]:
    text = corpus()
    bases = plural_bases(english)
    names: set[str] = set()
    for key in english:
        base = plural_base(key)
        names.add(base if base is not None and base in bases else key)
    return [
        f"{DEFAULT_LOCALE}: {name} is not used in src/ or scripts/build.py"
        for name in sorted(names)
        if f'"{name}"' not in text and f"__MSG_{name}__" not in text
    ]


def scanned_sources(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    """The source files whose string literals must not repeat catalog text."""
    paths: list[Path] = []
    for base in SOURCE_ROOTS:
        for path in sorted((root / base).rglob("*")):
            relative = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
            if (
                path.suffix in SOURCE_SUFFIXES
                and not path.name.endswith(GENERATED)
                and not relative.startswith(UNSCANNED)
            ):
                paths.append(path)
    return paths


def copy_problems(root: Path, catalogs: Mapping[str, Catalog]) -> list[str]:
    index = copy_index(catalogs)
    problems: list[str] = []
    for path in scanned_sources(root):
        where = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        for literal in string_literals(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
            if len(literal.parts) == 1 and literal.parts[0].strip() in DETECTION_CONSTANTS:
                continue
            refs = index.matches(literal.parts)
            if refs:
                keys = ", ".join(dict.fromkeys(ref.label() for ref in refs))
                problems.append(f"{where}:{literal.line}: {keys}: catalog text in a string literal")
    return problems


def main() -> None:
    problems: list[str] = []
    english = load(SHIPPED / DEFAULT_LOCALE / "messages.json")
    shipped: dict[str, Catalog] = {}
    for path in sorted(SHIPPED.glob("*/messages.json")):
        catalog = load(path)
        shipped[path.parent.name] = catalog
        problems += entry_problems(path, catalog)
        problems += [f"{path}: {key}: not snake_case" for key in catalog if not KEY.match(key)]
        problems += [
            f"{path}: {key}: needs a prefix from {', '.join(PREFIXES)}"
            for key in catalog
            if not key.startswith(PREFIXES)
        ]
        if path.parent.name != DEFAULT_LOCALE:
            problems += parity_problems(path.parent.name, catalog, english)
    names = {path.parent.name: load(path) for path in sorted(SHIPPED.glob("*/userscript.json"))}
    for locale, catalog in names.items():
        problems += entry_problems(SHIPPED / locale / "userscript.json", catalog)
        if locale != DEFAULT_LOCALE:
            problems += parity_problems(locale, catalog, names.get(DEFAULT_LOCALE, {}))
    for path in sorted(TEST_CATALOGS.glob("*/messages.json")):
        problems += entry_problems(path, load(path))
    problems += unused_problems(english)
    problems += copy_problems(ROOT, shipped)
    if problems:
        print("\n".join(problems))
        fail(f"{len(problems)} catalog problem(s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/check_text.py`:

```py
"""Check repo text hygiene (AGENTS.md rules 8 and 15).

- Every text file is ASCII, except non-English message catalogs.
- No "--" used as a dash in Markdown or MDX prose (code spans and fences are skipped).
- Lines are at most 100 columns in files whose formatter cannot wrap them all (shell has no
  width option; long strings and comments survive the others). Markdown, MDX, message catalogs
  and generated files are exempt.

Usage: check_text.py [--staged] [paths...]
"""

import argparse
import re
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

from repo import ROOT, fail, repo_files, staged_files

MAX_WIDTH = 100
SKIPPED = ("tests/fixtures/", "node_modules/", "dist/", "artifacts/", ".mise/")
SKIPPED_FILES = {"pnpm-lock.yaml", "mise.lock", "LICENSE", "CHANGELOG.md"}
BINARY_SUFFIXES = {".png", ".ico", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".webp", ".zip", ".woff", ".woff2"}
PROSE_SUFFIXES = {".md", ".mdx"}
WIDTH_SUFFIXES = {
    ".ts",
    ".mjs",
    ".js",
    ".py",
    ".sh",
    ".toml",
    ".yaml",
    ".yml",
    ".css",
    ".html",
    ".json",
}
CATALOG = re.compile(r"(^|/)locales/(?P<lang>[^/]+)/(messages|userscript)\.json$")
DASH = re.compile(r"(?:^|\s)--(?:\s|$)")
INLINE_CODE = re.compile(r"`[^`]*`")


def skipped(path: str) -> bool:
    return (
        path.startswith(SKIPPED)
        or path in SKIPPED_FILES
        or path.startswith(".changes/")
        or PurePosixPath(path).suffix.lower() in BINARY_SUFFIXES
    )


def non_english_catalog(path: str) -> bool:
    match = CATALOG.search(path)
    return match is not None and match.group("lang") != "en"


def prose_dashes(lines: list[str]) -> list[int]:
    found: list[int] = []
    fenced = False
    for number, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        if line.lstrip().startswith(("```", "~~~")):
            fenced = not fenced
            continue
        if not fenced and DASH.search(INLINE_CODE.sub("", line)):
            found.append(number)
    return found


def check(path: str) -> list[str]:
    file = ROOT / path
    raw = file.read_bytes()
    if b"\0" in raw:
        return []
    problems: list[str] = []
    suffix = PurePosixPath(path).suffix.lower()
    if not non_english_catalog(path):
        for number, raw_line in enumerate(raw.split(b"\n"), start=1):
            column = next((i for i, byte in enumerate(raw_line) if byte > 0x7F), None)
            if column is not None:
                problems.append(f"{path}:{number}:{column + 1}: non-ASCII byte")
    lines = raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace").split("\n")
    if suffix in PROSE_SUFFIXES:
        problems += [f"{path}:{n}: '--' used as a dash" for n in prose_dashes(lines)]
    if suffix in WIDTH_SUFFIXES and CATALOG.search(path) is None:
        for number, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
            if len(line) > MAX_WIDTH:
                problems.append(f"{path}:{number}: {len(line)} columns (limit {MAX_WIDTH})")
    return problems


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--staged", action="store_true", help="check the staged files only")
    parser.add_argument("paths", nargs="*", help="files to check (default: the whole repo)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    paths: list[str]
    if args.paths:
        paths = [Path(p).resolve().relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for p in args.paths]
    elif args.staged:
        paths = staged_files()
    else:
        paths = repo_files()
    problems = [
        problem
        for path in sorted(paths)
        if not skipped(path) and (ROOT / path).is_file()
        for problem in check(path)
    ]
    if problems:
        print("\n".join(problems))
        fail(f"{len(problems)} text problem(s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

"""Check that the pnpm pinned in mise.toml is the one package.json declares in packageManager.

pnpm-workspace.yaml sets `pmOnFail: error`, so a drift already fails `pnpm install`; this check
names the two pins and fails earlier, in `check`.

`scripts/cws.py`:

```py
"""Chrome Web Store API v2: upload a package to an existing item and submit it for review.

The access token comes from Workload Identity Federation (ADR 0007), so no key is stored.
"""

import json
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from collections.abc import Callable
from pathlib import Path

from repo import fail, json_object

API = "https://chromewebstore.googleapis.com"
POLL_SECONDS = 5.0
POLL_ATTEMPTS = 60
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120

type Call = Callable[[str, str, bytes], dict[str, object]]


def http_call(token: str) -> Call:
    """A Call that sends authorized requests to the store API and returns the JSON body."""

    def call(method: str, path: str, body: bytes) -> dict[str, object]:
        request = urllib.request.Request(  # noqa: S310
            f"{API}{path}",
            data=body,
            method=method,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/zip"},
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as response:  # noqa: S310
                return json_object(json.loads(response.read() or b"{}"), path)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            detail = error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            fail(f"{method} {path}: HTTP {error.code}\n{detail}")

    return call


def wait_for_upload(
    call: Call, item: str, state: object, sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep
) -> None:
    """Return once the last upload has succeeded; fail on FAILED or after the poll budget."""
    for _ in range(POLL_ATTEMPTS):
        if state == "SUCCEEDED":
            return
        if state != "IN_PROGRESS":
            fail(f"Chrome Web Store upload ended in state {state}")
        sleep(POLL_SECONDS)
        state = call("GET", f"/v2/{item}:fetchStatus", b"").get("lastAsyncUploadState")
    fail(f"Chrome Web Store upload still in progress after {POLL_ATTEMPTS} checks")


def publish(
    call: Call,
    publisher: str,
    extension: str,
    archive: Path,
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep,
) -> str:
    """Upload `archive`, wait for processing, submit it for review and return the item state."""
    item = f"publishers/{publisher}/items/{extension}"
    upload = call("POST", f"/upload/v2/{item}:upload", archive.read_bytes())
    wait_for_upload(call, item, upload.get("uploadState"), sleep)
    submitted = call("POST", f"/v2/{item}:publish", b"")
    warnings = json_object(submitted.get("warningInfo") or {}, "warningInfo").get("warnings")
    for warning in warnings if isinstance(warnings, list) else []:
        print(f"warning: {warning}")
    return str(submitted.get("state", "unknown"))

```

`scripts/gen_catalogs.py`:

```py
"""Generate the catalogs core ships, with only what the runtime reads.

Writes src/core/i18n/shipped.gen.ts: `SHIPPED_CATALOGS`, every catalog under src/locales/ by
locale code, each entry reduced to its `message`. Descriptions and placeholder examples are for
translators and stay out of the bundles; the runtime substitutes `$name$` by name, so it needs no
placeholder table either. The output is gitignored and regenerated by the tasks that need it.

Usage: gen_catalogs.py
"""

import json

from catalogs import DEFAULT_LOCALE, load
from repo import ROOT, fail

LOCALES = ROOT / "src" / "locales"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "src" / "core" / "i18n" / "shipped.gen.ts"


def render() -> str:
    sources = sorted(LOCALES.glob("*/messages.json"))
    if not any(source.parent.name == DEFAULT_LOCALE for source in sources):
        fail(f"missing the {DEFAULT_LOCALE} catalog in {LOCALES}")
    lines = [
        "// Generated by scripts/gen_catalogs.py from src/locales/*/messages.json. Do not edit.",
        "",
        'import type { Catalogs } from "./catalog";',
        "",
        "/** The shipped catalogs by locale code, messages only. */",
        "export const SHIPPED_CATALOGS: Catalogs = {",
    ]
    for source in sources:
        lines.append(f"  {json.dumps(source.parent.name)}: {{")
        for entry in load(source).values():
            message = json.dumps(entry.message, ensure_ascii=False)
            lines.append(f"    {json.dumps(entry.key)}: {{ message: {message} }},")
        lines.append("  },")
    lines += ["};", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main() -> None:
    text = render()
    if not OUTPUT.is_file() or OUTPUT.read_text(encoding="utf-8") != text:
        OUTPUT.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`scripts/gen_i18n_keys.py`:

```py
"""Generate typed message keys from the English catalogs.

For each catalog this writes a TypeScript module with:
- `MessageParams`: every message key, mapped to the named placeholders it takes;
- `PluralParams`: every plural base key (one with an `_other` form), mapped to its placeholders
  other than `count`, which `plural()` fills in;
- `MessageKey` and `PluralKey`, the key unions.

So `t("missing_key")` or a wrong placeholder fails the type check. The outputs are gitignored and
regenerated by the tasks that need them.

Usage: gen_i18n_keys.py
"""

from pathlib import Path

from catalogs import DEFAULT_LOCALE, Catalog, load, plural_base, plural_bases
from repo import ROOT, fail

TARGETS = (
    (ROOT / "src" / "locales", ROOT / "src" / "core" / "i18n" / "keys.gen.ts"),
    (ROOT / "tests" / "locales", ROOT / "tests" / "locales" / "keys.gen.ts"),
)
COUNT = "count"


def params_type(names: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
    if not names:
        return "NoParams"
    fields = "; ".join(f"readonly {name}: string" for name in names)
    return f"{{ {fields} }}"


def interface(name: str, members: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]]) -> list[str]:
    if not members:
        return [f"export type {name} = NoParams;"]
    lines = [f"export interface {name} {{"]
    lines += [f"  readonly {key}: {params_type(names)};" for key, names in sorted(members.items())]
    lines.append("}")
    return lines


def render(catalog: Catalog, source: Path) -> str:
    bases = plural_bases(catalog)
    messages: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {}
    plurals: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {}
    for key, entry in catalog.items():
        base = plural_base(key)
        if base is not None and base in bases:
            if key == f"{base}_other":
                plurals[base] = tuple(name for name in entry.placeholders if name != COUNT)
        else:
            messages[key] = entry.placeholders
    for base in bases:
        if f"{base}_one" not in catalog:
            fail(f"{source}: plural {base} needs both _one and _other")
    relative = source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    lines = [
        f"// Generated by scripts/gen_i18n_keys.py from {relative}. Do not edit.",
        "",
        "type NoParams = Readonly<Record<string, never>>;",
        "",
        *interface("MessageParams", messages),
        "",
        *interface("PluralParams", plurals),
        "",
        "export type MessageKey = keyof MessageParams;",
        "export type PluralKey = keyof PluralParams;",
        "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main() -> None:
    for locales, output in TARGETS:
        source = locales / DEFAULT_LOCALE / "messages.json"
        text = render(load(source), source)
        if not output.is_file() or output.read_text(encoding="utf-8") != text:
            output.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/gen_styles.py`:

```py
"""Generate the UI stylesheets as TypeScript string constants.

Core injects its CSS at runtime (a document stylesheet for badges and the list filter, a shadow
root for the banner), so every target needs the CSS as text. This writes
src/core/ui/styles.gen.ts with one constant per source file:

- `TOKENS_CSS` from docs/design/tokens.css, the design system's only source of values;
- `PAGE_CSS`, `BANNER_CSS`, `SETTINGS_CSS` and `DIALOG_CSS` from the component rules in
  src/core/ui/.

`@import "<relative path>";` lines are inlined, comments and blank lines are dropped, and the
rest is kept line for line, so the bundles stay readable (rule 2). No value is copied by hand:
a token changes in tokens.css and nowhere else. The output is gitignored and regenerated by the
tasks that need it.

Usage: gen_styles.py
"""

import re
from pathlib import Path

from repo import ROOT, fail

UI = ROOT / "src" / "core" / "ui"
SOURCES = (
    ("TOKENS_CSS", ROOT / "docs" / "design" / "tokens.css"),
    ("PAGE_CSS", UI / "styles.css"),
    ("BANNER_CSS", UI / "banner.css"),
    ("SETTINGS_CSS", UI / "settings.css"),
    ("DIALOG_CSS", UI / "dialog.css"),
)
OUTPUT = UI / "styles.gen.ts"
IMPORT = re.compile(r'^@import\s+"([^"]+)";\s*$')
COMMENT = re.compile(r"/\*.*?\*/", re.DOTALL)


def inline(path: Path, seen: tuple[Path, ...] = ()) -> str:
    if path in seen:
        fail(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}: @import cycle")
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}: not found")
    lines: list[str] = []
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        match = IMPORT.match(line)
        if match is None:
            lines.append(line)
        else:
            lines.append(inline((path.parent / match.group(1)).resolve(), (*seen, path)))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def compact(css: str) -> str:
    without_comments = COMMENT.sub("", css)
    if "/*" in without_comments or "*/" in without_comments:
        fail("unbalanced CSS comment")
    lines = [line.rstrip() for line in without_comments.splitlines()]
    return "\n".join(line for line in lines if line.strip()) + "\n"


def stylesheet(name: str) -> str:
    """The CSS text of one constant, exactly as styles.gen.ts holds it."""
    source = dict(SOURCES).get(name)
    if source is None:
        fail(f"unknown stylesheet {name}")
    return compact(inline(source.resolve()))


def template_literal(text: str) -> str:
    escaped = text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("`", "\\`").replace("${", "\\${")
    return f"`{escaped}`"


def render() -> str:
    lines = [
        "// Generated by scripts/gen_styles.py from docs/design/tokens.css and src/core/ui/*.css.",
        "// Do not edit.",
        "",
    ]
    for name, source in SOURCES:
        relative = source.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        lines += [
            f"/** {relative}, without comments. */",
            f"export const {name} = {template_literal(stylesheet(name))};",
            "",
        ]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main() -> None:
    text = render()
    if not OUTPUT.is_file() or OUTPUT.read_text(encoding="utf-8") != text:
        OUTPUT.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/notes.py`:

```py
"""Fit release notes into a store's length limit."""

AMO_LIMIT = 3000
ELLIPSIS = "..."


def fit(notes: str, limit: int, footer: str) -> str:
    """Return `notes` unchanged if it fits, else whole lines that fit with `footer` after them.

    A single line longer than the room left is cut and ends with an ellipsis.
    """
    if len(notes) <= limit:
        return notes
    room = limit - len(footer) - 2
    kept: list[str] = []
    used = 0
    for line in notes.splitlines():
        gap = 1 if kept else 0
        cost = len(line) + gap
        if used + cost > room:
            if all(item.startswith("#") for item in kept):
                cut = max(room - used - gap - len(ELLIPSIS), 0)
                kept.append(line[:cut].rstrip() + ELLIPSIS)
            break
        kept.append(line)
        used += cost
    while kept and kept[-1].startswith("#"):
        kept.pop()
    return "\n".join(kept) + "\n\n" + footer

```

`scripts/package.sh`:

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Write the release artifacts to artifacts/ from the current dist/ (run `mise run build` first).
#   steam-ai-reporter-chromium-<version>.zip   dist/chromium
#   steam-ai-reporter-gecko-<version>.zip      dist/gecko
#   steam-ai-reporter.user.js / .meta.js       dist/userscript (fixed names, stable URLs)
#   steam-ai-reporter-source-<version>.zip     git archive of HEAD (AMO): lockfile in, docs/ out
#                                              except the design tokens the build reads
# dist/dev (the dev injection bundle) is never packaged.
set -euo pipefail

if [[ -n "${WSL_DISTRO_NAME:-}" ]]; then
  echo "error: WSL bash; on Windows put Git Bash first on PATH (mise.local.toml.example)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
slug="steam-ai-reporter"
version="$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("package.json"))["version"])')"

for path in dist/chromium dist/gecko dist/userscript; do
  [[ -d "$path" ]] || {
    echo "error: $path is missing; run \`mise run build\` first" >&2
    exit 1
  }
done
if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ]]; then
  echo "warning: tracked files have uncommitted changes; the source archive holds HEAD only" >&2
fi

rm -rf artifacts
mkdir -p artifacts
python scripts/zip_dir.py dist/chromium "artifacts/${slug}-chromium-${version}.zip"
python scripts/zip_dir.py dist/gecko "artifacts/${slug}-gecko-${version}.zip"
cp "dist/userscript/${slug}.user.js" "dist/userscript/${slug}.meta.js" artifacts/
# A pathspec exclude of docs would drop the tokens too, so list every other top-level entry.
paths=()
while IFS= read -r entry; do
  [[ "$entry" == docs ]] || paths+=("$entry")
done < <(git ls-tree --name-only HEAD)
git archive --format=zip --prefix="${slug}-source-${version}/" \
  -o "artifacts/${slug}-source-${version}.zip" HEAD -- "${paths[@]}" docs/design/tokens.css

ls -l artifacts

```

`scripts/precommit_format.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Format the staged files we own and re-stage them (AGENTS.md rule 15). A file that is only partly
# staged stops the commit, so unstaged hunks are never committed by the re-stage. The staged list
# comes from Git itself, NUL-separated, because the hook's STAGED variable splits paths on spaces.
set -euo pipefail

if [[ -n "${WSL_DISTRO_NAME:-}" ]]; then
  echo "error: WSL bash; on Windows put Git Bash first on PATH (mise.local.toml.example)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
mapfile -d '' staged < <(git diff --cached --name-only -z --diff-filter=ACMR)
((${#staged[@]})) || exit 0

declare -A unstaged=()
while IFS= read -r -d '' path; do
  unstaged["$path"]=1
done < <(git diff --name-only -z)

partial=()
python_files=()
shell_files=()
other_files=()
for path in "${staged[@]}"; do
  [[ -n "${unstaged[$path]:-}" ]] && partial+=("$path")
  case "$path" in
    *.py) python_files+=("$path") ;;
    *.sh) shell_files+=("$path") ;;
    *) other_files+=("$path") ;;
  esac
done

if ((${#partial[@]})); then
  echo "error: these files are only partly staged; stage them whole (git add) and commit again:" >&2
  printf '  %s\n' "${partial[@]}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ((${#other_files[@]})); then
  dprint fmt --allow-no-files -- "${other_files[@]}"
fi
if ((${#python_files[@]})); then
  ruff format --force-exclude -- "${python_files[@]}"
fi
if ((${#shell_files[@]})); then
  shfmt --indent 2 --case-indent --write -- "${shell_files[@]}"
fi
git add -- "${staged[@]}"

```

`scripts/release.py`:

```py
"""Release train, nightly prereleases and store promotion (ADR 0005), run by the release:* tasks.

  train [--dry-run]     open a batch PR from the newest green commit on main
  tag                   tag a merged batch commit and dispatch the nightly
  validate [--release]  check the tag is CalVer, on main and green; --release checks the assets
  publish-nightly       create the GitHub prerelease from artifacts/
  chrome                upload and publish the Chromium zip to the Chrome Web Store
  amo                   submit the Gecko zip and the source zip to AMO, listed channel
  latest                mark the release latest, which moves the userscript update URLs

The release app writes with RELEASE_APP_TOKEN and RELEASE_APP_SLUG.
GH_TOKEN reads, and github-actions[bot] uses it to approve the batch PR.
RELEASE_TAG names the tag and RELEASE_SHA the commit to tag. DRY_RUN=true makes train report only.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

import cws
from calver import next_version, parse, release_tags, utc_today
from notes import AMO_LIMIT, fit
from repo import (
    ARTIFACTS,
    EXTENSION_TARGETS,
    ROOT,
    SLUG,
    fail,
    git,
    json_object,
    json_string,
    package_version,
)

CHANGES = ROOT / ".changes"
CHANGELOG = ROOT / "CHANGELOG.md"
CI_RUNS = "repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs"
RELEASE_BRANCH = "release/"
NIGHTLY_WORKFLOW = "release-nightly.yml"
PACKAGE_VERSION = re.compile(r'^(\s*"version":\s*)"[^"]*"', re.MULTILINE)
GREEN_LOOKBACK = 100


def run(*args: str, token: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Run a tool and return its stdout. A `token` replaces GH_TOKEN for this call."""
    env = os.environ | ({"GH_TOKEN": token} if token else {})
    result = subprocess.run(
        list(args), cwd=ROOT, env=env, check=False, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8"
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        fail(f"{args[0]} {args[1] if len(args) > 1 else ''} failed:\n{result.stderr.strip()}")
    return result.stdout


def gh_json(*args: str, token: str | None = None) -> object:
    parsed: object = json.loads(run("gh", *args, token=token))
    return parsed


def summary(*lines: str) -> None:
    """Print lines and add them to the job summary when running in GitHub Actions."""
    print("\n".join(lines))
    path = os.environ.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY")
    if path:
        with Path(path).open("a", encoding="utf-8") as file:
            file.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


def env(name: str) -> str:
    value = os.environ.get(name, "")
    if not value:
        fail(f"{name} is not set")
    return value


def app_token() -> str:
    return env("RELEASE_APP_TOKEN")


def run_list(value: object, key: str) -> list[object]:
    items = json_object(value, "response").get(key)
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        fail(f"response: expected a list under {key}")
    return list(items)


def ci_passed(sha: str) -> bool:
    runs = gh_json("api", f"{CI_RUNS}?head_sha={sha}&status=success&per_page=1")
    return bool(run_list(runs, "workflow_runs"))


def newest_green_commit() -> str | None:
    """The newest commit on origin/main with a successful CI run on a push, if any."""
    runs = gh_json("api", f"{CI_RUNS}?branch=main&event=push&status=success&per_page=100")
    green = {
        json_string(json_object(item, "run").get("head_sha"), "run head_sha")
        for item in run_list(runs, "workflow_runs")
    }
    commits = git("rev-list", f"--max-count={GREEN_LOOKBACK}", "origin/main").split()
    return next((sha for sha in commits if sha in green), None)


def release_pr_open() -> bool:
    pulls = gh_json("pr", "list", "--state", "open", "--json", "headRefName", "--limit", "100")
    if not isinstance(pulls, list):
        fail("gh pr list: expected a list")
    heads = [json_string(json_object(pull, "pull").get("headRefName"), "head") for pull in pulls]
    return any(head.startswith(RELEASE_BRANCH) for head in heads)


def fragments_at(sha: str) -> list[str]:
    names = git("ls-tree", "--name-only", f"{sha}:.changes/unreleased").split()
    return [name for name in names if name.endswith(".yaml")]


def changie_version(version: str) -> str:
    """changie takes only SemVer, so a recut `Y.M.D.N` goes in as `Y.M.D+N`."""
    parts = version.split(".")
    return version if len(parts) == 3 else f"{'.'.join(parts[:3])}+{parts[3]}"


def batch_changelog(version: str) -> None:
    """Batch the fragments and rebuild CHANGELOG.md, newest version first.

    `changie merge` drops four-segment version files, and this merge keeps them.
    """
    semver = changie_version(version)
    run("changie", "batch", semver)
    produced, target = CHANGES / f"{semver}.md", CHANGES / f"{version}.md"
    if produced != target:
        heading, _, rest = produced.read_text(encoding="utf-8").partition("\n")
        target.write_text(f"{heading.replace(semver, version, 1)}\n{rest}", encoding="utf-8")
        produced.unlink()
    sections = sorted(
        (version_key, path)
        for path in CHANGES.glob("*.md")
        if (version_key := parse(path.stem)) is not None
    )
    header = (CHANGES / "header.tpl.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").rstrip("\n")
    body = "".join(
        f"\n{path.read_text(encoding='utf-8').rstrip()}\n" for _, path in reversed(sections)
    )
    with CHANGELOG.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as file:
        file.write(f"{header}\n{body}")


def set_package_version(version: str) -> None:
    path = ROOT / "package.json"
    text, count = PACKAGE_VERSION.subn(
        lambda match: f'{match[1]}"{version}"', path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), count=1
    )
    if count != 1:
        fail("package.json: no version field")
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as file:
        file.write(text)


def open_batch_pr(version: str, base: str) -> None:
    token, slug = app_token(), env("RELEASE_APP_SLUG")
    app_user_id = run("gh", "api", f"users/{slug}[bot]", "--jq", ".id", token=token).strip()
    branch, title = f"{RELEASE_BRANCH}{version}", f"chore(release): {version}"
    git("switch", "--create", branch, base)
    batch_changelog(version)
    set_package_version(version)
    git("add", "--all", ".changes", "CHANGELOG.md", "package.json")
    git(
        "-c",
        f"user.name={slug}[bot]",
        "-c",
        f"user.email={app_user_id}+{slug}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com",
        "commit",
        "--message",
        title,
    )
    run("gh", "auth", "setup-git", token=token)
    run("git", "push", "origin", f"HEAD:refs/heads/{branch}", token=token)
    body = f"Batches the changelog fragments into {version} and sets the package.json version."
    create = ["pr", "create", "--base", "main", "--head", branch, "--title", title, "--body", body]
    url = run("gh", *create, token=token).strip()
    run("gh", "pr", "merge", url, "--auto", "--squash", token=token)
    decision = gh_json("pr", "view", url, "--json", "reviewDecision")
    if json_object(decision, "pr view").get("reviewDecision") == "REVIEW_REQUIRED":
        run("gh", "pr", "review", url, "--approve", "--body", "Release batch.")
    summary(f"Opened {url}; it merges once the required checks pass.")


def train(dry_run: bool) -> None:
    base = newest_green_commit()
    if base is None:
        summary("No green commit on main; nothing to release.")
        return
    if release_pr_open():
        summary("A release pull request is already open; skipped.")
        return
    tags = release_tags()
    if tags and not git("rev-list", f"{tags[-1]}..{base}").strip():
        summary(f"Nothing landed between {tags[-1]} and {base[:12]}; skipped.")
        return
    fragments = fragments_at(base)
    if not fragments:
        summary(f"No changelog fragments at {base[:12]}; no release.")
        return
    try:
        version = next_version(utc_today(), tags)
    except ValueError as error:
        fail(str(error))
    summary(
        f"Release {version} from {base[:12]} with {len(fragments)} fragment(s):",
        *(f"- {name}" for name in fragments),
    )
    if dry_run:
        summary("Dry run: no branch, pull request or tag was created.")
        return
    open_batch_pr(version, base)


def version_at(revision: str) -> str:
    package = json_object(json.loads(git("show", f"{revision}:package.json")), "package.json")
    return json_string(package.get("version"), "package.json version")


def tag() -> None:
    sha = env("RELEASE_SHA")
    version = version_at(sha)
    parsed = parse(version)
    if parsed is None or version == version_at(f"{sha}^1"):
        summary(f"{sha[:12]} is not a release batch commit; nothing to tag.")
        return
    tags = release_tags()
    if version in tags:
        summary(f"{version} is already tagged; nothing to do.")
        return
    newer = [old for old in tags if (other := parse(old)) is not None and other > parsed]
    if newer:
        fail(f"{version} does not come after the newest tag {newer[-1]}")
    if not ci_passed(sha):
        fail(f"CI has not passed for {sha}")
    token = app_token()
    ref_api = "repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs"
    run("gh", "api", ref_api, "-f", f"ref=refs/tags/{version}", "-f", f"sha={sha}", token=token)
    dispatch = ["workflow", "run", NIGHTLY_WORKFLOW, "--ref", version, "-f", f"tag={version}"]
    run("gh", *dispatch, token=token)
    summary(f"Tagged {sha[:12]} as {version} and dispatched {NIGHTLY_WORKFLOW}.")


def release_tag() -> str:
    version = env("RELEASE_TAG")
    if parse(version) is None:
        fail(f"{version!r} is not an unpadded CalVer version")
    return version


def asset_names(version: str) -> list[str]:
    return [
        *(f"{SLUG}-{target}-{version}.zip" for target in EXTENSION_TARGETS),
        f"{SLUG}.user.js",
        f"{SLUG}.meta.js",
        f"{SLUG}-source-{version}.zip",
    ]


def validate(release: bool) -> None:
    version = release_tag()
    ref = os.environ.get("GITHUB_REF")
    if ref is not None and ref != f"refs/tags/{version}":
        fail(f"run this workflow from the tag {version}, not {ref}")
    sha = git("rev-parse", f"refs/tags/{version}^{{commit}}").strip()
    if git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip() != sha:
        fail(f"the checkout is not at the tag {version}")
    if package_version() != version:
        fail(f"package.json at {version} holds version {package_version()}")
    try:
        git("merge-base", "--is-ancestor", sha, "origin/main")
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
        fail(f"{version} ({sha[:12]}) is not on origin/main")
    if not ci_passed(sha):
        fail(f"CI has not passed for {version} ({sha[:12]})")
    if release:
        view = json_object(gh_json("release", "view", version, "--json", "assets"), "release")
        names = {
            json_string(json_object(asset, "asset").get("name"), "asset name")
            for asset in run_list(view, "assets")
        }
        missing = sorted(set(asset_names(version)) - names)
        if missing:
            fail(f"release {version} lacks {', '.join(missing)}")
    summary(f"{version} ({sha[:12]}) is CalVer, on main, and green.")


def release_notes(version: str) -> str:
    path = CHANGES / f"{version}.md"
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"{path.relative_to(ROOT)} is missing; the release batch writes it")
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").partition("\n")[2].strip()


def publish_nightly() -> None:
    version = release_tag()
    files = [ARTIFACTS / name for name in asset_names(version)]
    present = sorted(path.name for path in ARTIFACTS.iterdir())
    if present != sorted(path.name for path in files):
        fail(f"artifacts/ holds {present}, expected {asset_names(version)}")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
        notes = Path(folder) / "notes.md"
        notes.write_text(release_notes(version) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        options = ["--prerelease", "--verify-tag", "--title", version, "--notes-file", str(notes)]
        run("gh", "release", "create", version, *map(str, files), *options)
    summary(f"Created the prerelease {version} with {len(files)} assets. No store was touched.")


def download(version: str, *names: str) -> list[Path]:
    ARTIFACTS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    patterns = [arg for name in names for arg in ("--pattern", name)]
    run("gh", "release", "download", version, "--dir", str(ARTIFACTS), "--clobber", *patterns)
    return [ARTIFACTS / name for name in names]


def manifest_version(archive: Path) -> str:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as files:
        manifest = json_object(json.loads(files.read("manifest.json")), "manifest.json")
    return json_string(manifest.get("version"), "manifest version")


def promoted_zip(version: str, target: str) -> Path:
    (path,) = download(version, f"{SLUG}-{target}-{version}.zip")
    if manifest_version(path) != version:
        fail(f"{path.name}: manifest version is {manifest_version(path)}, not {version}")
    return path


def require_env(*names: str) -> None:
    missing = [name for name in names if not os.environ.get(name)]
    if missing:
        fail(f"missing environment secrets: {', '.join(missing)}")


def chrome() -> None:
    """Submit the Chromium zip with a short-lived Workload Identity Federation token (ADR 0007).

    It reads CWS_ACCESS_TOKEN, CWS_PUBLISHER_ID and CWS_EXTENSION_ID.
    """
    require_env("CWS_ACCESS_TOKEN", "CWS_PUBLISHER_ID", "CWS_EXTENSION_ID")
    version = release_tag()
    archive = promoted_zip(version, "chromium")
    call = cws.http_call(env("CWS_ACCESS_TOKEN"))
    state = cws.publish(call, env("CWS_PUBLISHER_ID"), env("CWS_EXTENSION_ID"), archive)
    summary(f"Submitted {archive.name} to the Chrome Web Store for review (state {state}).")


def amo() -> None:
    """Submit to the AMO listed channel through web-ext sign, which reads WEB_EXT_API_*."""
    require_env("WEB_EXT_API_KEY", "WEB_EXT_API_SECRET")
    version = release_tag()
    archive = promoted_zip(version, "gecko")
    (source,) = download(version, f"{SLUG}-source-{version}.zip")
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
        unpacked, metadata = Path(folder) / "gecko", Path(folder) / "amo-metadata.json"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as files:
            files.extractall(unpacked)
        link = f"Full notes: https://github.com/{env('GH_REPO')}/releases/tag/{version}"
        text = fit(release_notes(version), AMO_LIMIT, link)
        notes = {"version": {"release_notes": {"en-US": text}}}
        metadata.write_text(json.dumps(notes, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        sign = {
            "--channel": "listed",
            "--source-dir": str(unpacked),
            "--upload-source-code": str(source),
            "--amo-metadata": str(metadata),
            "--approval-timeout": "0",
            "--artifacts-dir": str(Path(folder) / "signed"),
        }
        print(run("web-ext", "sign", *(part for pair in sign.items() for part in pair)))
    summary(f"Submitted {archive.name} and its source to AMO (listed); review follows.")


def latest() -> None:
    version = release_tag()
    run("gh", "release", "edit", version, "--prerelease=false", "--latest")
    summary(f"{version} is now the latest release; userscript installs will update.")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Release train and promotion.")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    train_parser = commands.add_parser("train")
    train_parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    validate_parser = commands.add_parser("validate")
    validate_parser.add_argument("--release", action="store_true")
    for name in ("tag", "publish-nightly", "chrome", "amo", "latest"):
        commands.add_parser(name)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    match args.command:
        case "train":
            train(args.dry_run or os.environ.get("DRY_RUN") == "true")
        case "validate":
            validate(args.release)
        case "tag":
            tag()
        case "publish-nightly":
            publish_nightly()
        case "chrome":
            chrome()
        case "amo":
            amo()
        case "latest":
            latest()
        case _:
            fail(f"unknown command {args.command}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/render_icons.py`:

```py
"""Write the mark's color files and the extension icon PNGs in assets/icons/.

mark-<color>.svg is mark.svg with its currentColor replaced. Headless Chromium ($SAR_CHROMIUM_BIN)
paints icon-<size>.png from mark-purple.svg, or from icon-<size>.svg when that hand-hinted file
exists. The 16 and 32 px renders from the mark are interim; no icon-<size>.svg is ever written.

Usage: render_icons.py
"""

import os
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from repo import ICON_SIZES, ICONS_DIR, ROOT, fail, png_size
from run_browser import env_path

MASTER = ICONS_DIR / "mark.svg"
COLORS = {"purple": "#8f73f3", "white": "#ffffff", "black": "#000000"}
PAINT_COLOR = "purple"
STORE_SIZE = 128
STORE_PADDING = 16
# The mark spans 4 to 285 on the master's 300 unit canvas. Cropping the view box to that span
# makes the render touch every edge, as design section 14 asks of the full bleed sizes.
FULL_VIEW_BOX = "0 0 300 300"
ART_VIEW_BOX = "4 4 281 281"
PAGE = (
    "<!doctype html><meta charset=utf-8>"
    "<style>html,body{{margin:0;background:transparent}}"
    "img{{position:absolute;inset:{padding}px;width:{art}px;height:{art}px}}</style>"
    '<img src="{source}" alt="">'
)
BROWSER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120
STDERR_LINES = 5


def colored(master: str, color: str) -> str:
    return master.replace("currentColor", color)


def cropped(text: str) -> str:
    if text.count(f'viewBox="{FULL_VIEW_BOX}"') != 1:
        fail(f'{MASTER.name}: expected exactly one viewBox="{FULL_VIEW_BOX}"')
    return text.replace(f'viewBox="{FULL_VIEW_BOX}"', f'viewBox="{ART_VIEW_BOX}"')


def kill_tree(process: subprocess.Popen[str]) -> None:
    """Stop the browser and the helper processes it started."""
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        subprocess.run(
            ["taskkill", "/PID", str(process.pid), "/T", "/F"], capture_output=True, check=False
        )
    else:
        os.killpg(os.getpgid(process.pid), signal.SIGKILL)


def run_headless(command: list[str], size: int) -> tuple[int, str]:
    with subprocess.Popen(
        command,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        start_new_session=True,
    ) as process:
        try:
            _, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=BROWSER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            kill_tree(process)
            process.communicate()
            fail(f"Chromium took over {BROWSER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS} s to render the {size} px icon")
        return process.returncode, stderr


def source_svg(work: Path, size: int, painted: str) -> Path:
    """The SVG to paint at this size: the hand-hinted file when it exists, else the cropped mark."""
    hinted = ICONS_DIR / f"icon-{size}.svg"
    target = work / f"icon-{size}.svg"
    text = hinted.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if hinted.is_file() else cropped(painted)
    target.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return target


def render(browser: Path, work: Path, size: int, painted: str) -> Path:
    padding = STORE_PADDING if size == STORE_SIZE else 0
    svg = source_svg(work, size, painted)
    page = work / f"icon-{size}.html"
    page.write_text(
        PAGE.format(padding=padding, art=size - 2 * padding, source=svg.name), encoding="utf-8"
    )
    shot = work / f"icon-{size}.png"
    code, stderr = run_headless(
        [
            str(browser),
            "--headless=new",
            "--disable-gpu",
            "--disable-background-networking",
            "--force-color-profile=srgb",
            "--hide-scrollbars",
            "--no-first-run",
            "--force-device-scale-factor=1",
            "--default-background-color=00000000",
            f"--user-data-dir={work / 'profile'}",
            f"--window-size={size},{size}",
            f"--screenshot={shot}",
            page.as_uri(),
        ],
        size,
    )
    if not shot.is_file():
        tail = "\n".join(stderr.strip().splitlines()[-STDERR_LINES:])
        fail(f"Chromium wrote no {size} px icon (exit {code})\n{tail}")
    if png_size(shot) != (size, size):
        fail(f"{shot.name}: expected {size}x{size}, got {png_size(shot)}")
    return shot


def write_all(browser: Path, work: Path) -> None:
    """Render every size first; touch assets/icons only when all of them rendered."""
    master = MASTER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    painted = colored(master, COLORS[PAINT_COLOR])
    shots = {size: render(browser, work, size, painted) for size in ICON_SIZES}
    for name, color in COLORS.items():
        target = ICONS_DIR / f"mark-{name}.svg"
        target.write_text(colored(master, color), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        print(f"wrote {target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}")
    for size, shot in shots.items():
        target = ICONS_DIR / f"icon-{size}.png"
        shutil.copyfile(shot, target)
        print(f"wrote {target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}")


def main() -> None:
    browser = env_path("SAR_CHROMIUM_BIN")
    if not browser.is_file():
        fail(f"SAR_CHROMIUM_BIN does not exist: {browser}")
    # The profile is a throwaway folder, so a running Chromium and its profiles stay untouched.
    scratch = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="sar-icons-", ignore_cleanup_errors=True)
    try:
        write_all(browser, Path(scratch.name))
    finally:
        scratch.cleanup()
        if Path(scratch.name).exists():
            print(f"warning: could not remove {scratch.name}", file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
