```ts
// @vitest-environment-options {"url":"https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=roguelike"}
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import kindItems from "../../tests/fixtures/getitems/kinds.json";
import searchItems from "../../tests/fixtures/getitems/search-roguelike-50.json";
import { clearRoot } from "../../tests/helpers/dom";
import { fakeHttp } from "../../tests/helpers/fake-http";
import { fixedClock } from "../../tests/helpers/fixed-clock";
import { fixtureItems, getItemsRequest, getItemsRoute, itemAs } from "../../tests/helpers/getitems";
import { englishI18n } from "../../tests/helpers/i18n";
import { memoryStore } from "../../tests/helpers/memory-store";
import { withKind, writeSettings } from "../../tests/helpers/settings";
import { loadPage, SURFACES } from "../../tests/helpers/surfaces";
import { type App, start } from "./app";
import type { JsonValue } from "./json";
import { toHexColor } from "./kinds/color";
import type { KindId } from "./kinds/id";
import { KIND_BY_ID } from "./kinds/registry";
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, encodeSettings } from "./settings/settings";
import { createSettingsSource } from "./settings/settings-source";
import { ALLOW_KEY, SETTINGS_KEY } from "./storage-keys";
import { KIND_ATTRIBUTE } from "./ui/kind-attributes";
import { adoptPageStyles } from "./ui/styles";

const i18n = englishI18n();
const DISCLOSED = "4461450";
const SEARCH_IDS = [4075620, 3934270, 3784030, 1045010, 3432110, 3664320, 4461450, 2624160];
const NOW = Date.UTC(2026, 9, 20);

const quiet = { error: vi.fn(), warn: vi.fn(), info: vi.fn(), debug: vi.fn() };

let app: App | undefined;

async function startOnSearch(
  initial: ReadonlyMap<string, JsonValue> = new Map(),
  items: readonly unknown[] = fixtureItems(searchItems),
) {
  loadPage(SURFACES.search);
  document.documentElement.lang = "en";
  const store = memoryStore(initial);
  const settings = createSettingsSource(store);
  const http = fakeHttp([getItemsRoute(items)]);
  app = await start({
    document,
    http,
    store,
    settings,
    clock: fixedClock(NOW),
    console: quiet,
    addPageStyles: adoptPageStyles,
  });
  return { http, settings, store };
}

const row = (id: string) => document.querySelector(`a.search_result_row[data-ds-appid="${id}"]`);
const rootMark = (name: string) => document.documentElement.getAttribute(name);

/** Waits for the page's one GetItems request, then for the draw that follows its answer. */
async function drawn(http: { readonly calls: readonly unknown[]; }): Promise<void> {
  await expect.poll(() => http.calls.length).toBe(1);
  for (let frame = 0; frame < 4; frame++) {
    await new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(resolve));
  }
}

afterEach(() => {
  app?.stop();
  app = undefined;
  clearRoot();
});

describe("start on the search page", () => {
  it("badges the disclosed row after one GetItems request for the page", async () => {
    const { http } = await startOnSearch();
    await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(1);

    expect(http.calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(getItemsRequest(http.calls[0] ?? "").ids).toEqual(SEARCH_IDS);
    const badge = row(DISCLOSED)?.querySelector(".search_name > .title + .sar-chips > .sar-badge");
    expect(badge?.querySelector(".sar-badge-label")?.textContent).toBe(i18n.t("kind_ai_chip"));
    expect(row(DISCLOSED)?.getAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe("ai");
    const others = SEARCH_IDS.filter((id) => String(id) !== DISCLOSED);
    expect(others.map((id) => row(String(id))?.hasAttribute("data-sar-kinds"))).toEqual(
      others.map(() => false),
    );
    expect(document.adoptedStyleSheets.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("switches one kind to hide mode with one root attribute per setting", async () => {
    const { settings } = await startOnSearch();
    await expect.poll(() => row(DISCLOSED)?.getAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe("ai");
    expect(rootMark("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("off");

    await writeSettings(
      settings,
      withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { filter: "hide", badge: false }),
    );
    expect(rootMark("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("hide");
    expect(rootMark("data-sar-filter-kernel")).toBe("off");
    const disclosed = row(DISCLOSED);
    const other = row(String(SEARCH_IDS[0]));
    expect(disclosed === null ? "" : getComputedStyle(disclosed).display).toBe("none");
    expect(other === null ? "" : getComputedStyle(other).display).not.toBe("none");
  });

  describe("with a game that discloses several kinds", () => {
    // ARC Raiders' item (AI notes, a kernel anti-cheat, a EULA and PvP) replaces the disclosed
    // row's item: the route keeps the last item of an ID.
    const several = [
      ...fixtureItems(searchItems),
      itemAs(kindItems, 1808500, Number(DISCLOSED)),
    ];
    const chips = () =>
      Array.from(
        row(DISCLOSED)?.querySelectorAll(".sar-chips > .sar-badge") ?? [],
        (element) => element.querySelector(".sar-badge-label")?.textContent,
      );
    const chip = (id: KindId) => i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[id].messages.chip);
    // PvP starts off, so these tests turn it on in the stored settings.
    const withPvp = withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "pvp", { enabled: true });
    const pvpOn = (): Map<string, JsonValue> => new Map([[SETTINGS_KEY, encodeSettings(withPvp)]]);

    it("draws the placement's allowance of chips and a +N chip for the rest", async () => {
      const { http } = await startOnSearch(pvpOn(), several);
      await drawn(http);
      expect(row(DISCLOSED)?.getAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe("ai kernel eula pvp");
      expect(chips()).toEqual([
        chip("ai"),
        chip("kernel"),
        chip("eula"),
        i18n.t("kind_chip_more", { count: "1" }),
      ]);
    });

    it("draws the chips again when a kind's badges are switched off", async () => {
      const { http, settings } = await startOnSearch(pvpOn(), several);
      await drawn(http);
      await writeSettings(settings, withKind(withPvp, "kernel", { badge: false }));
      await expect.poll(() => chips()).toEqual([
        chip("ai"),
        chip("eula"),
        chip("pvp"),
      ]);
      expect(row(DISCLOSED)?.getAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe("ai kernel eula pvp");
    });

    it("draws no chip for an ignored kind, and keeps the others", async () => {
      const ignored = pvpOn().set(ALLOW_KEY, {
        all: {},
        kernel: { [DISCLOSED]: { name: "Ignored", added: NOW } },
      });
      const { http } = await startOnSearch(ignored, several);
      await drawn(http);
      expect(row(DISCLOSED)?.getAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe("ai eula pvp");
      expect(chips()).toEqual([
        chip("ai"),
        chip("eula"),
        chip("pvp"),
      ]);
    });

    it("leaves the row alone when the kind that would hide it is ignored", async () => {
      const filters = withKind(withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "kernel", { filter: "hide" }), "ai", {
        filter: "dim",
      });
      const ignored = new Map<string, JsonValue>([
        [SETTINGS_KEY, encodeSettings(filters)],
        [ALLOW_KEY, { all: {}, kernel: { [DISCLOSED]: { name: "Ignored", added: NOW } } }],
      ]);
      const { http } = await startOnSearch(ignored, several);
      await drawn(http);
      expect(row(DISCLOSED)?.getAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe("ai eula pvp");
      expect(getComputedStyle(row(DISCLOSED) ?? document.body).display).not.toBe("none");
    });

    it("hides the row when any of its kinds hides, whatever the others do", async () => {
      const { http, settings } = await startOnSearch(pvpOn(), several);
      await drawn(http);
      const dimAi = withKind(withPvp, "ai", { filter: "dim" });
      await writeSettings(settings, withKind(dimAi, "pvp", { filter: "hide" }));
      const style = getComputedStyle(row(DISCLOSED) ?? document.body);
      expect(style.display).toBe("none");
    });
  });

  it("marks nothing for an allow-listed game, in lists or on badges", async () => {
    const { http } = await startOnSearch(
      new Map<string, JsonValue>([
        [ALLOW_KEY, { all: {}, ai: { [DISCLOSED]: { name: "Ignored", added: NOW } } }],
      ]),
    );
    await drawn(http);
    expect(row(DISCLOSED)?.hasAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe(false);
    expect(document.querySelector(".sar-badge")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("marks nothing for a game ignored for all kinds", async () => {
    const { http } = await startOnSearch(
      new Map<string, JsonValue>([
        [ALLOW_KEY, { all: { [DISCLOSED]: { name: "Ignored", added: NOW } }, ai: {} }],
      ]),
    );
    await drawn(http);
    expect(row(DISCLOSED)?.hasAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe(false);
    expect(document.querySelector(".sar-badge")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("shows no badge and filters nothing while the kind is disabled", async () => {
    const { settings } = await startOnSearch();
    await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(1);
    await writeSettings(
      settings,
      withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { enabled: false, filter: "hide" }),
    );
    expect(rootMark("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("off");
    await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(0);
    await writeSettings(settings, DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
    expect(rootMark("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("off");
    await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(1);
  });

  describe("with a custom tag color", () => {
    const property = "--sar-kind-color-ai";
    const colorOnRoot = () => document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue(property);
    const red = toHexColor("#ff0000");

    it("sets nothing by default, so the badges keep the violet", async () => {
      await startOnSearch();
      await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(1);
      expect(colorOnRoot()).toBe("");
      expect(document.documentElement.hasAttribute("style")).toBe(false);
    });

    it("applies a stored color at start as one root property", async () => {
      const stored = encodeSettings(withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { color: red }));
      await startOnSearch(new Map([[SETTINGS_KEY, stored]]));
      await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(1);
      expect(colorOnRoot()).toBe("#ff0000");
      expect(document.querySelector(".sar-badge")?.getAttribute(KIND_ATTRIBUTE)).toBe("ai");
      expect(document.querySelector(".sar-badge")?.hasAttribute("style")).toBe(false);
      expect(document.querySelector(".sar-chips")?.hasAttribute("style")).toBe(false);
    });

    it("follows a change and its removal without drawing a badge again", async () => {
      const { settings } = await startOnSearch();
      await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(1);
      const badge = document.querySelector(".sar-badge");
      await writeSettings(settings, withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { color: red }));
      expect(colorOnRoot()).toBe("#ff0000");
      await writeSettings(
        settings,
        withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { color: toHexColor("#00ff00") }),
      );
      expect(colorOnRoot()).toBe("#00ff00");
      await writeSettings(settings, DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
      expect(colorOnRoot()).toBe("");
      expect(document.querySelector(".sar-badge")).toBe(badge);
    });

    it("keeps the other kinds on the default", async () => {
      const { settings } = await startOnSearch();
      await writeSettings(settings, withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "drm", { color: red }));
      expect(document.documentElement.style.getPropertyValue("--sar-kind-color-drm")).toBe(
        "#ff0000",
      );
      expect(colorOnRoot()).toBe("");
    });
  });

  it("logs a settings read that fails and starts on the defaults", async () => {
    quiet.error.mockClear();
    loadPage(SURFACES.search);
    document.documentElement.lang = "en";
    const store = memoryStore();
    const problem = new Error();
    app = await start({
      document,
      http: fakeHttp([getItemsRoute(fixtureItems(searchItems))]),
      store,
      settings: {
        read: () => Promise.reject(problem),
        subscribe: () => () => undefined,
      },
      clock: fixedClock(NOW),
      console: quiet,
      addPageStyles: adoptPageStyles,
    });
    expect(quiet.error).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.any(String),
      i18n.t("error_unexpected"),
      problem,
    );
    expect(rootMark("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("off");
    await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(1);
  });

  it("starts on the settings and the ignored games a v1 install stored", async () => {
    const { http, store } = await startOnSearch(
      new Map<string, JsonValue>([
        ["v1:settings", { badges: false, banner: true, listFilter: "dim", locale: "auto" }],
        ["v1:allow", { [DISCLOSED]: { name: "Ignored", added: NOW } }],
      ]),
    );
    await drawn(http);
    expect(row(DISCLOSED)?.hasAttribute("data-sar-kinds")).toBe(false);
    expect(rootMark("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("dim");
    expect(rootMark("data-sar-filter-kernel")).toBe("off");
    const keys = await store.keys();
    expect(keys).toContain("v2:settings");
    expect(keys).toContain("v2:allow");
    expect(keys).toContain("v1:settings");
    expect(keys).toContain("v1:allow");
  });
});
```

`src/core/app.ts`:

```ts
import { type AppPage, startAppPage } from "./app-page";
import { cachedDetector } from "./cache/cached-detector";
import { maintainCache } from "./cache/maintenance";
import { createVerdictCache } from "./cache/verdict-cache";
import { createAppPageDetector, type OpenPage, parseLiveAppPage } from "./detect/app-page";
import { API_BREAKER_KEY, createBreaker, HTML_BREAKER_KEY } from "./detect/breaker";
import { createBudgetDetector } from "./detect/budget";
import { createChainDetector } from "./detect/chain";
import { createDedupingDetector } from "./detect/dedupe";
import { createGetItemsDetector } from "./detect/getitems";
import { createThrottledHttp } from "./detect/throttle";
import type { Catalogs } from "./i18n/catalog";
import {
  DEFAULT_STEAM_LANGUAGE,
  type LocaleContext,
  resolveLocale,
  type SteamLanguage,
  steamLanguage,
} from "./i18n/locale";
import { SHIPPED_CATALOGS } from "./i18n/shipped";
import { createI18n } from "./i18n/t";
import { isIgnored, loadIgnored } from "./ignored";
import { effectiveSettings, type KindSettings } from "./kinds/kind-settings";
import { KINDS } from "./kinds/registry";
import { type ConsoleSink, createLogger, type Logger } from "./log";
import type { Clock, Http, KeyValueStore, SettingsSource, Unsubscribe } from "./ports";
import { appIdFromHref } from "./scan/appid";
import { createScanner } from "./scan/scanner";
import { createAllowList } from "./settings/allow-list";
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, parseSettings, type Settings } from "./settings/settings";
import { createBadgeRenderer } from "./ui/badge";
import { createCapsuleUi } from "./ui/capsules";
import { createHoverCard } from "./ui/hover-card";
import { applyKindSettings } from "./ui/kind-attributes";
import { createHostKindsRenderer } from "./ui/list-filter";

/** What a composition root hands to core: the ports, already built for its platform. */
export interface AppDeps {
  readonly document: Document;
  /** Plain HTTP (`createFetchHttp`); `start` throttles it per host. */
  readonly http: Http;
  readonly store: KeyValueStore;
  readonly settings: SettingsSource;
  readonly clock: Clock;
  readonly console: ConsoleSink;
  /** `navigator.language`, which the `auto` locale follows off store pages. */
  readonly browserLang?: string;
  /** Defaults to the catalogs this build ships. */
  readonly catalogs?: Catalogs;
  /**
   * Puts the store page stylesheet (`TOKENS_CSS` and `PAGE_CSS`) on the page: `adoptPageStyles`,
   * or nothing where the platform loads it itself, as the extension's manifest `content.css` does.
   * A platform hook rather than a default, so that bundle carries no copy of the CSS text.
   */
  readonly addPageStyles: (doc: Document) => void;
}

/** A running app on one store page. */
export interface App {
  /** Stops scanning and listening; what is drawn stays. */
  stop(): void;
}

/** The stored settings, or the defaults and the failure to read them. */
interface SettingsRead {
  readonly settings: Settings;
  readonly failure: { readonly problem: unknown; } | undefined;
}

async function readSettings(source: SettingsSource): Promise<SettingsRead> {
  try {
    return { settings: parseSettings(await source.read()), failure: undefined };
  } catch (problem) {
    return { settings: DEFAULT_SETTINGS, failure: { problem } };
  }
}

/**
 * The detector stack (hand-overs of steps 7 and 8): the verdict cache outside, so cache hits never
 * touch the network, then in-flight dedupe, then the chain of GetItems and, for what it leaves
 * unknown, the English app page within a per-page budget. Each host has its own throttle and
 * breaker.
 */
function createDetector(
  deps: AppDeps,
  logger: Logger,
  language: SteamLanguage,
  open: OpenPage | undefined,
) {
  const { http, store, clock } = deps;
  const throttled = (key: string) =>
    createThrottledHttp({ http, clock, breaker: createBreaker({ store, clock, logger, key }) });
  const getItems = createGetItemsDetector({ http: throttled(API_BREAKER_KEY), language });
  const appPage = createBudgetDetector(createAppPageDetector(throttled(HTML_BREAKER_KEY), open));
  const chain = createDedupingDetector(createChainDetector([getItems, appPage]));
  return { getItems, detector: cachedDetector(chain, createVerdictCache(store, clock), logger) };
}

/** Whether some kind's setting, as it takes effect, differs between two settings. */
function changed(
  before: Settings,
  after: Settings,
  pick: (settings: KindSettings) => boolean,
): boolean {
  return KINDS.some((kind) =>
    pick(effectiveSettings(before.kinds[kind.id])) !== pick(effectiveSettings(after.kinds[kind.id]))
  );
}

const SHOWS_BADGE = (settings: KindSettings): boolean => settings.badge;
const SHOWS_BANNER = (settings: KindSettings): boolean => settings.banner;

/**
 * Starts Tag Kit for Steam on one store page: settings, locale and logger, cache upkeep, the
 * detector stack, the allow-list, the page stylesheet, the scanner with its renderers, and the app
 * page's banner. Settings changes from any tab re-render at once: badges, the list filter and the
 * tag colors are one root attribute or custom property each, the banner is drawn again from the
 * known verdicts.
 */
export async function start(deps: AppDeps): Promise<App> {
  const { document: doc, store, clock } = deps;
  const catalogs = deps.catalogs ?? SHIPPED_CATALOGS;
  const root = doc.documentElement;

  const read = await readSettings(deps.settings);
  let { settings } = read;
  const { browserLang } = deps;
  const localeContext: LocaleContext = browserLang === undefined
    ? { setting: settings.locale, pageLang: root.lang }
    : { setting: settings.locale, pageLang: root.lang, browserLang };
  const locale = resolveLocale(localeContext, new Set(Object.keys(catalogs)));
  const i18n = createI18n(catalogs, locale);
  const logger = createLogger(i18n, deps.console, settings.debug);
  if (read.failure !== undefined) {
    logger.error(read.failure.problem);
  }
  await maintainCache(store, clock).catch((problem: unknown) => {
    logger.error(problem);
  });

  const language = steamLanguage(root.lang) ?? DEFAULT_STEAM_LANGUAGE;
  const pageId = appIdFromHref(doc.URL, doc.URL);
  // An English app page holds its own verdicts, so nothing fetches the page that is open.
  const live = pageId === undefined ? undefined : parseLiveAppPage(doc, doc.URL);
  const open = pageId === undefined || live === undefined
    ? undefined
    : { id: pageId, verdicts: live };
  const detectors = createDetector(deps, logger, language, open);
  const allowList = createAllowList(store, clock);
  const ignored = await loadIgnored(allowList, logger);

  deps.addPageStyles(doc);
  applyKindSettings(root, settings.kinds);

  const card = createHoverCard(doc, i18n);
  const capsules = createCapsuleUi({
    document: doc,
    detector: detectors.detector,
    renderers: [createHostKindsRenderer(), createBadgeRenderer(doc, i18n, card)],
    isAllowed: (id, forKind) => isIgnored(ignored, id, forKind),
    isBadged: (forKind) => effectiveSettings(settings.kinds[forKind]).badge,
  });
  const scanner = createScanner({ document: doc, renderer: capsules });

  scanner.start();

  let appPage: AppPage | undefined;
  const unsubscribe: Unsubscribe = deps.settings.subscribe((value) => {
    const before = settings;
    settings = parseSettings(value);
    applyKindSettings(root, settings.kinds);
    const badges = changed(before, settings, SHOWS_BADGE);
    if (badges) {
      capsules.refresh();
    }
    if (badges || changed(before, settings, SHOWS_BANNER)) {
      appPage?.render();
    }
  });

  if (pageId !== undefined) {
    appPage = startAppPage(doc, pageId, i18n, {
      language,
      detectors,
      live,
      ignored,
      allowList,
      settings: () => settings,
      onAllowChange: (id) => {
        capsules.refresh(new Set([id]));
      },
      card,
      logger,
    });
  }

  return {
    stop() {
      scanner.stop();
      capsules.stop();
      card.stop();
      appPage?.stop();
      unsubscribe();
    },
  };
}
```

`src/core/cache/cached-detector.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { detectorContract } from "../../../tests/contracts/detector.contract";
import { appId, appIds } from "../../../tests/helpers/app-ids";
import { countingStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/counting-store";
import { fakeDetector } from "../../../tests/helpers/fake-detector";
import { fixedClock } from "../../../tests/helpers/fixed-clock";
import { memoryStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/memory-store";
import {
  aiVerdicts,
  disclosedVerdict,
  FULL_DISCLOSED,
  NOT_DISCLOSED,
} from "../../../tests/helpers/verdicts";
import type { AiVerdict } from "../kinds/ai";
import type { Detector } from "../ports";
import { type AppId, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { cachedDetector } from "./cached-detector";
import { createVerdictCache } from "./verdict-cache";

const T = 1_000_000_000_000;

/** A detector that answers from a table (not disclosed by default) and records its calls. */
function stubDetector(table: ReadonlyMap<AppId, AiVerdict> = new Map()) {
  const calls: (readonly AppId[])[] = [];
  const detector: Detector = {
    detect(ids) {
      calls.push(ids);
      return Promise.resolve(
        new Map(ids.map((id) => [id, aiVerdicts(table.get(id) ?? NOT_DISCLOSED)])),
      );
    },
  };
  return { detector, calls };
}

function memoryCountingStore() {
  return countingStore(memoryStore());
}

function setup(table?: ReadonlyMap<AppId, AiVerdict>) {
  const store = countingStore(memoryStore());
  const clock = fixedClock(T);
  const logger = { error: vi.fn<(problem: unknown) => void>() };
  const inner = stubDetector(table);
  const cache = createVerdictCache(store, clock);
  return { store, clock, logger, inner, detector: cachedDetector(inner.detector, cache, logger) };
}

detectorContract("cachedDetector", () => setup().detector);

describe("cachedDetector", () => {
  it("asks the inner detector once, then answers from the cache", async () => {
    const { detector, inner, store } = setup(new Map([[appId(10), disclosedVerdict()]]));
    const first = await detector.detect(appIds(10, 20));
    const second = await detector.detect(appIds(10, 20));
    expect(second).toStrictEqual(first);
    expect(inner.calls).toStrictEqual([[10, 20]]);
    expect(store.calls.set).toBe(1);
  });

  it("asks the inner detector only about the IDs the cache lacks", async () => {
    const { detector, inner } = setup();
    await detector.detect(appIds(1, 2));
    const got = await detector.detect(appIds(2, 3, 3, 4));
    expect(inner.calls).toStrictEqual([[1, 2], [3, 4]]);
    expect([...got.keys()].toSorted((a, b) => a - b)).toStrictEqual([2, 3, 4]);
  });

  it("makes one storage read and one write for a batch of new IDs", async () => {
    const { detector, store } = setup();
    await detector.detect(appIds(1, 2, 3, 4, 5));
    expect(store.calls.get).toBe(1);
    expect(store.calls.set).toBe(1);
  });

  it("does not call the inner detector when everything is cached", async () => {
    const { detector, inner, store } = setup();
    await detector.detect(appIds(1, 2));
    const gets = store.calls.get;
    await detector.detect(appIds(1, 2));
    expect(inner.calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(store.calls.get).toBe(gets);
  });

  it("asks again after the verdict expires", async () => {
    const { detector, inner, clock } = setup();
    await detector.detect(appIds(1));
    clock.advance(12 * 3_600_000);
    await detector.detect(appIds(1));
    expect(inner.calls).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it("asks again about every kind when the shortest-lived one expires", async () => {
    // Six kinds hold a seven day verdict; the AI kind holds a twelve hour one.
    const verdicts = { ...FULL_DISCLOSED, ai: NOT_DISCLOSED };
    const inner = fakeDetector(() => verdicts);
    const clock = fixedClock(T);
    const logger = { error: vi.fn<(problem: unknown) => void>() };
    const detector = cachedDetector(
      inner,
      createVerdictCache(memoryCountingStore(), clock),
      logger,
    );
    await detector.detect(appIds(1));
    clock.advance(12 * 3_600_000 - 1);
    expect(await detector.detect(appIds(1))).toStrictEqual(new Map([[appId(1), verdicts]]));
    expect(inner.calls).toHaveLength(1);
    clock.advance(1);
    await detector.detect(appIds(1));
    expect(inner.calls).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it("remembers unknown error in memory for a while and never stores it", async () => {
    const { detector, inner, store } = setup(new Map([[appId(1), UNKNOWN.error]]));
    await detector.detect(appIds(1));
    await detector.detect(appIds(1));
    expect(inner.calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(store.calls.set).toBe(0);
  });

  it("detects through broken storage and logs the failures", async () => {
    const { detector, store, logger } = setup(new Map([[appId(1), disclosedVerdict()]]));
    store.break();
    const got = await detector.detect(appIds(1, 2));
    expect(got.get(appId(1))).toStrictEqual(aiVerdicts(disclosedVerdict()));
    expect(got.get(appId(2))).toStrictEqual(aiVerdicts(NOT_DISCLOSED));
    expect(logger.error).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
});
```

`src/core/cache/cached-detector.ts`:

```ts
import type { KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Logger } from "../log";
import type { Detector } from "../ports";
import type { AppId } from "../types";
import type { VerdictCache } from "./verdict-cache";

/**
 * A `Detector` that answers from the cache and asks `inner` only about the IDs the cache does not
 * hold, then remembers what `inner` answered. Storage is best effort: when the cache cannot be
 * read or written, the failure is logged and detection goes on without it, so this detector keeps
 * the contract of never rejecting.
 */
export function cachedDetector(
  inner: Detector,
  cache: VerdictCache,
  logger: Pick<Logger, "error">,
): Detector {
  return {
    async detect(ids) {
      const distinct = [...new Set(ids)];
      const verdicts = new Map<AppId, KindVerdicts>(
        await lookupQuietly(cache, distinct, logger),
      );
      const misses = distinct.filter((id) => !verdicts.has(id));
      if (misses.length === 0) {
        return verdicts;
      }
      const fetched = await inner.detect(misses);
      for (const [id, found] of fetched) {
        verdicts.set(id, found);
      }
      await cache.save(fetched).catch((problem: unknown) => {
        logger.error(problem);
      });
      return verdicts;
    },
  };
}

async function lookupQuietly(
  cache: VerdictCache,
  ids: readonly AppId[],
  logger: Pick<Logger, "error">,
): Promise<ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>> {
  try {
    return await cache.lookup(ids);
  } catch (problem) {
    logger.error(problem);
    return new Map();
  }
}
```

`src/core/cache/lru.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { Lru, MEMORY_CAPACITY } from "./lru";

describe("Lru", () => {
  it("is capped at 2,000 entries by default", () => {
    expect(MEMORY_CAPACITY).toBe(2000);
    const lru = new Lru<number, number>(MEMORY_CAPACITY);
    for (let n = 0; n < MEMORY_CAPACITY + 500; n++) {
      lru.set(n, n);
    }
    expect(lru.size).toBe(MEMORY_CAPACITY);
    expect(lru.get(0)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(lru.get(499)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(lru.get(500)).toBe(500);
    expect(lru.get(MEMORY_CAPACITY + 499)).toBe(MEMORY_CAPACITY + 499);
  });

  it("evicts the least recently used entry", () => {
    const lru = new Lru<string, number>(3);
    lru.set("a", 1);
    lru.set("b", 2);
    lru.set("c", 3);
    expect(lru.get("a")).toBe(1);
    lru.set("d", 4);
    expect(lru.get("b")).toBeUndefined();
    expect([lru.get("a"), lru.get("c"), lru.get("d")]).toStrictEqual([1, 3, 4]);
  });

  it("counts a write to an existing key as a use, without growing", () => {
    const lru = new Lru<string, number>(2);
    lru.set("a", 1);
    lru.set("b", 2);
    lru.set("a", 10);
    lru.set("c", 3);
    expect(lru.size).toBe(2);
    expect(lru.get("a")).toBe(10);
    expect(lru.get("b")).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("deletes entries", () => {
    const lru = new Lru<string, number>(2);
    lru.set("a", 1);
    lru.delete("a");
    lru.delete("missing");
    expect(lru.size).toBe(0);
    expect(lru.get("a")).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("holds at least one entry", () => {
    const lru = new Lru<string, number>(0);
    lru.set("a", 1);
    lru.set("b", 2);
    expect(lru.size).toBe(1);
    expect(lru.get("b")).toBe(2);
  });
});
```

`src/core/cache/lru.ts`:

```ts
/** The in-memory verdict map holds at most this many entries (rule 13: bounded cache). */
export const MEMORY_CAPACITY = 2000;

/**
 * A least-recently-used map with a fixed capacity. A `Map` iterates in insertion order, so the
 * first key is always the least recently used: reads and writes re-insert their key at the end.
 */
export class Lru<K, V> {
  readonly #capacity: number;
  readonly #entries = new Map<K, V>();

  constructor(capacity: number) {
    this.#capacity = Math.max(1, Math.floor(capacity));
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.#entries.size;
  }

  /** The value, marked as most recently used. */
  get(key: K): V | undefined {
    const value = this.#entries.get(key);
    if (value !== undefined) {
      this.#entries.delete(key);
      this.#entries.set(key, value);
    }
    return value;
  }

  /** Stores the value as most recently used, evicting the least recently used one when full. */
  set(key: K, value: V): void {
    this.#entries.delete(key);
    this.#entries.set(key, value);
    if (this.#entries.size > this.#capacity) {
      for (const oldest of this.#entries.keys()) {
        this.#entries.delete(oldest);
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  delete(key: K): void {
    this.#entries.delete(key);
  }
}
```

`src/core/cache/maintenance.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { countingStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/counting-store";
import { fixedClock } from "../../../tests/helpers/fixed-clock";
import { memoryStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/memory-store";
import { uniformVerdicts } from "../../../tests/helpers/verdicts";
import type { JsonValue } from "../json";
import { AI_KIND } from "../kinds/ai";
import { CACHE_SCHEMA, META_KEY } from "../storage-keys";
import { maintainCache } from "./maintenance";
import { encodeVerdicts } from "./stored";
import { DAY_MS } from "./ttl";

const T = 1_000_000_000_000;
// An app whose kinds are all in one state expires with the AI kind, the shortest-lived.
const { disclosed: DISCLOSED_TTL_MS, notDisclosed: NOT_DISCLOSED_TTL_MS } = AI_KIND.ttl;
const BREAKER: JsonValue = { openUntil: T + 60_000 };
const SETTINGS: JsonValue = { badges: false };
const ALLOW: JsonValue = { "10": { name: "Ignored", added: T } };

/** The stored value of an app whose kinds all have this state; `null` (invalid) if not stored. */
function verdict(state: Parameters<typeof uniformVerdicts>[0], time: number): JsonValue {
  return encodeVerdicts(uniformVerdicts(state), time) ?? null;
}

function setup(entries: readonly (readonly [string, JsonValue])[]) {
  const store = countingStore(memoryStore(new Map(entries)));
  const clock = fixedClock(T);
  return { store, clock, run: () => maintainCache(store, clock) };
}

async function keysOf(store: { keys(): Promise<readonly string[]>; }): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  return (await store.keys()).toSorted();
}

describe("maintainCache: schema reset", () => {
  const others: readonly (readonly [string, JsonValue])[] = [
    ["v1:breaker", BREAKER],
    ["v1:settings", SETTINGS],
    ["v1:allow", ALLOW],
  ];

  it("clears the verdict keys when the stored schema differs, and nothing else", async () => {
    const { store, run } = setup([
      [META_KEY, { schema: CACHE_SCHEMA - 1, sweptAt: T }],
      ["v1:a:1", verdict("not-disclosed", T)],
      ["v1:a:2", verdict("disclosed", T)],
      ...others,
    ]);
    expect(await run()).toBe("reset");
    expect(await keysOf(store)).toStrictEqual(["v1:allow", "v1:breaker", META_KEY, "v1:settings"]);
    expect(await store.get(["v1:breaker", "v1:settings", "v1:allow"])).toStrictEqual(
      new Map<string, unknown>(others),
    );
    expect(await store.get([META_KEY])).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[META_KEY, { schema: CACHE_SCHEMA, sweptAt: T }]]),
    );
  });

  it("drops the verdicts written before the per-kind layout, once", async () => {
    // Version 1 kept one flat verdict per app, with the time inside.
    const flat: JsonValue = {
      state: "disclosed",
      time: T,
      notes: "Concept art was generated.",
      language: "english",
      source: "api",
    };
    const { store, run } = setup([
      [META_KEY, { schema: 1, sweptAt: T }],
      ["v1:a:1", flat],
      ["v1:a:2", { state: "not-disclosed", time: T, source: "api" }],
      ...others,
    ]);
    expect(CACHE_SCHEMA).toBeGreaterThan(1);
    expect(await run()).toBe("reset");
    expect(await keysOf(store)).toStrictEqual(["v1:allow", "v1:breaker", META_KEY, "v1:settings"]);
    expect(await run()).toBe("skipped");
  });

  it("clears the verdicts of a newer schema too, after a downgrade", async () => {
    const { store, run } = setup([
      [META_KEY, { schema: CACHE_SCHEMA + 1, sweptAt: T }],
      ["v1:a:1", verdict("not-disclosed", T)],
    ]);
    expect(await run()).toBe("reset");
    expect(await keysOf(store)).toStrictEqual([META_KEY]);
  });

  it("treats a missing or invalid meta record as a mismatch", async () => {
    for (
      const meta of [undefined, "v1", 1, { schema: CACHE_SCHEMA }, { schema: "1", sweptAt: T }]
    ) {
      const { store, run } = setup([
        ...(meta === undefined ? [] : [[META_KEY, meta] as const]),
        ["v1:a:1", verdict("not-disclosed", T)],
        ["v1:breaker", BREAKER],
      ]);
      expect(await run()).toBe("reset");
      expect(await keysOf(store)).toStrictEqual(["v1:breaker", META_KEY]);
    }
  });

  it("does not reset again once the meta record is current", async () => {
    const { store, run } = setup([["v1:a:1", verdict("not-disclosed", T)]]);
    expect(await run()).toBe("reset");
    await store.set(new Map([["v1:a:1", verdict("not-disclosed", T)]]));
    expect(await run()).toBe("skipped");
    expect(await keysOf(store)).toStrictEqual(["v1:a:1", META_KEY]);
  });
});

describe("maintainCache: daily sweep", () => {
  const current = (sweptAt: number): readonly [string, JsonValue] => [
    META_KEY,
    { schema: CACHE_SCHEMA, sweptAt },
  ];

  it("skips within a day without reading verdicts", async () => {
    const { store, clock, run } = setup([current(T), ["v1:a:1", verdict("not-disclosed", T - 1)]]);
    clock.set(T + DAY_MS - 1);
    expect(await run()).toBe("skipped");
    expect(store.calls).toStrictEqual({ get: 1, set: 0, remove: 0, keys: 0 });
  });

  it("sweeps at exactly a day and removes expired, invalid and future entries", async () => {
    const { store, clock, run } = setup([
      current(T),
      ["v1:a:1", verdict("not-disclosed", T - 1)],
      ["v1:a:2", verdict("disclosed", T - 1)],
      ["v1:a:3", verdict("gated", T + DAY_MS - 1)],
      ["v1:a:4", { s: "old" }],
      ["v1:a:5", verdict("not-disclosed", T + DAY_MS + 1)],
      ["v1:breaker", BREAKER],
      ["v1:settings", SETTINGS],
    ]);
    clock.set(T + DAY_MS);
    expect(await run()).toBe("swept");
    expect(await keysOf(store)).toStrictEqual([
      "v1:a:2",
      "v1:a:3",
      "v1:breaker",
      META_KEY,
      "v1:settings",
    ]);
    expect(store.calls.remove).toBe(1);
  });

  it("keeps an entry until its TTL passes, to the millisecond", async () => {
    const sweepAt = T + 30 * DAY_MS;
    const { store, clock, run } = setup([
      current(T),
      ["v1:a:1", verdict("not-disclosed", sweepAt - NOT_DISCLOSED_TTL_MS + 1)],
      ["v1:a:2", verdict("not-disclosed", sweepAt - NOT_DISCLOSED_TTL_MS)],
      ["v1:a:3", verdict("disclosed", sweepAt - DISCLOSED_TTL_MS + 1)],
      ["v1:a:4", verdict("disclosed", sweepAt - DISCLOSED_TTL_MS)],
    ]);
    clock.set(sweepAt);
    expect(await run()).toBe("swept");
    expect(await keysOf(store)).toStrictEqual(["v1:a:1", "v1:a:3", META_KEY]);
  });

  it("records the sweep time, so the next sweep is a day later", async () => {
    const { store, clock, run } = setup([current(T)]);
    clock.set(T + DAY_MS);
    expect(await run()).toBe("swept");
    expect(await store.get([META_KEY])).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[META_KEY, { schema: CACHE_SCHEMA, sweptAt: T + DAY_MS }]]),
    );
    clock.advance(DAY_MS - 1);
    expect(await run()).toBe("skipped");
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(await run()).toBe("swept");
  });

  it("sweeps when the clock moved back past the last sweep", async () => {
    const { clock, run } = setup([current(T + 10 * DAY_MS)]);
    clock.set(T);
    expect(await run()).toBe("swept");
  });

  it("writes only the meta record when nothing has expired", async () => {
    const { store, clock, run } = setup([current(T), [
      "v1:a:1",
      verdict("not-disclosed", T + DAY_MS),
    ]]);
    clock.set(T + DAY_MS);
    expect(await run()).toBe("swept");
    expect(store.calls.remove).toBe(0);
    expect(store.calls.set).toBe(1);
  });
});
```

`src/core/cache/maintenance.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import type { Clock, KeyValueStore } from "../ports";
import { CACHE_SCHEMA, isVerdictKey, META_KEY } from "../storage-keys";
import { decodeVerdicts } from "./stored";
import { DAY_MS, isFresh } from "./ttl";

const MetaSchema = v.object({
  schema: v.number(),
  sweptAt: v.pipe(v.number(), v.finite()),
});

/**
 * What a maintenance run did: `reset` dropped every verdict because the stored schema is not
 * `CACHE_SCHEMA`; `swept` removed the expired and invalid verdicts; `skipped` found nothing due.
 */
export type Maintenance = "reset" | "swept" | "skipped";

/**
 * Housekeeping for the stored verdicts, run once when a page starts. A schema mismatch (or a
 * missing or invalid meta record) clears the verdict keys `v1:a:*` and nothing else: settings,
 * the allow-list and the breaker survive. Otherwise the expiry sweep runs at most once a day.
 * Both are best effort and idempotent, so two tabs racing each other is harmless.
 */
export async function maintainCache(store: KeyValueStore, clock: Clock): Promise<Maintenance> {
  const now = clock.now();
  const meta = v.safeParse(MetaSchema, (await store.get([META_KEY])).get(META_KEY));
  const current = meta.success && meta.output.schema === CACHE_SCHEMA ? meta.output : undefined;
  if (current !== undefined && !sweepDue(current.sweptAt, now)) {
    return "skipped";
  }
  const verdictKeys = (await store.keys()).filter(isVerdictKey);
  const doomed = current === undefined ? verdictKeys : await expired(store, verdictKeys, now);
  if (doomed.length > 0) {
    await store.remove(doomed);
  }
  await store.set(new Map([[META_KEY, { schema: CACHE_SCHEMA, sweptAt: now }]]));
  return current === undefined ? "reset" : "swept";
}

/** A sweep is due a day after the last one, or when the clock moved back past it. */
function sweepDue(sweptAt: number, now: number): boolean {
  const since = now - sweptAt;
  return since < 0 || since >= DAY_MS;
}

/** The keys whose value is invalid or no longer fresh. */
async function expired(
  store: KeyValueStore,
  keys: readonly string[],
  now: number,
): Promise<readonly string[]> {
  if (keys.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  const stored = await store.get(keys);
  return keys.filter((key) => {
    const entry = decodeVerdicts(stored.get(key));
    return entry === undefined || !isFresh(entry.verdicts, entry.time, now);
  });
}
```

```ts
      uniformVerdicts("missing"),

    expect(encoded).toStrictEqual({

    expect(Object.keys(perKind(() => 0))).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
  });

  it("stores a disclosed verdict as itself, and the unknown ones as their reason", () => {
    expect(encodeVerdicts(FULL_DISCLOSED, T)).toStrictEqual({ time: T, kinds: STORED_KINDS });
    expect(encodeVerdicts(uniformVerdicts("gated"), T)).toStrictEqual({

    });

      eula: { state: "disclosed", kind: "eula", source: "api", items: [{ name: "Game terms" }] },

        kernel: { state: "disclosed", kind: "kernel", source: "api", uninstallsCompletely: false },
        eula: { state: "disclosed", kind: "eula", source: "api", items: [{ name: "Game terms" }] },
      },
    });
    expect(JSON.stringify(stored)).not.toMatch(/undefined|null|nameToken|service|bootProtection/);
  });

  it("stores a kind whose field is malformed as such and keeps the other kinds", () => {
    const verdicts = { ...FULL_DISCLOSED, eula: UNKNOWN.malformed };
    expect(encodeVerdicts(verdicts, T)).toStrictEqual({
      time: T,
      kinds: { ...STORED_KINDS, eula: { state: "unknown", reason: "malformed" } },
    });
  });

  it("does not encode an app that has a verdict living in memory only", () => {
    expect(encodeVerdicts(UNKNOWN_KINDS.error, T)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(encodeVerdicts(UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"], T)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(encodeVerdicts(aiVerdicts(UNKNOWN.error), T)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(encodeVerdicts({ ...FULL_DISCLOSED, pvp: UNKNOWN.error }, T)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(encodeVerdicts({ ...FULL_DISCLOSED, drm: UNKNOWN["rate-limited"] }, T)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("shares the not disclosed verdict objects", () => {
    const html = {
      ...uniformVerdicts("not-disclosed"),
      ai: NOT_DISCLOSED_VERDICT.html,
    };
    const decoded = decodeVerdicts(encodeVerdicts(html, T));
    expect(decoded?.verdicts.ai).toBe(NOT_DISCLOSED_VERDICT.html);
    for (const id of KIND_IDS) {
      if (id !== "ai") {
        expect(decoded?.verdicts[id]).toBe(NOT_DISCLOSED_VERDICT.api);
      }
    }
  });

  it("shares the unknown verdict objects", () => {
    const decoded = decodeVerdicts(encodeVerdicts(UNKNOWN_KINDS.gated, T));
    for (const id of KIND_IDS) {
      expect(decoded?.verdicts[id]).toBe(UNKNOWN.gated);
    }
  });
});

describe("decodeVerdicts", () => {
  const valid = { time: T, kinds: STORED_KINDS };

  /** The valid entry with the stored value of one kind replaced. */
  function withEntry(id: string, entry: unknown, time: unknown = T): unknown {
    return { time, kinds: { ...STORED_KINDS, [id]: entry } };
  }

  it("accepts the valid shape", () => {
    expect(decodeVerdicts(valid)).toStrictEqual({ verdicts: FULL_DISCLOSED, time: T });
  });

  it("discards values of the wrong type", () => {
    for (const stored of [undefined, null, 7, "disclosed", true, [], [valid]]) {
      expect(decodeVerdicts(stored)).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it("discards an entry that lacks a registered kind", () => {
    expect(decodeVerdicts({ time: T, kinds: {} })).toBeUndefined();
    expect(decodeVerdicts({ time: T })).toBeUndefined();
    expect(decodeVerdicts({ time: T, kinds: { other: STORED_KINDS.ai } })).toBeUndefined();
    for (const id of KIND_IDS) {
      const kinds = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(STORED_KINDS).filter(([key]) => key !== id));
      expect(decodeVerdicts({ time: T, kinds })).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it("discards the v1 shape, which kept one verdict flat under the key", () => {
    const v1 = { state: "disclosed", time: T, notes: "text", language: "english", source: "api" };
    expect(decodeVerdicts(v1)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(decodeVerdicts({ state: "not-disclosed", time: T, source: "api" })).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("discards an AI entry that carries no kind", () => {
    const { kind: _kind, ...legacy } = STORED_KINDS.ai;
    expect(decodeVerdicts(withEntry("ai", legacy))).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("discards malformed entries instead of casting them", () => {
    const { ai, kernel, anticheat, drm, account, eula, pvp } = STORED_KINDS;
    const bad: readonly unknown[] = [
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, state: "maybe" }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, state: undefined }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, kind: "drm" }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, kind: undefined }),
      withEntry("ai", ai, "yesterday"),
      withEntry("ai", ai, Number.NaN),
      { kinds: STORED_KINDS },
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, notes: "" }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, notes: 5 }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, language: "klingon" }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, language: undefined }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, source: "guess" }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, service: 3 }),
      withEntry("ai", { ...ai, name: null }),
      withEntry("ai", { state: "not-disclosed" }),
      withEntry("ai", { state: "unknown", reason: "error" }),
      withEntry("ai", { state: "unknown", reason: "rate-limited" }),
      withEntry("ai", { state: "unknown" }),
      withEntry("ai", null),
      withEntry("kernel", { ...kernel, uninstallsCompletely: undefined }),
      withEntry("kernel", { ...kernel, uninstallsCompletely: "yes" }),
      withEntry("kernel", { ...kernel, name: 7 }),
      withEntry("kernel", { ...kernel, nameToken: [] }),
      withEntry("kernel", { ...kernel, bootProtection: true }),
      withEntry("kernel", { ...kernel, bootProtection: { token: 1 } }),
      withEntry("kernel", { ...anticheat }),
      withEntry("anticheat", { ...anticheat, name: false }),
      withEntry("anticheat", { ...anticheat, kind: "kernel" }),
      withEntry("drm", { ...drm, text: "" }),
      withEntry("drm", { ...drm, text: undefined }),
      withEntry("drm", { ...drm, activationLimit: 5 }),
      withEntry("account", { ...account, text: "" }),
      withEntry("account", { ...account, linksToSteam: undefined }),
      withEntry("account", { ...account, linksToSteam: "true" }),
      withEntry("eula", { ...eula, items: [] }),
      withEntry("eula", { ...eula, items: "Game terms" }),
      withEntry("eula", { ...eula, items: [{ url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1" }] }),
      withEntry("eula", { ...eula, items: [{ name: "Game terms", url: 5 }] }),
      withEntry("pvp", { ...pvp, categoryIds: [] }),
      withEntry("pvp", { ...pvp, categoryIds: ["49"] }),
      withEntry("pvp", { ...pvp, categoryIds: [49.5] }),
      withEntry("pvp", { ...pvp, categoryIds: undefined }),
    ];
    for (const stored of bad) {
      expect(decodeVerdicts(stored)).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it("drops a stored link that is not an EULA link and keeps the name", () => {
    const items = [
      { name: "Script", url: "javascript:alert(1)" },
      { name: "Elsewhere", url: "https://example.com/eula/1" },
      { name: "Clean", url: "https://store.steampowered.com//eula/3_eula_0" },
      { name: "Plain" },
    ];
    const decoded = decodeVerdicts(withEntry("eula", { ...STORED_KINDS.eula, items }));
    expect(decoded?.verdicts.eula).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "eula",
      source: "api",
      items: [
        { name: "Script" },
        { name: "Elsewhere" },
        { name: "Clean", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/3_eula_0" },
        { name: "Plain" },
      ],
    });
  });

  it("drops unknown keys and kinds", () => {
    const decoded = decodeVerdicts({
      time: T,
      extra: "x",
      kinds: {
        ...STORED_KINDS,
        ai: { ...STORED_KINDS.ai, extra: "x" },
        eula: { ...STORED_KINDS.eula, items: [{ name: "Game terms", extra: 1 }] },
        other: { state: "unknown" },
      },
    });
    expect(decoded?.verdicts).toStrictEqual({
      ...FULL_DISCLOSED,
      eula: { state: "disclosed", kind: "eula", source: "api", items: [{ name: "Game terms" }] },
    });
  });
});
```

`src/core/cache/stored.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { type JsonValue, toJsonValue } from "../json";
import type { KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import type { TagKind } from "../kinds/kind";
import { KINDS } from "../kinds/registry";
import { isKindVerdicts, type KindVerdict, type KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import { NOT_DISCLOSED, UNKNOWN, VerdictSourceSchema } from "../types";
import { isStoredReason, STORED_REASONS } from "./ttl";

// An app is stored as `v1:a:<appid>`: its fetch time and one entry per kind. A disclosed entry is
// the verdict, read back with its kind's schema. Storage is untrusted, so a read that fails is
// discarded.

const TimeSchema = v.pipe(v.number(), v.finite());

const StoredOtherSchema = v.variant("state", [
  v.object({ state: v.literal("not-disclosed"), source: VerdictSourceSchema }),
  v.object({ state: v.literal("unknown"), reason: v.picklist(STORED_REASONS) }),
]);

/** The entries stay `unknown` here and are validated kind by kind. */
const StoredAppSchema = v.object({
  time: TimeSchema,
  kinds: v.record(v.string(), v.unknown()),
});

/** An app's verdicts and the time (ms since the epoch) they were fetched. */
export interface TimedVerdicts {
  readonly verdicts: KindVerdicts;
  readonly time: number;
}

function isDisclosedEntry(stored: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof stored === "object" && stored !== null && "state" in stored
    && stored.state === "disclosed";
}

/** The verdict of a stored entry. Not disclosed and unknown entries come back as shared objects. */
function decodeVerdict(kind: TagKind, stored: unknown): KindVerdict | undefined {
  if (isDisclosedEntry(stored)) {
    const disclosed = v.safeParse(kind.stored, stored);
    return disclosed.success ? disclosed.output : undefined;
  }
  const other = v.safeParse(StoredOtherSchema, stored);
  if (!other.success) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return other.output.state === "unknown"
    ? UNKNOWN[other.output.reason]
    : NOT_DISCLOSED[other.output.source];
}

/**
 * The stored value as verdicts with their fetch time. Undefined when it is not a valid entry or
 * lacks a registered kind; that app is then fetched again.
 */
export function decodeVerdicts(stored: unknown): TimedVerdicts | undefined {
  const app = v.safeParse(StoredAppSchema, stored);
  if (!app.success) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const verdicts: Partial<Record<KindId, KindVerdict>> = {};
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    const verdict = decodeVerdict(kind, app.output.kinds[kind.id]);
    if (verdict === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    verdicts[kind.id] = verdict;
  }
  return isKindVerdicts(verdicts) ? { verdicts, time: app.output.time } : undefined;
}

function encodeVerdict(verdict: KindVerdict): JsonValue | undefined {
  switch (verdict.state) {
    case "disclosed":
      return toJsonValue(verdict);
    case "not-disclosed":
      return { state: "not-disclosed", source: verdict.source };
    case "unknown":
      return isStoredReason(verdict.reason)
        ? { state: "unknown", reason: verdict.reason }
        : undefined;
    default:
      return verdict satisfies never;
  }
}

/**
 * The stored value for verdicts fetched at `time`. Undefined when any kind holds a verdict that
 * is never persisted (`error`, `rate-limited`): the app is then asked about again as a whole.
 */
export function encodeVerdicts(verdicts: KindVerdicts, time: number): JsonValue | undefined {
  const kinds: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    const entry = encodeVerdict(verdicts[kind.id]);
    if (entry === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    kinds[kind.id] = entry;
  }
  return { time, kinds };
}
```

`src/core/cache/ttl.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  disclosedVerdict,
  FULL_DISCLOSED,
  NOT_DISCLOSED,
  uniformVerdicts,
} from "../../../tests/helpers/verdicts";
import { AI_KIND } from "../kinds/ai";
import { DAY_MS, HOUR_MS, WEEK_TTL } from "../kinds/kind-ttl";
import { KINDS } from "../kinds/registry";
import type { KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import { UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { isFresh, isStoredReason, TRANSIENT_TTL_MS, ttlMs, UNKNOWN_TTL_MS } from "./ttl";

const T = 1_000_000_000_000;

describe("kind TTLs", () => {
  it("keep the AI notes for 7 days and a missing disclosure for 12 hours", () => {
    expect(AI_KIND.ttl).toStrictEqual({ disclosed: 7 * DAY_MS, notDisclosed: 12 * HOUR_MS });
  });

  it("keep every other kind for 7 days, disclosed or not", () => {
    for (const kind of KINDS) {
      if (kind.id !== "ai") {
        expect(kind.ttl).toBe(WEEK_TTL);
      }
    }
    expect(WEEK_TTL).toStrictEqual({ disclosed: 7 * DAY_MS, notDisclosed: 7 * DAY_MS });
  });
});

describe("ttlMs", () => {
  it("takes disclosed and not disclosed from the kind's TTLs", () => {
    expect(ttlMs(AI_KIND.ttl, disclosedVerdict())).toBe(7 * DAY_MS);
    expect(ttlMs(AI_KIND.ttl, NOT_DISCLOSED)).toBe(12 * HOUR_MS);
    expect(ttlMs(WEEK_TTL, NOT_DISCLOSED)).toBe(7 * DAY_MS);
  });

  it("is 6 hours for gated, missing and malformed, whatever the kind", () => {
    for (const reason of ["gated", "missing", "malformed"] as const) {
      expect(ttlMs(AI_KIND.ttl, UNKNOWN[reason])).toBe(6 * HOUR_MS);
      expect(ttlMs(WEEK_TTL, UNKNOWN[reason])).toBe(6 * HOUR_MS);
    }
  });

  it("is short for the verdicts that are not stored", () => {
    expect(ttlMs(AI_KIND.ttl, UNKNOWN.error)).toBe(TRANSIENT_TTL_MS);
    expect(ttlMs(AI_KIND.ttl, UNKNOWN["rate-limited"])).toBe(TRANSIENT_TTL_MS);
    expect(TRANSIENT_TTL_MS).toBeLessThan(UNKNOWN_TTL_MS);
  });
});

describe("isStoredReason", () => {
  it("stores gated, missing and malformed only", () => {
    expect(isStoredReason("gated")).toBe(true);
    expect(isStoredReason("missing")).toBe(true);
    expect(isStoredReason("malformed")).toBe(true);
    expect(isStoredReason("error")).toBe(false);
    expect(isStoredReason("rate-limited")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("isFresh", () => {
  const cases: readonly (readonly [string, KindVerdicts, number])[] = [
    ["disclosed", uniformVerdicts("disclosed"), 7 * DAY_MS],
    ["not disclosed", uniformVerdicts("not-disclosed"), 12 * HOUR_MS],
    ["unknown gated", uniformVerdicts("gated"), UNKNOWN_TTL_MS],
    ["unknown missing", uniformVerdicts("missing"), UNKNOWN_TTL_MS],
    ["unknown malformed", uniformVerdicts("malformed"), UNKNOWN_TTL_MS],
    ["unknown error", uniformVerdicts("error"), TRANSIENT_TTL_MS],
    ["unknown rate-limited", uniformVerdicts("rate-limited"), TRANSIENT_TTL_MS],
  ];

  it.each(cases)("%s: fresh until exactly its TTL", (_name, verdicts, ttl) => {
    expect(isFresh(verdicts, T, T)).toBe(true);
    expect(isFresh(verdicts, T, T + ttl - 1)).toBe(true);
    expect(isFresh(verdicts, T, T + ttl)).toBe(false);
    expect(isFresh(verdicts, T, T + ttl + 1)).toBe(false);
  });

  it("treats a fetch time in the future as stale", () => {
    expect(isFresh(uniformVerdicts("not-disclosed"), T + 1, T)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("isFresh across kinds", () => {
  const notDisclosed = uniformVerdicts("not-disclosed");

  function expiresAt(verdicts: KindVerdicts, ttl: number): void {
    expect(isFresh(verdicts, T, T + ttl - 1)).toBe(true);
    expect(isFresh(verdicts, T, T + ttl)).toBe(false);
  }

  it("keeps the AI notes for 7 days while every other kind is not disclosed", () => {
    expiresAt({ ...notDisclosed, ai: FULL_DISCLOSED.ai }, 7 * DAY_MS);
  });

  it("keeps a game that disclosed nothing for 12 hours, the AI kind's TTL", () => {
    expiresAt(notDisclosed, 12 * HOUR_MS);
  });

  it("does not shorten an app because a non-AI kind is not disclosed", () => {
    for (const kind of KINDS) {
      if (kind.id !== "ai") {
        expiresAt({ ...FULL_DISCLOSED, [kind.id]: NOT_DISCLOSED }, 7 * DAY_MS);
      }
    }
  });

  it("expires with the AI kind when it is not disclosed, whatever the others are", () => {
    expiresAt({ ...FULL_DISCLOSED, ai: NOT_DISCLOSED }, 12 * HOUR_MS);
  });

  it("expires after 6 hours when any kind is gated, missing or malformed", () => {
    const aiNotes = { ...notDisclosed, ai: FULL_DISCLOSED.ai };
    for (const kind of KINDS) {
      for (const reason of ["gated", "missing", "malformed"] as const) {
        expiresAt({ ...aiNotes, [kind.id]: UNKNOWN[reason] }, UNKNOWN_TTL_MS);
      }
    }
  });

  it("expires at once with a verdict that is not stored", () => {
    for (const kind of KINDS) {
      const failed = { ...FULL_DISCLOSED, [kind.id]: UNKNOWN.error };
      expect(isFresh(failed, T, T + TRANSIENT_TTL_MS - 1)).toBe(true);
      expect(isFresh(failed, T, T + TRANSIENT_TTL_MS)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it("keeps disclosed kinds for 7 days when no kind is shorter", () => {
    expiresAt(FULL_DISCLOSED, 7 * DAY_MS);
  });
});
```

`src/core/cache/ttl.ts`:

```ts
import { DAY_MS, HOUR_MS, type KindTtl } from "../kinds/kind-ttl";
import { KINDS } from "../kinds/registry";
import type { KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { UnknownReason, Verdict } from "../types";

export { DAY_MS };

/** How long a stored unknown verdict (`gated`, `missing`, `malformed`) stays fresh. */
export const UNKNOWN_TTL_MS = 6 * HOUR_MS;
/**
 * How long an `error` or `rate-limited` verdict is remembered in page memory. About the breaker's
 * backoff, so a failed ID is asked again soon after the breaker closes but not on every rescan.
 */
export const TRANSIENT_TTL_MS = 60_000;

/**
 * The unknown reasons that are written to storage. `error` and `rate-limited` say nothing about
 * the app, so they live in page memory only.
 */
export const STORED_REASONS = ["gated", "missing", "malformed"] as const;

export type StoredReason = (typeof STORED_REASONS)[number];

export function isStoredReason(reason: UnknownReason): reason is StoredReason {
  return reason === "gated" || reason === "missing" || reason === "malformed";
}

/** How long one verdict stays fresh, given the TTLs of its kind. */
export function ttlMs(ttl: KindTtl, verdict: Verdict): number {
  switch (verdict.state) {
    case "disclosed":
      return ttl.disclosed;
    case "not-disclosed":
      return ttl.notDisclosed;
    case "unknown":
      return isStoredReason(verdict.reason) ? UNKNOWN_TTL_MS : TRANSIENT_TTL_MS;
    default:
      return verdict satisfies never;
  }
}

/**
 * An app's verdicts expire when the first kind's TTL runs out, at exactly that TTL.
 * A fetch time in the future is stale, so a wrong clock cannot pin a verdict.
 */
export function isFresh(verdicts: KindVerdicts, time: number, now: number): boolean {
  const age = now - time;
  if (age < 0) {
    return false;
  }
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    if (age >= ttlMs(kind.ttl, verdicts[kind.id])) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

```

`src/core/cache/verdict-cache.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { appId, appIds } from "../../../tests/helpers/app-ids";
import { countingStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/counting-store";
import { fixedClock } from "../../../tests/helpers/fixed-clock";
import { memoryStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/memory-store";
import {
  aiVerdicts,
  disclosedVerdict,
  NOT_DISCLOSED,
  uniformVerdicts,
} from "../../../tests/helpers/verdicts";
import type { JsonValue } from "../json";
import { AI_KIND, type AiVerdict } from "../kinds/ai";
import { perKind } from "../kinds/registry";
import type { KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import { type AppId, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { TRANSIENT_TTL_MS, UNKNOWN_TTL_MS } from "./ttl";
import { createVerdictCache } from "./verdict-cache";

const T = 1_000_000_000_000;
const { disclosed: DISCLOSED_TTL_MS, notDisclosed: NOT_DISCLOSED_TTL_MS } = AI_KIND.ttl;

function setup(capacity?: number) {
  const store = countingStore(memoryStore());
  const clock = fixedClock(T);
  return {
    store,
    clock,
    cache: createVerdictCache(store, clock, capacity),
    /** Another tab: a cache with its own memory over the same storage. */
    another: () => createVerdictCache(store, clock, capacity),
  };
}

describe("VerdictCache", () => {
  it("returns saved verdicts from memory without reading storage", async () => {
    const { cache, store } = setup();
    const verdicts = aiVerdicts(disclosedVerdict());
    await cache.save(new Map([[appId(10), verdicts]]));
    expect(await cache.lookup(appIds(10))).toStrictEqual(new Map([[10, verdicts]]));
    expect(store.calls.get).toBe(0);
  });

  it("serves another tab from storage and then from its memory", async () => {
    const { cache, another, store } = setup();
    const verdicts = aiVerdicts(disclosedVerdict({ language: "german" }));
    await cache.save(new Map([[appId(10), verdicts]]));
    const tab = another();
    expect(await tab.lookup(appIds(10))).toStrictEqual(new Map([[10, verdicts]]));
    expect(store.calls.get).toBe(1);
    await tab.lookup(appIds(10));
    expect(store.calls.get).toBe(1);
  });

  it("stores one entry per app, holding the fetch time and a verdict for each kind", async () => {
    const { cache, store } = setup();
    await cache.save(new Map([[appId(10), uniformVerdicts("not-disclosed")]]));
    const entry = { time: T, kinds: perKind(() => ({ state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" })) };
    expect(await store.get(["v1:a:10"])).toStrictEqual(new Map([["v1:a:10", entry]]));
  });

  it("keeps the language the notes were fetched in", async () => {
    const { cache, another } = setup();
    const verdicts = aiVerdicts(disclosedVerdict({ language: "spanish", notes: "Arte generado." }));
    await cache.save(new Map([[appId(10), verdicts]]));
    const got = (await another().lookup(appIds(10))).get(appId(10));
    expect(got).toStrictEqual(verdicts);
  });

  it("answers only the fresh IDs and leaves the rest out", async () => {
    const { cache, another } = setup();
    await cache.save(new Map([[appId(10), aiVerdicts(NOT_DISCLOSED)]]));
    const got = await another().lookup(appIds(10, 20));
    expect([...got.keys()]).toStrictEqual([10]);
  });

  it("reads storage once for a whole batch and writes it once", async () => {
    const { cache, another, store } = setup();
    const ids = Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, n) => appId(1000 + n));
    await cache.save(new Map(ids.map((id) => [id, aiVerdicts(NOT_DISCLOSED)])));
    expect(store.calls.set).toBe(1);
    expect(store.calls.get).toBe(0);

    const found = await another().lookup([...ids, appId(2000)]);
    expect(found.size).toBe(50);
    expect(store.calls.get).toBe(1);
    expect(store.gets[0]).toHaveLength(51);
  });

  it("asks storage only for the IDs memory does not hold", async () => {
    const { cache, another, store } = setup();
    await cache.save(
      new Map<AppId, KindVerdicts>([
        [appId(1), aiVerdicts(NOT_DISCLOSED)],
        [appId(2), aiVerdicts(NOT_DISCLOSED)],
      ]),
    );
    const tab = another();
    await tab.lookup(appIds(1));
    await tab.lookup(appIds(1, 2));
    expect(store.gets).toStrictEqual([["v1:a:1"], ["v1:a:2"]]);
  });

  it("makes no storage call for nothing to look up or to save", async () => {
    const { cache, store } = setup();
    expect(await cache.lookup([])).toStrictEqual(new Map());
    await cache.save(new Map());
    expect(store.calls).toStrictEqual({ get: 0, set: 0, remove: 0, keys: 0 });
  });

  describe("TTL edges", () => {
    const cases: readonly (readonly [string, KindVerdicts, number])[] = [
      ["disclosed", uniformVerdicts("disclosed"), DISCLOSED_TTL_MS],
      ["not disclosed", uniformVerdicts("not-disclosed"), NOT_DISCLOSED_TTL_MS],
      ["unknown gated", uniformVerdicts("gated"), UNKNOWN_TTL_MS],
      ["unknown missing", uniformVerdicts("missing"), UNKNOWN_TTL_MS],
    ];

    it.each(cases)("%s: stored for its TTL, gone at exactly the TTL", async (_n, verdicts, ttl) => {
      const { cache, another, clock } = setup();
      await cache.save(new Map([[appId(10), verdicts]]));

      clock.set(T + ttl - 1);
      expect((await another().lookup(appIds(10))).has(appId(10))).toBe(true);
      expect((await cache.lookup(appIds(10))).has(appId(10))).toBe(true);

      clock.set(T + ttl);
      expect((await another().lookup(appIds(10))).has(appId(10))).toBe(false);
      expect((await cache.lookup(appIds(10))).has(appId(10))).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  describe("verdicts that are not stored", () => {
    const cases: readonly (readonly [string, AiVerdict])[] = [
      ["unknown error", UNKNOWN.error],
      ["unknown rate-limited", UNKNOWN["rate-limited"]],
    ];

    it.each(cases)("%s: page memory only, for a short while", async (_name, verdict) => {
      const { cache, another, store, clock } = setup();
      const verdicts = aiVerdicts(verdict);
      await cache.save(new Map([[appId(10), verdicts]]));
      expect(store.calls.set).toBe(0);
      expect(await store.keys()).toStrictEqual([]);
      expect(await another().lookup(appIds(10))).toStrictEqual(new Map());

      clock.set(T + TRANSIENT_TTL_MS - 1);
      expect(await cache.lookup(appIds(10))).toStrictEqual(new Map([[10, verdicts]]));
      clock.set(T + TRANSIENT_TTL_MS);
      expect(await cache.lookup(appIds(10))).toStrictEqual(new Map());
    });

    it("writes only the stored verdicts of a mixed batch", async () => {
      const { cache, store } = setup();
      const verdicts: readonly (readonly [AppId, KindVerdicts])[] = [
        [appId(1), aiVerdicts(NOT_DISCLOSED)],
        [appId(2), aiVerdicts(UNKNOWN.error)],
        [appId(3), aiVerdicts(UNKNOWN.gated)],
      ];
      await cache.save(new Map(verdicts));
      expect(store.calls.set).toBe(1);
      expect((await store.keys()).toSorted()).toStrictEqual(["v1:a:1", "v1:a:3"]);
    });
  });

  describe("invalid stored values", () => {
    const invalid: readonly (readonly [string, JsonValue])[] = [
      ["a string", "disclosed"],
      ["a v1 entry, one flat verdict", { ...encoded(), time: T }],
      ["an old-schema entry", { s: "d", t: T, n: "old notes" }],
      ["an unknown language", entry({ ...encoded(), language: "klingon" })],
      ["a stored error", entry({ state: "unknown", reason: "error" })],
      ["a missing time", { kinds: { ai: { state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" } } }],
      ["an entry without kinds", { time: T, kinds: {} }],
    ];

    it.each(invalid)("discards %s", async (_name, value) => {
      const store = countingStore(memoryStore(new Map([["v1:a:10", value]])));
      const cache = createVerdictCache(store, fixedClock(T));
      expect(await cache.lookup(appIds(10))).toStrictEqual(new Map());
    });
  });

  describe("memory cap", () => {
    it("evicts the least recently used entries and falls back to storage", async () => {
      const { cache, store } = setup(3);
      const ids = appIds(1, 2, 3, 4, 5);
      await cache.save(new Map(ids.map((id) => [id, aiVerdicts(NOT_DISCLOSED)])));

      await cache.lookup(appIds(5));
      expect(store.calls.get).toBe(0);

      const oldest = await cache.lookup(appIds(1));
      expect(oldest.has(appId(1))).toBe(true);
      expect(store.gets).toStrictEqual([["v1:a:1"]]);
    });

    it("never holds more than the cap in memory", async () => {
      const { cache, store } = setup(2);
      await cache.save(
        new Map(appIds(1, 2, 3, 4).map((id) => [id, aiVerdicts(UNKNOWN["rate-limited"])])),
      );
      expect((await cache.lookup(appIds(1, 2, 3, 4))).size).toBe(2);
      expect(store.calls.get).toBe(1);
    });
  });
});

/** A verdict body as stored: no time of its own. */
function encoded(): Record<string, JsonValue> {
  return { state: "disclosed", notes: "text", language: "english", source: "api" };
}

/** A stored app entry with this body for the AI kind. */
function entry(ai: JsonValue): JsonValue {
  return { time: T, kinds: { ai } };
}
```

`src/core/cache/verdict-cache.ts`:

```ts
import type { JsonValue } from "../json";
import type { KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Clock, KeyValueStore } from "../ports";
import { verdictKey } from "../storage-keys";
import type { AppId } from "../types";
import { Lru, MEMORY_CAPACITY } from "./lru";
import { decodeVerdicts, encodeVerdicts, type TimedVerdicts } from "./stored";
import { isFresh } from "./ttl";

/**
 * Fresh verdicts remembered in page memory and in storage. Storage is shared by every tab, so a
 * verdict fetched once serves them all; page memory also holds the verdicts that are never
 * stored (`error`, `rate-limited`). Rejections from the store propagate to the caller.
 */
export interface VerdictCache {
  /** The fresh verdicts among `ids`: one storage read for the IDs memory does not hold. */
  lookup(ids: readonly AppId[]): Promise<ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>>;
  /** Remembers the verdicts now: one storage write for the ones that are stored. */
  save(verdicts: ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>): Promise<void>;
}

export function createVerdictCache(
  store: KeyValueStore,
  clock: Clock,
  capacity: number = MEMORY_CAPACITY,
): VerdictCache {
  const memory = new Lru<AppId, TimedVerdicts>(capacity);

  return {
    async lookup(ids) {
      const now = clock.now();
      const found = new Map<AppId, KindVerdicts>();
      const unseen = new Set<AppId>();
      for (const id of ids) {
        const held = memory.get(id);
        if (held !== undefined && isFresh(held.verdicts, held.time, now)) {
          found.set(id, held.verdicts);
        } else {
          memory.delete(id);
          unseen.add(id);
        }
      }
      if (unseen.size === 0) {
        return found;
      }
      const stored = await store.get([...unseen].map(verdictKey));
      for (const id of unseen) {
        const entry = decodeVerdicts(stored.get(verdictKey(id)));
        if (entry !== undefined && isFresh(entry.verdicts, entry.time, now)) {
          memory.set(id, entry);
          found.set(id, entry.verdicts);
        }
      }
      return found;
    },

    async save(verdicts) {
      const now = clock.now();
      const entries = new Map<string, JsonValue>();
      for (const [id, found] of verdicts) {
        memory.set(id, { verdicts: found, time: now });
        const value = encodeVerdicts(found, now);
        if (value !== undefined) {
          entries.set(verdictKey(id), value);
        }
      }
      if (entries.size > 0) {
        await store.set(entries);
      }
    },
  };
}
```

`src/core/detect/app-page.ts`:

```ts
import { steamLanguage } from "../i18n/locale";
import type { KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import { KINDS } from "../kinds/registry";
import {
  isKindVerdicts,
  type KindVerdict,
  type KindVerdicts,
  UNKNOWN_KINDS,
} from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Detector, Http, HttpResult } from "../ports";
import { type AppId, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { trimNotes } from "./notes";

// Detection from the English app page (ADR 0001, the fallback when GetItems cannot answer). Rules
// from rq6: S7 for the redirects and the duplicated block ID, S2 for the age gate.

export const APP_PAGE_ORIGIN = "https://store.steampowered.com";

const NAME_SELECTOR = "#appHubAppName";
const HTTP_OK = 200;
const HTTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS = 429;
const APP_PATH = /^\/app\/\d+(?:\/|$)/;

/** `/app/<id>` is the only path of an app page; `/agecheck/`, `/login/` and `/` are gates. */
function isAppPage(finalUrl: string): boolean {
  try {
    return APP_PATH.test(new URL(finalUrl).pathname);
  } catch {
    // An unparsable URL is not an app page.
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * The verdicts an English app page gives. `finalUrl` is where the request ended after redirects.
 * Every kind is unknown `gated` when that is no app page, or the page has no app name.
 * A kind that cannot be read from the page is unknown `missing`.
 */
export function parseAppPage(doc: Document, finalUrl: string): KindVerdicts {
  if (!isAppPage(finalUrl)) {
    return UNKNOWN_KINDS.gated;
  }
  const name = trimNotes(doc.querySelector(NAME_SELECTOR)?.textContent ?? "");
  if (name === "") {
    return UNKNOWN_KINDS.gated;
  }
  const verdicts: Partial<Record<KindId, KindVerdict>> = {};
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    verdicts[kind.id] = kind.fromAppPage?.(doc, name) ?? UNKNOWN.missing;
  }
  return isKindVerdicts(verdicts) ? verdicts : UNKNOWN_KINDS.error;
}

/**
 * The verdicts of the app page the user is on, with no request. It answers only when the page is
 * English, because the notes of a localized page would be labelled as English; otherwise undefined.
 */
export function parseLiveAppPage(doc: Document, pageUrl: string): KindVerdicts | undefined {
  return steamLanguage(doc.documentElement.lang) === "english"
    ? parseAppPage(doc, pageUrl)
    : undefined;
}

export function appPageUrl(id: AppId): string {
  return `${APP_PAGE_ORIGIN}/app/${id}/?l=english`;
}

function verdictsOf(
  result: HttpResult,
  parse: (body: string, url: string) => KindVerdicts,
): KindVerdicts {
  switch (result.kind) {
    case "response":
      if (result.status === HTTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS) {
        return UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"];
      }
      return result.status === HTTP_OK ? parse(result.body, result.url) : UNKNOWN_KINDS.error;
    case "failed":
      return UNKNOWN_KINDS.error;
    case "withheld":
      return UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"];
  }
}

/** The app page the visitor has open: its verdicts are in the document, so no request is needed. */
export interface OpenPage {
  readonly id: AppId;
  readonly verdicts: KindVerdicts;
}

/**
 * The HTML detector: one request per app, one after another, except for the open page, which it
 * reads from the document. Spacing, the per-page budget and the breaker come from the `Http` it is
 * given (a throttling decorator) or from a chain around it.
 */
export function createAppPageDetector(http: Http, open?: OpenPage): Detector {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const parse = (body: string, url: string): KindVerdicts =>
    parseAppPage(parser.parseFromString(body, "text/html"), url);
  return {
    async detect(ids: readonly AppId[]): Promise<ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>> {
      const verdicts = new Map<AppId, KindVerdicts>();
      for (const id of new Set(ids)) {
        if (id === open?.id) {
          verdicts.set(id, open.verdicts);
          continue;
        }
        // Sequential on purpose: one request in flight (rule 13).
        verdicts.set(id, verdictsOf(await http.get(appPageUrl(id)), parse));
      }
      return verdicts;
    },
  };
}
```
