```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { httpResult, type Reply } from "../../../tests/helpers/fake-http";
import { fixedClock } from "../../../tests/helpers/fixed-clock";
import { englishI18n } from "../../../tests/helpers/i18n";
import { memoryStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/memory-store";
import { recordingLogger } from "../../../tests/helpers/recording-logger";
import type { JsonValue } from "../json";
import type { HttpResult, KeyValueStore } from "../ports";
import {
  API_BREAKER_KEY,
  type BreakerOptions,
  createBreaker,
  HTML_BREAKER_KEY,
  tripsBreaker,
} from "./breaker";

const T0 = 1_000_000;
const i18n = englishI18n();
const URL = "https://api.steampowered.com/IStoreBrowseService/GetItems/v1";

function result(reply: Reply): HttpResult {
  return httpResult(reply, URL);
}

function setup(overrides: Partial<BreakerOptions> = {}) {
  const clock = fixedClock(T0);
  const store = memoryStore();
  const { logger, sink } = recordingLogger();
  const options: BreakerOptions = {
    store,
    clock,
    logger,
    key: API_BREAKER_KEY,
    random: () => 0.5,
    ...overrides,
  };
  return { clock, store, sink, options, breaker: createBreaker(options) };
}

/** A store whose every call rejects, like storage that is full or gone. */
const brokenStore: KeyValueStore = {
  get: () => Promise.reject(new Error()),
  set: () => Promise.reject(new Error()),
  remove: () => Promise.reject(new Error()),
  keys: () => Promise.reject(new Error()),
};

describe("tripsBreaker", () => {
  it.each(
    [
      [{ status: 429 }, true],
      [{ status: 500 }, true],
      [{ status: 503 }, true],
      [{ status: 599 }, true],
      ["network-error", true],
      [{ status: 200 }, false],
      [{ status: 400 }, false],
      [{ status: 404 }, false],
    ] as const,
  )("%j trips: %s", (reply, trips) => {
    expect(tripsBreaker(result(reply))).toBe(trips);
  });

  it("does not trip on a withheld request", () => {
    expect(tripsBreaker({ kind: "withheld" })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("createBreaker", () => {
  it("starts closed and stays closed on answers that do not trip it", async () => {
    const { breaker, store } = setup();
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(false);
    await breaker.record(result({ status: 200 }));
    await breaker.record(result({ status: 404 }));
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(false);
    expect(await store.keys()).toStrictEqual([]);
  });

  it("opens on a 429 for 60 s plus jitter, then closes", async () => {
    const { breaker, clock, store, sink } = setup();
    await breaker.record(result({ status: 429 }));
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(true);
    expect(await store.get([API_BREAKER_KEY])).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[API_BREAKER_KEY, { until: T0 + 65_000 }]]),
    );
    expect(sink.warn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      "[sar]",
      i18n.t("warn_breaker_opened", { seconds: "65", breaker: API_BREAKER_KEY }),
    );
    clock.advance(64_999);
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(true);
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(false);
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(false);
    expect(sink.info).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(sink.info).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      "[sar]",
      i18n.t("notice_breaker_closed", { breaker: API_BREAKER_KEY }),
    );
  });

  it.each([[0, 60_000], [0.999_99, 69_999]])("with random %d pauses %d ms", async (r, ms) => {
    const { breaker, clock } = setup({ random: () => r });
    await breaker.record(result("network-error"));
    clock.advance(ms - 1);
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(true);
    clock.advance(1);
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("opens on a TypeError from fetch and on a 5xx", async () => {
    const failed = setup();
    await failed.breaker.record({ kind: "failed", cause: new TypeError() });
    expect(await failed.breaker.isOpen()).toBe(true);
    const server = setup();
    await server.breaker.record(result({ status: 503 }));
    expect(await server.breaker.isOpen()).toBe(true);
  });

  it("is honored by a new instance reading the same store, as in another tab", async () => {
    const { breaker, options, clock } = setup();
    await breaker.record(result({ status: 429 }));
    const otherTab = createBreaker({ ...options, logger: recordingLogger().logger });
    expect(await otherTab.isOpen()).toBe(true);
    clock.advance(65_000);
    expect(await otherTab.isOpen()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("keeps the API and HTML breakers apart", async () => {
    const { breaker, options } = setup();
    await breaker.record(result({ status: 429 }));
    expect(await createBreaker({ ...options, key: HTML_BREAKER_KEY }).isOpen()).toBe(false);
  });

  it.each<[string, JsonValue]>([
    ["a string", "open"],
    ["a non-numeric until", { until: "later" }],
    ["a fractional until", { until: T0 + 0.5 }],
    ["an until beyond the longest pause", { until: T0 + 70_001 }],
  ])("ignores a stored value with %s", async (_, value) => {
    const { options } = setup();
    await options.store.set(new Map([[API_BREAKER_KEY, value]]));
    expect(await createBreaker(options).isOpen()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("works on this tab's state when storage fails, without rejecting", async () => {
    const { breaker } = setup({ store: brokenStore });
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(false);
    await expect(breaker.record(result({ status: 429 }))).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    expect(await breaker.isOpen()).toBe(true);
  });

  it("never shortens a pause when it trips again", async () => {
    const jitter = [0.999_99, 0];
    const { breaker, clock, store } = setup({ random: () => jitter.shift() ?? 0 });
    await breaker.record(result({ status: 429 }));
    clock.advance(1_000);
    await breaker.record(result({ status: 429 }));
    expect(await store.get([API_BREAKER_KEY])).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[API_BREAKER_KEY, { until: T0 + 69_999 }]]),
    );
  });
});
```

`src/core/detect/breaker.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import type { Logger } from "../log";
import type { Clock, HttpResult, KeyValueStore } from "../ports";

// The circuit breaker that pauses detection after Steam refuses a request (ADR 0001, rq6 S1).
// `Retry-After` is not readable cross-origin, so the pause is always the fixed backoff below.

/** Where the GetItems breaker is stored; other tabs read it, so all of them pause together. */
export const API_BREAKER_KEY = "v1:breaker";
/** The HTML fallback's own breaker, so a refused app page does not pause GetItems. */
export const HTML_BREAKER_KEY = "v1:breaker:html";

const HTTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS = 429;
const HTTP_SERVER_ERROR = 500;
const HTTP_MAX_STATUS = 599;
const MS_PER_SECOND = 1000;

export interface Backoff {
  /** The fixed part of the pause. */
  readonly baseMs: number;
  /** The most random jitter added to it, so tabs and users do not retry in step. */
  readonly jitterMs: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_BACKOFF: Backoff = { baseMs: 60_000, jitterMs: 10_000 };

/**
 * Whether a result trips the breaker: a 429, a 5xx, or no readable answer. A failed request counts
 * like a 429 because Steam's error answers carry no CORS headers and reach `fetch` as a bare
 * `TypeError` (rq6, S1). A withheld request was never sent, so it trips nothing.
 */
export function tripsBreaker(result: HttpResult): boolean {
  switch (result.kind) {
    case "response":
      return result.status === HTTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS
        || (result.status >= HTTP_SERVER_ERROR && result.status <= HTTP_MAX_STATUS);
    case "failed":
      return true;
    case "withheld":
      return false;
  }
}

const StoredBreakerSchema = v.object({ until: v.pipe(v.number(), v.safeInteger()) });

/**
 * A persisted circuit breaker. Both methods never reject: when storage fails, the breaker keeps
 * working on what this tab knows.
 */
export interface Breaker {
  /** Whether requests are held back now, by this tab's state or by another tab's. */
  isOpen(): Promise<boolean>;
  /** Opens the breaker when `result` trips it; any other result changes nothing. */
  record(result: HttpResult): Promise<void>;
}

export interface BreakerOptions {
  readonly store: KeyValueStore;
  readonly clock: Clock;
  readonly logger: Logger;
  /** The storage key, `API_BREAKER_KEY` or `HTML_BREAKER_KEY`. */
  readonly key: string;
  readonly backoff?: Backoff;
  /** A number in [0, 1); `Math.random` unless a test fixes it. */
  readonly random?: () => number;
}

/**
 * A circuit breaker persisted as `{ until }` (epoch milliseconds) under its key. Open means
 * `now < until`. There is no half-open probe count: once the pause is over the next request goes
 * out, and a new trip opens the breaker again. An expired value is left in place rather than
 * removed, because removing could race with another tab that just opened it.
 */
export function createBreaker(options: BreakerOptions): Breaker {
  const { store, clock, logger, key } = options;
  const backoff = options.backoff ?? DEFAULT_BACKOFF;
  const random = options.random ?? Math.random;
  const longest = backoff.baseMs + backoff.jitterMs;
  /** This tab's own pause, which holds even when storage cannot be read or written. */
  let localUntil = 0;
  let open = false;

  /** Another tab's pause. Values out of range (corrupt, or a clock moved back) are ignored. */
  async function storedUntil(now: number): Promise<number> {
    try {
      const parsed = v.safeParse(StoredBreakerSchema, (await store.get([key])).get(key));
      return parsed.success && parsed.output.until <= now + longest ? parsed.output.until : 0;
    } catch {
      return 0;
    }
  }

  return {
    async isOpen() {
      const now = clock.now();
      const until = Math.max(localUntil, await storedUntil(now));
      const nowOpen = now < until;
      if (open && !nowOpen) {
        logger.info("notice_breaker_closed", { breaker: key });
      }
      open = nowOpen;
      return nowOpen;
    },

    async record(result) {
      if (!tripsBreaker(result)) {
        return;
      }
      const now = clock.now();
      const pauseMs = backoff.baseMs + Math.floor(random() * backoff.jitterMs);
      const until = Math.max(localUntil, now + pauseMs);
      localUntil = until;
      open = true;
      logger.warn("warn_breaker_opened", {
        seconds: String(Math.ceil((until - now) / MS_PER_SECOND)),
        breaker: key,
      });
      try {
        await store.set(new Map([[key, { until }]]));
      } catch {
        // This tab still honors `localUntil`; other tabs find out from their own requests.
      }
    },
  };
}
```

`src/core/detect/budget.ts`:

```ts
import { type KindVerdicts, UNKNOWN_KINDS } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Detector } from "../ports";
import type { AppId } from "../types";
import { settle } from "./settle";

/** HTML fallback apps per page view (ADR 0001): each one is a full app page request. */
export const DEFAULT_HTML_BUDGET = 10;

/**
 * A `Detector` decorator that passes at most `limit` IDs to `inner` over its lifetime, which is
 * one page view: the composition root builds one per page. IDs past the budget get unknown
 * `rate-limited`, which is kept in page memory only, so a later page view can try them again.
 * Pacing comes from the throttled `Http` that `inner` is built on.
 */
export function createBudgetDetector(inner: Detector, limit = DEFAULT_HTML_BUDGET): Detector {
  let left = limit;
  return {
    async detect(ids) {
      const distinct = [...new Set(ids)];
      const allowed = distinct.slice(0, Math.max(left, 0));
      left -= allowed.length;
      const verdicts = new Map<AppId, KindVerdicts>(
        distinct.slice(allowed.length).map((id): [AppId, KindVerdicts] => [
          id,
          UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"],
        ]),
      );
      if (allowed.length > 0) {
        for (const [id, found] of await settle(inner, allowed)) {
          verdicts.set(id, found);
        }
      }
      return verdicts;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
  kind: "ai",

  return fakeDetector(() => UNKNOWN_KINDS.missing);
}

/**
 * A stand-in for the HTML fallback detector, built in its own step: one app page request per ID,
 * all sent at once (the worst case for pacing). 200 is not disclosed; withheld is rate-limited.
 */
function pageDetector(http: Http): Detector {
  return {
    async detect(ids) {
      const distinct = [...new Set(ids)];
      const results = await Promise.all(distinct.map((id) => http.get(`${PAGE}${String(id)}/`)));
      return new Map(
        distinct.map((id, index): [AppId, KindVerdicts] => {
          const result = results[index];
          if (result?.kind === "withheld") {
            return [id, UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"]];
          }
          return [
            id,
            result?.kind === "response" && result.status === 200
              ? NOT_DISCLOSED
              : UNKNOWN_KINDS.error,
          ];
        }),
      );
    },
  };
}

    const clock = useTimerClock();
    const server = fakeHttp(routes);
    const sent: number[] = [];
    const timed: Http = {
      get(url) {
        sent.push(clock.now() - T0);
        return server.get(url);
      },
    };
    const breaker = createBreaker({
      store: memoryStore(),
      clock,
      logger: recordingLogger().logger,
      key: HTML_BREAKER_KEY,
      random: () => 0,
    });
    const html = pageDetector(createThrottledHttp({ http: timed, breaker, clock }));
    const chain = createChainDetector([allMissing(), createBudgetDetector(html)]);
    return { chain, server, sent };
  }

  it("fetches at most 10 app pages per page view, one at a time, 1 s apart", async () => {
    const { chain, server, sent } = setup([[PAGE, { status: 200 }]]);
    const first = chain.detect(ids);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(20_000);
    const verdicts = await first;
    expect(sent).toStrictEqual(Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => index * 1_000));
    expect(server.maxInFlight).toBe(1);
    const states = [...verdicts.values()];
    expect(states.filter((verdict) => verdict === NOT_DISCLOSED)).toHaveLength(10);
    expect(states.filter((verdict) => verdict === UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"])).toHaveLength(5);

    // The budget is spent for this page view: later scans send nothing.
    const later = chain.detect(appIds(5_000_000));
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(5_000);
    expect(await later).toStrictEqual(new Map([[appId(5_000_000), UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"]]]));
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(10);
  });

  it("stops at the first 429 from an app page", async () => {
    const { chain, sent } = setup([[PAGE, { status: 429 }]]);
    const pending = chain.detect(ids);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(20_000);
    const verdicts = await pending;
    expect(sent).toStrictEqual([0]);
    expect([...verdicts.values()].filter((v) => v === UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"])).toHaveLength(
      14,
    );
  });
});
```

`src/core/detect/chain.ts`:

```ts
import { KINDS } from "../kinds/registry";
import { type KindVerdicts, UNKNOWN_KINDS } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Detector } from "../ports";
import type { AppId } from "../types";
import { settle } from "./settle";

/** Only Steam having no usable item, so that no kind has an answer, is worth a second source. */
function passesOn(verdicts: KindVerdicts): boolean {
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    const verdict = verdicts[kind.id];
    if (verdict.state !== "unknown" || verdict.reason !== "missing") {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * A `Detector` over an ordered list of links, such as GetItems and then the HTML fallback. Each
 * link gets only the IDs the links before it left as unknown `missing`; a link is not called when
 * none are left. Any other verdict, unknown `error` and `rate-limited` included, is final, so an
 * outage or a pause of one source does not move its load onto the next. New sources are new
 * links; this module is not edited for them.
 */
export function createChainDetector(links: readonly Detector[]): Detector {
  return {
    async detect(ids) {
      let pending: readonly AppId[] = [...new Set(ids)];
      // What no link has answered yet is unknown `missing`, so an empty chain still answers.
      const verdicts = new Map(
        pending.map((id): [AppId, KindVerdicts] => [id, UNKNOWN_KINDS.missing]),
      );
      for (const link of links) {
        if (pending.length === 0) {
          break;
        }
        // Sequential on purpose: each link sees only what the one before it could not settle.
        const next: AppId[] = [];
        for (const [id, found] of await settle(link, pending)) {
          verdicts.set(id, found);
          if (passesOn(found)) {
            next.push(id);
          }
        }
        pending = next;
      }
      return verdicts;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { detectorContract } from "../../../tests/contracts/detector.contract";

const NOT_DISCLOSED = aiVerdicts({ state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" });

detectorContract(
  "createDedupingDetector",
  () => createDedupingDetector(fakeDetector(() => NOT_DISCLOSED)),

  "createDedupingDetector over a rejecting detector",
  () => createDedupingDetector({ detect: () => Promise.reject(new Error()) }),

/** A detector whose single call answers only when the test says so. */
function heldDetector() {
  const calls: (readonly AppId[])[] = [];
  let release = (): void => undefined;
  const detector: Detector = {
    async detect(ids) {
      calls.push(ids);
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        release = resolve;
      });
      return new Map(ids.map((id): [AppId, KindVerdicts] => [id, NOT_DISCLOSED]));
    },
  };
  const releaseNow = (): void => {
    release();
  };
  return { detector, calls, release: releaseNow };
}

describe("createDedupingDetector", () => {
  it("costs one GetItems request for one ID asked for twice in the same tick", async () => {
    const http = fakeHttp([getItemsRoute([storeItem(413150)])]);
    const detector = createDedupingDetector(createGetItemsDetector({ http, language: "english" }));
    const [first, second] = await Promise.all([
      detector.detect(appIds(413150)),
      detector.detect(appIds(413150)),
    ]);
    expect(http.calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(first.get(appId(413150))?.ai).toStrictEqual({ state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" });
    expect(second).toStrictEqual(first);
  });

  it("merges the IDs of one tick into one call and answers each caller its own", async () => {
    const http = fakeHttp([getItemsRoute([storeItem(1), storeItem(2), storeItem(3)])]);
    const detector = createDedupingDetector(createGetItemsDetector({ http, language: "english" }));
    const [left, right] = await Promise.all([
      detector.detect(appIds(1, 2)),
      detector.detect(appIds(2, 3, 3)),
    ]);
    expect(http.calls.map((url) => getItemsRequest(url).ids)).toStrictEqual([[1, 2, 3]]);
    expect([...left.keys()]).toStrictEqual(appIds(1, 2));
    expect([...right.keys()]).toStrictEqual(appIds(2, 3));
  });

  it("lets a later request wait for an ID still in flight", async () => {
    const held = heldDetector();
    const detector = createDedupingDetector(held.detector);
    const first = detector.detect(appIds(1));
    await Promise.resolve();
    await Promise.resolve();
    const second = detector.detect(appIds(1));
    await Promise.resolve();
    held.release();
    expect(await second).toStrictEqual(await first);
    expect(held.calls).toStrictEqual([appIds(1)]);
  });

  it("asks again once the earlier call has settled", async () => {
    const inner = fakeDetector(() => NOT_DISCLOSED);
    const detector = createDedupingDetector(inner);
    await detector.detect(appIds(1));
    await detector.detect(appIds(1));
    expect(inner.calls).toStrictEqual([appIds(1), appIds(1)]);
  });

  it("answers unknown error when the inner detector rejects", async () => {
    const detector = createDedupingDetector({ detect: () => Promise.reject(new Error()) });
    expect(await detector.detect(appIds(9))).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[appId(9), UNKNOWN_KINDS.error]]),
    );
  });
});
```

`src/core/detect/dedupe.ts`:

```ts
import { type KindVerdicts, UNKNOWN_KINDS } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Detector } from "../ports";
import type { AppId } from "../types";
import { settle } from "./settle";

type Answer = Promise<ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>>;

/** The IDs asked for in the current tick, and the one call that will answer them. */
interface Tick {
  readonly ids: AppId[];
  readonly answer: Answer;
}

function nextMicrotask(): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    queueMicrotask(resolve);
  });
}

/**
 * A `Detector` decorator that deduplicates in-flight IDs. IDs asked for in the same tick, by any
 * number of `detect` calls, go to `inner` in one call, so one ID asked for twice costs one
 * request; an ID asked for while its call is still running waits for that call instead of
 * starting another. Once a call settles its IDs are forgotten: remembering verdicts is the
 * cache's job. Memory is bounded by the IDs in flight.
 */
export function createDedupingDetector(inner: Detector): Detector {
  const inFlight = new Map<AppId, Answer>();
  let tick: Tick | undefined;

  async function flush(ids: readonly AppId[]): Answer {
    await nextMicrotask();
    tick = undefined;
    const verdicts = await settle(inner, ids);
    for (const id of ids) {
      inFlight.delete(id);
    }
    return verdicts;
  }

  function answerFor(id: AppId): Answer {
    const running = inFlight.get(id);
    if (running !== undefined) {
      return running;
    }
    if (tick === undefined) {
      const ids: AppId[] = [];
      tick = { ids, answer: flush(ids) };
    }
    tick.ids.push(id);
    inFlight.set(id, tick.answer);
    return tick.answer;
  }

  return {
    async detect(ids) {
      const distinct = [...new Set(ids)];
      const answers = new Set(distinct.map(answerFor));
      const found = new Map<AppId, KindVerdicts>();
      for (const verdicts of await Promise.all(answers)) {
        for (const [id, verdict] of verdicts) {
          found.set(id, verdict);
        }
      }
      // A shared call may also hold other callers' IDs; answer only the requested ones.
      return new Map(
        distinct.map((id): [AppId, KindVerdicts] => [id, found.get(id) ?? UNKNOWN_KINDS.error]),
      );
    },
  };
}

```

`src/core/detect/getitems.kinds.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import kinds from "../../../tests/fixtures/getitems/kinds.json";
import { appId, appIds } from "../../../tests/helpers/app-ids";
import { httpResult } from "../../../tests/helpers/fake-http";
import { fixtureItems, getItemsResponse, storeItem } from "../../../tests/helpers/getitems";
import { KIND_IDS } from "../kinds/id";
import { perKind } from "../kinds/registry";
import { type KindVerdicts, UNKNOWN_KINDS } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import { GETITEMS_URL, parseGetItems } from "./getitems";

// Every kind derived from the batch captured for the tag kinds (tests/fixtures/README.md).
const DECLARING = [3751950, 2807960, 1808500, 730, 570, 105600, 1245620, 1172470, 271590];
// Games from 2004 to 2024 that declare nothing, and have no PvP category.
const NOTHING = [813230, 1145360, 413150, 504230, 367520, 2379780, 620];
const IDS = [...DECLARING, ...NOTHING];
const OTHER_ITEMS = [320795, 1, 99999999];

const verdicts = parseGetItems(
  appIds(...IDS, ...OTHER_ITEMS),
  httpResult(getItemsResponse(fixtureItems(kinds)), GETITEMS_URL),
  "english",
);

function of(id: number): KindVerdicts {
  const found = verdicts.get(appId(id));
  if (found === undefined) {
    throw new TypeError();
  }
  return found;
}

/** The state of each kind, with the reason for unknown. */
function states(id: number): Readonly<Record<string, string>> {
  const found = of(id);
  return perKind((kind) => {
    const verdict = found[kind.id];
    return verdict.state === "unknown" ? `unknown:${verdict.reason}` : verdict.state;
  });
}

const NONE = {
  ai: "not-disclosed",
  kernel: "not-disclosed",
  anticheat: "not-disclosed",
  drm: "not-disclosed",
  account: "not-disclosed",
  eula: "not-disclosed",
  pvp: "not-disclosed",
};

describe("parseGetItems over the tag kind fixture", () => {
  it("answers every requested ID with a verdict for every kind", () => {
    expect(verdicts.size).toBe(IDS.length + OTHER_ITEMS.length);
    for (const found of verdicts.values()) {
      expect(Object.keys(found)).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
    }
  });

  it("reads DRM, account, EULA and a plain category list (3751950)", () => {
    expect(states(3751950)).toStrictEqual({
      ...NONE,
      drm: "disclosed",
      account: "disclosed",
      eula: "disclosed",
    });
    const found = of(3751950);
    expect(found.drm).toMatchObject({ text: "Denuvo Anti-tamper" });
    expect(found.drm).not.toHaveProperty("activationLimit");
    expect(found.account).toMatchObject({ text: "Ubisoft Account", linksToSteam: true });
    expect(found.eula).toMatchObject({
      items: [{
        name: "Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced EULA",
        url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/3751950_eula_0",
      }],
    });
  });

  it("reads a kernel anti-cheat with boot protection and no vendor name (2807960)", () => {
    expect(states(2807960)).toStrictEqual({
      ...NONE,
      kernel: "disclosed",
      account: "disclosed",
      eula: "disclosed",
      pvp: "disclosed",
    });
    const found = of(2807960);
    expect(found.kernel).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "kernel",
      source: "api",
      uninstallsCompletely: true,
      bootProtection: { token: "secureboot_tpm2" },
    });
    expect(found.account).toMatchObject({ text: "EA Account linking required" });
    expect(found.pvp).toMatchObject({ categoryIds: [49, 36] });
  });

  it("reads a kernel anti-cheat from Denuvo next to AI notes (1808500)", () => {
    expect(states(1808500)).toStrictEqual({
      ...NONE,
      ai: "disclosed",
      kernel: "disclosed",
      eula: "disclosed",
      pvp: "disclosed",
    });
    expect(of(1808500).kernel).toMatchObject({
      name: "Denuvo",
      nameToken: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_denuvo",
      uninstallsCompletely: false,
    });
  });

  it("reads a game that declares nothing as not disclosed for every kind", () => {
    for (const id of NOTHING) {
      expect(states(id)).toStrictEqual(NONE);
    }
  });

  it("reads the VAC anti-cheat of Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 as non-kernel (730, 570)", () => {
    for (const id of [730, 570]) {
      expect(states(id)).toStrictEqual({ ...NONE, anticheat: "disclosed" });
      expect(of(id).anticheat).toMatchObject({
        name: "VAC (Valve Anti-Cheat)",
        nameToken: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_vac",
      });
    }
  });

  it("reads PvP from the categories and nothing else (105600, 1245620)", () => {
    expect(states(105600)).toStrictEqual({ ...NONE, pvp: "disclosed" });
    expect(of(105600).pvp).toMatchObject({ categoryIds: [49, 36] });
    expect(states(1245620)).toStrictEqual({ ...NONE, eula: "disclosed", pvp: "disclosed" });
    expect(of(1245620).eula).toMatchObject({
      items: [{ name: "ELDEN RING EULA" }, { name: "ELDEN RING EULA (JP)" }],
    });
  });

  it("reads Apex Legends and a delisted game like any other (1172470, 271590)", () => {
    for (const id of [1172470, 271590]) {
      expect(states(id)).toStrictEqual({
        ...NONE,
        kernel: "disclosed",
        account: "disclosed",
        eula: "disclosed",
        pvp: "disclosed",
      });
    }
    expect(of(1172470).kernel).toMatchObject({ name: "Easy Anti-Cheat" });
    expect(of(271590).kernel).toMatchObject({ name: "BattlEye" });
  });

  it("is unknown missing for a package, a bundle and an ID that does not exist", () => {
    // The package has categories but no extra_details, so even PvP stays unknown.
    for (const id of OTHER_ITEMS) {
      expect(of(id)).toBe(UNKNOWN_KINDS.missing);
    }
  });
});

describe("parseGetItems with one malformed field", () => {
  function parse(item: unknown): KindVerdicts {
    const id = appId(1);
    const found = parseGetItems([id], httpResult(getItemsResponse([item]), GETITEMS_URL), "english")
      .get(id);
    if (found === undefined) {
      throw new TypeError();
    }
    return found;
  }

  const FULL = {
    content_survey_ai_notes: "Art.",
    anticheat: { kernel_mode: true },
    drm_third_party_type: "Denuvo",
    user_account_third_party: "EA",
    eula: [{ name: "Game terms", url: "https://store.steampowered.com//eula/1_eula_0" }],
  };

  function disclosedKinds(found: KindVerdicts): readonly string[] {
    return KIND_IDS.filter((id) => found[id].state === "disclosed");
  }

  it("costs only the kinds that read the field", () => {
    const cases: readonly (readonly [string, unknown, readonly string[]])[] = [
      ["content_survey_ai_notes", 5, ["ai"]],
      ["anticheat", "kernel", ["kernel", "anticheat"]],
      ["drm_third_party_type", 5, ["drm"]],
      ["user_account_third_party", 5, ["account"]],
      ["eula", "none", ["eula"]],
    ];
    for (const [field, value, lost] of cases) {
      const found = parse(storeItem(1, {
        categories: { supported_player_categoryids: [49] },
        extra_details: { ...FULL, [field]: value },
      }));
      const broken = KIND_IDS.filter((id) => {
        const verdict = found[id];
        return verdict.state === "unknown" && verdict.reason === "malformed";
      });
      expect(broken).toStrictEqual(KIND_IDS.filter((id) => lost.includes(id)));
      expect(disclosedKinds(found)).toStrictEqual(
        ["ai", "kernel", "drm", "account", "eula", "pvp"].filter((id) => !lost.includes(id)),
      );
    }
  });

  it("costs only PvP when the categories are malformed", () => {
    const found = parse(storeItem(1, { categories: "co-op", extra_details: FULL }));
    expect(found.pvp).toStrictEqual({ state: "unknown", reason: "malformed" });
    expect(disclosedKinds(found)).toStrictEqual(["ai", "kernel", "drm", "account", "eula"]);
  });

  it("reads an empty list for extra_details as an object that declares nothing", () => {
    const categories = { supported_player_categoryids: [2] };
    const found = parse(storeItem(1, { extra_details: [], categories }));
    expect(disclosedKinds(found)).toStrictEqual([]);
    for (const id of KIND_IDS) {
      expect(found[id].state).toBe("not-disclosed");
    }
  });

  it("keeps the item-level rule: no extra_details is unknown for every kind", () => {
    const categories = { supported_player_categoryids: [49] };
    expect(parse(storeItem(1, { extra_details: undefined, categories }))).toBe(
      UNKNOWN_KINDS.missing,
    );
  });
});
```

```ts
    }

  describe("size caps", () => {

    const list = (length: number) => Array.from({ length }, () => ({ name: "Agreement" }));

    it("allows a developer string of 4,000 characters and marks a longer one malformed", () => {
      expect(MAX_TEXT_LENGTH).toBe(4000);
      const read = (value: string) =>
        detailsOf(storeItem(1, {

        }));
      expect(read(text(4000)).drm_third_party_type).toBe(text(4000));
      expect(read(text(4000)).user_account_third_party).toBe(text(4000));
      expect(read(text(4001)).drm_third_party_type).toBe(MALFORMED);
      expect(read(text(4001)).user_account_third_party).toBe(MALFORMED);
    });

    it("applies the cap to the AI notes, the store name and the EULA names", () => {
      expect(
        detailsOf(storeItem(1, { extra_details: { content_survey_ai_notes: text(4001) } }))
          .content_survey_ai_notes,
      ).toBe(MALFORMED);
      expect(parse(storeItem(1, { name: text(4001) })).name).toBe(MALFORMED);
      expect(parse(storeItem(1, { name: text(4000) })).name).toBe(text(4000));
      const eula = [{ name: text(4001) }];
      expect(detailsOf(storeItem(1, { extra_details: { eula } })).eula).toBe(MALFORMED);
    });

    it("reads an over-long enrichment string as absent", () => {
      const details = detailsOf(storeItem(1, {
        extra_details: { drm_activation_limit: text(4001), anticheat: { name: text(4001) } },
      }));
      expect(details.drm_activation_limit).toBeUndefined();
      expect(details.anticheat).toStrictEqual({ name: undefined });
    });

    it("allows 50 EULA entries and marks 51 malformed", () => {
      expect(MAX_LIST_LENGTH).toBe(50);
      const read = (eula: unknown) => detailsOf(storeItem(1, { extra_details: { eula } })).eula;
      expect(read(list(50))).toHaveLength(50);
      expect(read(list(51))).toBe(MALFORMED);
    });

    it("allows 50 category IDs and marks 51 malformed", () => {
      const read = (ids: readonly number[]) =>
        parse(storeItem(1, { categories: { supported_player_categoryids: ids } })).categories;
      expect(read(Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => i))).toMatchObject({
        supported_player_categoryids: { length: 50 },
      });
      expect(read(Array.from({ length: 51 }, (_, i) => i))).toBe(MALFORMED);
    });
  });

  it("drops the keys it does not read", () => {
    const details = detailsOf(storeItem(1, { extra_details: { has_community_hub: true } }));
    expect(details).not.toHaveProperty("has_community_hub");
  });
});
```

`src/core/detect/getitems.schema.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { AppIdSchema } from "../types";

// Schemas for the IStoreBrowseService/GetItems answer (ADR 0001, rq6 S2). They name only the
// fields the kinds read; valibot drops every other key. Each nested object is readonly, so the
// parsed data is deep readonly.

/**
 * The envelope. `store_items` entries stay `unknown` here and are validated one by one with
 * `StoreItemSchema`, so one malformed item does not discard the batch (rq7, S8).
 */
export const GetItemsEnvelopeSchema = v.pipe(
  v.object({
    response: v.pipe(
      v.object({
        store_items: v.exactOptional(v.pipe(v.array(v.unknown()), v.readonly())),
      }),
      v.readonly(),
    ),
  }),
  v.readonly(),
);

/** What a field holds when Steam sent it in the wrong shape. */
export const MALFORMED: unique symbol = Symbol("malformed");

/** The longest developer string a kind reads; a longer one is malformed. */
export const MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 4000;
/** The most entries a list a kind reads may have; a longer one is malformed. */
export const MAX_LIST_LENGTH = 50;

const MalformedSchema = v.pipe(v.unknown(), v.transform((): typeof MALFORMED => MALFORMED));
const DroppedSchema = v.pipe(v.unknown(), v.transform((): undefined => undefined));

const TextSchema = v.pipe(v.string(), v.maxLength(MAX_TEXT_LENGTH));

/** A list of at most `MAX_LIST_LENGTH` entries. */
function list<const TItem extends v.GenericSchema>(item: TItem) {
  return v.pipe(v.array(item), v.maxLength(MAX_LIST_LENGTH), v.readonly());
}

/**
 * A field that parses to its own value, or to `MALFORMED`. A kind answers unknown when a field it
 * reads is malformed. One bad field costs only the kinds that read it.
 */
function lenient<const TSchema extends v.GenericSchema>(schema: TSchema) {
  return v.exactOptional(v.union([schema, MalformedSchema]));
}

/** A field that only adds detail to a verdict. When malformed it reads as absent. */
function droppable<const TSchema extends v.GenericSchema>(schema: TSchema) {
  return v.exactOptional(v.union([schema, DroppedSchema]));
}

/** Steam's JSON has shown `[]` for an empty object, so an empty array stands for `{}`. */
function emptyArrayAsObject(input: unknown): unknown {
  return Array.isArray(input) && input.length === 0 ? {} : input;
}

/**
 * A readonly object schema. Unlike valibot's `object`, it takes no array as an object.
 * A list with entries in an object's place is malformed.
 */
function record<const TEntries extends v.ObjectEntries>(entries: TEntries) {
  return v.pipe(
    v.unknown(),
    v.transform(emptyArrayAsObject),
    v.check((input) => !Array.isArray(input)),
    v.object(entries),
    v.readonly(),
  );
}

const AnticheatSchema = record({
  kernel_mode: v.exactOptional(v.boolean()),
  uninstall_completely: droppable(v.boolean()),
  boot_protection: droppable(v.boolean()),
  name: droppable(TextSchema),
  name_loc: droppable(TextSchema),
  boot_protection_name: droppable(TextSchema),
});

const EulaEntrySchema = record({ name: TextSchema, url: v.exactOptional(TextSchema) });

const ExtraDetailsSchema = record({
  content_survey_ai_notes: lenient(TextSchema),
  ai_generation_service: lenient(record({ name: v.exactOptional(TextSchema) })),
  anticheat: lenient(AnticheatSchema),
  drm_third_party_type: lenient(TextSchema),
  drm_activation_limit: droppable(TextSchema),
  user_account_third_party: lenient(TextSchema),
  user_account_third_party_link_to_steam: droppable(v.boolean()),
  eula: lenient(list(EulaEntrySchema)),
});

const CategoriesSchema = record({
  supported_player_categoryids: v.exactOptional(list(v.number())),
});

/**
 * One store item. `id` echoes the requested ID; `appid` is 0 for invalid items and unused.
 * The name and the categories are lenient. An item without a valid `id`, `success` or
 * `extra_details` says nothing about any kind.
 */
export const StoreItemSchema = v.pipe(
  v.object({
    id: AppIdSchema,
    success: v.number(),
    name: lenient(TextSchema),
    categories: lenient(CategoriesSchema),
    extra_details: v.exactOptional(ExtraDetailsSchema),
  }),
  v.readonly(),
);

/**
 * Only the `id` of an item, to attribute an item that fails `StoreItemSchema` to its app, so that
 * app gets unknown `error` rather than `missing`.
 */
export const StoreItemIdSchema = v.object({ id: AppIdSchema });

export type GetItemsEnvelope = v.InferOutput<typeof GetItemsEnvelopeSchema>;
export type StoreItem = v.InferOutput<typeof StoreItemSchema>;
export type ExtraDetails = v.InferOutput<typeof ExtraDetailsSchema>;

```

```ts
import {
  createGetItemsDetector,
  DEFAULT_BATCH_LIMITS,
  GETITEMS_URL,
  getItemsUrl,
  parseGetItems,
  planBatches,

const URL_FOR_TESTS = `${GETITEMS_URL}?input_json=%7B%7D`;

function parse(
  ids: readonly AppId[],
  reply: Reply,
  language: SteamLanguage = "english",
): ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts> {
  return parseGetItems(ids, httpResult(reply, URL_FOR_TESTS), language);
}

function fixtureReply(fixture: unknown): Reply {
  return getItemsResponse(fixtureItems(fixture));
}

/** The state of the AI kind's verdict, with the reason for unknown. */
function stateOf(verdicts: ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>, id: number): string | undefined {
  const verdict = verdicts.get(appId(id))?.ai;
  return verdict?.state === "unknown" ? `unknown:${verdict.reason}` : verdict?.state;
}

function notesOf(verdicts: ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>, id: number): string | undefined {
  const verdict = verdicts.get(appId(id))?.ai;
  return verdict?.state === "disclosed" ? verdict.notes : undefined;
}

/** Seven-digit IDs, like current Steam apps. */
function sequentialIds(count: number): readonly AppId[] {
  return appIds(...Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => 4_000_000 + index));
}

describe("parseGetItems over the captured fixtures", () => {
  it("maps every item state in mixed-states.json", () => {
    const ids = appIds(5072580, 1808500, 1938090, 413150, 339800, 99999999, 50300);
    const verdicts = parse(ids, fixtureReply(mixed));
    expect(notesOf(verdicts, 5072580)).toMatch(/^Generative AI is used in both pre-generated/);
    expect(verdicts.get(appId(5072580))?.ai).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "ai",
      notes: notesOf(verdicts, 5072580),
      language: "english",
      service: "OpenAI API",
      name: "Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods",
      source: "api",
    });
    expect(notesOf(verdicts, 1808500)).toMatch(/^During the development process/);
    expect(verdicts.get(appId(1808500))?.ai).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "ai",
      notes: notesOf(verdicts, 1808500),
      language: "english",
      name: "ARC Raiders",
      source: "api",
    });
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 1938090)).toBe("disclosed");
    // Not disclosed: 413150 has no notes, 339800 has mature notes only, 50300 is delisted.
    for (const id of [413150, 339800, 50300]) {
      expect(verdicts.get(appId(id))?.ai).toStrictEqual({ state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" });
    }
    // Invalid ID: success 15, appid 0, no extra_details; keyed by the requested id.
    expect(verdicts.get(appId(99999999))).toBe(UNKNOWN_KINDS.missing);
    expect(verdicts.size).toBe(7);
  });

  it("keeps the requested language and the developer's translation (german-context.json)", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(appIds(1938090, 5072580), fixtureReply(german), "german");
    const cod = verdicts.get(appId(1938090))?.ai;
    expect(cod?.state === "disclosed" ? cod.language : undefined).toBe("german");
    expect(notesOf(verdicts, 1938090)).toMatch(/^Unser Team setzt generative KI-Tools ein/);
    // No German translation: Steam answers in English, still requested as german.
    const courage = verdicts.get(appId(5072580))?.ai;
    expect(courage?.state === "disclosed" ? courage.language : undefined).toBe("german");
    expect(notesOf(verdicts, 5072580)).toMatch(/^Generative AI is used/);
  });

  it("finds the 10 disclosures among 50 search rows (search-roguelike-50.json)", () => {
    const items = fixtureItems(roguelike);
    const ids = itemIds(items);
    const verdicts = parse(ids, fixtureReply(roguelike));
    const disclosed = [...verdicts].filter(([, verdict]) => verdict.ai.state === "disclosed");
    expect(disclosed.map(([id]) => id)).toStrictEqual([
      4461450,
      5269270,
      4829430,
      4431800,
      5245850,
      5000470,
      4529660,
      5383550,
      5271980,
      5081750,
    ]);
    expect([...verdicts.values()].filter((v) => v.ai.state === "not-disclosed")).toHaveLength(40);
    expect(notesOf(verdicts, 4431800)).toBe(
      "Partily AI Assets:\r\nWaifus\r\nBackgrounds\r\nMusics",
    );
    expect(notesOf(verdicts, 5269270)).toContain("\u200b\u200b");
    for (const [, verdict] of disclosed) {
      const notes = verdict.ai.state === "disclosed" ? verdict.ai.notes : "";
      expect(notes).toBe(notes.trim());
    }
  });

  it("treats the body without store_items as a batch error (empty-response.json)", () => {
    const reply: Reply = { body: JSON.stringify(empty), headers: { "x-eresult": "1" } };
    expect(parse(appIds(413150, 5072580), reply)).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[appId(413150), UNKNOWN_KINDS.error], [appId(5072580), UNKNOWN_KINDS.error]]),
    );
    const contextless: Reply = { body: JSON.stringify(empty), headers: { "x-eresult": "8" } };
    expect(stateOf(parse(appIds(413150), contextless), 413150)).toBe("unknown:error");
  });
});

describe("parseGetItems edge cases", () => {
  it("reads blank notes, U+200B included, as not disclosed", () => {
    const ids = appIds(1, 2, 3);
    const verdicts = parse(
      ids,
      getItemsResponse([
        disclosedItem(1, "   "),
        disclosedItem(2, "\u200b"),
        disclosedItem(3, "\r\n\u200b \t"),
      ]),
    );
    for (const id of [1, 2, 3]) {
      expect(stateOf(verdicts, id)).toBe("not-disclosed");
    }
  });

  it("keeps \\r\\n inside notes and trims the edges", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(appIds(1), getItemsResponse([disclosedItem(1, "\u200b A\r\n\r\nB \n")]));
    expect(notesOf(verdicts, 1)).toBe("A\r\n\r\nB");
  });

  it("names the service and the app only when they are not blank", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(
      appIds(1, 2),
      getItemsResponse([
        disclosedItem(1, "notes", " Midjourney "),
        storeItem(2, {
          name: " ",
          extra_details: { content_survey_ai_notes: "notes", ai_generation_service: {} },
        }),
      ]),
    );
    const named = verdicts.get(appId(1))?.ai;
    expect(named?.state === "disclosed" ? named.service : undefined).toBe("Midjourney");
    expect(verdicts.get(appId(2))?.ai).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "ai",
      notes: "notes",
      language: "english",
      source: "api",
    });
  });

  it("gives every registered kind a verdict for each requested ID", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(
      appIds(1, 2, 3),
      getItemsResponse([disclosedItem(1, "notes"), storeItem(2)]),
    );
    expect(verdicts.size).toBe(3);
    for (const found of verdicts.values()) {
      expect(Object.keys(found)).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
    }
  });

  it("reads an item without extra_details as unknown missing", () => {
    const item = storeItem(1, { extra_details: undefined });
    expect(stateOf(parse(appIds(1), getItemsResponse([item])), 1)).toBe("unknown:missing");
  });

  it("keys an invalid item (success 15, appid 0) by its id", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(appIds(99999999), getItemsResponse([invalidItem(99999999)]));
    expect([...verdicts]).toStrictEqual([[99999999, UNKNOWN_KINDS.missing]]);
  });

  it("reads a requested ID without an item as unknown missing", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(appIds(1, 2), getItemsResponse([disclosedItem(1, "notes")]));
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 2)).toBe("unknown:missing");
  });

  it("gives unknown to an item with wrong field types, and keeps the rest", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(
      appIds(1, 2, 3, 4),
      getItemsResponse([
        storeItem(1, { success: "1" }),
        storeItem(2, { extra_details: { content_survey_ai_notes: 42 } }),
        storeItem(3, { extra_details: "none" }),
        disclosedItem(4, "notes"),
      ]),
    );
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 1)).toBe("unknown:error");
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 2)).toBe("unknown:malformed");
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 3)).toBe("unknown:error");
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 4)).toBe("disclosed");
  });

  it("reads unmatched IDs as unknown error when an item's id is unreadable", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(
      appIds(1, 2, 3),
      getItemsResponse([disclosedItem(1, "notes"), storeItem(2, { id: "2" }), null]),
    );
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 1)).toBe("disclosed");
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 2)).toBe("unknown:error");
    expect(stateOf(verdicts, 3)).toBe("unknown:error");
  });

  it("ignores items for IDs that were not requested, and repeated items", () => {
    const verdicts = parse(
      appIds(1),
      getItemsResponse([storeItem(7), disclosedItem(1, "first"), disclosedItem(1, "second")]),
    );
    expect([...verdicts.keys()]).toStrictEqual([1]);
    expect(notesOf(verdicts, 1)).toBe("first");
  });

  it("treats x-eresult other than 1 as a batch error", () => {
    const reply = getItemsResponse([disclosedItem(1, "notes")], { eresult: "8" });
    expect(stateOf(parse(appIds(1), reply), 1)).toBe("unknown:error");
  });

  it("accepts an answer whose x-eresult header is not exposed", () => {
    const reply = getItemsResponse([disclosedItem(1, "notes")], { eresult: null });
    expect(stateOf(parse(appIds(1), reply), 1)).toBe("disclosed");
  });

  it("treats a missing store_items, bad JSON or a wrong envelope as a batch error", () => {
    const ids = appIds(1, 2);
    for (
      const reply of [
        getItemsResponse(undefined),
        { body: "{" },
        { body: "null" },
        { body: JSON.stringify({ response: { store_items: {} } }) },
        { body: JSON.stringify({ store_items: [disclosedItem(1, "notes")] }) },
      ]
    ) {
      const verdicts = parse(ids, reply);
      expect([...verdicts.values()]).toStrictEqual([UNKNOWN_KINDS.error, UNKNOWN_KINDS.error]);
    }
  });

  it("maps statuses: 429 to rate-limited, any other non-200 to error", () => {
    const ok = [disclosedItem(1, "notes")];
    expect(stateOf(parse(appIds(1), getItemsResponse(ok, { status: 429 })), 1)).toBe(
      "unknown:rate-limited",
    );
    for (const status of [400, 404, 414, 500, 503]) {
      expect(stateOf(parse(appIds(1), getItemsResponse(ok, { status })), 1)).toBe("unknown:error");
    }
  });

  it("maps a failed request to error and a withheld one to rate-limited", () => {
    const ids = appIds(1);
    expect(parseGetItems(ids, { kind: "failed", cause: new TypeError() }, "english")).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[appId(1), UNKNOWN_KINDS.error]]),
    );
    expect(parseGetItems(ids, { kind: "withheld" }, "english")).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[appId(1), UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"]]]),
    );
  });
});

describe("planBatches", () => {
  it("removes duplicate IDs and keeps the first-seen order", () => {
    const batches = planBatches(appIds(3, 1, 3, 2, 1), "english");
    expect(batches.map(({ ids }) => ids)).toStrictEqual([[3, 1, 2]]);
  });

  it("sends at most 50 IDs per request", () => {
    const batches = planBatches(sequentialIds(120), "english");
    expect(batches.map(({ ids }) => ids.length)).toStrictEqual([50, 50, 20]);
    expect(Math.max(...batches.map(({ url }) => url.length))).toBeLessThan(
      DEFAULT_BATCH_LIMITS.maxUrlLength,
    );
  });

  it("splits a batch whose URL would pass the length guard", () => {
    const ids = sequentialIds(10);
    const maxUrlLength = getItemsUrl(ids.slice(0, 3), "english").length;
    const batches = planBatches(ids, "english", { maxIds: 50, maxUrlLength });
    expect(batches.map((batch) => batch.ids.length)).toStrictEqual([3, 3, 3, 1]);
    for (const batch of batches) {
      expect(batch.url).toBe(getItemsUrl(batch.ids, "english"));
      expect(batch.url.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(maxUrlLength);
    }
  });

  it("still sends a single ID whose URL is over the guard", () => {
    const batches = planBatches(appIds(5072580), "english", { maxIds: 50, maxUrlLength: 10 });
    expect(batches.map(({ ids }) => ids)).toStrictEqual([[5072580]]);
  });

  it("plans nothing for no IDs", () => {
    expect(planBatches([], "english")).toStrictEqual([]);
  });

  it("asks for extra details in the caller's language", () => {
    const [batch] = planBatches(appIds(5072580), "latam");
    const input = new URL(batch?.url ?? GETITEMS_URL).searchParams.get("input_json");
    expect(input).toBe(
      JSON.stringify({
        ids: [{ appid: 5072580 }],
        context: { language: "latam", country_code: "US" },
        data_request: { include_extra_details: true },
      }),
    );
  });
});
```

`src/core/detect/getitems.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import type { SteamLanguage } from "../i18n/locale";
import { parseJson } from "../json";
import { kindsFromGetItems, type KindVerdicts, UNKNOWN_KINDS } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Detector, Http, HttpResponse, HttpResult } from "../ports";
import type { AppId, UnknownReason } from "../types";
import {
  type GetItemsEnvelope,
  GetItemsEnvelopeSchema,
  type StoreItem,
  StoreItemIdSchema,
  StoreItemSchema,
} from "./getitems.schema";

// Detection through IStoreBrowseService/GetItems (ADR 0001). Rules from rq6: S1 for batch sizes,
// S2 for item states and batch errors.

export const GETITEMS_URL = "https://api.steampowered.com/IStoreBrowseService/GetItems/v1";

/** GetItems needs a country; it only affects prices, which are not read. */
const COUNTRY_CODE = "US";
const HTTP_OK = 200;
const HTTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS = 429;
/** Steam's EResult for success, in the `x-eresult` header and each item's `success`. */
const ERESULT_OK = 1;
const SEPARATOR_LENGTH = encodeURIComponent(",").length;

export interface BatchLimits {
  /** IDs per request. */
  readonly maxIds: number;
  /** Encoded URL length per request; S1 saw the server fail between 6,886 and 8,236. */
  readonly maxUrlLength: number;
}

export const DEFAULT_BATCH_LIMITS: BatchLimits = { maxIds: 50, maxUrlLength: 4000 };

/** One GetItems request: its distinct IDs and its URL. */
export interface GetItemsBatch {
  readonly ids: readonly AppId[];
  readonly url: string;
}

/** The GetItems URL for these IDs, with `context.language` set to the page's Steam language. */
export function getItemsUrl(ids: readonly AppId[], language: SteamLanguage): string {
  const input = {
    ids: ids.map((appid) => ({ appid })),
    context: { language, country_code: COUNTRY_CODE },
    data_request: { include_extra_details: true },
  };
  return `${GETITEMS_URL}?input_json=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(input))}`;
}

/**
 * Splits IDs into requests: duplicates removed (GetItems does not merge them), at most
 * `maxIds` per request, and fewer when the encoded URL would exceed `maxUrlLength`. The length is
 * summed per ID, so planning is linear; one ID alone always gets a request.
 */
export function planBatches(
  ids: Iterable<AppId>,
  language: SteamLanguage,
  limits: BatchLimits = DEFAULT_BATCH_LIMITS,
): readonly GetItemsBatch[] {
  const overhead = getItemsUrl([], language).length;
  const batches: GetItemsBatch[] = [];
  let current: AppId[] = [];
  let length = overhead;
  for (const id of new Set(ids)) {
    const cost = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({ appid: id })).length;
    const full = current.length >= limits.maxIds
      || length + SEPARATOR_LENGTH + cost > limits.maxUrlLength;
    if (current.length > 0 && full) {
      batches.push({ ids: current, url: getItemsUrl(current, language) });
      current = [];
      length = overhead;
    }
    length += current.length === 0 ? cost : SEPARATOR_LENGTH + cost;
    current.push(id);
  }
  if (current.length > 0) {
    batches.push({ ids: current, url: getItemsUrl(current, language) });
  }
  return batches;
}

/** The parsed envelope, or undefined when the body is not JSON or not a GetItems answer. */
function envelopeOf(body: string): GetItemsEnvelope | undefined {
  try {
    const result = v.safeParse(GetItemsEnvelopeSchema, parseJson(body));
    return result.success ? result.output : undefined;
  } catch {
    // parseJson throws SyntaxError on malformed text.
    return undefined;
  }
}

type BatchItems =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly items: readonly unknown[]; }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly reason: UnknownReason; };

function batchFailure(reason: UnknownReason): BatchItems {
  return { ok: false, reason };
}

/** The raw items of a 200 answer, or why the whole batch is unknown. */
function responseItems(response: HttpResponse): BatchItems {
  if (response.status === HTTP_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS) {
    return batchFailure("rate-limited");
  }
  if (response.status !== HTTP_OK) {
    return batchFailure("error");
  }
  const eresult = response.headers.get("x-eresult");
  if (eresult !== undefined && eresult.trim() !== String(ERESULT_OK)) {
    return batchFailure("error");
  }
  const items = envelopeOf(response.body)?.response.store_items;
  return items === undefined ? batchFailure("error") : { ok: true, items };
}

function batchItems(result: HttpResult): BatchItems {
  switch (result.kind) {
    case "response":
      return responseItems(result);
    case "failed":
      return batchFailure("error");
    case "withheld":
      return batchFailure("rate-limited");
  }
}

/** Every kind's verdict for one item; unknown `missing` when the item has no usable details. */
function itemVerdicts(item: StoreItem, language: SteamLanguage): KindVerdicts {
  const details = item.extra_details;
  if (item.success !== ERESULT_OK || details === undefined) {
    return UNKNOWN_KINDS.missing;
  }
  return kindsFromGetItems(item, details, language);
}

/**
 * Maps one GetItems result to the verdicts of every requested ID, keyed by the item's `id` (never
 * by `appid`, which is 0 for invalid items). An item that fails its schema gets unknown `error`; a
 * requested ID with no item gets unknown `missing`, or `error` when the batch also held an item
 * whose ID could not be read. A broken answer makes the whole batch unknown.
 */
export function parseGetItems(
  ids: readonly AppId[],
  result: HttpResult,
  language: SteamLanguage,
): ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts> {
  const read = batchItems(result);
  if (!read.ok) {
    const unknown = UNKNOWN_KINDS[read.reason];
    return new Map(ids.map((id): [AppId, KindVerdicts] => [id, unknown]));
  }
  const found = new Map<AppId, KindVerdicts>();
  let unattributed = false;
  for (const entry of read.items) {
    const item = v.safeParse(StoreItemSchema, entry);
    if (item.success) {
      if (!found.has(item.output.id)) {
        found.set(item.output.id, itemVerdicts(item.output, language));
      }
      continue;
    }
    const idOnly = v.safeParse(StoreItemIdSchema, entry);
    if (idOnly.success) {
      if (!found.has(idOnly.output.id)) {
        found.set(idOnly.output.id, UNKNOWN_KINDS.error);
      }
    } else {
      unattributed = true;
    }
  }
  const rest = unattributed ? UNKNOWN_KINDS.error : UNKNOWN_KINDS.missing;
  return new Map(ids.map((id): [AppId, KindVerdicts] => [id, found.get(id) ?? rest]));
}

export interface GetItemsOptions {
  readonly http: Http;
  /** The page's Steam language (`steamLanguage(<html lang>)`, else `english`). */
  readonly language: SteamLanguage;
  readonly limits?: BatchLimits;
}

/**
 * The GetItems detector. Batches run one after another, so at most one request is in flight;
 * spacing and backoff come from the `Http` it is given (a throttling decorator).
 */
export function createGetItemsDetector(options: GetItemsOptions): Detector {
  const { http, language } = options;
  const limits = options.limits ?? DEFAULT_BATCH_LIMITS;
  return {
    async detect(ids: readonly AppId[]): Promise<ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>> {
      const verdicts = new Map<AppId, KindVerdicts>();
      for (const batch of planBatches(ids, language, limits)) {
        // Sequential on purpose: one request in flight (rule 13).
        const result = await http.get(batch.url);
        for (const [id, verdict] of parseGetItems(batch.ids, result, language)) {
          verdicts.set(id, verdict);
        }
      }
      return verdicts;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { hasText, trimNotes } from "./notes";

describe("trimNotes", () => {
  it("removes outer whitespace and zero-width characters", () => {
    expect(trimNotes("\n\t\u200bSome art\u00a0 \u200b\ufeff")).toBe("Some art");
    expect(trimNotes("\u200c\u200d\u2060x\u2060")).toBe("x");
  });

  it("keeps inner text verbatim, line breaks and zero-width spaces included", () => {
    expect(trimNotes(" Waifus\r\nBackgrounds \u200b\u200band music ")).toBe(
      "Waifus\r\nBackgrounds \u200b\u200band music",
    );
  });

  it("returns an empty string for blank notes", () => {
    for (const text of ["", " ", "\r\n", "\u200b", "\u200b \u200b\n"]) {
      expect(trimNotes(text)).toBe("");
    }
  });
});

    expect(hasText("Denuvo")).toBe(true);
    expect(hasText(" a ")).toBe(true);
    for (const text of ["", " ", "\r\n", "\u200b", "\u200b \u200b\n"]) {
      expect(hasText(text)).toBe(false);
    }
  });
```

`src/core/detect/notes.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Whitespace plus the invisible characters developers leave around their notes: zero-width space,
 * non-joiner and joiner, and word joiner (rq6, S2). `\s` already covers U+FEFF.
 */
const BLANK = /[\s\u200b-\u200d\u2060]/;

function isBlank(text: string, index: number): boolean {
  return BLANK.test(text.charAt(index));
}

/** Whether the text holds anything but blanks, so a developer's blank field says nothing. */
export function hasText(text: string): boolean {
  return trimNotes(text) !== "";
}

/** `{ [key]: text }` when the text has content, else `{}`, to spread into a verdict. */
export function optionalText<const TKey extends string>(
  key: TKey,
  text: string | undefined,
): Partial<Record<TKey, string>> {
  const fields: Partial<Record<TKey, string>> = {};
  if (text !== undefined && hasText(text)) {
    fields[key] = text;
  }
  return fields;
}

/**
 * Developer notes without leading or trailing blanks; inner text, line breaks included, stays
 * verbatim. An empty result means the developer disclosed nothing. Linear in the text length.
 */
export function trimNotes(text: string): string {
  let start = 0;
  let end = text.length;
  while (start < end && isBlank(text, start)) {
    start += 1;
  }
  while (end > start && isBlank(text, end - 1)) {
    end -= 1;
  }
  return text.slice(start, end);
}
```

`src/core/detect/settle.ts`:

```ts
import { type KindVerdicts, UNKNOWN_KINDS } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Detector } from "../ports";
import type { AppId } from "../types";

/**
 * One `KindVerdicts` for each of `ids` (already distinct) from `detector`, even if it breaks its
 * contract: a rejection or an ID it left out becomes unknown `error`. Decorators call their inner
 * detectors through this, so one faulty link cannot reject the whole detection.
 */
export async function settle(
  detector: Detector,
  ids: readonly AppId[],
): Promise<ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>> {
  let found: ReadonlyMap<AppId, KindVerdicts>;
  try {
    found = await detector.detect(ids);
  } catch {
    found = new Map();
  }
  return new Map(
    ids.map((id): [AppId, KindVerdicts] => [id, found.get(id) ?? UNKNOWN_KINDS.error]),
  );
}
```

`src/core/detect/throttle.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { httpContract } from "../../../tests/contracts/http.contract";
import { appIds } from "../../../tests/helpers/app-ids";
import { fakeHttp, type Reply, type Route } from "../../../tests/helpers/fake-http";
import { getItemsRequest, getItemsRoute, storeItem } from "../../../tests/helpers/getitems";
import { memoryStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/memory-store";
import { recordingLogger } from "../../../tests/helpers/recording-logger";
import { T0, useTimerClock } from "../../../tests/helpers/timer-clock";
import { UNKNOWN_KINDS } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Clock, Http, KeyValueStore } from "../ports";
import { API_BREAKER_KEY, type Breaker, createBreaker } from "./breaker";
import { createGetItemsDetector, GETITEMS_URL } from "./getitems";
import { createThrottledHttp } from "./throttle";

const API = `${GETITEMS_URL}?input_json=%7B%7D`;

interface Sent {
  readonly url: string;
  readonly at: number;
}

/** A fake server that also records when each request went out. */
function timedHttp(routes: readonly Route[], clock: Clock) {
  const inner = fakeHttp(routes);
  const sent: Sent[] = [];
  const http: Http = {
    get(url) {
      sent.push({ url, at: clock.now() - T0 });
      return inner.get(url);
    },
  };
  return { http, sent, inner };
}

function setup(routes: readonly Route[], store: KeyValueStore = memoryStore()) {
  const clock = useTimerClock();
  const server = timedHttp(routes, clock);
  const breaker = createBreaker({
    store,
    clock,
    logger: recordingLogger().logger,
    key: API_BREAKER_KEY,
    random: () => 0,
  });
  const http = createThrottledHttp({ http: server.http, breaker, clock });
  return { ...server, http, store };
}

/** Answers the URL with each reply in turn, then with the last one. */
function sequence(...replies: readonly Reply[]): Route {
  let index = 0;
  return [API, () => replies[Math.min(index++, replies.length - 1)] ?? { status: 200 }];
}

/** The settled value of `promise` after the fake timers ran for `ms`. */
async function after<T>(ms: number, promise: Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(ms);
  return promise;
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

/** A breaker that never opens: the contract checks what the throttle passes through. */
const closedBreaker: Breaker = {
  isOpen: () => Promise.resolve(false),
  record: () => Promise.resolve(),
};

httpContract("createThrottledHttp", (routes) => {
  const clock: Clock = { now: () => Date.now() };
  // No spacing, so the contract runs on real timers; spacing and the breaker have their own tests.
  return createThrottledHttp({
    http: fakeHttp(routes),
    breaker: closedBreaker,
    clock,
    spacingMs: 0,
  });
});

describe("createThrottledHttp", () => {
  it("keeps one request in flight, 1 s after the previous answer", async () => {
    const { http, sent, inner } = setup([[API, { status: 200 }]]);
    const all = Promise.all([http.get(API), http.get(`${API}&2`), http.get(`${API}&3`)]);
    await after(2_000, all);
    expect(sent.map(({ at }) => at)).toStrictEqual([0, 1_000, 2_000]);
    expect(inner.maxInFlight).toBe(1);
  });

  it("sends at once when the last answer is older than the spacing", async () => {
    const { http, sent } = setup([[API, { status: 200 }]]);
    await after(0, http.get(API));
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(5_000);
    await after(0, http.get(API));
    expect(sent.map(({ at }) => at)).toStrictEqual([0, 5_000]);
  });

  it.each<[string, Reply]>([
    ["a 429", { status: 429 }],
    ["a TypeError from fetch", "network-error"],
    ["a 503", { status: 503 }],
  ])("after %s, sends nothing until the breaker closes", async (_, reply) => {
    const { http, sent } = setup([sequence(reply, { status: 200 })]);
    const first = await after(0, http.get(API));
    expect(first.kind).toBe(reply === "network-error" ? "failed" : "response");
    // Queued behind the trip, and asked for during the pause: all withheld, none sent.
    const queued = http.get(API);
    expect(await after(1_000, queued)).toStrictEqual({ kind: "withheld" });
    expect(await after(30_000, http.get(API))).toStrictEqual({ kind: "withheld" });
    expect(await after(28_000, http.get(API))).toStrictEqual({ kind: "withheld" });
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(1);
    // 60 s after the trip (random 0, so no jitter) the next request goes out.
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1_000);
    expect((await after(0, http.get(API))).kind).toBe("response");
    expect(sent.map(({ at }) => at)).toStrictEqual([0, 60_000]);
  });

  it("honors a breaker another tab opened", async () => {
    const store = memoryStore(new Map([[API_BREAKER_KEY, { until: T0 + 10_000 }]]));
    const { http, sent } = setup([[API, { status: 200 }]], store);
    expect(await after(0, http.get(API))).toStrictEqual({ kind: "withheld" });
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10_000);
    expect((await after(0, http.get(API))).kind).toBe("response");
    expect(sent.map(({ at }) => at)).toStrictEqual([10_000]);
  });
});

describe("GetItems through the throttle", () => {
  const ids = appIds(...Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, index) => 4_000_000 + index));
  const pool = ids.map((id) => storeItem(id));

  it("sends 120 IDs as calls of 50, 50 and 20, 1 s apart", async () => {
    const { http, sent, inner } = setup([getItemsRoute(pool)]);
    const detector = createGetItemsDetector({ http, language: "english" });
    const verdicts = await after(2_000, detector.detect(ids));
    expect(sent.map(({ url }) => getItemsRequest(url).ids.length)).toStrictEqual([50, 50, 20]);
    expect(sent.map(({ at }) => at)).toStrictEqual([0, 1_000, 2_000]);
    expect(inner.maxInFlight).toBe(1);
    expect(verdicts.size).toBe(120);
    expect([...verdicts.values()].every((verdict) => verdict.ai.state === "not-disclosed")).toBe(
      true,
    );
  });

  it.each<[string, Reply]>([
    ["a 429", { status: 429 }],
    ["a TypeError", "network-error"],
  ])("stops after %s and answers every ID unknown rate-limited", async (_, reply) => {
    const { http, sent } = setup([[GETITEMS_URL, reply]]);
    const detector = createGetItemsDetector({ http, language: "english" });
    const verdicts = await after(2_000, detector.detect(ids));
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(1);
    const first = new Set(ids.slice(0, 50));
    for (const [id, verdict] of verdicts) {
      // The batch that tripped is `rate-limited` (429) or `error` (TypeError); the rest were held.
      if (!first.has(id)) {
        expect(verdict).toBe(UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"]);
      }
    }
    expect(await after(50_000, detector.detect(ids.slice(0, 1)))).toStrictEqual(
      new Map([[ids[0], UNKNOWN_KINDS["rate-limited"]]]),
    );
    expect(sent).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
```

`src/core/detect/throttle.ts`:

```ts
import type { Clock, Http, HttpResult, HttpWithheld } from "../ports";
import type { Breaker } from "./breaker";

// Request pacing for Steam (rq6, S1): 30 back-to-back calls passed, so these are safety margins
// for the user's own browsing on the same IP, not measured limits.

export const DEFAULT_SPACING_MS = 1000;

const WITHHELD: HttpWithheld = { kind: "withheld" };

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    setTimeout(resolve, ms);
  });
}

export interface ThrottleOptions {
  readonly http: Http;
  readonly breaker: Breaker;
  readonly clock: Clock;
  /** The quiet time between one answer and the next request. */
  readonly spacingMs?: number;
}

/**
 * An `Http` decorator: one request in flight, `spacingMs` between the end of one request and the
 * start of the next, and nothing sent while the breaker is open (the result is `withheld`). Each
 * result is recorded before the next queued request checks the breaker, so a 429 stops the rest
 * of the queue. Like every `Http`, it never rejects.
 */
export function createThrottledHttp(options: ThrottleOptions): Http {
  const { http, breaker, clock } = options;
  const spacingMs = options.spacingMs ?? DEFAULT_SPACING_MS;
  let lastEnd = Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
  let tail: Promise<unknown> = Promise.resolve();

  async function send(url: string): Promise<HttpResult> {
    const wait = lastEnd + spacingMs - clock.now();
    if (wait > 0) {
      await sleep(wait);
    }
    if (await breaker.isOpen()) {
      return WITHHELD;
    }
    const result = await http.get(url);
    lastEnd = clock.now();
    await breaker.record(result);
    return result;
  }

  return {
    get(url) {
      const result = tail.then(() => send(url));
      tail = result;
      return result;
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The project's error type. It carries a catalog key and that message's typed params, never

export class SarError<K extends MessageKey = MessageKey> extends Error {

  readonly code: K;
  readonly params: MessageParams[K];

  constructor(code: K, params: MessageParams[K], options?: ErrorOptions) {
```

`src/core/http.ts`:

```ts
import type { Http, HttpResult } from "./ports";

/** The part of `fetch` the HTTP port uses; composition roots pass `globalThis.fetch`. */
export type Fetch = (url: string, init: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;

/** Every request goes without cookies or HTTP auth (rule 1), as the spikes ran them. */
const REQUEST: RequestInit = { credentials: "omit" };

/** How long a request may take before it counts as failed, so a hung one cannot hold a queue. */
const REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;

/**
 * The `Http` port over `fetch`, shared by the extension and the userscript: both can call plain
 * `fetch` from the store page (rq6, S4 and S6). This is the one place requests get their options.
 */
export function createFetchHttp(fetchFn: Fetch, timeoutMs = REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS): Http {
  return {
    async get(url: string): Promise<HttpResult> {
      try {
        const response = await fetchFn(url, { ...REQUEST, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs) });
        const body = await response.text();
        // Browsers already iterate header names in lower case; happy-dom keeps the sent case.
        const headers = new Map<string, string>();
        response.headers.forEach((value, name) => {
          headers.set(name.toLowerCase(), value);
        });
        return {
          kind: "response",
          status: response.status,
          // Constructed responses have an empty URL; a fetched one always has its final URL.
          url: response.url === "" ? url : response.url,
          headers,
          body,
        };
      } catch (cause) {
        return { kind: "failed", cause };
      }
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
  });

    expect(substitute("Hello, $name$!", {})).toBe("Hello, $name$!");
  });

  it("inserts values verbatim, without reading placeholders inside them", () => {
    expect(substitute("$a$", { a: "$b$", b: "no" })).toBe("$b$");
```

`src/core/i18n/catalog.ts`:

```ts
/** One message of a Chrome `messages.json` catalog, as far as the runtime reads it. */
export interface CatalogEntry {
  readonly message: string;
  readonly placeholders?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

/** A catalog as authored in `src/locales/<locale>/messages.json`: message key to entry. */
export type Catalog = Readonly<Partial<Record<string, CatalogEntry>>>;

/** Catalogs by catalog locale code (`en`, `es`, `pt_BR`). English is always present. */
export type Catalogs = Readonly<Partial<Record<string, Catalog>>>;

/** Named placeholder values. Names are lower case, as `gen_i18n_keys.py` writes them. */
export type Params = Readonly<Record<string, string>>;

export const DEFAULT_LOCALE = "en";

const TOKEN = /\$\$|\$([A-Za-z0-9_@]+)\$/g;

/**
 * Replaces each `$name$` with the parameter of that name (case-insensitive, as in Chrome) and
 * `$$` with `$`. A placeholder without a parameter stays as written, so a gap is visible.
 */
export function substitute(message: string, params: Params): string {
  return message.replace(TOKEN, (token: string, name: string | undefined): string => {
    if (name === undefined) {
      return "$";
    }
    return params[name.toLowerCase()] ?? token;
  });
}
```

`src/core/i18n/locale.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE } from "./catalog";

/**
 * Steam's `<html lang>` values with Steam's own language name and our catalog locale code
 * (rq6, S5). One table serves both directions: the page language picks the catalog, and the
 * Steam name is the `context.language` that GetItems takes.
 */
const STEAM_LANGUAGES = [
  ["en", "english", "en"],
  ["de", "german", "de"],
  ["fr", "french", "fr"],
  ["es", "spanish", "es"],
  ["es-419", "latam", "es_419"],
  ["pt", "portuguese", "pt_PT"],
  ["pt-br", "brazilian", "pt_BR"],
  ["zh-cn", "schinese", "zh_CN"],
  ["zh-tw", "tchinese", "zh_TW"],
  ["ja", "japanese", "ja"],
  ["ko", "koreana", "ko"],
  ["ru", "russian", "ru"],
  ["uk", "ukrainian", "uk"],
  ["pl", "polish", "pl"],
  ["tr", "turkish", "tr"],
  ["th", "thai", "th"],
  ["vi", "vietnamese", "vi"],
  ["id", "indonesian", "id"],
  ["ar", "arabic", "ar"],
  ["cs", "czech", "cs"],
  ["da", "danish", "da"],
  ["nl", "dutch", "nl"],
  ["fi", "finnish", "fi"],
  ["el", "greek", "el"],
  ["hu", "hungarian", "hu"],
  ["it", "italian", "it"],
  ["no", "norwegian", "no"],
  ["ro", "romanian", "ro"],
  ["sv", "swedish", "sv"],
  ["bg", "bulgarian", "bg"],
] as const;

type Row = (typeof STEAM_LANGUAGES)[number];

/** Steam's name for a store language, as GetItems' `context.language` takes it. */
export type SteamLanguage = Row[1];

export const DEFAULT_STEAM_LANGUAGE: SteamLanguage = "english";

/** Validates a Steam language name read from outside, for example a stored verdict. */
export const SteamLanguageSchema = v.picklist(STEAM_LANGUAGES.map((row) => row[1]));

export interface LocaleContext {
  /** The `locale` setting: `auto`, or a catalog locale code the user chose. */
  readonly setting: string;
  /** `<html lang>` on a store page; absent elsewhere, for example on the options page. */
  readonly pageLang?: string;
  /** `navigator.language`, which `auto` follows off store pages. */
  readonly browserLang?: string;
}

const BY_PAGE_LANG: ReadonlyMap<string, Row> = new Map(
  STEAM_LANGUAGES.map((row): [string, Row] => [row[0], row]),
);

function normalize(tag: string): string {
  return tag.trim().toLowerCase().replaceAll("_", "-");
}

/** The Steam language of a store page from its `<html lang>`; undefined outside the table. */
export function steamLanguage(pageLang: string): SteamLanguage | undefined {
  return BY_PAGE_LANG.get(normalize(pageLang))?.[1];
}

/** Catalog locale codes to try for a language tag, most specific first. */
function candidates(tag: string): readonly string[] {
  const normalized = normalize(tag);
  const known = BY_PAGE_LANG.get(normalized)?.[2];
  const [language = "", region] = normalized.split("-");
  const regional = region === undefined ? [] : [`${language}_${region.toUpperCase()}`];
  return [...(known === undefined ? [] : [known]), ...regional, language];
}

/**
 * The catalog locale to use. A chosen locale wins when it has a catalog. `auto` follows the
 * store page's `<html lang>` on store pages and the browser language elsewhere. Every path
 * falls back from region to language, then to English.
 */
export function resolveLocale(context: LocaleContext, available: ReadonlySet<string>): string {
  const tag = context.setting === "auto"
    ? (context.pageLang ?? context.browserLang ?? DEFAULT_LOCALE)
    : context.setting;
  return candidates(tag).find((code) => available.has(code)) ?? DEFAULT_LOCALE;
}
```
