`src/core/i18n/shipped.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import en from "../../locales/en/messages.json";
import es from "../../locales/es/messages.json";
import { type Catalog, DEFAULT_LOCALE, type Params, substitute } from "./catalog";
import { resolveLocale } from "./locale";
import { SHIPPED_CATALOGS } from "./shipped";
import { createI18n } from "./t";

const PLACEHOLDER = /\$[A-Za-z0-9_@]+\$/;

const locales = new Set(Object.keys(SHIPPED_CATALOGS));

// A locale without a catalog reads as empty; the first test fails on it.
function shipped(locale: string): Catalog {
  return SHIPPED_CATALOGS[locale] ?? {};
}

describe("shipped catalogs", () => {
  it("ships English and Spanish", () => {
    expect([...locales].sort()).toEqual(["en", "es"]);
  });

  it("gives Spanish the same keys as English", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(shipped("es")).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(shipped("en")).sort());
    expect(Object.keys(es).sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(en).sort());
  });

  it("gives Spanish the same placeholders as English for every message", () => {
    const names = (entry: { readonly message: string; }) =>
      [...entry.message.matchAll(new RegExp(PLACEHOLDER, "g"))].map(([name]) => name.toLowerCase())
        .sort();
    for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(en)) {
      expect(names(shipped("es")[key] ?? { message: "" }), key).toEqual(names(entry));
    }
  });

  it("loads the Spanish messages", () => {
    const spanish = createI18n(SHIPPED_CATALOGS, "es");
    expect(spanish.locale).toBe("es");
    expect(spanish.t("banner_ignore")).toBe(es.banner_ignore.message);
    const restore = { name: "Fixture Game", scope: spanish.t("options_allow_scope_all") };
    expect(spanish.t("options_allow_restore_label", restore)).toBe(
      substitute(es.options_allow_restore_label.message, restore),
    );
    expect(spanish.t("options_allow_empty", { action: spanish.t("banner_ignore") })).toBe(
      substitute(es.options_allow_empty.message, { action: es.banner_ignore.message }),
    );
  });

  it("serves every Spanish message without placeholders as the catalog writes it", () => {
    const spanish = createI18n<Record<string, Params>>(SHIPPED_CATALOGS, "es");
    const bare = Object.entries(es).filter(([, entry]) => !PLACEHOLDER.test(entry.message));
    expect(bare.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(bare.map(([key]) => [key, spanish.t(key)])).toStrictEqual(
      bare.map(([key, entry]) => [key, entry.message]),
    );
  });

  it("resolves Spanish and Latin American store pages to the Spanish catalog", () => {
    expect(resolveLocale({ setting: "auto", pageLang: "es" }, locales)).toBe("es");
    expect(resolveLocale({ setting: "auto", pageLang: "es-419" }, locales)).toBe("es");
    expect(resolveLocale({ setting: "es", pageLang: "en" }, locales)).toBe("es");
  });

  it("keeps other store languages on English", () => {
    expect(resolveLocale({ setting: "auto", pageLang: "de" }, locales)).toBe(DEFAULT_LOCALE);
    expect(resolveLocale({ setting: "auto", pageLang: "pt-br" }, locales)).toBe(DEFAULT_LOCALE);
  });

  it("falls back to English for a key the Spanish catalog lacks", () => {
    const partial = { en: shipped("en"), es: { kind_ai_chip: shipped("es")["kind_ai_chip"] } };
    const spanish = createI18n(partial, "es");
    expect(spanish.t("kind_ai_chip")).toBe(es.kind_ai_chip.message);
    expect(spanish.t("banner_ignore")).toBe(en.banner_ignore.message);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import en from "../../../tests/locales/en/messages.json";
import es from "../../../tests/locales/es/messages.json";
import type { MessageParams, PluralParams } from "../../../tests/locales/keys.gen";
import xx from "../../../tests/locales/xx/messages.json";
import type { Catalogs } from "./catalog";
import { createI18n } from "./t";

// Test-only catalogs: `xx` is a pseudo-locale for fallback, plurals and placeholders, `es` a
// realistic translation. All three are test-only; src/locales holds the shipped catalogs.
const catalogs: Catalogs = { en, es, xx };

// Repo text is ASCII (rule 8), so the Spanish characters are spelled out by code point.
const INVERTED_EXCLAMATION = String.fromCodePoint(0xa1);
const O_ACUTE = String.fromCodePoint(0xf3);

function i18n(locale: string, from: Catalogs = catalogs) {
  return createI18n<MessageParams, PluralParams>(from, locale);
}

describe("t", () => {
  it("fills named placeholders", () => {
    expect(i18n("en").t("greeting", { name: "Ana" })).toBe("Hello, Ana!");
    expect(i18n("es").t("greeting", { name: "Ana" })).toBe(`${INVERTED_EXCLAMATION}Hola, Ana!`);
    expect(i18n("xx").t("greeting", { name: "Ana" })).toBe("[xx Hello, Ana! xx]");
  });

  it("takes no params for a message without placeholders", () => {
    expect(i18n("es").t("farewell")).toBe(`Adi${O_ACUTE}s.`);
  });

  it("falls back to English for a key the locale lacks", () => {
    expect(i18n("xx").t("only_english")).toBe("Only in English.");
    expect(i18n("es").t("only_english")).toBe("Only in English.");
  });

  it("falls back to English for a locale without a catalog", () => {
    const french = i18n("fr");
    expect(french.locale).toBe("en");
    expect(french.t("farewell")).toBe("Goodbye.");
  });

  it("returns the key when even English lacks it", () => {
    expect(i18n("en", { en: {} }).t("farewell")).toBe("farewell");
  });
});

describe("plural", () => {
  it("picks the English form by count and formats the number", () => {
    const english = i18n("en");
    expect(english.plural("games", 1, { list: "Wishlist" })).toBe("1 game in Wishlist");
    expect(english.plural("games", 0, { list: "Wishlist" })).toBe("0 games in Wishlist");
    expect(english.plural("games", 1200, { list: "Wishlist" })).toBe("1,200 games in Wishlist");
  });

  it("uses the locale's plural rules and number format", () => {
    const spanish = i18n("es");
    expect(spanish.plural("games", 1, { list: "Deseados" })).toBe("1 juego en Deseados");
    expect(spanish.plural("games", 3, { list: "Deseados" })).toBe("3 juegos en Deseados");
  });

  it("falls back to the _other form for a category the locale leaves out", () => {
    // Spanish selects "many" for a million; the catalog has only _one and _other.
    expect(new Intl.PluralRules("es").select(1_000_000)).toBe("many");
    expect(i18n("es").plural("games", 1_000_000, { list: "Deseados" })).toBe(
      "1.000.000 juegos en Deseados",
    );
  });

  it("uses English rules for a locale Intl does not know", () => {
    expect(i18n("xx").plural("games", 1, { list: "W" })).toBe("[xx 1 game in W xx]");
    expect(i18n("xx").plural("games", 2, { list: "W" })).toBe("[xx 2 games in W xx]");
  });

  it("falls back to English when the locale lacks the plural", () => {
    const partial: Catalogs = { en, xx: { farewell: { message: "[xx Bye xx]" } } };
    expect(i18n("xx", partial).plural("games", 2, { list: "W" })).toBe("2 games in W");
  });
});
```

`src/core/i18n/t.ts`:

```ts
import { type Catalog, type Catalogs, DEFAULT_LOCALE, type Params, substitute } from "./catalog";
import type { MessageParams, PluralParams } from "./keys.gen";

/** Maps each key of a catalog schema to the placeholders its message takes. */
export type ParamsSchema<S> = { readonly [K in keyof S]: Params; };

/** Keys whose message takes no placeholders, so the params may be omitted. */
export type BareKey<S> =
  & { [K in keyof S]: Record<never, never> extends S[K] ? K : never; }[keyof S]
  & string;

/** A shipped catalog key whose message takes no placeholders. */
export type BareMessageKey = BareKey<MessageParams>;

/**
 * Message lookup for one locale. `M` and `P` default to the types generated from the shipped
 * catalogs; tests pass the types generated from their own catalogs.
 */
export interface I18n<
  M extends ParamsSchema<M> = MessageParams,
  P extends ParamsSchema<P> = PluralParams,
> {
  /** The catalog locale in use: the requested one if it has a catalog, else English. */
  readonly locale: string;
  t(key: BareKey<M>): string;
  t<K extends keyof M & string>(key: K, params: M[K]): string;
  /** Picks `<base>_<category>` by `Intl.PluralRules`, else `<base>_other`; fills `$count$`. */
  plural(base: BareKey<P>, count: number): string;
  plural<K extends keyof P & string>(base: K, count: number, params: P[K]): string;
}

interface IntlPair {
  readonly rules: Intl.PluralRules;
  readonly numbers: Intl.NumberFormat;
}

const NO_PARAMS: Params = {};

/** Plural rules and number format for a catalog locale, or English ones when `Intl` lacks it. */
function intlFor(locale: string): IntlPair {
  const tag = locale.replaceAll("_", "-");
  const supported = Intl.PluralRules.supportedLocalesOf(tag).length > 0 ? tag : DEFAULT_LOCALE;
  return { rules: new Intl.PluralRules(supported), numbers: new Intl.NumberFormat(supported) };
}

function pluralText(catalog: Catalog, base: string, count: number, intl: IntlPair) {
  const entry = catalog[`${base}_${intl.rules.select(count)}`] ?? catalog[`${base}_other`];
  return entry?.message;
}

/**
 * Creates the message lookup for `locale`. A key or a whole locale missing from the catalogs
 * falls back to English; a key missing from English too returns the key itself.
 */
export function createI18n<
  M extends ParamsSchema<M> = MessageParams,
  P extends ParamsSchema<P> = PluralParams,
>(catalogs: Catalogs, locale: string): I18n<M, P> {
  const english = catalogs[DEFAULT_LOCALE] ?? {};
  const own = catalogs[locale];
  const active = own ?? english;
  const resolved = own === undefined ? DEFAULT_LOCALE : locale;
  const local = intlFor(resolved);
  const fallback = intlFor(DEFAULT_LOCALE);

  const t = (key: string, params: Params = NO_PARAMS): string => {
    const text = active[key]?.message ?? english[key]?.message;
    return text === undefined ? key : substitute(text, params);
  };

  const plural = (base: string, count: number, params: Params = NO_PARAMS): string => {
    const text = pluralText(active, base, count, local);
    if (text !== undefined) {
      return substitute(text, { ...params, count: local.numbers.format(count) });
    }
    const englishText = pluralText(english, base, count, fallback);
    return englishText === undefined
      ? base
      : substitute(englishText, { ...params, count: fallback.numbers.format(count) });
  };

  return { locale: resolved, t, plural };
}
```

```ts
describe("loadIgnored", () => {

    const allowList = createAllowList(memoryStore(), fixedClock(0));
    await allowList.add("drm", appId(10), "Ten");
    await allowList.add(ALLOW_ALL, appId(20), "Twenty");
    const ignored = await loadIgnored(allowList, quiet);
    expect([...ignored.drm]).toEqual([10]);
    expect([...ignored[ALLOW_ALL]]).toEqual([20]);

  });

  it("logs a list that cannot be read and starts with none ignored", async () => {
    const problem = new Error();
    const ignored = await loadIgnored({
      list: () => Promise.reject(problem),
      add: () => Promise.resolve(),
      remove: () => Promise.resolve(),
    }, quiet);
    expect(quiet.error).toHaveBeenCalledWith(problem);
    expect(Object.values(ignored).every((games) => games.size === 0)).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe("isIgnored", () => {
  const ignored = perScope(() => new Set<ReturnType<typeof appId>>());
  ignored.kernel.add(appId(1));
  ignored[ALLOW_ALL].add(appId(2));

  it("ignores a game for the kinds it was ignored for", () => {
    expect(isIgnored(ignored, appId(1), "kernel")).toBe(true);
    expect(isIgnored(ignored, appId(1), "ai")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("ignores a game ignored for all kinds in every kind", () => {
    expect(isIgnored(ignored, appId(2), "ai")).toBe(true);
    expect(isIgnored(ignored, appId(2), "pvp")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("ignores no other game", () => {
    expect(isIgnored(ignored, appId(3), "kernel")).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

`src/core/ignored.ts`:

```ts
import type { KindId } from "./kinds/id";
import type { Logger } from "./log";
import { ALLOW_ALL, type AllowScope, perScope } from "./settings/allow-data";
import type { AllowList } from "./settings/allow-list";
import type { AppId } from "./types";

/** The games the user ignored, in page memory: one set of app IDs per scope. */
export type IgnoredGames = Readonly<Record<AllowScope, Set<AppId>>>;

/** The stored ignore list. A list that cannot be read is logged and counts as empty. */
export async function loadIgnored(
  allowList: AllowList,
  logger: Pick<Logger, "error">,
): Promise<IgnoredGames> {
  try {
    const entries = await allowList.list();
    return perScope((scope) => new Set(entries[scope].keys()));
  } catch (problem) {
    logger.error(problem);
    return perScope(() => new Set());
  }
}

/** Whether the game is ignored for the kind, on its own or for all kinds. */
export function isIgnored(ignored: IgnoredGames, id: AppId, kind: KindId): boolean {
  return ignored[ALLOW_ALL].has(id) || ignored[kind].has(id);
}
```

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { parseJson, parseWithDefaults, toJsonValue } from "./json";

describe("parseJson", () => {
  it("returns the parsed value as unknown", () => {
    expect(parseJson('{"a":[1,2]}')).toStrictEqual({ a: [1, 2] });
  });

  it("throws on malformed text", () => {
    expect(() => parseJson("{")).toThrow(SyntaxError);
  });

  it("runs in happy-dom", () => {
    expect(document.createElement("div").tagName).toBe("DIV");
  });
});

describe("parseWithDefaults", () => {
  const schema = v.object({
    on: v.fallback(v.boolean(), true),
    name: v.fallback(v.string(), "none"),
  });

  it("keeps the valid fields and defaults the others", () => {
    expect(parseWithDefaults(schema, { on: false, name: 7 })).toStrictEqual({
      on: false,
      name: "none",
    });
  });

  it("gives the defaults for input that is not an object", () => {
    for (const input of [undefined, null, 7, "x", true]) {
      expect(parseWithDefaults(schema, input)).toStrictEqual({ on: true, name: "none" });
    }
  });
});

describe("toJsonValue", () => {
  it("keeps strings, booleans, null, finite numbers, arrays and objects", () => {
    const value = { a: [1, "two", false, null], b: { c: 0.5 } };
    expect(toJsonValue(value)).toStrictEqual(value);
  });

  it("keeps an own __proto__ key as data and leaves the prototype alone", () => {
    const parsed = parseJson('{"__proto__":{"polluted":true},"a":1}');
    const json: unknown = toJsonValue(parsed);
    if (typeof json !== "object" || json === null) {
      throw new TypeError();
    }
    expect(json).toStrictEqual(parsed);
    expect(Object.hasOwn(json, "__proto__")).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.getPrototypeOf(json)).toBe(Object.prototype);
    expect(Reflect.get(json, "polluted")).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("leaves out object keys whose value is undefined", () => {
    expect(toJsonValue({ a: 1, b: undefined })).toStrictEqual({ a: 1 });
  });

  it("gives undefined for what JSON cannot carry, at any depth", () => {
    for (const value of [undefined, Symbol("s"), () => 1, Number.NaN, 1n, { a: () => 1 }, [1n]]) {
      expect(toJsonValue(value)).toBeUndefined();
    }
    expect(toJsonValue([Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY])).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

`src/core/json.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";

/** A value that survives a JSON round trip, as storage ports accept it. */
export type JsonValue =
  | null
  | boolean
  | number
  | string
  | readonly JsonValue[]
  | { readonly [key: string]: JsonValue; };

/**
 * Parses JSON text without trusting it: the result stays `unknown` until a validation schema turns
 * it into a typed value. The only place allowed to call `JSON.parse` (see lint/restricted-syntax).
 * Throws `SyntaxError` on malformed text, like `JSON.parse`.
 */
export function parseJson(text: string): unknown {
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

/**
 * The parsed value, or what an empty object parses to when the input does not parse. The schema
 * gives every field a fallback, so it holds the defaults once.
 */
export function parseWithDefaults<TSchema extends v.GenericSchema>(
  schema: TSchema,
  input: unknown,
): v.InferOutput<TSchema> {
  const result = v.safeParse(schema, input);
  return result.success ? result.output : v.parse(schema, {});
}

/**
 * The JSON form of a plain data value, or undefined when JSON cannot carry it (a function, NaN).
 * Keys whose value is undefined are left out, and a `__proto__` key stays an own key.
 */
export function toJsonValue(value: unknown): JsonValue | undefined {
  if (value === null || typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "boolean") {
    return value;
  }
  if (typeof value === "number") {
    return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    const items: JsonValue[] = [];
    for (const item of value) {
      const json = toJsonValue(item);
      if (json === undefined) {
        return undefined;
      }
      items.push(json);
    }
    return items;
  }
  if (typeof value === "object") {
    const fields: [string, JsonValue][] = [];
    for (const [key, field] of Object.entries(value)) {
      const json = toJsonValue(field);
      if (json !== undefined) {
        fields.push([key, json]);
      } else if (field !== undefined) {
        return undefined;
      }
    }
    return Object.fromEntries(fields);
  }
  return undefined;
}
```

```ts
    });

  });

    expect(fromDetails({ user_account_third_party: "EA", anticheat: 5 }).state).toBe("disclosed");
  });

    expect(fromDetails({ user_account_third_party: text })).toMatchObject({ text });
  });

    for (const link of ["yes", 1, []]) {
      const verdict = fromDetails({
        user_account_third_party: "EA",
        user_account_third_party_link_to_steam: link,
      });
      expect(verdict).toMatchObject({ state: "disclosed", linksToSteam: false });
    }
  });

  it("is not disclosed on a malformed link flag alone", () => {
    expect(fromDetails({ user_account_third_party_link_to_steam: 1 }).state).toBe("not-disclosed");
  });
```

`src/core/kinds/account.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { MALFORMED } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import { hasText } from "../detect/notes";
import { NOT_DISCLOSED, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import type { KindDefinition } from "./kind";
import { DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS } from "./kind-settings";
import { WEEK_TTL } from "./kind-ttl";
import { storedDisclosed } from "./stored-disclosed";

const STORED = storedDisclosed("account", {
  /** What the developer typed in `user_account_third_party`. */
  text: v.pipe(v.string(), v.minLength(1)),
  /** The account can be linked to a Steam account. */
  linksToSteam: v.boolean(),
});

/** The disclosed verdict of the third-party account kind. */
export type AccountDisclosed = v.InferOutput<typeof STORED>;

/** A third-party account the game requires. Free text, like the launcher it names. */
export const ACCOUNT_KIND: KindDefinition<AccountDisclosed> = {
  id: "account",

  fromGetItems(_item, details) {
    const { user_account_third_party: text, user_account_third_party_link_to_steam: link } =
      details;
    if (text === MALFORMED) {
      return UNKNOWN.malformed;
    }
    if (text === undefined || !hasText(text)) {
      return NOT_DISCLOSED.api;
    }
    return {
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "account",
      source: "api",
      text,
      linksToSteam: link === true,
    };
  },

  stored: STORED,

  messages: { heading: "kind_account_heading", chip: "kind_account_chip" },
  defaults: DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS,
  ttl: WEEK_TTL,
};
```

```ts
    );
  });

      source: "html",
    });
```

`src/core/kinds/ai.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { type ExtraDetails, MALFORMED, type StoreItem } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import { optionalText, trimNotes } from "../detect/notes";
import { type SteamLanguage, SteamLanguageSchema } from "../i18n/locale";
import { NOT_DISCLOSED, UNKNOWN, type Verdict } from "../types";
import type { KindDefinition } from "./kind";
import { DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS } from "./kind-settings";
import { DAY_MS, HOUR_MS } from "./kind-ttl";
import { storedDisclosed } from "./stored-disclosed";

const STORED = storedDisclosed("ai", {
  /** The developer's text, trimmed of outer whitespace and zero-width characters only. */
  notes: v.pipe(v.string(), v.minLength(1)),
  /** The Steam language the notes were requested in; Steam answers in English when untranslated. */
  language: SteamLanguageSchema,
  /** `ai_generation_service.name`, when the developer named one. */
  service: v.exactOptional(v.string()),
  /** The app's store name, for the allow-list. */
  name: v.exactOptional(v.string()),
});

/** The disclosed verdict of the AI kind: the developer's notes and, when named, the service. */
export type AiDisclosed = v.InferOutput<typeof STORED>;

/** The AI kind's verdict: disclosed with notes, not disclosed, or unknown. */
export type AiVerdict = Verdict<AiDisclosed>;

/** Steam's own heading of the AI block; the mature content block uses the same element ID. */
const DISCLOSURE_HEADING = "AI Generated Content Disclosure";
const BLOCK_SELECTOR = "#game_area_content_descriptors";
const NOTES_SELECTOR = "p > i";

/** The notes of the AI block among the blocks sharing the ID, or undefined when there is none. */
function disclosureNotes(doc: Document): string | undefined {
  for (const block of doc.querySelectorAll(BLOCK_SELECTOR)) {
    if (block.querySelector("h2")?.textContent.trim() === DISCLOSURE_HEADING) {
      return trimNotes(block.querySelector(NOTES_SELECTOR)?.textContent ?? "");
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

function fromGetItems(item: StoreItem, details: ExtraDetails, language: SteamLanguage): AiVerdict {
  const { content_survey_ai_notes: rawNotes, ai_generation_service: rawService } = details;
  if (rawNotes === MALFORMED || rawService === MALFORMED || item.name === MALFORMED) {
    return UNKNOWN.malformed;
  }
  const notes = trimNotes(rawNotes ?? "");
  if (notes === "") {
    return NOT_DISCLOSED.api;
  }
  return {
    state: "disclosed",
    kind: "ai",
    notes,
    language,
    source: "api",
    ...optionalText("service", trimNotes(rawService?.name ?? "")),
    ...optionalText("name", trimNotes(item.name ?? "")),
  };
}

/**
 * The page has no block for a game that disclosed nothing, or an empty one: not disclosed. Notes
 * keep their line breaks: each `<br>` is followed by a newline in the source.
 */
function fromAppPage(doc: Document, name: string): AiVerdict {
  const notes = disclosureNotes(doc);
  if (notes === undefined || notes === "") {
    return NOT_DISCLOSED.html;
  }
  return { state: "disclosed", kind: "ai", notes, language: "english", source: "html", name };
}

/** Generative AI use that the developer reported on Steam's content survey. */
export const AI_KIND: KindDefinition<AiDisclosed> = {
  id: "ai",
  fromGetItems,
  fromAppPage,

  stored: STORED,

  messages: { heading: "kind_ai_heading", chip: "kind_ai_chip" },

  defaults: DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS,
  // A disclosure rarely goes away; a missing one can appear.
  ttl: { disclosed: 7 * DAY_MS, notDisclosed: 12 * HOUR_MS },
};

```

`src/core/kinds/anticheat-vendor.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import type { ExtraDetails, MALFORMED } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import { optionalText } from "../detect/notes";

/** The anti-cheat object of a game that declared one, as the kernel and anti-cheat kinds read. */
export type Anticheat = Exclude<ExtraDetails["anticheat"], typeof MALFORMED | undefined>;

/** The stored fields that name the vendor, the same for a kernel and for another anti-cheat. */
export const VENDOR_FIELDS = {
  /** The vendor Steam lists; a custom anti-cheat has none, and its name is on the page only. */
  name: v.exactOptional(v.string()),
  /** Steam's own key for the vendor. */
  nameToken: v.exactOptional(v.string()),
};

/** The vendor name and token of the anti-cheat, the ones that have text. */
export function vendorOf(anticheat: Anticheat): { name?: string; nameToken?: string; } {
  return {
    ...optionalText("name", anticheat.name),
    ...optionalText("nameToken", anticheat.name_loc),
  };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { verdictOf } from "../../../tests/helpers/getitems";
import { UNKNOWN } from "../types";

describe("ANTICHEAT_KIND.fromGetItems", () => {

      anticheat: { name: "VAC (Valve Anti-Cheat)", name_loc: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_vac" },
    });
    expect(verdict).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "anticheat",
      source: "api",
      name: "VAC (Valve Anti-Cheat)",
      nameToken: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_vac",
    });
  });

  it("is disclosed with no name for an empty anti-cheat object, as for Marvel Rivals", () => {
    const expected = { state: "disclosed", kind: "anticheat", source: "api" };
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: {} })).toStrictEqual(expected);
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: { kernel_mode: false } })).toStrictEqual(expected);
  });

  it("keeps the vendor text as Steam sent it, and leaves out a blank one", () => {
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: { name: " BattlEye " } })).toMatchObject({
      name: " BattlEye ",
    });
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: { name: "", name_loc: " " } })).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "anticheat",
      source: "api",
    });
  });

  it("is not disclosed without an anti-cheat, or with a kernel one", () => {
    const none = { state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" };
    expect(fromDetails({})).toStrictEqual(none);
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: { kernel_mode: true } })).toStrictEqual(none);
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, name: "BattlEye" } })).toStrictEqual(none);
  });

  it("is unknown malformed when the anti-cheat field is malformed", () => {
    for (const anticheat of [0, "VAC", null, [{}], { kernel_mode: 1 }]) {
      expect(fromDetails({ anticheat })).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
    }
  });

  it("stays disclosed when the name is malformed, and reads an empty list as no object", () => {
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: { name: {}, name_loc: 4 } })).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "anticheat",
      source: "api",
    });
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: [] }).state).toBe("disclosed");
  });
});

describe("the kernel and anti-cheat kinds", () => {
  const anticheats: readonly Record<string, unknown>[] = [
    {},
    { kernel_mode: true },
    { kernel_mode: false },
    { name: "VAC (Valve Anti-Cheat)", name_loc: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_vac" },
    { kernel_mode: true, name: "BattlEye", name_loc: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_battleye" },
    { kernel_mode: true, uninstall_completely: true, boot_protection: true },
  ];

  it("never disclose the same anti-cheat object together, and always one of them", () => {
    for (const anticheat of anticheats) {
      const kernel = verdictOf(KERNEL_KIND, { anticheat }).state;
      const other = verdictOf(ANTICHEAT_KIND, { anticheat }).state;
      expect([kernel, other].toSorted()).toStrictEqual(["disclosed", "not-disclosed"]);
      expect(kernel === "disclosed").toBe(anticheat["kernel_mode"] === true);
    }
  });

  it("disclose neither when there is no anti-cheat object", () => {
    expect(verdictOf(KERNEL_KIND, {}).state).toBe("not-disclosed");
    expect(verdictOf(ANTICHEAT_KIND, {}).state).toBe("not-disclosed");
  });

  it("are both unknown malformed for a malformed anti-cheat object", () => {
    expect(verdictOf(KERNEL_KIND, { anticheat: "yes" })).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
    expect(verdictOf(ANTICHEAT_KIND, { anticheat: "yes" })).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
  });
});
```

`src/core/kinds/anticheat.ts`:

```ts
import type * as v from "valibot";
import { MALFORMED } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import { NOT_DISCLOSED, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { VENDOR_FIELDS, vendorOf } from "./anticheat-vendor";
import type { KindDefinition } from "./kind";
import { DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS } from "./kind-settings";
import { WEEK_TTL } from "./kind-ttl";
import { storedDisclosed } from "./stored-disclosed";

const STORED = storedDisclosed("anticheat", VENDOR_FIELDS);

/** The disclosed verdict of the anti-cheat kind: software that is not kernel level. */
export type AnticheatDisclosed = v.InferOutput<typeof STORED>;

/** An anti-cheat the developer declared without the kernel flag. The kernel kind supersedes it. */
export const ANTICHEAT_KIND: KindDefinition<AnticheatDisclosed> = {
  id: "anticheat",

  fromGetItems(_item, details) {
    const anticheat = details.anticheat;
    if (anticheat === MALFORMED) {
      return UNKNOWN.malformed;
    }
    if (anticheat === undefined || anticheat.kernel_mode === true) {
      return NOT_DISCLOSED.api;
    }
    return { state: "disclosed", kind: "anticheat", source: "api", ...vendorOf(anticheat) };
  },

  stored: STORED,

  messages: { heading: "kind_anticheat_heading", chip: "kind_anticheat_chip" },
  defaults: DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS,
  ttl: WEEK_TTL,
};
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { readTypedColor, toHexColor } from "./color";

describe("toHexColor", () => {
  it.each([
    ["#8f73f3", "#8f73f3"],
    ["8f73f3", "#8f73f3"],
    ["#8F73F3", "#8f73f3"],
    ["#abc", "#aabbcc"],
    ["ABC", "#aabbcc"],
    [" #0a0 ", "#00aa00"],
  ])("reads %s as %s", (typed, normal) => {
    expect(toHexColor(typed)).toBe(normal);
  });

  it.each([
    "",
    "#",
    "#ab",
    "#abcd",
    "#abcde",
    "#abcdeff",
    "#abcdefgh",
    "##abc",
    "#ggg",
    "red",
    "rgb(1, 2, 3)",
    "#abc; background: url(x)",
    "#abc}",
    "var(--x)",
    "\n#abc\n#def",
  ])("rejects %j", (typed) => {
    expect(toHexColor(typed)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it.each([undefined, null, 7, true, [], {}, ["#abc"]])("rejects the non-text %j", (value) => {
    expect(toHexColor(value)).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe("readTypedColor", () => {
  it("reads empty text as the default, which is valid", () => {
    expect(readTypedColor("")).toStrictEqual({ valid: true, color: undefined });
    expect(readTypedColor("   ")).toStrictEqual({ valid: true, color: undefined });
  });

  it("reads a color, and flags text that is none", () => {
    expect(readTypedColor("F00")).toStrictEqual({ valid: true, color: "#ff0000" });
    expect(readTypedColor("#12")).toStrictEqual({ valid: false });
  });
});
```

`src/core/kinds/color.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";

/** What a person may type: three or six hex digits, with or without the leading `#`. */
const TYPED_COLOR = /^#?([0-9a-f]{3}|[0-9a-f]{6})$/i;

/** The one form that ever reaches a style value: `#` and six lowercase hex digits. */
const NORMAL_COLOR = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/;

/** The typed text in its normal form; text that is no color stays as it is, for the check. */
function normalize(text: string): string {
  const digits = TYPED_COLOR.exec(text.trim())?.[1]?.toLowerCase();
  if (digits === undefined) {
    return text;
  }
  const full = digits.length === 3 ? digits.replace(/./g, "$&$&") : digits;
  return `#${full}`;
}

/**
 * A tag's custom color. The brand is applied only by this schema, so every `HexColor` in core is
 * `#rrggbb` in lowercase and is safe to write into a CSS custom property. It accepts `#rgb` and
 * `#rrggbb`, with or without the `#`, in any case, and gives the normal form.
 */
export const HexColorSchema = v.pipe(
  v.string(),
  v.transform(normalize),
  v.regex(NORMAL_COLOR),
  v.brand("HexColor"),
);

export type HexColor = v.InferOutput<typeof HexColorSchema>;

/** The color in normal form, or undefined when the text is not a hex color. */
export function toHexColor(text: unknown): HexColor | undefined {
  const result = v.safeParse(HexColorSchema, text);
  return result.success ? result.output : undefined;
}

/** What a color field holds: no color (the default), a color, or text that is neither. */
export type TypedColor =
  | { readonly valid: true; readonly color: HexColor | undefined; }
  | { readonly valid: false; };

/** Reads the text of a color field. Empty text, or only spaces, is the default color. */
export function readTypedColor(text: string): TypedColor {
  if (text.trim() === "") {
    return { valid: true, color: undefined };
  }
  const color = toHexColor(text);
  return color === undefined ? { valid: false } : { valid: true, color };
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { verdictOf } from "../../../tests/helpers/getitems";
import { UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { DRM_KIND } from "./drm";

function fromDetails(details: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) {
  return verdictOf(DRM_KIND, details);
}

describe("DRM_KIND.fromGetItems", () => {
  it("is disclosed with the developer's text", () => {
    expect(fromDetails({ drm_third_party_type: "Denuvo Anti-tamper" })).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "drm",
      source: "api",
      text: "Denuvo Anti-tamper",
    });
  });

  it("keeps the text verbatim: spacing, line breaks and markup stay", () => {
    const text = " EA online activation required.\n<b>Denuvo</b> Anti-tamper ";
    expect(fromDetails({ drm_third_party_type: text })).toMatchObject({ text });
  });

  it("adds the activation limit when Steam sends one", () => {
    const verdict = fromDetails({
      drm_third_party_type: "Denuvo",
      drm_activation_limit: "5 activations within 24 hours",
    });
    expect(verdict).toMatchObject({ activationLimit: "5 activations within 24 hours" });
    expect(fromDetails({ drm_third_party_type: "Denuvo", drm_activation_limit: " " })).not
      .toHaveProperty("activationLimit");
  });

  it("is not disclosed when the field is absent or holds only blanks", () => {
    for (const details of [{}, { drm_third_party_type: "" }, { drm_third_party_type: " \n" }]) {
      expect(fromDetails(details)).toStrictEqual({ state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" });
    }
  });

  it("is not disclosed on an activation limit alone", () => {
    expect(fromDetails({ drm_activation_limit: "5 a day" }).state).toBe("not-disclosed");
  });

  it("is unknown malformed when a field it reads is malformed, and only then", () => {
    expect(fromDetails({ drm_third_party_type: 4 })).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
    expect(fromDetails({ drm_third_party_type: "x".repeat(4001) })).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
    expect(fromDetails({ drm_third_party_type: "Denuvo", anticheat: 5, eula: 6 }).state).toBe(
      "disclosed",
    );
  });

  it("allows 4,000 characters of text", () => {
    const text = "x".repeat(4000);
    expect(fromDetails({ drm_third_party_type: text })).toMatchObject({ text });
  });

  it("stays disclosed without the activation limit when that field is malformed", () => {
    for (const drm_activation_limit of [[], 5, "x".repeat(4001)]) {
      const verdict = fromDetails({ drm_third_party_type: "Denuvo", drm_activation_limit });
      expect(verdict).toStrictEqual({
        state: "disclosed",
        kind: "drm",
        source: "api",
        text: "Denuvo",
      });
    }
  });
});
```

`src/core/kinds/drm.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { MALFORMED } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import { hasText, optionalText } from "../detect/notes";
import { NOT_DISCLOSED, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import type { KindDefinition } from "./kind";
import { DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS } from "./kind-settings";
import { WEEK_TTL } from "./kind-ttl";
import { storedDisclosed } from "./stored-disclosed";

const STORED = storedDisclosed("drm", {
  /** What the developer typed in `drm_third_party_type`. */
  text: v.pipe(v.string(), v.minLength(1)),
  /** `drm_activation_limit`, when Steam sends it. */
  activationLimit: v.exactOptional(v.string()),
});

/** The disclosed verdict of the third-party DRM kind. */
export type DrmDisclosed = v.InferOutput<typeof STORED>;

/** Third-party DRM that the developer declared. Free text: "Denuvo" has several spellings. */
export const DRM_KIND: KindDefinition<DrmDisclosed> = {
  id: "drm",

  fromGetItems(_item, details) {
    const { drm_third_party_type: text, drm_activation_limit: limit } = details;
    if (text === MALFORMED) {
      return UNKNOWN.malformed;
    }
    if (text === undefined || !hasText(text)) {
      return NOT_DISCLOSED.api;
    }
    return {
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "drm",
      source: "api",
      text,
      ...optionalText("activationLimit", limit),
    };
  },

  stored: STORED,

  messages: { heading: "kind_drm_heading", chip: "kind_drm_chip" },
  defaults: DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS,
  ttl: WEEK_TTL,
};

```

`src/core/kinds/eula.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { verdictOf } from "../../../tests/helpers/getitems";
import { UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { EULA_KIND, eulaLink } from "./eula";

function fromEula(eula: unknown) {
  return verdictOf(EULA_KIND, { eula });
}

describe("eulaLink", () => {
  it("collapses the doubled slash Steam serves", () => {
    expect(eulaLink("https://store.steampowered.com//eula/3751950_eula_0")).toBe(
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/3751950_eula_0",
    );
    expect(eulaLink("https://store.steampowered.com///eula/1_eula_0")).toBe(
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1_eula_0",
    );
  });

  it("keeps a clean link, and the query and fragment", () => {
    expect(eulaLink("https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1_eula_0")).toBe(
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1_eula_0",
    );
    expect(eulaLink("https://store.steampowered.com//eula/1_eula_0?l=english#top")).toBe(
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1_eula_0?l=english#top",
    );
  });

  it("writes the scheme and host in lower case", () => {
    expect(eulaLink("HTTPS://STORE.STEAMPOWERED.COM//eula/1")).toBe(
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1",
    );
  });

  it("drops a link on another scheme", () => {
    const schemes = [
      "http://store.steampowered.com//eula/1_eula_0",
      "javascript:alert(1)",
      "javascript://store.steampowered.com/eula/1%0Aalert(1)",
      "data:text/html,<script>alert(1)</script>",
      "ftp://store.steampowered.com/eula/1",
      "blob:https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1",
    ];
    for (const raw of schemes) {
      expect(eulaLink(raw)).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it("drops a link on another host, however the host is dressed", () => {
    const hosts = [
      "https://example.com//eula/1_eula_0",
      "https://steampowered.com/eula/1",
      "https://help.steampowered.com/eula/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com.example.com/eula/1",
      "https://example.com/store.steampowered.com/eula/1",
      "https://example.com/?next=https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com@example.com/eula/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com:pw@example.com/eula/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com./eula/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com\\@example.com/eula/1",
      "https://STORE.STEAMPOWERED.COM.example.com/eula/1",
    ];
    for (const raw of hosts) {
      expect(eulaLink(raw)).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it("drops a link with credentials or a port", () => {
    expect(eulaLink("https://user@store.steampowered.com/eula/1")).toBeUndefined();
    expect(eulaLink("https://user:pw@store.steampowered.com/eula/1")).toBeUndefined();
    expect(eulaLink("https://store.steampowered.com:8443/eula/1")).toBeUndefined();
    expect(eulaLink("https://store.steampowered.com:443/eula/1")).toBe(
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1",
    );
  });

  it("drops a link outside /eula/, also when dot segments lead out of it", () => {
    const paths = [
      "https://store.steampowered.com/",
      "https://store.steampowered.com/app/1/",
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula",
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eulas/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com/EULA/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com//app/1//eula/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/../app/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/%2e%2e/app/1",
      "https://store.steampowered.com/%65ula/1/..",
    ];
    for (const raw of paths) {
      expect(eulaLink(raw)).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });

  it("drops what is not an absolute URL", () => {
    for (const raw of ["", " ", "/eula/1", "//store.steampowered.com/eula/1", "eula/1", "null"]) {
      expect(eulaLink(raw)).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });
});

describe("EULA_KIND.fromGetItems", () => {
  it("is disclosed with every entry, in order, as for Elden Ring", () => {
    const verdict = fromEula([
      { name: "ELDEN RING EULA", url: "https://store.steampowered.com//eula/1245620_eula_0" },
      { name: "ELDEN RING EULA (JP)", url: "https://store.steampowered.com//eula/1245620_eula_1" },
    ]);
    expect(verdict).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "eula",
      source: "api",
      items: [
        { name: "ELDEN RING EULA", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1245620_eula_0" },
        { name: "ELDEN RING EULA (JP)", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1245620_eula_1" },
      ],
    });
  });

  it("keeps the name and drops the link of an entry whose URL is not an EULA link", () => {
    const verdict = fromEula([
      { name: "Terms", url: "https://example.com//eula/1" },
      { name: "More terms", url: "javascript:alert(1)" },
      { name: "Other", url: "" },
      { name: "Good", url: "https://store.steampowered.com//eula/9_eula_0" },
    ]);
    expect(verdict).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "eula",
      source: "api",
      items: [
        { name: "Terms" },
        { name: "More terms" },
        { name: "Other" },
        { name: "Good", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/9_eula_0" },
      ],
    });
  });

  it("keeps the name verbatim, markup and spacing included", () => {
    const name = " <img src=x onerror=alert(1)> EULA\n";
    const verdict = fromEula([{ name, url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1" }]);
    expect(verdict).toMatchObject({ items: [{ name }] });
  });

  it("keeps the kind disclosed for an entry that has a name and no link", () => {
    expect(fromEula([{ name: "Game terms" }])).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "eula",
      source: "api",
      items: [{ name: "Game terms" }],
    });
  });

  it("drops the entries with a blank name and keeps the others in order", () => {
    const verdict = fromEula([
      { name: "", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1" },
      { name: "First" },
      { name: " \n" },
      { name: "Second", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/2" },
    ]);
    expect(verdict).toMatchObject({
      state: "disclosed",
      items: [{ name: "First" }, { name: "Second", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/2" }],
    });
  });

  it("is not disclosed when every entry has a blank name", () => {
    const none = { state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" };
    expect(fromEula([{ name: "" }, { name: "  ", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1" }]))
      .toStrictEqual(none);
  });

  it("allows 50 entries and is unknown malformed at 51", () => {
    const entries = (count: number) => Array.from({ length: count }, () => ({ name: "Agreement" }));
    expect(fromEula(entries(50))).toMatchObject({ state: "disclosed" });
    expect(fromEula(entries(51))).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
  });

  it("allows a name of 4,000 characters and is unknown malformed at 4,001", () => {
    expect(fromEula([{ name: "x".repeat(4000) }]).state).toBe("disclosed");
    expect(fromEula([{ name: "x".repeat(4001) }])).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
  });

  it("is not disclosed without entries", () => {
    expect(verdictOf(EULA_KIND, {})).toStrictEqual({ state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" });
    expect(fromEula([])).toStrictEqual({ state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" });
  });

  it("is unknown malformed when the field is malformed, and only then", () => {
    for (const eula of ["none", {}, [3], [{ url: "https://x" }], [{ name: 4 }]]) {
      expect(fromEula(eula)).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
    }
    const others = { drm_third_party_type: 4, anticheat: "x" };
    const eula = [{ name: "Game terms", url: "https://store.steampowered.com/eula/1" }];
    expect(verdictOf(EULA_KIND, { ...others, eula }).state).toBe("disclosed");
  });
});
```

`src/core/kinds/eula.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { MALFORMED } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import { hasText } from "../detect/notes";
import { NOT_DISCLOSED, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import type { KindDefinition } from "./kind";
import { DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS } from "./kind-settings";
import { WEEK_TTL } from "./kind-ttl";
import { storedDisclosed } from "./stored-disclosed";

/** A link that `eulaLink` checked: an HTTPS address of the store's own EULA pages. */
export type EulaUrl = string & v.Brand<"EulaUrl">;

/** One third-party agreement: its name as typed, and a link when it is safe to show. */
export interface EulaItem {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly url?: EulaUrl;
}

/** What is stored for an agreement: the link is checked again when it is read back. */
const ITEM = v.pipe(
  v.object({ name: v.string(), url: v.exactOptional(v.string()) }),
  v.readonly(),
);

const EULA_HOST = "store.steampowered.com";
const EULA_PATH = "/eula/";
/** Steam serves its EULA links with a doubled slash after the host. */
const LEADING_SLASHES = /^\/{2,}/;

const EulaUrlSchema = v.pipe(v.string(), v.brand("EulaUrl"));

function parseUrl(raw: string): URL | undefined {
  try {
    return new URL(raw);
  } catch {
    // Not an absolute URL, so there is no link to keep.
    return undefined;
  }
}

/**
 * The link as `https://store.steampowered.com/eula/...`, or undefined for anything else.
 * That covers another host or scheme, credentials, a port, and a path outside `/eula/`.
 * Steam's doubled leading slash collapses to one.
 */
export function eulaLink(raw: string): EulaUrl | undefined {
  const url = parseUrl(raw);
  if (
    url?.protocol !== "https:" || url.host !== EULA_HOST || url.username !== ""
    || url.password !== ""
  ) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const path = url.pathname.replace(LEADING_SLASHES, "/");
  return path.startsWith(EULA_PATH)
    ? v.parse(EulaUrlSchema, `https://${EULA_HOST}${path}${url.search}${url.hash}`)
    : undefined;
}

/** The entries as stored, with a link that is not an EULA link dropped and the name kept. */
function keepSafeLinks(stored: v.InferOutput<typeof ITEM>[]): EulaItem[] {
  return stored.map(({ name, url }) => {
    const link = url === undefined ? undefined : eulaLink(url);
    return link === undefined ? { name } : { name, url: link };
  });
}

const STORED = storedDisclosed("eula", {
  /** Every agreement the developer lists. */
  items: v.pipe(v.array(ITEM), v.minLength(1), v.transform(keepSafeLinks), v.readonly()),
});

/** The disclosed verdict of the third-party EULA kind. */
export type EulaDisclosed = v.InferOutput<typeof STORED>;

/** The third-party agreements a player must accept: the names the developer typed, and links. */
export const EULA_KIND: KindDefinition<EulaDisclosed> = {
  id: "eula",

  fromGetItems(_item, details) {
    const eula = details.eula;
    if (eula === MALFORMED) {
      return UNKNOWN.malformed;
    }
    const items: EulaItem[] = [];
    for (const entry of eula ?? []) {
      if (hasText(entry.name)) {
        const url = entry.url === undefined ? undefined : eulaLink(entry.url);
        items.push(url === undefined ? { name: entry.name } : { name: entry.name, url });
      }
    }
    return items.length === 0
      ? NOT_DISCLOSED.api
      : { state: "disclosed", kind: "eula", source: "api", items };
  },

  stored: STORED,

  messages: { heading: "kind_eula_heading", chip: "kind_eula_chip" },
  defaults: DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS,
  ttl: WEEK_TTL,
};

```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { verdictOf } from "../../../tests/helpers/getitems";
import { UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { KERNEL_KIND } from "./kernel";

function fromDetails(details: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>) {
  return verdictOf(KERNEL_KIND, details);
}

describe("KERNEL_KIND.fromGetItems", () => {
  it("is disclosed with the vendor Steam names, as for ARC Raiders", () => {
    const verdict = fromDetails({
      anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, name: "Denuvo", name_loc: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_denuvo" },
    });
    expect(verdict).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "kernel",
      source: "api",
      name: "Denuvo",
      nameToken: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_denuvo",
      uninstallsCompletely: false,
    });
  });

  it("is disclosed with no name for a custom anti-cheat, with boot protection", () => {
    const verdict = fromDetails({
      anticheat: {
        kernel_mode: true,
        uninstall_completely: true,
        boot_protection: true,
        boot_protection_name: "secureboot_tpm2",
      },
    });
    expect(verdict).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "kernel",
      source: "api",
      uninstallsCompletely: true,
      bootProtection: { token: "secureboot_tpm2" },
    });
  });

  it("sets boot protection from its flag alone, with no token when Steam sent none", () => {
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, boot_protection: true } })).toMatchObject({
      bootProtection: {},
    });
    const ignored = fromDetails({
      anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, boot_protection: false, boot_protection_name: "tpm" },
    });
    expect(ignored).not.toHaveProperty("bootProtection");
    expect(
      fromDetails({
        anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, boot_protection: true, boot_protection_name: " " },
      }),
    ).toMatchObject({ bootProtection: {} });
  });

  it("keeps the vendor text as Steam sent it, and leaves out a blank one", () => {
    const padded = fromDetails({ anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, name: " <b>EAC</b> " } });
    expect(padded).toMatchObject({ name: " <b>EAC</b> " });
    const blank = fromDetails({ anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, name: "  ", name_loc: "" } });
    expect(blank).not.toHaveProperty("name");
    expect(blank).not.toHaveProperty("nameToken");
  });

  it("is not disclosed without the kernel flag, or without an anti-cheat", () => {
    const cases = [
      {},
      { anticheat: {} },
      { anticheat: { kernel_mode: false } },
      { anticheat: { name: "VAC (Valve Anti-Cheat)", name_loc: "#Store_AntiCheat_Type_vac" } },
    ];
    for (const details of cases) {
      expect(fromDetails(details)).toStrictEqual({ state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" });
    }
  });

  it("is unknown malformed when the anti-cheat field is malformed, and only then", () => {
    for (const anticheat of [true, "kernel", [1], { kernel_mode: "true" }, { kernel_mode: 1 }]) {
      expect(fromDetails({ anticheat })).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
    }
    const others = { drm_third_party_type: 4, eula: "x", user_account_third_party: [] };
    expect(fromDetails({ ...others, anticheat: { kernel_mode: true } }).state).toBe("disclosed");
  });

  it("stays disclosed when a field that only adds detail is malformed", () => {
    const anticheat = {
      kernel_mode: true,
      uninstall_completely: "yes",
      boot_protection: 1,
      name: 3,
      name_loc: [],
      boot_protection_name: false,
    };
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat })).toStrictEqual({
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "kernel",
      source: "api",
      uninstallsCompletely: false,
    });
  });

  it("reads a name over 4,000 characters as absent, and 4,000 as given", () => {
    const name = "x".repeat(4000);
    expect(fromDetails({ anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, name } })).toMatchObject({ name });
    const over = fromDetails({ anticheat: { kernel_mode: true, name: `${name}x` } });
    expect(over).toMatchObject({ state: "disclosed" });
    expect(over).not.toHaveProperty("name");
  });
});
```

`src/core/kinds/kernel.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { MALFORMED } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import { optionalText } from "../detect/notes";
import { NOT_DISCLOSED, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { VENDOR_FIELDS, vendorOf } from "./anticheat-vendor";
import type { KindDefinition } from "./kind";
import { DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS } from "./kind-settings";
import { WEEK_TTL } from "./kind-ttl";
import { storedDisclosed } from "./stored-disclosed";

const STORED = storedDisclosed("kernel", {
  ...VENDOR_FIELDS,
  /** False when the anti-cheat leaves files behind after an uninstall. */
  uninstallsCompletely: v.boolean(),
  /** Set when the game needs boot protection, with Steam's key for the kind when it sent one. */
  bootProtection: v.exactOptional(
    v.pipe(v.object({ token: v.exactOptional(v.string()) }), v.readonly()),
  ),
});

/** The disclosed verdict of the kernel-level anti-cheat kind. */
export type KernelDisclosed = v.InferOutput<typeof STORED>;

/** An anti-cheat that runs at kernel level, as Steam's own `kernel_mode` flag says. */
export const KERNEL_KIND: KindDefinition<KernelDisclosed> = {
  id: "kernel",

  fromGetItems(_item, details) {
    const anticheat = details.anticheat;
    if (anticheat === MALFORMED) {
      return UNKNOWN.malformed;
    }
    if (anticheat?.kernel_mode !== true) {
      return NOT_DISCLOSED.api;
    }
    return {
      state: "disclosed",
      kind: "kernel",
      source: "api",
      ...vendorOf(anticheat),
      uninstallsCompletely: anticheat.uninstall_completely === true,
      ...(anticheat.boot_protection === true
        ? { bootProtection: optionalText("token", anticheat.boot_protection_name) }
        : {}),
    };
  },

  stored: STORED,

  messages: { heading: "kind_kernel_heading", chip: "kind_kernel_chip" },
  defaults: DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS,
  ttl: WEEK_TTL,
};
```

`src/core/kinds/kind-settings.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { toHexColor } from "./color";
import {
  effectiveSettings,
  encodeKindSettings,
  type KindSettings,
  LIST_FILTERS,
  mergeKindSettings,
  parseKindSettings,
} from "./kind-settings";

const DEFAULTS: KindSettings = { enabled: true, badge: true, banner: true, filter: "off" };
const VIOLET = toHexColor("#8f73f3");

describe("LIST_FILTERS", () => {
  it("lists the three filters in the order the settings show them", () => {
    expect(LIST_FILTERS).toStrictEqual(["off", "dim", "hide"]);
  });
});

describe("parseKindSettings", () => {
  it("returns the defaults when nothing valid is stored", () => {
    for (const stored of [undefined, null, 7, "dim", true, [], [{ badge: false }]]) {
      expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, stored)).toStrictEqual(DEFAULTS);
    }
  });

  it("accepts every valid value", () => {
    const stored: KindSettings = { enabled: false, badge: false, banner: false, filter: "hide" };
    expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, stored)).toStrictEqual(stored);
  });

  it("falls back per field and keeps the valid ones", () => {
    expect(
      parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { enabled: 0, badge: "yes", banner: false, filter: "blur" }),
    ).toStrictEqual({ ...DEFAULTS, banner: false });
  });

  it("falls back to the given defaults, not to fixed ones", () => {
    const other: KindSettings = { enabled: false, badge: false, banner: true, filter: "dim" };
    expect(parseKindSettings(other, {})).toStrictEqual(other);
  });

  it("has no color until one is stored, and no color key either", () => {
    expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, {})).not.toHaveProperty("color");
    expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { color: undefined })).not.toHaveProperty("color");
  });

  it("reads a stored color in its normal form", () => {
    expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { color: "#8F73F3" }).color).toBe(VIOLET);
    expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { color: "f0a" }).color).toBe("#ff00aa");
  });

  it("drops a color that is not one and keeps the other fields", () => {
    for (const color of ["red", "#12", "#abc; x", 7, null, true, {}, []]) {
      const parsed = parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { color, filter: "dim" });
      expect(parsed, JSON.stringify(color)).toStrictEqual({ ...DEFAULTS, filter: "dim" });
    }
  });

  it("falls back to the color of the given defaults", () => {
    const tinted = mergeKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { color: VIOLET });
    expect(parseKindSettings(tinted, { color: "nope" })).toStrictEqual(tinted);
  });

  it("drops keys it does not know", () => {
    expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { ...DEFAULTS, theme: "dark" })).toStrictEqual(DEFAULTS);
  });
});

describe("effectiveSettings", () => {
  it("keeps the color of a disabled kind", () => {
    const tinted = mergeKindSettings({ ...DEFAULTS, enabled: false }, { color: VIOLET });
    expect(effectiveSettings(tinted).color).toBe(VIOLET);
  });

  it("keeps the settings of an enabled kind as they are", () => {
    const settings: KindSettings = { enabled: true, badge: false, banner: true, filter: "dim" };
    expect(effectiveSettings(settings)).toBe(settings);
  });

  it("shows no badge or banner and filters nothing while the kind is disabled", () => {
    expect(
      effectiveSettings({ enabled: false, badge: true, banner: true, filter: "hide" }),
    ).toStrictEqual({ enabled: false, badge: false, banner: false, filter: "off" });
  });
});

describe("mergeKindSettings", () => {
  it("replaces the fields of the patch and keeps the others", () => {
    expect(mergeKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { badge: false })).toStrictEqual({
      ...DEFAULTS,
      badge: false,
    });
    expect(mergeKindSettings(DEFAULTS, undefined)).toStrictEqual(DEFAULTS);
  });

  it("sets a color, keeps it through other patches and clears it with undefined", () => {
    const tinted = mergeKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { color: VIOLET });
    expect(tinted.color).toBe(VIOLET);
    expect(mergeKindSettings(tinted, { filter: "dim" }).color).toBe(VIOLET);
    const cleared = mergeKindSettings(tinted, { color: undefined });
    expect(cleared).toStrictEqual(DEFAULTS);
    expect(cleared).not.toHaveProperty("color");
  });
});

describe("encodeKindSettings", () => {
  it("stores every field and reads back through parseKindSettings", () => {
    const settings: KindSettings = { enabled: false, badge: true, banner: false, filter: "hide" };
    expect(encodeKindSettings(settings)).toStrictEqual({
      enabled: false,
      badge: true,
      banner: false,
      filter: "hide",
    });
    expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, encodeKindSettings(settings))).toStrictEqual(settings);
  });

  it("stores a color as the text #rrggbb, and no key at all without one", () => {
    expect(encodeKindSettings(DEFAULTS)).not.toHaveProperty("color");
    const tinted = mergeKindSettings(DEFAULTS, { color: VIOLET });
    expect(encodeKindSettings(tinted)).toStrictEqual({ ...DEFAULTS, color: "#8f73f3" });
    expect(parseKindSettings(DEFAULTS, encodeKindSettings(tinted))).toStrictEqual(tinted);
  });
});
```

`src/core/kinds/kind-settings.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { type JsonValue, parseWithDefaults } from "../json";
import { type HexColor, HexColorSchema } from "./color";

/** What the list filter does to hosts whose app carries a kind's tag. */
export const LIST_FILTERS = ["off", "dim", "hide"] as const;

export type ListFilter = (typeof LIST_FILTERS)[number];

/** The user's settings for one tag kind. */
export interface KindSettings {
  /** Master switch: a disabled kind draws no badge, banner or filter. */
  readonly enabled: boolean;
  /** Show the badge on capsules. */
  readonly badge: boolean;
  /** Show the banner on app pages. */
  readonly banner: boolean;
  readonly filter: ListFilter;
  /** The tag's own color on every surface that carries it; absent, the default violet. */
  readonly color?: HexColor | undefined;
}

/**
 * What a kind starts with: switched on, badge and banner shown, the list left alone, and no custom
 * color.
 */
export const DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS: KindSettings = {
  enabled: true,
  badge: true,
  banner: true,
  filter: "off",
};

function kindSettingsSchema(defaults: KindSettings) {
  return v.object({
    enabled: v.fallback(v.boolean(), defaults.enabled),
    badge: v.fallback(v.boolean(), defaults.badge),
    banner: v.fallback(v.boolean(), defaults.banner),
    filter: v.fallback(v.picklist(LIST_FILTERS), defaults.filter),
    color: v.fallback(v.optional(HexColorSchema), defaults.color),
  });
}

const schemas = new WeakMap<KindSettings, ReturnType<typeof kindSettingsSchema>>();

/** The stored settings: each valid field, and the default for every other one. */
export function parseKindSettings(defaults: KindSettings, stored: unknown): KindSettings {
  let schema = schemas.get(defaults);
  if (schema === undefined) {
    schema = kindSettingsSchema(defaults);
    schemas.set(defaults, schema);
  }
  const { color, ...rest } = parseWithDefaults(schema, stored);
  // No `color` key at all while none is set, so a kind with no color reads back as its defaults.
  return color === undefined ? rest : { ...rest, color };
}

/**
 * One kind's settings with the fields of `patch` replaced. A `color` of `undefined` clears the
 * color, and leaves no key behind, so settings with no color are equal however they got there.
 */
export function mergeKindSettings(
  settings: KindSettings,
  patch: Readonly<Partial<KindSettings>> | undefined,
): KindSettings {
  const { color, ...rest } = { ...settings, ...patch };
  return color === undefined ? rest : { ...rest, color };
}

/** The stored value of one kind's settings; a field added to `KindSettings` must be added here. */
export function encodeKindSettings(settings: KindSettings): JsonValue {
  const stored: Readonly<Record<Exclude<keyof KindSettings, "color">, JsonValue>> = {
    enabled: settings.enabled,
    badge: settings.badge,
    banner: settings.banner,
    filter: settings.filter,
  };
  // An unset color is left out, so what is stored stays what it was before colors existed.
  return settings.color === undefined ? stored : { ...stored, color: settings.color };
}

/** The settings that take effect: a disabled kind shows no badge or banner and filters nothing. */
export function effectiveSettings(settings: KindSettings): KindSettings {
  return settings.enabled ? settings : { ...settings, badge: false, banner: false, filter: "off" };
}

```

`src/core/kinds/kind-ttl.ts`:

```ts
export const HOUR_MS = 3_600_000;
export const DAY_MS = 24 * HOUR_MS;

/** How long a kind's verdicts stay fresh in the cache, by state. Unknown ones have their own. */
export interface KindTtl {
  readonly disclosed: number;
  readonly notDisclosed: number;
}

/** A declaration the developer rarely changes: both answers keep for a week. */
export const WEEK_TTL: KindTtl = { disclosed: 7 * DAY_MS, notDisclosed: 7 * DAY_MS };

```

`src/core/kinds/kind.ts`:

```ts
import type * as v from "valibot";
import type { ExtraDetails, StoreItem } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import type { SteamLanguage } from "../i18n/locale";
import type { BareMessageKey } from "../i18n/t";
import type { DisclosedBase, Verdict } from "../types";
import type { KindSettings } from "./kind-settings";
import type { KindTtl } from "./kind-ttl";
import type { KINDS } from "./registry";

/** The catalog keys of the words a kind uses on every surface, in Steam's vocabulary. */
export interface KindMessages {
  /**
   * Steam's own line for the kind: the hover card title, the banner heading and, after the chip
   * text, the chip's accessible name.
   */
  readonly heading: BareMessageKey;
  /** The short text of the kind's chip. */
  readonly chip: BareMessageKey;
}

/**
 * One tag kind: what the extension reports about a game. `Disclosed` is the shape of its disclosed
 * verdict. A new kind is a definition listed in `registry.ts`; the scanner, the chain and the
 * cache stay as they are.
 */
export interface KindDefinition<Disclosed extends DisclosedBase> {
  /** Stable; stored in the settings and in the ignore list. */
  readonly id: Disclosed["kind"];
  /**
   * The kind's verdict for a GetItems item and its `extra_details`. It is unknown malformed when a
   * field it reads has the wrong shape. The language is the one the request asked for.
   */
  readonly fromGetItems: (
    item: StoreItem,
    details: ExtraDetails,
    language: SteamLanguage,
  ) => Verdict<Disclosed>;
  /**
   * The kind's verdict from an English app page that passed the store checks, given the app's name.
   * Only kinds that can be read from the page declare it; the others stay unknown on that path.
   */
  readonly fromAppPage?: (doc: Document, name: string) => Verdict<Disclosed>;
  /** Reads a stored disclosed verdict back; anything that does not fit is dropped. */
  readonly stored: v.GenericSchema<unknown, Disclosed>;
  readonly messages: KindMessages;
  readonly defaults: KindSettings;
  readonly ttl: KindTtl;
}

/** Every registered kind. */
export type TagKind = (typeof KINDS)[number];

```

`src/core/kinds/pvp.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { verdictOf } from "../../../tests/helpers/getitems";
import { UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import { PVP_CATEGORY_IDS, PVP_KIND, pvpCategoryMessage } from "./pvp";

function fromCategories(categories: unknown) {
  return verdictOf(PVP_KIND, {}, { categories });
}

function fromIds(ids: readonly unknown[]) {
  return fromCategories({ supported_player_categoryids: ids });
}

describe("pvpCategoryMessage", () => {
  it("names each PvP category with its own catalog key", () => {
    const keys = PVP_CATEGORY_IDS.map((id) => pvpCategoryMessage(id));
    expect(keys).toStrictEqual([
      "kind_pvp_category_pvp",
      "kind_pvp_category_online",
      "kind_pvp_category_lan",
      "kind_pvp_category_split",
    ]);
  });

  it("names no other category", () => {
    expect(pvpCategoryMessage(1)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(pvpCategoryMessage(0)).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe("PVP_KIND.fromGetItems", () => {
  it("knows Steam's four PvP categories", () => {
    expect(PVP_CATEGORY_IDS).toStrictEqual([49, 36, 47, 37]);
  });

  it("is disclosed by each PvP category on its own", () => {
    for (const id of PVP_CATEGORY_IDS) {
      expect(fromIds([2, id, 9])).toStrictEqual({
        state: "disclosed",
        kind: "pvp",
        source: "api",
        categoryIds: [id],
      });
    }
  });

  it("lists the matching categories in the order Steam sent them", () => {
    expect(fromIds([2, 1, 37, 49, 36, 9, 47])).toMatchObject({ categoryIds: [37, 49, 36, 47] });
  });

  it("is not disclosed when no category is a PvP one", () => {
    const none = { state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" };
    expect(fromIds([2, 1, 9, 38, 27])).toStrictEqual(none);
    expect(fromIds([])).toStrictEqual(none);
    // Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 carry no PvP category.
    expect(fromIds([1, 27])).toStrictEqual(none);
  });

  it("is unknown missing when the item has no player categories", () => {
    expect(verdictOf(PVP_KIND)).toBe(UNKNOWN.missing);
    expect(fromCategories({})).toBe(UNKNOWN.missing);
    expect(fromCategories({ feature_categoryids: [49] })).toBe(UNKNOWN.missing);
  });

  it("is unknown malformed when the categories are malformed", () => {
    for (const categories of ["pvp", [49], { supported_player_categoryids: "49" }]) {
      expect(fromCategories(categories)).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
    }
    expect(fromIds([49, "36"])).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
    expect(fromIds([49, null])).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
  });

  it("allows 50 category IDs and is unknown malformed at 51", () => {
    const ids = (count: number) => Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => 1000 + i);
    expect(fromIds([...ids(49), 49]).state).toBe("disclosed");
    expect(fromIds(ids(51))).toBe(UNKNOWN.malformed);
  });

  it("is not moved by a malformed field of another kind", () => {
    const verdict = verdictOf(PVP_KIND, { anticheat: 4, eula: "x" }, {
      categories: { supported_player_categoryids: [49] },
    });
    expect(verdict.state).toBe("disclosed");
  });
});
```

`src/core/kinds/pvp.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { MALFORMED } from "../detect/getitems.schema";
import type { BareMessageKey } from "../i18n/t";
import { NOT_DISCLOSED, UNKNOWN } from "../types";
import type { KindDefinition } from "./kind";
import { DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS } from "./kind-settings";
import { WEEK_TTL } from "./kind-ttl";
import { storedDisclosed } from "./stored-disclosed";

/**
 * Steam's player category IDs for player-versus-player modes, with the catalog key of the name
 * Steam gives each: 49 PvP, 36 Online PvP, 47 LAN PvP, 37 Shared/Split Screen PvP.
 */
const CATEGORY_MESSAGES: ReadonlyMap<number, BareMessageKey> = new Map([
  [49, "kind_pvp_category_pvp"],
  [36, "kind_pvp_category_online"],
  [47, "kind_pvp_category_lan"],
  [37, "kind_pvp_category_split"],
]);

export const PVP_CATEGORY_IDS: readonly number[] = [...CATEGORY_MESSAGES.keys()];

/** The catalog key of a PvP category's name, or undefined for any other category ID. */
export function pvpCategoryMessage(id: number): BareMessageKey | undefined {
  return CATEGORY_MESSAGES.get(id);
}

const STORED = storedDisclosed("pvp", {
  /** The player categories of the game that mean PvP. */
  categoryIds: v.pipe(v.array(v.pipe(v.number(), v.integer())), v.minLength(1), v.readonly()),
});

/** The disclosed verdict of the PvP kind. */
export type PvpDisclosed = v.InferOutput<typeof STORED>;

/**
 * The game has a player-versus-player mode, from its Steam categories. Unlike the other kinds this
 * is not a developer's declaration in `extra_details`; an item without categories says nothing.
 */
export const PVP_KIND: KindDefinition<PvpDisclosed> = {
  id: "pvp",

  fromGetItems(item) {
    const { categories } = item;
    if (categories === MALFORMED) {
      return UNKNOWN.malformed;
    }
    const ids = categories?.supported_player_categoryids;
    if (ids === undefined) {
      return UNKNOWN.missing;
    }
    const categoryIds: number[] = [];
    for (const id of ids) {
      if (PVP_CATEGORY_IDS.includes(id)) {
        categoryIds.push(id);
      }
    }
    return categoryIds.length === 0
      ? NOT_DISCLOSED.api
      : { state: "disclosed", kind: "pvp", source: "api", categoryIds };
  },

  stored: STORED,

  messages: { heading: "kind_pvp_heading", chip: "kind_pvp_chip" },
  // A PvP mode is on most games, so the tag starts off until the player turns it on.
  defaults: { ...DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS, enabled: false },
  ttl: WEEK_TTL,
};

```

```ts
describe("KINDS", () => {

    expect(new Set(KIND_IDS).size).toBe(KIND_IDS.length);

        badge: true,
        banner: true,
        filter: "off",
      });

describe("perKind", () => {
  it("calls make once for each registered kind and keys the results by kind id", () => {
    const seen: string[] = [];
    const result = perKind((kind) => {
      seen.push(kind.id);
      return kind.messages.chip;
    });
    expect(seen).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
    expect(Object.keys(result)).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
    expect(result.ai).toBe(KINDS[0].messages.chip);

      expect(KIND_BY_ID[kind.id]).toBe(kind);
    }
  });

describe("holdsEveryKind", () => {
  it("is true only when a value is present for each registered kind", () => {
    expect(holdsEveryKind(perKind(() => 1))).toBe(true);
    expect(holdsEveryKind({})).toBe(false);
    expect(holdsEveryKind({ ...perKind(() => 1), ai: undefined })).toBe(false);
  });

  it("asks `fits` about every slot and fails when one value does not fit", () => {
    const seen: string[] = [];
    const fits = (id: string, value: number): boolean => {
      seen.push(id);
      return value > 0;
    };
    expect(holdsEveryKind(perKind(() => 1), fits)).toBe(true);
    expect(seen).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
    expect(holdsEveryKind({ ...perKind(() => 1), kernel: 0 }, fits)).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("kind messages", () => {
  const locales = Object.entries(SHIPPED_CATALOGS);

  it.each(locales)("%s names every kind with a heading and a chip", (_locale, catalog) => {
    for (const kind of KINDS) {
      expect(catalog?.[kind.messages.heading]?.message).toBeTruthy();
      expect(catalog?.[kind.messages.chip]?.message).toBeTruthy();
    }
  });

  it.each(locales)(
    "%s gives every kind its own chip, no longer than its heading",
    (_l, catalog) => {
      const chips = KINDS.map((kind) => catalog?.[kind.messages.chip]?.message ?? "");
      expect(new Set(chips).size).toBe(KINDS.length);
      for (const kind of KINDS) {
        const chip = catalog?.[kind.messages.chip]?.message ?? "";
        const heading = catalog?.[kind.messages.heading]?.message ?? "";
        expect(chip.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(heading.length);

    },
```

`src/core/kinds/registry.ts`:

```ts
import { SarError } from "../errors";
import { ACCOUNT_KIND } from "./account";
import { AI_KIND } from "./ai";
import { ANTICHEAT_KIND } from "./anticheat";
import { DRM_KIND } from "./drm";
import { EULA_KIND } from "./eula";
import type { KindId } from "./id";
import { KERNEL_KIND } from "./kernel";
import type { TagKind } from "./kind";
import { PVP_KIND } from "./pvp";

/**
 * The one place that lists the kinds. The kind ids, the settings defaults and every per-kind
 * record derive from it. A new kind is one entry here and its definition.
 */
export const KINDS = [
  AI_KIND,
  KERNEL_KIND,
  ANTICHEAT_KIND,
  DRM_KIND,
  ACCOUNT_KIND,
  EULA_KIND,
  PVP_KIND,
] as const;

function anyValue(): boolean {
  return true;
}

/**
 * Whether `values` holds a value for every registered kind, and `fits` accepts each one in its
 * slot. Builders fill one slot per kind from that kind's own definition.
 */
export function holdsEveryKind<T>(
  values: Partial<Record<KindId, T>>,
  fits: (id: KindId, value: T) => boolean = anyValue,
): values is Readonly<Record<KindId, T>> {
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    const value = values[kind.id];
    if (value === undefined || !fits(kind.id, value)) {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * One `make(kind)` result for each registered kind, keyed by kind id. `make` never returns
 * undefined. The hot paths loop over `KINDS` instead, so they allocate no closure per call.
 */
export function perKind<T>(make: (kind: TagKind) => T): Readonly<Record<KindId, T>> {
  const values: Partial<Record<KindId, T>> = {};
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    values[kind.id] = make(kind);
  }
  if (holdsEveryKind(values)) {
    return values;
  }
  throw new SarError("error_unexpected", {});
}

/** Each registered kind's definition by id, for code that holds a verdict and needs its words. */
export const KIND_BY_ID: Readonly<Record<KindId, TagKind>> = perKind((kind) => kind);

```

`src/core/kinds/stored-disclosed.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { VerdictSourceSchema } from "../types";

type StoredEntries<TKind extends string, TFields extends v.ObjectEntries> =
  & {
    readonly state: v.LiteralSchema<"disclosed", undefined>;
    readonly kind: v.LiteralSchema<TKind, undefined>;
    readonly source: typeof VerdictSourceSchema;
  }
  & TFields;

type StoredObject<TKind extends string, TFields extends v.ObjectEntries> = v.ObjectSchema<
  StoredEntries<TKind, TFields>,
  undefined
>;

type StoredSchema<TKind extends string, TFields extends v.ObjectEntries> = v.SchemaWithPipe<
  readonly [
    StoredObject<TKind, TFields>,
    v.ReadonlyAction<v.InferOutput<StoredObject<TKind, TFields>>>,
  ]
>;

/**
 * The schema of a stored disclosed verdict of `kind`: the common fields, then the kind's `fields`.
 * The verdict type is this schema's output, so a field cannot be added without being stored.
 */
export function storedDisclosed<
  const TKind extends string,
  const TFields extends v.ObjectEntries,
>(kind: TKind, fields: TFields): StoredSchema<TKind, TFields> {
  return v.pipe(
    v.object({
      state: v.literal("disclosed"),
      kind: v.literal(kind),
      source: VerdictSourceSchema,
      ...fields,
    }),
    v.readonly(),
  );
}
```

```ts
  it("holds the shared unknown verdict of its reason for every kind", () => {

      expect(Object.keys(UNKNOWN_KINDS[reason])).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);

    expect(sameVerdicts([], [])).toBe(true);
    expect(sameVerdicts([ai, drm], [ai, drm])).toBe(true);
  });

  it("fails on another order, another length or a copy of a verdict", () => {
    expect(sameVerdicts([ai, drm], [drm, ai])).toBe(false);
    expect(sameVerdicts([ai], [ai, pvp])).toBe(false);
    expect(sameVerdicts([ai, drm], [ai])).toBe(false);
    expect(sameVerdicts([ai], [{ ...ai }])).toBe(false);
  });

    expect(isKindVerdicts(FULL_DISCLOSED)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects a disclosed verdict in the slot of another kind", () => {
    expect(isKindVerdicts({ ...FULL_DISCLOSED, kernel: FULL_DISCLOSED.anticheat })).toBe(false);
    expect(isKindVerdicts({ ...FULL_DISCLOSED, ai: FULL_DISCLOSED.pvp })).toBe(false);

    }
  });

    const verdicts = kindsFromGetItems(item, details, "english");
```
