`src/core/settings/migrate.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { SarError } from "../errors";
import { type JsonValue, parseWithDefaults } from "../json";
import { LIST_FILTERS } from "../kinds/kind-settings";
import type { KeyValueStore } from "../ports";
import { ALLOW_KEY, LEGACY_ALLOW_KEY, LEGACY_SETTINGS_KEY, SETTINGS_KEY } from "../storage-keys";
import { decodeAllowScope, encodeAllow, perScope } from "./allow-data";
import {
  AUTO_LOCALE,
  DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
  encodeSettings,
  LocaleSchema,
  type Settings,
} from "./settings";

// Layout v1 kept one flat settings object and one list of ignored games, both about AI. The
// migration copies them to the v2 keys and leaves the v1 keys as they are.

const LegacySettingsSchema = v.object({
  badges: v.fallback(v.boolean(), true),
  banner: v.fallback(v.boolean(), true),
  listFilter: v.fallback(v.picklist(LIST_FILTERS), "off"),
  locale: v.fallback(LocaleSchema, AUTO_LOCALE),
  debug: v.fallback(v.boolean(), false),
});

/** The v2 settings for a stored v1 value: valid fields carry over, the rest take defaults. */
export function settingsFromV1(stored: unknown): Settings {
  const legacy = parseWithDefaults(LegacySettingsSchema, stored);
  return {
    ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
    locale: legacy.locale,
    debug: legacy.debug,
    kinds: {
      ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.kinds,
      ai: {
        ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.kinds.ai,
        badge: legacy.badges,
        banner: legacy.banner,
        filter: legacy.listFilter,
      },
    },
  };
}

/** The v2 stored ignore list for a stored v1 list: every valid entry, in the AI scope. */
export function allowFromV1(stored: unknown): JsonValue {
  return encodeAllow({ ...perScope(() => new Map()), ai: decodeAllowScope(stored) });
}

/** What a migration run did to a v2 key: copied the v1 value, or found nothing to copy. */
export type Migration = "migrated" | "current";

/** One v1 key and the v2 key that replaces it. Each move runs on its own. */
interface Move {
  readonly from: string;
  readonly to: string;
  /** The v2 stored value for a stored v1 value. */
  readonly convert: (v1: unknown) => JsonValue;
}

const SETTINGS_MOVE: Move = {
  from: LEGACY_SETTINGS_KEY,
  to: SETTINGS_KEY,
  convert: (v1) => encodeSettings(settingsFromV1(v1)),
};

const ALLOW_MOVE: Move = { from: LEGACY_ALLOW_KEY, to: ALLOW_KEY, convert: allowFromV1 };

const MOVES: readonly Move[] = [SETTINGS_MOVE, ALLOW_MOVE];

const ObjectSchema = v.record(v.string(), v.unknown());

/** Whether a stored v2 value is usable: an object, of which readers take every valid field. */
function isUsable(value: unknown): boolean {
  return v.is(ObjectSchema, value) && !Array.isArray(value);
}

async function usableValue(store: KeyValueStore, key: string): Promise<boolean> {
  return isUsable((await store.get([key])).get(key));
}

/**
 * Copies one v1 value to its v2 key unless the v2 key holds a usable value, which always wins.
 * It throws when the copy is missing or unusable on read-back; any usable value passes.
 */
async function migrateMove(store: KeyValueStore, move: Move): Promise<Migration> {
  if (await usableValue(store, move.to)) {
    return "current";
  }
  const legacy = await store.get([move.from]);
  // Another context may have written the v2 key since the first read.
  if (!legacy.has(move.from) || await usableValue(store, move.to)) {
    return "current";
  }
  await store.set(new Map([[move.to, move.convert(legacy.get(move.from))]]));
  const stored = (await store.get([move.to])).get(move.to);
  if (!isUsable(stored)) {
    throw new SarError("error_settings_load", {}, { cause: { key: move.to, stored } });
  }
  return "migrated";
}

/**
 * Migrates every move on its own: one that fails does not stop or undo another. The first
 * failure is thrown, as the cause of a migration error, after all have run.
 */
export async function migrateStorage(store: KeyValueStore): Promise<Migration> {
  let result: Migration = "current";
  let failure: { readonly problem: unknown; } | undefined;
  for (const move of MOVES) {
    try {
      if (await migrateMove(store, move) === "migrated") {
        result = "migrated";
      }
    } catch (problem) {
      failure ??= { problem };
    }
  }
  if (failure !== undefined) {
    throw new SarError("error_settings_load", {}, { cause: failure.problem });
  }
  return result;
}

const running = new WeakMap<KeyValueStore, Map<Move, Promise<Migration>>>();

/** `migrateMove`, shared by the callers that ask while it runs. A settled run is forgotten. */
function migrateOnce(store: KeyValueStore, move: Move): Promise<Migration> {
  const moves = running.get(store) ?? new Map<Move, Promise<Migration>>();
  running.set(store, moves);
  const earlier = moves.get(move);
  if (earlier !== undefined) {
    return earlier;
  }
  const run = migrateMove(store, move);
  moves.set(move, run);
  const forget = (): void => {
    moves.delete(move);
  };
  void run.then(forget, forget);
  return run;
}

export function migrateSettings(store: KeyValueStore): Promise<Migration> {
  return migrateOnce(store, SETTINGS_MOVE);
}

/**
 * The stored value of a v2 key. A usable value is one read; the v1 key is read only when it is
 * absent or unusable, and its value is then copied before the key is read again.
 */
async function readMigrated(store: KeyValueStore, move: Move): Promise<unknown> {
  const stored = (await store.get([move.to])).get(move.to);
  if (isUsable(stored) || !(await store.get([move.from])).has(move.from)) {
    return stored;
  }
  await migrateOnce(store, move);
  return (await store.get([move.to])).get(move.to);
}

export function readSettingsValue(store: KeyValueStore): Promise<unknown> {
  return readMigrated(store, SETTINGS_MOVE);
}

export function readAllowValue(store: KeyValueStore): Promise<unknown> {
  return readMigrated(store, ALLOW_MOVE);
}

```

`src/core/settings/settings-source.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { countingStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/counting-store";
import { memoryStore } from "../../../tests/helpers/memory-store";
import { withKind, writeSettings } from "../../../tests/helpers/settings";
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, encodeSettings, parseSettings, type Settings } from "./settings";
import { createSettingsSource, type RemoteSettingsChanges } from "./settings-source";

const DIMMED: Settings = withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { filter: "dim" });

/** A platform change event that the test can fire, and that counts its subscribers. */
function remoteEvents() {
  const listeners = new Set<(value: unknown) => void>();
  const remote: RemoteSettingsChanges = (listener) => {
    listeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  };
  return {
    remote,
    fire(value: unknown) {
      for (const listener of listeners) {
        listener(value);
      }
    },
    subscribers: () => listeners.size,
  };
}

describe("a subscriber that throws", () => {
  it("does not reject a patch that was saved, and the others still hear it", async () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    const heard = vi.fn();
    source.subscribe(() => {
      throw new Error();
    });
    source.subscribe(heard);
    const written = await source.patch({ debug: true });
    expect(written.debug).toBe(true);
    expect(heard).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read()).debug).toBe(true);
  });

  it("does not stop a change from another tab reaching the others", () => {
    const events = remoteEvents();
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore(), events.remote);
    const heard = vi.fn();
    source.subscribe(() => {
      throw new Error();
    });
    source.subscribe(heard);
    events.fire(encodeSettings(DIMMED));
    expect(heard).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});

describe("patch", () => {
  it("changes only the fields it names in what is stored now", async () => {
    const store = memoryStore();
    const source = createSettingsSource(store);
    await writeSettings(source, { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, locale: "es" });
    await source.patch({ kinds: { drm: { badge: false } } });
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read())).toStrictEqual({
      ...withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "drm", { badge: false }),
      locale: "es",
    });
  });

  it("keeps what another source stored since this one last read", async () => {
    const store = memoryStore();
    const first = createSettingsSource(store);
    const second = createSettingsSource(store);
    await writeSettings(first, DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
    await second.patch({ kinds: { kernel: { filter: "hide" } } });
    await first.patch({ kinds: { drm: { banner: false } } });
    const stored = parseSettings(await first.read());
    expect(stored.kinds.kernel.filter).toBe("hide");
    expect(stored.kinds.drm.banner).toBe(false);
  });

  it("returns the settings it wrote", async () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    const written = await source.patch({ kinds: { pvp: { enabled: false } } });
    expect(written).toStrictEqual(withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "pvp", { enabled: false }));
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read())).toStrictEqual(written);
  });

  it("starts from the defaults when nothing is stored", async () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    await source.patch({ debug: true });
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read())).toStrictEqual({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, debug: true });
  });

  it("copies v1 settings before it patches, so a patch never puts defaults over them", async () => {
    const store = memoryStore(
      new Map([["v1:settings", { badges: false, banner: true, listFilter: "hide", locale: "es" }]]),
    );
    const source = createSettingsSource(store);
    await source.patch({ kinds: { kernel: { enabled: false } } });
    const stored = parseSettings(await source.read());
    expect(stored.locale).toBe("es");
    expect(stored.kinds.ai).toStrictEqual({
      enabled: true,
      badge: false,
      banner: true,
      filter: "hide",
    });
    expect(stored.kinds.kernel.enabled).toBe(false);
  });

  it("runs patches from one context one after another, losing none", async () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    await Promise.all([
      source.patch({ kinds: { ai: { badge: false } } }),
      source.patch({ kinds: { drm: { badge: false } } }),
      source.patch({ kinds: { eula: { badge: false } } }),
    ]);
    const { kinds } = parseSettings(await source.read());
    expect([kinds.ai.badge, kinds.drm.badge, kinds.eula.badge, kinds.pvp.badge]).toEqual([
      false,
      false,
      false,
      true,
    ]);
  });

  it("rejects when the stored settings cannot be read, and the next patch still runs", async () => {
    const inner = memoryStore(new Map([["v2:settings", encodeSettings(DIMMED)]]));
    const store = countingStore(inner);
    const source = createSettingsSource(store);
    store.break();
    await expect(source.patch({ debug: true })).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(Error);
    store.heal();
    await source.patch({ debug: true });
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read())).toStrictEqual({ ...DIMMED, debug: true });
  });

  it("tells this context's subscribers the patched settings", async () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    const heard = vi.fn();
    source.subscribe(heard);
    await source.patch({ kinds: { pvp: { filter: "dim" } } });
    expect(heard).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(parseSettings(heard.mock.calls[0]?.[0]).kinds.pvp.filter).toBe("dim");
  });
});

describe("createSettingsSource", () => {
  it("reads nothing before settings are written", async () => {
    expect(await createSettingsSource(memoryStore()).read()).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("reads what was written, as a value parseSettings accepts", async () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    await writeSettings(source, DIMMED);
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read())).toStrictEqual(DIMMED);
  });

  it("shares storage with another source over the same store", async () => {
    const store = memoryStore();
    await writeSettings(createSettingsSource(store), DIMMED);
    expect(parseSettings(await createSettingsSource(store).read())).toStrictEqual(DIMMED);
  });

  it("reads with one storage call and writes with one once settings are stored", async () => {
    const store = countingStore(memoryStore(new Map([["v2:settings", encodeSettings(DIMMED)]])));
    const source = createSettingsSource(store);
    await source.read();
    expect(store.calls).toStrictEqual({ get: 1, set: 0, remove: 0, keys: 0 });
    await writeSettings(source, DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
    expect(store.calls.set).toBe(1);
  });

  it("rejects a write while v1 settings cannot be copied, and writes nothing", async () => {
    const inner = memoryStore(new Map([["v1:settings", { badges: false }]]));
    const store = countingStore(inner);
    const source = createSettingsSource(store);
    store.break();
    await expect(writeSettings(source, DEFAULT_SETTINGS)).rejects.toThrow();
    store.heal();
    expect(await inner.keys()).toStrictEqual(["v1:settings"]);
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read()).kinds.ai.badge).toBe(false);
  });

  it("stores the settings under the v2 key", async () => {
    const store = memoryStore();
    await writeSettings(createSettingsSource(store), DIMMED);
    expect([...(await store.keys())]).toStrictEqual(["v2:settings"]);
  });

  it("copies v1 settings to the v2 key on the first read", async () => {
    const store = memoryStore(
      new Map([["v1:settings", { badges: false, banner: true, listFilter: "hide", locale: "es" }]]),
    );
    const source = createSettingsSource(store);
    const expected = withKind(
      { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, locale: "es" },
      "ai",
      { badge: false, filter: "hide" },
    );
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read())).toStrictEqual(expected);
    expect([...(await store.keys())].toSorted()).toStrictEqual(["v1:settings", "v2:settings"]);
  });

  it("reads again after a migration that failed, instead of remembering the failure", async () => {
    const store = countingStore(memoryStore(new Map([["v1:settings", { badges: false }]])));
    const source = createSettingsSource(store);
    store.break();
    await expect(source.read()).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(Error);
    store.heal();
    expect(parseSettings(await source.read()).kinds.ai.badge).toBe(false);
  });

  it("tells subscribers about this context's writes, once per change", async () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    const listener = vi.fn<(value: unknown) => void>();
    source.subscribe(listener);
    await writeSettings(source, DIMMED);
    await writeSettings(source, DIMMED);
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(parseSettings(listener.mock.calls[0]?.[0])).toStrictEqual(DIMMED);
    await writeSettings(source, DEFAULT_SETTINGS);
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it("stops telling a subscriber that unsubscribed, even if it unsubscribes twice", async () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    const listener = vi.fn<(value: unknown) => void>();
    const stop = source.subscribe(listener);
    stop();
    stop();
    await writeSettings(source, DIMMED);
    expect(listener).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("forwards the other tabs' changes unvalidated", () => {
    const events = remoteEvents();
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore(), events.remote);
    const listener = vi.fn<(value: unknown) => void>();
    source.subscribe(listener);
    events.fire({ kinds: { ai: { filter: "hide" } } });
    events.fire("garbage");
    expect(listener.mock.calls).toStrictEqual([
      [{ kinds: { ai: { filter: "hide" } } }],
      ["garbage"],
    ]);
  });

  it("does not tell twice when the platform echoes this context's own write", async () => {
    const events = remoteEvents();
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore(), events.remote);
    const listener = vi.fn<(value: unknown) => void>();
    source.subscribe(listener);
    await writeSettings(source, DIMMED);
    events.fire(await source.read());
    expect(listener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("listens to the platform only while someone is subscribed", () => {
    const events = remoteEvents();
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore(), events.remote);
    expect(events.subscribers()).toBe(0);
    const stopA = source.subscribe(vi.fn());
    const stopB = source.subscribe(vi.fn());
    expect(events.subscribers()).toBe(1);
    stopA();
    expect(events.subscribers()).toBe(1);
    stopB();
    expect(events.subscribers()).toBe(0);
    source.subscribe(vi.fn());
    expect(events.subscribers()).toBe(1);
  });

  it("never calls a subscriber when the platform reports no changes", () => {
    const source = createSettingsSource(memoryStore());
    const listener = vi.fn<(value: unknown) => void>();
    source.subscribe(listener);
    expect(listener).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

`src/core/settings/settings-source.ts`:

```ts
import type { KeyValueStore, SettingsSource, Unsubscribe } from "../ports";
import { createSerial } from "../serial";
import { SETTINGS_KEY } from "../storage-keys";
import { migrateSettings, readSettingsValue } from "./migrate";
import {
  applyPatch,
  encodeSettings,
  parseSettings,
  type Settings,
  type SettingsPatch,
} from "./settings";

/**
 * Reports changes made by other tabs. The platform adapter supplies it from its own change event
 * (`storage.onChanged`, `GM_addValueChangeListener`) and passes the new stored settings value; a
 * platform without one passes nothing, and settings then apply on the next page load.
 */
export type RemoteSettingsChanges = (listener: (value: unknown) => void) => Unsubscribe;

/** The stored settings: a `SettingsSource` that can also change them. */
export interface StoredSettings extends SettingsSource {
  /**
   * Replaces the fields of `patch` in the settings stored now, writes them and returns them.
   * Patches from one context run in turn; two tabs at once can still lose one.
   */
  patch(patch: SettingsPatch): Promise<Settings>;
}

/**
 * `SettingsSource` over a `KeyValueStore`. Subscribers hear this context's writes and the other
 * tabs' changes from `remote`, without telling the same value twice. A read copies v1 settings.
 */
export function createSettingsSource(
  store: KeyValueStore,
  remote?: RemoteSettingsChanges,
): StoredSettings {
  const listeners = new Set<(value: unknown) => void>();
  let lastTold: string | undefined;
  let unsubscribeRemote: Unsubscribe | undefined;
  const serial = createSerial();

  function tell(value: unknown): void {
    const signature = JSON.stringify(value);
    if (signature === lastTold) {
      return;
    }
    lastTold = signature;
    for (const listener of listeners) {
      try {
        listener(value);
      } catch {
        // A subscriber's failure is its own; the write that told it has landed.
      }
    }
  }

  async function write(settings: Settings): Promise<void> {
    // Never put defaults over v1 settings that were not copied: a failed copy rejects the write.
    await migrateSettings(store);
    const value = encodeSettings(settings);
    await store.set(new Map([[SETTINGS_KEY, value]]));
    tell(value);
  }

  return {
    async read() {
      return readSettingsValue(store);
    },

    patch(patch) {
      return serial(async () => {
        const next = applyPatch(parseSettings(await readSettingsValue(store)), patch);
        await write(next);
        return next;
      });
    },

    subscribe(listener) {
      listeners.add(listener);
      unsubscribeRemote ??= remote?.(tell);
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
        if (listeners.size === 0) {
          unsubscribeRemote?.();
          unsubscribeRemote = undefined;
        }
      };
    },
  };
}
```

`src/core/settings/settings.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { type JsonValue, parseWithDefaults } from "../json";
import type { KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import {
  encodeKindSettings,
  type KindSettings,
  mergeKindSettings,
  parseKindSettings,
} from "../kinds/kind-settings";
import { KINDS, perKind } from "../kinds/registry";

/** The `locale` setting that follows the store page's language (see `resolveLocale`). */
export const AUTO_LOCALE = "auto";

/** A locale code such as `en`, `pt_BR` or `zh-CN`; `resolveLocale` checks that it has a catalog. */
const LOCALE_PATTERN = /^[A-Za-z]{2,3}(?:[_-][A-Za-z0-9]{2,8})*$/;

export const LocaleSchema = v.union([
  v.literal(AUTO_LOCALE),
  v.pipe(v.string(), v.regex(LOCALE_PATTERN)),
]);

export interface Settings {
  /** `auto`, or a catalog locale code the user chose. */
  readonly locale: string;
  /** Write debug lines to the console. */
  readonly debug: boolean;
  readonly kinds: Readonly<Record<KindId, KindSettings>>;
}

export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: Settings = {
  locale: AUTO_LOCALE,
  debug: false,
  kinds: perKind((kind) => kind.defaults),
};

// Each field falls back to its own default, so one bad or missing field (an old version, a
// hand-edited value) does not reset the others. The kinds stay unvalidated until each one is
// parsed against its own defaults.
const SettingsSchema = v.object({
  locale: v.fallback(LocaleSchema, DEFAULT_SETTINGS.locale),
  debug: v.fallback(v.boolean(), DEFAULT_SETTINGS.debug),
  kinds: v.fallback(v.record(v.string(), v.unknown()), {}),
});

/** The settings in a stored value: every valid field, and the default for every other one. */
export function parseSettings(stored: unknown): Settings {
  const { locale, debug, kinds } = parseWithDefaults(SettingsSchema, stored);
  return {
    locale,
    debug,
    kinds: perKind((kind) => parseKindSettings(kind.defaults, kinds[kind.id])),
  };
}

/** The stored value of the settings. */
export function encodeSettings(settings: Settings): JsonValue {
  const kinds: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    kinds[kind.id] = encodeKindSettings(settings.kinds[kind.id]);
  }
  return { locale: settings.locale, debug: settings.debug, kinds };
}

/** A change to the settings: only the fields it names, so it leaves every other one alone. */
export interface SettingsPatch {
  readonly locale?: string;
  readonly debug?: boolean;
  readonly kinds?: Readonly<Partial<Record<KindId, Readonly<Partial<KindSettings>>>>>;
}

/** The settings with the fields of `patch` replaced. */
export function applyPatch(settings: Settings, patch: SettingsPatch): Settings {
  return {
    locale: patch.locale ?? settings.locale,
    debug: patch.debug ?? settings.debug,
    kinds: perKind((kind) => mergeKindSettings(settings.kinds[kind.id], patch.kinds?.[kind.id])),
  };
}
```

`src/core/storage-keys.ts`:

```ts
import { type AppId, toAppId } from "./types";

// Settings and the ignore list use layout `v2`, with one entry per tag kind, and so does the small
// record of which settings sections are open. The verdict cache, its meta record and the breaker
// keep `v1`. `CACHE_SCHEMA` versions the cache; the breaker owns `v1:breaker`.

/**
 * Bump to discard every cached verdict on the next start (and only verdicts). Version 2 stores
 * one entry per tag kind in each verdict.
 */
export const CACHE_SCHEMA = 2;

const VERDICT_PREFIX = "v1:a:";

export const SETTINGS_KEY = "v2:settings";
export const ALLOW_KEY = "v2:allow";
/** Which settings sections the user closed or opened again; interface state, not a setting. */
export const SECTION_STATE_KEY = "v2:ui";
export const META_KEY = "v1:meta";

/** The layout `v1` keys of settings and the ignore list; only the migration reads them. */
export const LEGACY_SETTINGS_KEY = "v1:settings";
export const LEGACY_ALLOW_KEY = "v1:allow";

export function verdictKey(id: AppId): string {
  return `${VERDICT_PREFIX}${id}`;
}

export function isVerdictKey(key: string): boolean {
  return key.startsWith(VERDICT_PREFIX);
}

/** The app ID of a verdict key; undefined for any other key or a malformed ID. */
export function appIdOfVerdictKey(key: string): AppId | undefined {
  if (!isVerdictKey(key)) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const digits = key.slice(VERDICT_PREFIX.length);
  return /^[1-9]\d*$/.test(digits) ? toAppId(Number(digits)) : undefined;
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { toAppId, UNKNOWN } from "./types";

describe("toAppId", () => {
  it("accepts unsigned 32-bit integers above zero", () => {
    expect(toAppId(1)).toBe(1);
    expect(toAppId(5072580)).toBe(5072580);
    expect(toAppId(0xffff_ffff)).toBe(0xffff_ffff);
  });

  it("rejects everything else", () => {
    for (const value of [0, -1, 1.5, 0x1_0000_0000, Number.NaN, "10", null, undefined]) {
      expect(toAppId(value)).toBeUndefined();
    }
  });
});

describe("UNKNOWN", () => {
  it("holds one unknown verdict per reason", () => {
    for (const [reason, verdict] of Object.entries(UNKNOWN)) {
      expect(verdict).toStrictEqual({ state: "unknown", reason });
    }
  });
});
```

`src/core/types.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";

/** Steam app IDs are unsigned 32-bit integers; 0 is what GetItems reports for an invalid item. */
const MAX_APP_ID = 0xffff_ffff;

/**
 * A Steam app ID. The brand is applied only by this schema, so every `AppId` in core was checked
 * to be an integer in 1 to 2^32 - 1. Other schemas (GetItems `id`, stored verdicts) reuse it.
 */
export const AppIdSchema = v.pipe(
  v.number(),
  v.integer(),
  v.minValue(1),
  v.maxValue(MAX_APP_ID),
  v.brand("AppId"),
);

export type AppId = v.InferOutput<typeof AppIdSchema>;

/** The value as an `AppId`, or undefined when it is not a valid app ID. */
export function toAppId(value: unknown): AppId | undefined {
  const result = v.safeParse(AppIdSchema, value);
  return result.success ? result.output : undefined;
}

/** Where a known verdict came from: the GetItems API or the English app page (HTML fallback). */
export const VerdictSourceSchema = v.picklist(["api", "html"]);

export type VerdictSource = v.InferOutput<typeof VerdictSourceSchema>;

/**
 * Why a verdict is unknown. `gated`: the app page hid the store content (age gate, sign-in,
 * redirect). `missing`: Steam returned no usable item. `malformed`: a field the kind reads came in
 * the wrong shape. `error`: the request or its answer was broken. `rate-limited`: a breaker held
 * the request back. Unknown is never shown as not disclosed.
 */
export type UnknownReason = "gated" | "missing" | "malformed" | "error" | "rate-limited";

/**
 * What every disclosed verdict carries. A tag kind adds its own fields (see `kinds/`): the
 * developer's text, the named product, the matching categories.
 */
export interface DisclosedBase<Kind extends string = string> {
  readonly state: "disclosed";
  /** The id of the tag kind the developer disclosed. */
  readonly kind: Kind;
  readonly source: VerdictSource;
}

export interface NotDisclosedVerdict {
  readonly state: "not-disclosed";
  readonly source: VerdictSource;
}

export interface UnknownVerdict {
  readonly state: "unknown";
  readonly reason: UnknownReason;
}

/** One shared object per unknown reason, so unknown verdicts cost no allocation. */
export const UNKNOWN: Readonly<Record<UnknownReason, UnknownVerdict>> = {
  "gated": { state: "unknown", reason: "gated" },
  "missing": { state: "unknown", reason: "missing" },
  "malformed": { state: "unknown", reason: "malformed" },
  "error": { state: "unknown", reason: "error" },
  "rate-limited": { state: "unknown", reason: "rate-limited" },
};

/** One shared object per source, so a not disclosed verdict costs no allocation. */
export const NOT_DISCLOSED: Readonly<Record<VerdictSource, NotDisclosedVerdict>> = {
  api: { state: "not-disclosed", source: "api" },
  html: { state: "not-disclosed", source: "html" },
};

/**
 * What core knows about one app for one tag kind. Exactly three states (rule 4). `Disclosed` is
 * the disclosed shape of one kind; without it the verdict is the shape every kind shares.
 */
export type Verdict<Disclosed extends DisclosedBase = DisclosedBase> =
  | Disclosed
  | NotDisclosedVerdict
  | UnknownVerdict;

```

`src/core/ui/announce.test.ts`:

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { announce, POLITE } from "./announce";

afterEach(() => {
  document.body.replaceChildren();
});

function region(): HTMLElement {
  const node = document.createElement("div");
  node.setAttribute("aria-live", POLITE);
  document.body.append(node);
  return node;
}

describe("announce", () => {
  it("empties the region and fills it on the next frame", async () => {
    const live = region();
    const earlier = "Earlier";
    live.textContent = earlier;
    announce(document, live, "Saved");
    expect(live.textContent).toBe("");
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(live.textContent).toBe("Saved");
    });
  });

  it("empties the region again for a message that repeats, so it is heard twice", async () => {
    const live = region();
    announce(document, live, "Saved");
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(live.textContent).toBe("Saved");
    });
    announce(document, live, "Saved");
    expect(live.textContent).toBe("");
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(live.textContent).toBe("Saved");
    });
  });

  it("fills the region at once where the document has no window", () => {
    const detached = document.implementation.createHTMLDocument("");
    const live = detached.createElement("div");
    announce(detached, live, "Saved");
    expect(live.textContent).toBe("Saved");
  });
});

```

`src/core/ui/announce.ts`:

```ts
/** An `aria-live` token, not copy. */
export const POLITE = "polite";

/**
 * Says `text` through a live region. The region empties first and fills on the next frame, so a
 * message that repeats, such as a second "Saved.", is announced again.
 */
export function announce(doc: Document, live: Element, text: string): void {
  live.textContent = "";
  const view = doc.defaultView;
  if (view === null) {
    live.textContent = text;
    return;
  }
  view.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    live.textContent = text;
  });
}
```

`src/core/ui/app-page.ts`:

```ts
import type { KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import { KINDS } from "../kinds/registry";
import type { AnyDisclosed, KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { MessageCatalog } from "../ports";
import { ALLOW_ALL, type AllowScope } from "../settings/allow-data";
import {
  type Banner,
  type BannerActions,
  type BannerOptions,
  type BannerView,
  createBanner,
  placeBanner,
} from "./banner";
import type { CardTriggers } from "./hover-card";
import { createTagSection } from "./tag-section";

/** What the app page shows for its own game. */
export interface AppPageView {
  readonly verdicts: KindVerdicts;
  /** Per scope: the game is on the ignore list there. */
  readonly ignored: Readonly<Record<AllowScope, boolean>>;
  /** Per kind: its badge switch is on, which the tag section follows. */
  readonly badge: Readonly<Record<KindId, boolean>>;
  /**
   * Per kind: its entry may show in the banner (the kind is enabled and its banner setting is on).
   * Each kind's badge switch is a root attribute (`applyKindSettings`).
   */
  readonly banner: Readonly<Record<KindId, boolean>>;
}

/** The game's own page: the banner above the purchase box and the tag section. */
export interface AppPageUi {
  /** Idempotent: an unchanged view changes nothing; a node a store re-render dropped returns. */
  render(view: AppPageView): void;
}

export interface AppPageOptions extends BannerOptions {
  /** Opens on the tag section's chips; without one they show no notes. */
  readonly card?: CardTriggers;
}

/**
 * What the banner shows: an entry for each disclosed kind the settings allow, a note for each
 * kind the game is ignored for, or one note for all kinds. Undefined when there is nothing.
 */
function bannerView(view: AppPageView): BannerView | undefined {
  const shown: AnyDisclosed[] = [];
  const ignored: AllowScope[] = [];
  let silenced = false;
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    const verdict = view.verdicts[kind.id];
    if (verdict.state !== "disclosed" || !view.banner[kind.id]) {
      continue;
    }
    if (view.ignored[ALLOW_ALL]) {
      silenced = true;
    } else if (view.ignored[kind.id]) {
      ignored.push(kind.id);
    } else {
      shown.push(verdict);
    }
  }
  if (silenced) {
    ignored.push(ALLOW_ALL);
  }
  return shown.length + ignored.length === 0
    ? undefined
    : { shown, ignored };
}

/**
 * The verdicts the tag section shows, in registry order: each disclosed kind with its badge on
 * that is not ignored for the game.
 */
function tagVerdicts(view: AppPageView): readonly AnyDisclosed[] {
  const shown: AnyDisclosed[] = [];
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    const verdict = view.verdicts[kind.id];
    const ignored = view.ignored[ALLOW_ALL] || view.ignored[kind.id];
    if (verdict.state === "disclosed" && view.badge[kind.id] && !ignored) {
      shown.push(verdict);
    }
  }
  return shown;
}

/**
 * Renders the app page per components.mdx ("What renders for each state"): the banner, and the
 * tag section under the store's user-defined tags with one chip for each shown kind.
 */
export function createAppPageUi(
  doc: Document,
  i18n: MessageCatalog,
  actions: BannerActions,
  options: AppPageOptions = {},
): AppPageUi {
  let banner: Banner | undefined;
  const section = createTagSection(doc, i18n, options.card);

  function renderBanner(shown: BannerView | undefined): void {
    if (shown === undefined) {
      banner?.host.remove();
      return;
    }
    banner ??= createBanner(doc, i18n, actions, options);
    banner.show(shown);
    placeBanner(doc, banner.host);
  }

  return {
    render(view) {
      renderBanner(bannerView(view));
      section.render(tagVerdicts(view));
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { setBody } from "../../../tests/helpers/dom";
import { hostView, type HostViewOptions } from "../../../tests/helpers/host-view";

  host: HTMLElement;
  link: HTMLAnchorElement;
  image: HTMLElement;
  title: HTMLElement;

  const link = document.querySelector<HTMLAnchorElement>(".link");
  const image = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".image");
  const title = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".title");
  if (host === null || link === null || image === null || title === null) {
    throw new TypeError();
  }
  return { host, link, image, title };
}

function view(host: Element, slot: BadgeSlot | undefined, options: HostViewOptions = {}) {

    expect(compactSize(300, 31)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("uses the text tier from 180px and the large tier from 400 by 150", () => {
    expect(compactSize(180, 32)).toBe("text");
    expect(compactSize(399, 400)).toBe("text");
    expect(compactSize(400, 149)).toBe("text");
    expect(compactSize(400, 150)).toBe("large");
  });

describe("createBadgeRenderer", () => {
  const i18n = englishI18n();
  const chip = (id: KindId) => i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[id].messages.chip);
  // The accessible name starts with the visible chip text, then Steam's full line.
  const nameOf = (id: KindId) => {
    const heading = i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[id].messages.heading);
    return chip(id) === heading ? heading : i18n.t("kind_chip_name", { chip: chip(id), heading });
  };
  const AI_NAME = nameOf("ai");
  const MANY: readonly KindId[] = ["ai", "kernel", "drm", "eula", "pvp"];

  let bound = new Map<Element, readonly AnyDisclosed[]>();
  let renderer = createBadgeRenderer(document, i18n, { bind: () => undefined });

  beforeEach(() => {
    bound = new Map();
    renderer = createBadgeRenderer(document, i18n, {
      bind: (trigger, entries) => bound.set(trigger, entries),
    });
  });

  const full = (anchor: Element): BadgeSlot => ({ kind: "full", anchor, position: "afterend" });
  const overlay = (anchor: Element, size: "text" | "large" = "text"): BadgeSlot => ({
    kind: "compact",
    anchor,
    position: "beforeend",
    size,
  });

  /** A chip's visible text and its accessible name. */
  function texts(element: Element) {
    return [
      element.querySelector(":scope > [aria-hidden]")?.textContent,
      element.querySelector(":scope > .sar-vh")?.textContent,
    ];
  }

  const chipsIn = (host: Element) => Array.from(host.querySelectorAll(".sar-chips > *"));
  const kindsOf = (host: Element) => chipsIn(host).map((c) => c.getAttribute("data-sar-kind"));

  it("draws the full badge with the catalog label and binds it to the hover card", () => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    const verdict = disclosedVerdict({ notes: "Concept art." });
    renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdict }));
    const group = host.querySelector(".sar-chips");
    expect(group?.previousElementSibling).toBe(title);
    expect(group?.getAttribute("data-sar-chips")).toBe("full");
    const badge = host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-badge");
    expect(badge?.parentElement).toBe(group);
    expect(badge?.querySelector(".sar-badge-label")?.textContent).toBe(chip("ai"));
    expect(badge?.querySelector(".sar-badge-label")?.getAttribute("aria-hidden")).toBe("true");
    expect(badge?.querySelector(".sar-vh")?.textContent).toBe(AI_NAME);
    expect(badge?.getAttribute("data-sar-kind")).toBe("ai");
    expect(badge?.querySelector("svg")).toBeNull();
    expect(badge?.hasAttribute("title")).toBe(false);
    expect(badge === null ? undefined : bound.get(badge)).toEqual([verdict]);
  });

  it.each(KIND_IDS.filter((id) => id !== "pvp"))(
    "gives the %s chip an accessible name that starts with its text",
    (id) => {
      const { host, title } = capsule();
      renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds([id]) }));
      const [label, name] = texts(chipsIn(host)[0] ?? host);
      expect(label).toBe(chip(id));
      expect(name).toBe(nameOf(id));
      expect(name?.startsWith(`${label ?? ""}: `)).toBe(true);
      expect(name).toContain(i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[id].messages.heading));
    },
  );

  it("gives the PvP chip the name PvP once, not PvP: PvP", () => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(["pvp"]) }));
    const [label, name] = texts(chipsIn(host)[0] ?? host);
    expect(label).toBe(i18n.t("kind_pvp_chip"));
    expect(name).toBe(i18n.t("kind_pvp_heading"));
  });

  it("draws one chip per disclosed kind, in registry order, whatever the data order", () => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    const verdicts = disclosedKinds(["pvp", "drm", "ai"]);
    renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts, maxChips: 5 }));
    expect(host.querySelectorAll(".sar-chips")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(kindsOf(host)).toEqual(["ai", "drm", "pvp"]);
    expect(chipsIn(host).map((c) => texts(c)[0])).toEqual([chip("ai"), chip("drm"), chip("pvp")]);
  });

  it("binds every chip to the verdicts of all the kinds shown", () => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: FULL_DISCLOSED, maxChips: 7 }));
    const expected = KIND_IDS.map((id) => FULL_DISCLOSED[id]);
    expect(chipsIn(host)).toHaveLength(KIND_IDS.length);
    for (const element of chipsIn(host)) {
      expect(bound.get(element)).toEqual(expected);
    }
  });

  describe("past the placement's allowance", () => {
    it("shows the allowed chips and a +N chip for the rest", () => {
      const { host, title } = capsule();
      renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(MANY), maxChips: 2 }));
      expect(kindsOf(host)).toEqual(["ai", "kernel", null]);
      const more = chipsIn(host)[2];
      const label = i18n.t("kind_chip_more", { count: "3" });
      expect(more?.classList.contains("sar-badge")).toBe(true);
      expect(texts(more ?? host)).toEqual([
        label,
        i18n.t("kind_chip_name", { chip: label, heading: i18n.t("kind_chip_more_name") }),
      ]);
    });

    it("lists all the kinds in the hover card from the +N chip too", () => {
      const { host, title } = capsule();
      renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(MANY), maxChips: 2 }));
      const more = chipsIn(host)[2];
      expect(more === undefined ? undefined : bound.get(more)?.map((v) => v.kind)).toEqual(MANY);
    });

    it("draws no +N chip when the kinds fit exactly", () => {
      const { host, title } = capsule();
      renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(MANY), maxChips: 5 }));
      expect(kindsOf(host)).toEqual(MANY);
    });

    it("can show nothing but the +N chip", () => {
      const { host, title } = capsule();
      renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(MANY), maxChips: 0 }));
      expect(kindsOf(host)).toEqual([null]);
    });

    it("counts only the kinds shown, not the ones whose badges are off", () => {
      const { host, title } = capsule();
      const unbadged: readonly KindId[] = ["ai", "kernel", "pvp"];
      renderer.render(
        view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(MANY), unbadged, maxChips: 2 }),
      );
      expect(kindsOf(host)).toEqual(["drm", "eula"]);
    });

    it("draws the +N chip in the compact style over an image", () => {
      const { host, image } = capsule();
      renderer.render(view(host, overlay(image), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(MANY), maxChips: 1 }));
      const chips = chipsIn(host);
      expect(chips.map((c) => c.className)).toEqual(["sar-compact", "sar-compact"]);
      expect(chips[1]?.querySelector(".sar-compact-label")?.textContent).toBe(
        i18n.t("kind_chip_more", { count: "4" }),
      );
      expect(chips[1]?.getAttribute("data-sar-size")).toBe("text");
    });
  });

  it("binds a kept group to new verdicts without drawing it again", () => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    const slot = full(title);
    renderer.render(view(host, slot));
    const group = host.querySelector(".sar-chips");
    const next = disclosedVerdict({ notes: "Voice lines." });
    renderer.render(view(host, slot, { verdict: next }));
    expect(host.querySelector(".sar-chips")).toBe(group);
    const badge = host.querySelector(".sar-badge");
    expect(badge === null ? undefined : bound.get(badge)).toEqual([next]);
  });

  it("draws the group again when the kinds, the allowance or the slot change", () => {
    const { host, title, image } = capsule();
    renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(["ai"]) }));
    const first = host.querySelector(".sar-chips");
    renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts: disclosedKinds(["ai", "drm"]) }));
    expect(host.querySelector(".sar-chips")).not.toBe(first);
    expect(first?.isConnected).toBe(false);
    expect(kindsOf(host)).toEqual(["ai", "drm"]);
    const verdicts = disclosedKinds(["ai", "drm"]);
    renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdicts, maxChips: 1 }));
    expect(kindsOf(host)).toEqual(["ai", null]);
    renderer.render(view(host, overlay(image), { verdicts, maxChips: 1 }));
    expect(host.querySelectorAll(".sar-chips")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(host.querySelector(".sar-chips")?.getAttribute("data-sar-chips")).toBe("compact");
  });

  it("draws the compact chips in their tier, linked to the capsule link", () => {
    const { host, image } = capsule();
    const verdicts = disclosedKinds(["ai", "kernel"]);
    renderer.render(view(host, overlay(image, "large"), { verdicts }));
    const chips = Array.from(image.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".sar-chips > .sar-compact"));
    expect(image.querySelector(".sar-chips")?.getAttribute("data-sar-chips")).toBe("compact");
    expect(chips.map((c) => c.getAttribute("data-sar-size"))).toEqual(["large", "large"]);
    expect(chips.map((c) => c.getAttribute("data-sar-in-link"))).toEqual(["true", "true"]);
    expect(chips.map((c) => texts(c))).toEqual([
      [chip("ai"), AI_NAME],
      [chip("kernel"), nameOf("kernel")],
    ]);
    expect(chips.some((c) => c.hasAttribute("title"))).toBe(false);
    expect(chips.every((c) => bound.has(c))).toBe(true);
  });

  it("gives compact chips outside a link no pointer", () => {
    setBody('<div class="row"><div class="image"></div></div>');
    const host = document.querySelector(".row");
    const image = document.querySelector(".image");
    if (host === null || image === null) {
      throw new TypeError();
    }
    renderer.render(view(host, overlay(image)));
    expect(image.querySelector(".sar-compact")?.hasAttribute("data-sar-in-link")).toBe(false);
  });

  it.each([
    ["not disclosed", NOT_DISCLOSED],
    ["unknown", UNKNOWN.error],
  ])("renders nothing for %s", (_name, verdict) => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    const before = host.innerHTML;
    renderer.render(view(host, full(title), { verdict }));
    expect(host.innerHTML).toBe(before);
  });

  it("draws no chip for a kind that is ignored or has its badges off", () => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    renderer.render(
      view(host, full(title), {
        verdicts: disclosedKinds(["ai", "drm", "eula"]),
        ignored: ["drm"],
        unbadged: ["eula"],
      }),
    );
    expect(kindsOf(host)).toEqual(["ai"]);
  });

  it("removes the chips of a game that is ignored for every kind", () => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    const slot = full(title);
    renderer.render(view(host, slot));
    expect(host.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge")).toHaveLength(1);
    renderer.render(view(host, slot, { allowed: true }));
    expect(host.querySelector(".sar-chips")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("keeps the group for the same view and restores one a re-render dropped", () => {
    const { host, title } = capsule();
    const slot = full(title);
    renderer.render(view(host, slot));
    const first = host.querySelector(".sar-chips");
    renderer.render(view(host, slot));
    expect(host.querySelector(".sar-chips")).toBe(first);
    first?.remove();
    renderer.render(view(host, slot));
    expect(host.querySelectorAll(".sar-chips")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(host.querySelector(".sar-chips")).not.toBe(first);
  });

  it("draws no chip where the placement gives no slot", () => {
    const { host } = capsule();
    renderer.render(view(host, undefined));
    expect(host.querySelector(".sar-chips, .sar-badge, .sar-compact")).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("createChip", () => {
  it("builds a chip with the kind's text, name and id", () => {
    const i18n = englishI18n();
    const element = createChip(document, i18n, KIND_BY_ID.drm);
    expect(element.className).toBe("sar-badge");
    expect(element.getAttribute("data-sar-kind")).toBe("drm");
    expect(element.querySelector(".sar-badge-label")?.textContent).toBe(i18n.t("kind_drm_chip"));
  });
});
```

`src/core/ui/badge.ts`:

```ts
import type { KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import type { TagKind } from "../kinds/kind";
import { KINDS, perKind } from "../kinds/registry";
import { type AnyDisclosed, sameVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { MessageCatalog } from "../ports";
import type { BadgeSlot, CompactSize, HostRenderer } from "./host";
import type { CardTriggers } from "./hover-card";
import { KIND_ATTRIBUTE } from "./kind-attributes";

/** Compact badge tiers by image box (components.mdx, section 2). Smaller images get none. */
const TEXT_MIN_WIDTH = 180;
const TEXT_MIN_HEIGHT = 32;
const LARGE_MIN_WIDTH = 400;
const LARGE_MIN_HEIGHT = 150;

/** The compact badge tier for an image box, or undefined when the image is too small for one. */
export function compactSize(width: number, height: number): CompactSize | undefined {
  if (width < TEXT_MIN_WIDTH || height < TEXT_MIN_HEIGHT) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return width >= LARGE_MIN_WIDTH && height >= LARGE_MIN_HEIGHT ? "large" : "text";
}

/** An ARIA or data token, not copy. */
const TRUE = "true";

/** A chip's visible text, and the accessible name that starts with it. */
interface ChipText {
  readonly label: string;
  readonly name: string;
}

function chipText(i18n: MessageCatalog, kind: TagKind): ChipText {
  const label = i18n.t(kind.messages.chip);
  const heading = i18n.t(kind.messages.heading);
  // PvP reads the same as its heading, so its name is that word once, not "PvP: PvP".
  const name = label === heading ? label : i18n.t("kind_chip_name", { chip: label, heading });
  return { label, name };
}

/** The "+N" chip's text, for the N kinds that did not fit. */
function moreText(i18n: MessageCatalog, count: number): ChipText {
  const label = i18n.t("kind_chip_more", { count: String(count) });
  const name = i18n.t("kind_chip_name", { chip: label, heading: i18n.t("kind_chip_more_name") });
  return { label, name };
}

/**
 * A chip: the short text, which screen readers skip, and the accessible name read instead. The
 * name starts with the visible text and goes on with Steam's full line. A kind's chip carries the
 * kind, so the style rules can switch its badges off.
 */
function createChipElement(
  doc: Document,
  text: ChipText,
  className: string,
  labelClass: string,
  kind?: KindId,
): HTMLElement {
  const chip = doc.createElement("span");
  chip.className = className;
  if (kind !== undefined) {
    chip.setAttribute(KIND_ATTRIBUTE, kind);
  }
  const label = doc.createElement("span");
  label.className = labelClass;
  label.setAttribute("aria-hidden", TRUE);
  label.textContent = text.label;
  const name = doc.createElement("span");
  name.className = "sar-vh";
  name.textContent = text.name;
  chip.append(label, name);
  return chip;
}

/** The full badge's chip, the store's tag-chip shape in our hue. The tag section reuses it. */
export function createChip(doc: Document, i18n: MessageCatalog, kind: TagKind): HTMLElement {
  return createChipElement(doc, chipText(i18n, kind), "sar-badge", "sar-badge-label", kind.id);
}

/** The `span.sar-chips` that holds chips of one size, so a row or a section places them as one. */
export function createChipGroup(doc: Document, size: BadgeSlot["kind"]): HTMLElement {
  const group = doc.createElement("span");
  group.className = "sar-chips";
  group.setAttribute("data-sar-chips", size);
  return group;
}

interface Drawn {
  /** The `span.sar-chips` that holds this host's chips. */
  readonly group: HTMLElement;
  /** The disclosed verdicts the chips stand for, in chip order. */
  readonly present: readonly AnyDisclosed[];
  readonly slot: BadgeSlot;
  readonly maxChips: number;
}

function sameSlot(a: BadgeSlot, b: BadgeSlot): boolean {
  return a.anchor === b.anchor && a.position === b.position
    && (a.kind === "full" ? b.kind === "full" : b.kind === "compact" && a.size === b.size);
}

/** Whether the lists stand for the same kinds in the same order, whatever their verdicts. */
function sameKinds(a: readonly AnyDisclosed[], b: readonly AnyDisclosed[]): boolean {
  return a.length === b.length && a.every((verdict, index) => verdict.kind === b[index]?.kind);
}

/**
 * Draws a host's chips in the slot its placement chose: one text chip for each kind that is
 * disclosed, not ignored and shown by its settings, in registry order. A placement shows at most
 * `maxChips` of them; a "+N" chip stands for the rest. Every chip registers with the hover card,
 * which lists all the kinds. A host with no such kind loses its chips. The chips of a host sit in
 * one group, so a refresh removes and places them as one.
 */
export function createBadgeRenderer(
  doc: Document,
  i18n: MessageCatalog,
  card: CardTriggers,
): HostRenderer {
  const drawn = new WeakMap<Element, Drawn>();
  const texts = perKind((kind) => chipText(i18n, kind));

  function chipFor(slot: BadgeSlot, text: ChipText, kind?: KindId): HTMLElement {
    if (slot.kind === "full") {
      return createChipElement(doc, text, "sar-badge", "sar-badge-label", kind);
    }
    const chip = createChipElement(doc, text, "sar-compact", "sar-compact-label", kind);
    chip.setAttribute("data-sar-size", slot.size);
    return chip;
  }

  function build(slot: BadgeSlot, present: readonly AnyDisclosed[], maxChips: number): HTMLElement {
    const group = createChipGroup(doc, slot.kind);
    for (const verdict of present.slice(0, maxChips)) {
      group.append(chipFor(slot, texts[verdict.kind], verdict.kind));
    }
    if (present.length > maxChips) {
      group.append(chipFor(slot, moreText(i18n, present.length - maxChips)));
    }
    return group;
  }

  /** Compact chips inside the capsule's own link take the pointer and open the card. */
  function linkCompact(group: HTMLElement, host: Element): void {
    const link = group.parentElement?.closest("a");
    if (link !== null && link !== undefined && (host.contains(link) || link.contains(host))) {
      for (const chip of group.children) {
        chip.setAttribute("data-sar-in-link", TRUE);
      }
    }
  }

  function bind(group: HTMLElement, present: readonly AnyDisclosed[]): void {
    for (const chip of group.children) {
      card.bind(chip, present);
    }
  }

  return {
    render({ host, verdicts, allowed, badged, slot, maxChips }) {
      let present: AnyDisclosed[] | undefined;
      for (const kind of KINDS) {
        const verdict = verdicts[kind.id];
        if (verdict.state === "disclosed" && !allowed[kind.id] && badged[kind.id]) {
          (present ??= []).push(verdict);
        }
      }
      const current = drawn.get(host);
      if (present === undefined || slot === undefined) {
        current?.group.remove();
        drawn.delete(host);
        return;
      }
      if (
        current !== undefined && current.group.isConnected && sameSlot(current.slot, slot)
        && current.maxChips === maxChips && sameKinds(current.present, present)
      ) {
        if (!sameVerdicts(current.present, present)) {
          bind(current.group, present);
          drawn.set(host, { ...current, present });
        }
        return;
      }
      current?.group.remove();
      const group = build(slot, present, maxChips);
      slot.anchor.insertAdjacentElement(slot.position, group);
      if (slot.kind === "compact") {
        linkCompact(group, host);
      }
      bind(group, present);
      drawn.set(host, { group, present, slot, maxChips });
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { SHIPPED_CATALOGS } from "../i18n/shipped";
import { createI18n } from "../i18n/t";
import { KIND_BY_ID } from "../kinds/registry";
import type { AnyDisclosed } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import { ALLOW_ALL } from "../settings/allow-data";
import {
  type Banner,
  type BannerActions,
  type BannerOptions,
  type BannerView,
  createBanner,
  placeBanner,
} from "./banner";

function isEventTarget(value: object): value is EventTarget {
  return "addEventListener" in value;
}

const i18n = englishI18n();
const XSS = '<img src=x onerror="alert(1)">Backgrounds\r\nwere generated.';
const heading = (verdict: AnyDisclosed) => i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[verdict.kind].messages.heading);
const ignoredKind = (kind: "drm" | "pvp") =>
  i18n.t("banner_ignored_kind", { heading: i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[kind].messages.heading) });

function view(shown: readonly AnyDisclosed[], extra: Partial<BannerView> = {}): BannerView {
  return { shown, ignored: [], ...extra };
}

interface Pending {
  resolve(): void;
  reject(): void;
}

/** Actions whose promises the test settles by hand. A resolved action shows the owner's view. */
function manualActions() {
  const calls: Pending[] = [];
  let banner: Banner | undefined;
  let owner: BannerView | undefined;
  const settle = () =>
    new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      calls.push({
        resolve: () => {
          if (banner !== undefined && owner !== undefined) {
            banner.show(owner);
          }
          resolve();
        },
        reject: () => {
          reject(new Error());
        },
      });
    });
  const ignore = vi.fn(settle);
  const restore = vi.fn(settle);
  const actions: BannerActions = { ignore, restore };
  return {
    actions,
    ignore,
    restore,
    calls,
    /** What the owner shows once the next action settles. */
    thenShow: (next: BannerView): void => {
      owner = next;
    },
    attach: (created: Banner): void => {
      banner = created;
    },
  };
}

function setup(options: BannerOptions = {}, actions: BannerActions = manualActions().actions) {
  setBody('<div class="game_description_column"><div id="game_area_purchase"></div></div>');
  const frames: (() => void)[] = [];
  const banner = createBanner(document, i18n, actions, {
    frame: (callback) => frames.push(callback),
    ...options,
  });
  placeBanner(document, banner.host);
  const root = banner.host.shadowRoot;
  if (root === null) {
    throw new TypeError();
  }
  const runFrames = () => {
    for (const callback of frames.splice(0)) {
      callback();
    }
  };
  return { banner, root, runFrames };
}

function query(root: ShadowRoot, selector: string): HTMLElement {
  const found = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
  if (found === null) {
    throw new TypeError(selector);
  }
  return found;
}

/** The accessible name: the text of the elements `aria-labelledby` names, else `aria-label`. */
function nameOf(root: ShadowRoot, element: Element): string {
  const ids = element.getAttribute("aria-labelledby")?.split(" ") ?? [];
  if (ids.length > 0) {
    return ids.map((id) => root.getElementById(id)?.textContent ?? "").join(" ");
  }
  return element.getAttribute("aria-label") ?? element.textContent;
}

const texts = (root: ShadowRoot, selector: string) =>
  [...root.querySelectorAll(selector)].map((node) => node.textContent);

const withoutDrm = (shown: readonly AnyDisclosed[]) =>
  shown.filter((verdict) => verdict.kind !== "drm");

afterEach(() => {
  document.body.replaceChildren();
});

  function wired(initial: BannerView) {
    const wiring = manualActions();
    const { banner, root } = setup({}, wiring.actions);
    wiring.attach(banner);
    banner.show(initial);
    return { ...wiring, banner, root };
  }

  it("ignores one kind, moves focus to its Undo and announces it", async () => {
    const shown = disclosedList(capturedVerdicts(3751950));
    const { root, ignore, calls, thenShow } = wired(view(shown));
    thenShow(view(withoutDrm(shown), { ignored: ["drm"] }));

    query(root, '.sar-banner-action[data-sar-scope="drm"]').click();
    query(root, '.sar-banner-action[data-sar-scope="drm"]').click();
    expect(ignore).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(ignore).toHaveBeenCalledWith("drm");
    calls[0]?.resolve();
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(root.querySelector('[data-sar-action="undo"][data-sar-scope="drm"]')).not.toBeNull();
    });
    expect(root.activeElement).toBe(query(root, '[data-sar-action="undo"]'));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(query(root, "[aria-live]").textContent).toBe(
        i18n.t("notice_marking_stopped_kind", { heading: heading(shown[0] ?? disclosedVerdict()) }),
      );
    });
    expect(texts(root, "h2")).toEqual(withoutDrm(shown).map(heading));
  });

  it("ignores the game for all tags from the link below the entries", async () => {
    const shown = disclosedList(capturedVerdicts(3751950));
    const { root, ignore, calls, thenShow } = wired(view(shown));
    thenShow(view([], { ignored: [ALLOW_ALL] }));

    query(root, '.sar-banner-foot [data-sar-action="ignore"]').click();
    expect(ignore).toHaveBeenCalledWith(ALLOW_ALL);
    calls[0]?.resolve();
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(query(root, "aside").getAttribute("data-sar-variant")).toBe("ignored");
    });
    expect(root.activeElement).toBe(query(root, '[data-sar-action="undo"]'));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(query(root, "[aria-live]").textContent).toBe(i18n.t("notice_marking_stopped"));
    });
  });

  it("undoes an ignored kind and puts focus on its ignore button again", async () => {
    const shown = disclosedList(capturedVerdicts(3751950));
    const { root, restore, calls, thenShow } = wired(
      view(withoutDrm(shown), { ignored: ["drm"] }),
    );
    thenShow(view(shown));

    query(root, '[data-sar-action="undo"]').click();
    expect(restore).toHaveBeenCalledWith("drm");
    calls[0]?.resolve();
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(texts(root, "h2")).toHaveLength(3);
    });

  it("undoes an ignore for all tags and focuses the ignore link", async () => {

    thenShow(view(shown));

    query(root, '[data-sar-action="undo"]').click();
    calls[0]?.resolve();
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(root.querySelector("h2")).not.toBeNull();
    });
    expect(root.activeElement).toBe(query(root, '.sar-banner-foot [data-sar-action="ignore"]'));
  });

  it("keeps the entries and shows an error when the ignore list cannot be saved", async () => {
    const { root, calls } = wired(view([disclosedVerdict()]));
    query(root, ".sar-banner-action").click();
    calls[0]?.reject();
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(query(root, ".sar-banner-error").hidden).toBe(false);
    });

    const { root, ignore } = wired(view([disclosedVerdict()]));

    button.setAttribute("data-sar-scope", "nothing");
    button.click();
    button.setAttribute("data-sar-scope", "ai");
    button.setAttribute("data-sar-action", "other");
    button.click();
    expect(ignore).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
import { KIND_BY_ID } from "../kinds/registry";
import type { AnyDisclosed } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { MessageCatalog } from "../ports";
import { ALLOW_ALL, type AllowScope, toAllowScope } from "../settings/allow-data";

import { KIND_ATTRIBUTE } from "./kind-attributes";

/** The banner host's id. */
export const BANNER_ID = "sar-banner";

/** The store's left description column; the banner goes first in it, above the purchase box. */
const COLUMN_SELECTOR = ".game_description_column";

/** What the banner's buttons do outside the banner. Each rejects when storage fails. */
export interface BannerActions {
  /** Ignores the game in the scope: for one kind, or for all kinds. */
  ignore(scope: AllowScope): Promise<void>;
  /** Stops ignoring the game in the scope. */
  restore(scope: AllowScope): Promise<void>;
}

export interface BannerOptions {
  /** Schedules the collapse measurement after layout; `requestAnimationFrame` by default. */
  readonly frame?: (callback: () => void) => void;
  /** Whether the collapsed notes hide text; compares scroll and client height by default. */
  readonly overflows?: (quote: HTMLElement) => boolean;
}

/** What the banner shows for the game. */
export interface BannerView {
  /** The disclosed kinds listed in full, in registry order. */
  readonly shown: readonly AnyDisclosed[];
  /** The scopes the game is ignored in that the banner notes with an Undo. */
  readonly ignored: readonly AllowScope[];
}

export interface Banner {
  /** `div.sar-banner-host`, the light-DOM element that holds the shadow root. */
  readonly host: HTMLElement;
  /** Shows the entries and the notes. Same view: no change. */
  show(view: BannerView): void;
}

const ACTIONS = ["ignore", "undo", "toggle"] as const;

type Action = (typeof ACTIONS)[number];

function parseAction(value: string | null): Action | undefined {
  return ACTIONS.find((action) => action === value);
}

function defaultFrame(doc: Document): (callback: () => void) => void {
  return (callback) => {
    const view = doc.defaultView;
    if (view === null) {
      callback();
    } else {
      view.requestAnimationFrame(callback);
    }
  };
}

function defaultOverflows(quote: HTMLElement): boolean {
  return quote.scrollHeight > quote.clientHeight;
}

/** The id of a part of an entry or note, unique in the banner. */
function partId(scope: string, part: string): string {
  return `sar-banner-${scope}-${part}`;
}

/**
 * The developer's own long text and what labels it. Steam's short lines for a kind stay in
 * Steam's own boxes on the page and in the hover card.
 */
type DeveloperText = Extract<KindDetail, { readonly kind: "quote" | "labeled"; }>;

function isDeveloperText(detail: KindDetail): detail is DeveloperText {
  return detail.kind === "quote" || detail.kind === "labeled";
}

function sameView(a: BannerView, b: BannerView): boolean {
  return a.shown.length === b.shown.length
    && a.shown.every((verdict, index) => verdict === b.shown[index])
    && a.ignored.length === b.ignored.length
    && a.ignored.every((scope, index) => scope === b.ignored[index]);
}

/**
 * The app page banner, in a shadow root so store CSS cannot reach it. It lists each disclosed kind
 * as Steam's line with an ignore button; the AI kind adds the developer's text, set through
 * `textContent`. An ignored scope becomes a note with Undo; one delegated listener serves clicks.
 */
export function createBanner(
  doc: Document,
  i18n: MessageCatalog,
  actions: BannerActions,
  options: BannerOptions = {},
): Banner {
  const frame = options.frame ?? defaultFrame(doc);
  const overflows = options.overflows ?? defaultOverflows;

  const host = doc.createElement("div");
  host.className = "sar-banner-host";
  host.id = BANNER_ID;
  const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
  adoptStyles(shadow, BANNER_CSS);

  let box = doc.createElement("aside");
  const live = element("div", "sar-vh");
  live.setAttribute("aria-live", POLITE);
  shadow.append(box, live);

  let shown: BannerView | undefined;
  let pending = false;

  function element<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(
    tag: K,
    className: string,
    text?: string,
  ): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K] {
    const node = doc.createElement(tag);
    node.className = className;
    if (text !== undefined) {
      node.textContent = text;
    }
    return node;
  }

  function button(
    className: string,
    action: Action,
    label: string,
    scope?: AllowScope,
  ): HTMLButtonElement {
    const node = element("button", className, label);
    node.type = "button";
    node.setAttribute("data-sar-action", action);
    if (scope !== undefined) {
      node.setAttribute("data-sar-scope", scope);
    }
    return node;
  }

  function errorLine(): HTMLElement {
    const line = element("p", "sar-banner-error");
    line.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    line.hidden = true;
    return line;
  }

  /** Long notes start clamped; short ones lose the clamp and the toggle before first paint. */
  function measure(quote: HTMLElement, toggle: HTMLElement): void {
    if (!quote.isConnected) {
      return;
    }
    if (overflows(quote)) {
      toggle.hidden = false;
    } else {
      quote.removeAttribute("data-sar-collapsed");
      toggle.remove();
    }
  }

  /** The developer's long text behind its source line, with a toggle once it overflows. */
  function appendQuote(entry: HTMLElement, id: string, text: string): void {
    const quote = element("blockquote", "sar-banner-quote", normalizeBreaks(text));
    quote.id = id;
    quote.setAttribute("data-sar-collapsed", "true");
    const toggle = button("sar-banner-link", "toggle", i18n.t("banner_expand"));
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(false));
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-controls", id);
    toggle.hidden = true;
    entry.append(element("p", "sar-banner-source", i18n.t("banner_source")), quote, toggle);
    frame(() => {
      measure(quote, toggle);
    });
  }

  function appendDetail(entry: HTMLElement, detail: DeveloperText, quoteId: string): void {
    if (detail.kind === "quote") {
      appendQuote(entry, quoteId, detail.text);
      return;
    }
    const line = element("p", "sar-banner-service", i18n.t(detail.key));
    line.append(" ", element("span", "sar-banner-service-name", detail.text));
    entry.append(line);
  }

  /** One kind: Steam's line as the heading and its own ignore button, then the developer's text. */
  function buildEntry(verdict: AnyDisclosed): HTMLElement {
    const entry = element("div", "sar-banner-entry");
    const titleId = partId(verdict.kind, "title");
    const ignoreId = partId(verdict.kind, "ignore");
    const heading = i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[verdict.kind].messages.heading);
    const title = element("h2", "sar-banner-title", heading);
    title.id = titleId;
    const ignore = button(
      "sar-banner-action",
      "ignore",
      i18n.t("banner_ignore_kind"),
      verdict.kind,
    );
    ignore.id = ignoreId;
    ignore.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", [ignoreId, titleId].join(" "));
    const head = element("div", "sar-banner-head");
    head.append(title, ignore);
    entry.append(head);
    for (const [index, detail] of kindDetails(verdict).filter(isDeveloperText).entries()) {
      appendDetail(entry, detail, `${partId(verdict.kind, "notes")}-${String(index)}`);
    }
    return entry;
  }

  /** What an ignored scope says: the whole game, or one kind by Steam's line. */
  function noteText(scope: AllowScope): string {
    return scope === ALLOW_ALL
      ? i18n.t("banner_ignored")
      : i18n.t("banner_ignored_kind", { heading: i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[scope].messages.heading) });
  }

  function buildNote(scope: AllowScope): HTMLElement {
    const note = element("p", "sar-banner-note");
    const text = element("span", "sar-banner-ignored-text", noteText(scope));
    text.id = partId(scope, "note");
    const undo = button("sar-banner-link", "undo", i18n.t("banner_undo"), scope);
    undo.id = partId(scope, "undo");
    undo.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", [undo.id, text.id].join(" "));
    note.append(text, undo);
    return note;
  }

  function build(view: BannerView): HTMLElement {
    const aside = element("aside", "sar-banner");
    aside.tabIndex = -1;
    const [only] = view.shown;
    if (only !== undefined && view.shown.length === 1 && view.ignored.length === 0) {
      aside.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", partId(only.kind, "title"));
    } else {
      aside.setAttribute("aria-label", i18n.t("banner_region_label"));
    }
    if (only === undefined) {
      aside.setAttribute("data-sar-variant", "ignored");
    } else {
      // A banner with one tag takes its color; several tags keep the default violet.
      if (view.shown.length > 1) {
        aside.setAttribute("data-sar-entries", "many");
      } else {
        aside.setAttribute(KIND_ATTRIBUTE, only.kind);
      }
    }
    for (const verdict of view.shown) {
      aside.append(buildEntry(verdict));
    }
    for (const scope of view.ignored) {
      aside.append(buildNote(scope));
    }
    if (view.shown.length > 0) {
      const foot = element("div", "sar-banner-foot");
      foot.append(button("sar-banner-link", "ignore", i18n.t("banner_ignore"), ALLOW_ALL));
      aside.append(foot);
    }
    aside.append(errorLine());
    return aside;
  }

  function render(view: BannerView): void {
    const next = build(view);
    box.replaceWith(next);
    box = next;
    shown = view;
  }

  function toggleNotes(toggle: Element): void {
    const quote = shadow.getElementById(toggle.getAttribute("aria-controls") ?? "");
    if (quote === null) {
      return;
    }
    const expand = quote.getAttribute("data-sar-collapsed") === "true";
    quote.setAttribute("data-sar-collapsed", expand ? "false" : "true");
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", expand ? "true" : "false");
    toggle.textContent = i18n.t(expand ? "banner_collapse" : "banner_expand");
  }

  function control(action: Action, scope: AllowScope): HTMLElement | undefined {
    return [...box.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-sar-action]")].find((candidate) =>
      candidate.getAttribute("data-sar-action") === action
      && candidate.getAttribute("data-sar-scope") === scope
    );
  }

  /** What a screen reader hears after an ignore or an undo: for all tags, or for one tag. */
  function announcement(action: Action, scope: AllowScope): string {
    const restoring = action === "undo";
    if (scope === ALLOW_ALL) {
      return i18n.t(restoring ? "notice_marking_restored" : "notice_marking_stopped");
    }
    const heading = i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[scope].messages.heading);
    return restoring
      ? i18n.t("notice_marking_restored_kind", { heading })
      : i18n.t("notice_marking_stopped_kind", { heading });
  }

  /** Undo takes the focus after an ignore, and the ignore button after an undo. */
  function focusAfter(action: Action, scope: AllowScope): void {
    const next = action === "undo" ? "ignore" : "undo";
    (control(next, scope) ?? control("ignore", ALLOW_ALL) ?? box).focus();
  }

  async function run(action: Action, scope: AllowScope): Promise<void> {
    if (pending || shown === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    pending = true;
    try {
      await (action === "undo" ? actions.restore(scope) : actions.ignore(scope));
    } catch {
      const error = box.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-banner-error");
      if (error !== null) {
        error.textContent = i18n.t("error_allow_list_save");
        error.hidden = false;
      }
      return;
    } finally {
      pending = false;
    }
    focusAfter(action, scope);
    announce(doc, live, announcement(action, scope));
  }

  shadow.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    const target = event.target;
    const clicked = target instanceof Element ? target.closest("[data-sar-action]") : null;
    if (clicked === null) {
      return;
    }
    const action = parseAction(clicked.getAttribute("data-sar-action"));
    const scope = toAllowScope(clicked.getAttribute("data-sar-scope"));
    if (action === "toggle") {
      toggleNotes(clicked);
    } else if (action !== undefined && scope !== undefined) {
      void run(action, scope);
    }
  });

  return {
    host,

    show(view) {
      if (shown === undefined || !sameView(shown, view)) {
        render(view);
      }
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Puts the banner first in the description column, directly above the purchase box. Returns
 * false when the page has no such column (a gate, a redirect, a layout we do not know).
 */
export function placeBanner(doc: Document, host: HTMLElement): boolean {
  const column = doc.querySelector(COLUMN_SELECTOR);
  if (column === null) {
    return false;
  }
  if (column.firstElementChild !== host) {
    column.prepend(host);
  }
  return true;
}
```
