`src/core/ui/capsules.test.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { setBody } from "../../../tests/helpers/dom";
import {
  aiVerdicts,
  disclosedVerdict,
  FULL_DISCLOSED,
  NOT_DISCLOSED,
} from "../../../tests/helpers/verdicts";
import type { AiVerdict } from "../kinds/ai";
import { KIND_IDS, type KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import type { KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Detector } from "../ports";
import { GENERIC, type Placement, type RowPlacement } from "../scan/placements";
import type { CapsuleHost } from "../scan/renderer";
import { type AppId, toAppId } from "../types";
import { createCapsuleUi, type SizeWatch } from "./capsules";
import type { HostView } from "./host";

const ROW: RowPlacement = {
  id: "row",
  host: "*",
  hideable: false,
  maxChips: 3,
  badge: "full",
  slot: "after",
  anchor: (host) => host.firstElementChild ?? undefined,
};

function appId(value: number): AppId {
  const id = toAppId(value);
  if (id === undefined) {
    throw new TypeError();
  }
  return id;
}

function setup(
  verdicts: ReadonlyMap<AppId, AiVerdict>,
  allowed = new Set<AppId>(),
  /** Verdicts of kinds other than the AI kind, for every app. */
  others: Partial<KindVerdicts> = {},
  /** Kinds whose badges are off in the settings. */
  unbadged: ReadonlySet<KindId> = new Set(),
) {
  const detect = vi.fn((ids: readonly AppId[]) =>
    Promise.resolve(
      new Map(ids.flatMap((id) => {
        const verdict = verdicts.get(id);
        return verdict === undefined ? [] : [[id, { ...aiVerdicts(verdict), ...others }] as const];
      })),
    )
  );
  const detector: Detector = { detect };
  const views: HostView[] = [];
  const frames: (() => void)[] = [];
  const watched = new Set<Element>();
  let disconnects = 0;
  let reportSized: (elements: readonly Element[]) => void = () => undefined;
  const ui = createCapsuleUi({
    document,
    detector,
    renderers: [{
      render: (view) =>
        views.push({ ...view, allowed: { ...view.allowed }, badged: { ...view.badged } }),
    }],
    isAllowed: (id) => allowed.has(id),
    isBadged: (kind) => !unbadged.has(kind),
    frame: (callback) => frames.push(callback),
    watchSize: (onSized): SizeWatch => {
      reportSized = onSized;
      return {
        observe: (element) => watched.add(element),
        unobserve: (e) => watched.delete(e),
        disconnect: () => {
          disconnects += 1;
          watched.clear();
        },
      };
    },
  });
  const flush = async () => {
    await Promise.resolve();
    await Promise.resolve();
    for (const callback of frames.splice(0)) {
      callback();
    }
  };
  const sized = (elements: readonly Element[]) => {
    reportSized(elements);
  };
  return { ui, detect, views, flush, watched, sized, disconnects: () => disconnects };
}

function host(id: number, placement: Placement = ROW): CapsuleHost {
  setBody(
    `<div data-sar-appid="${String(id)}"><span class="line"></span><div class="art"></div></div>`,
  );
  const element = document.querySelector("[data-sar-appid]");
  const anchor = placement.anchor(element ?? document.body);
  if (element === null || anchor === undefined) {
    throw new TypeError();
  }
  return { element, appId: appId(id), placement, anchor };
}

describe("createCapsuleUi", () => {
  it("detects found hosts in one call and draws them with their full-badge slot", async () => {
    const id = appId(7);
    const { ui, detect, views, flush } = setup(new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]));
    const found = host(7);
    ui.render({ found: [found], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(detect).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(views).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(views[0]?.slot).toEqual({ kind: "full", anchor: found.anchor, position: "afterend" });
    expect(views[0]?.hideable).toBe(false);
  });

  it("gives a host a slot for a disclosure in any kind, whichever it is", async () => {
    const id = appId(4);
    const pvpOnly = setup(new Map([[id, NOT_DISCLOSED]]), new Set(), { pvp: FULL_DISCLOSED.pvp });
    pvpOnly.ui.render({ found: [host(4)], changed: [] });
    await pvpOnly.flush();
    expect(pvpOnly.views[0]?.slot).toMatchObject({ kind: "full" });
    const none = setup(new Map([[id, NOT_DISCLOSED]]));
    none.ui.render({ found: [host(4)], changed: [] });
    await none.flush();
    expect(none.views[0]?.slot).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("passes the chip allowance and the badge settings to the renderers", async () => {
    const id = appId(3);
    const { ui, views, flush } = setup(
      new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]),
      new Set(),
      {},
      new Set<KindId>(["drm", "pvp"]),
    );
    ui.render({ found: [host(3, { ...ROW, maxChips: 2 })], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(views[0]?.maxChips).toBe(2);
    expect(KIND_IDS.filter((kind) => views[0]?.badged[kind] === false)).toEqual(["drm", "pvp"]);
  });

  it("gives a host no slot when the only kind it discloses has its badges off", async () => {
    const id = appId(2);
    const aiOff = setup(
      new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]),
      new Set(),
      {},
      new Set<KindId>(["ai"]),
    );
    aiOff.ui.render({ found: [host(2)], changed: [] });
    await aiOff.flush();
    expect(aiOff.views[0]?.slot).toBeUndefined();
    const withPvp = setup(new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]), new Set(), {
      pvp: FULL_DISCLOSED.pvp,
    }, new Set<KindId>(["ai"]));
    withPvp.ui.render({ found: [host(2)], changed: [] });
    await withPvp.flush();
    expect(withPvp.views[0]?.slot).toMatchObject({ kind: "full" });
  });

  it("draws a full badge of an end slot as the anchor's last child", async () => {
    const id = appId(6);
    const { ui, views, flush } = setup(new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]));
    const found = host(6, { ...ROW, slot: "end" });
    ui.render({ found: [found], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(views[0]?.slot).toEqual({ kind: "full", anchor: found.anchor, position: "beforeend" });
  });

  it("measures the image box for a compact badge and anchors a static box", async () => {
    const id = appId(8);
    const { ui, views, flush } = setup(new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]));
    const found = host(8, {
      ...GENERIC,
      anchor: (element) => element.querySelector(".art") ?? undefined,
    });
    vi.spyOn(found.anchor, "getBoundingClientRect").mockReturnValue(new DOMRect(0, 0, 231, 87));
    ui.render({ found: [found], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(views[0]?.slot).toMatchObject({ kind: "compact", size: "text", position: "beforeend" });
    expect(found.anchor.hasAttribute("data-sar-anchor")).toBe(true);
  });

  it("gives a small image no slot", async () => {
    const id = appId(9);
    const { ui, views, flush } = setup(new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]));
    const found = host(9, {
      ...GENERIC,
      anchor: (element) => element.querySelector(".art") ?? undefined,
    });
    vi.spyOn(found.anchor, "getBoundingClientRect").mockReturnValue(new DOMRect(0, 0, 120, 45));
    ui.render({ found: [found], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(views[0]?.slot).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("watches an image box with no size until a compact badge fits, then draws it", async () => {
    const id = appId(13);
    const { ui, detect, views, flush, watched, sized } = setup(
      new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]),
    );
    const found = host(13, {
      ...GENERIC,
      anchor: (element) => element.querySelector(".art") ?? undefined,
    });
    const box = vi.spyOn(found.anchor, "getBoundingClientRect");
    box.mockReturnValue(new DOMRect(0, 0, 0, 0));
    ui.render({ found: [found], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(views[0]?.slot).toBeUndefined();
    expect([...watched]).toEqual([found.anchor]);
    box.mockReturnValue(new DOMRect(0, 0, 1, 75));
    sized([found.anchor]);
    await flush();
    expect(views[1]?.slot).toBeUndefined();
    expect([...watched]).toEqual([found.anchor]);
    box.mockReturnValue(new DOMRect(0, 0, 231, 87));
    sized([found.anchor]);
    await flush();
    expect(views[2]?.slot).toMatchObject({ kind: "compact", size: "text" });
    expect(watched.size).toBe(0);
    expect(detect).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("lets go of the size watch on pagehide and starts a new one when needed", async () => {
    const id = appId(16);
    const { ui, flush, watched, disconnects } = setup(new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]));
    const found = host(16, {
      ...GENERIC,
      anchor: (element) => element.querySelector(".art") ?? undefined,
    });
    vi.spyOn(found.anchor, "getBoundingClientRect").mockReturnValue(new DOMRect(0, 0, 0, 0));
    ui.render({ found: [found], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(watched.size).toBe(1);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("pagehide"));
    expect(disconnects()).toBe(1);
    expect(watched.size).toBe(0);
    ui.refresh();
    await flush();
    expect([...watched]).toEqual([found.anchor]);
  });

  it("stops listening for pagehide when stopped", () => {
    const { ui, disconnects } = setup(new Map());
    ui.stop();
    expect(disconnects()).toBe(0);
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("pagehide"));
    expect(disconnects()).toBe(0);
  });

  it("does not watch a small image that has a size, nor a host without a badge", async () => {
    const { ui, flush, watched } = setup(
      new Map<AppId, AiVerdict>([[appId(14), disclosedVerdict()], [appId(15), NOT_DISCLOSED]]),
    );
    const small = host(14, {
      ...GENERIC,
      anchor: (element) => element.querySelector(".art") ?? undefined,
    });
    vi.spyOn(small.anchor, "getBoundingClientRect").mockReturnValue(new DOMRect(0, 0, 120, 45));
    ui.render({ found: [small], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    const hidden = host(15, {
      ...GENERIC,
      anchor: (element) => element.querySelector(".art") ?? undefined,
    });
    vi.spyOn(hidden.anchor, "getBoundingClientRect").mockReturnValue(new DOMRect(0, 0, 0, 0));
    ui.render({ found: [hidden], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(watched.size).toBe(0);
  });

  it("draws a changed host again from its known verdict, without a new detection", async () => {
    const id = appId(10);
    const { ui, detect, views, flush } = setup(new Map([[id, NOT_DISCLOSED]]));
    const found = host(10);
    ui.render({ found: [found], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    ui.render({ found: [], changed: [found] });
    await flush();
    expect(detect).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(views).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  it("gives the renderers a verdict and an allow-list flag for every kind", async () => {
    const id = appId(9);
    const { ui, views, flush } = setup(new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]));
    ui.render({ found: [host(9)], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    expect(Object.keys(views[0]?.verdicts ?? {})).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
    expect(Object.keys(views[0]?.allowed ?? {})).toStrictEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
  });

  it("redraws the hosts of an app after an allow-list change", async () => {
    const id = appId(11);
    const allowed = new Set<AppId>();
    const { ui, views, flush } = setup(new Map([[id, disclosedVerdict()]]), allowed);
    ui.render({ found: [host(11)], changed: [] });
    await flush();
    allowed.add(id);
    ui.refresh(new Set([id]));
    await flush();
    expect(views.map((view) => view.allowed.ai)).toEqual([false, true]);
    ui.refresh(new Set([appId(12)]));
    await flush();
    expect(views).toHaveLength(2);
  });
});
```

`src/core/ui/capsules.ts`:

```ts
import type { KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import { KINDS, perKind } from "../kinds/registry";
import type { KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { Detector } from "../ports";
import { HOST_APPID } from "../scan/marks";
import type { RowPlacement } from "../scan/placements";
import type { CapsuleHost, CapsuleRenderer, ScanBatch } from "../scan/renderer";
import type { AppId } from "../types";
import { compactSize } from "./badge";
import type { BadgeSlot, HostRenderer } from "./host";

/** Where a full badge goes for each row slot, relative to its anchor. */
const ROW_POSITION = {
  after: "afterend",
  end: "beforeend",
} as const satisfies Record<RowPlacement["slot"], InsertPosition>;
/** Set on a capsule image box that computes to `position: static`; CSS makes it relative. */
const ANCHOR_MARK = "data-sar-anchor";
/** Positions that already contain an absolutely placed badge. */
const POSITIONED: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["relative", "absolute", "fixed", "sticky"]);

/** Watches elements until they get a size; `ResizeObserver` fits it as is. */
export interface SizeWatch {
  observe(element: Element): void;
  unobserve(element: Element): void;
  /** Stops watching every element. */
  disconnect(): void;
}

/** Makes a size watch that reports elements whose box became non-empty. */
export type SizeWatchFactory = (onSized: (elements: readonly Element[]) => void) => SizeWatch;

/** One `ResizeObserver` for the page; a no-op where the document has no window. */
function resizeWatch(doc: Document): SizeWatchFactory {
  return (onSized) => {
    const view = doc.defaultView;
    if (view === null) {
      return { observe: () => undefined, unobserve: () => undefined, disconnect: () => undefined };
    }
    return new view.ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      onSized(
        entries.filter((entry) => entry.contentRect.width > 0 && entry.contentRect.height > 0)
          .map((entry) => entry.target),
      );
    });
  };
}

export interface CapsuleUiOptions {
  readonly document: Document;
  readonly detector: Detector;
  /** Drawn in order for every host: state marks, badges. */
  readonly renderers: readonly HostRenderer[];
  /** Whether the game is on the allow-list for the kind now. */
  readonly isAllowed: (id: AppId, kind: KindId) => boolean;
  /** Whether the kind's badges show now, by its settings. */
  readonly isBadged: (kind: KindId) => boolean;
  /** Schedules a read-then-write pass; `requestAnimationFrame` by default. */
  readonly frame?: (callback: () => void) => void;
  /** Watches image boxes that had no size when drawn; one `ResizeObserver` by default. */
  readonly watchSize?: SizeWatchFactory;
}

/** The scanner's renderer, plus a way to draw known hosts again after a change. */
export interface CapsuleUi extends CapsuleRenderer {
  /** Draws every known host again, or only those of `ids`, as after an allow-list change. */
  refresh(ids?: ReadonlySet<AppId>): void;
  /** Stops watching image boxes and listening for `pagehide`. */
  stop(): void;
}

interface HostRecord {
  host: CapsuleHost;
  verdicts: KindVerdicts | undefined;
  /** Per kind: the game is ignored. Each draw refreshes it, so drawing allocates nothing. */
  readonly allowed: Record<KindId, boolean>;
  /** Per kind: the badge shows. Refreshed by each draw like `allowed`. */
  readonly badged: Record<KindId, boolean>;
}

const NOT_ALLOWED: Readonly<Record<KindId, boolean>> = perKind(() => false);
const ALL_BADGED: Readonly<Record<KindId, boolean>> = perKind(() => true);

/** One host's draw, decided in the read phase. */
interface Draw {
  readonly record: HostRecord;
  readonly verdicts: KindVerdicts;
  readonly allowed: Readonly<Record<KindId, boolean>>;
  readonly badged: Readonly<Record<KindId, boolean>>;
  readonly slot: BadgeSlot | undefined;
  readonly markAnchor: boolean;
}

/** Where a host's badge goes; `unsized` when its image box had no size to measure. */
interface SlotRead {
  readonly slot: BadgeSlot | undefined;
  readonly markAnchor: boolean;
  readonly unsized: boolean;
}

const NO_SLOT: SlotRead = { slot: undefined, markAnchor: false, unsized: false };

/**
 * The adapter between the scanner and the renderers. Found hosts are detected in one call per
 * scan batch (the detector batches and caches); changed hosts are drawn again from their known
 * verdicts. Drawing reads every image box first and writes after, in one frame per pass. Records
 * live in a `WeakMap` keyed by host, and a refresh walks the marked hosts in the page, so no host
 * outlives its element. An image box with no size waits in one shared size watch until a compact
 * badge fits. Showing a hidden tab changes no node the scanner sees, and tabs fade in.
 */
export function createCapsuleUi(options: CapsuleUiOptions): CapsuleUi {
  const { document: doc, detector, renderers, isAllowed, isBadged } = options;
  const frame = options.frame ?? ((callback: () => void) => {
    const view = doc.defaultView;
    if (view === null) {
      callback();
    } else {
      view.requestAnimationFrame(callback);
    }
  });
  const records = new WeakMap<Element, HostRecord>();
  /** Image boxes waiting for a size that fits a compact badge, with the host to draw again. */
  let unsized = new WeakMap<Element, HostRecord>();
  const watchSize = options.watchSize ?? resizeWatch(doc);
  let sizeWatch: SizeWatch | undefined;
  let queued = new Set<HostRecord>();

  function slotOf(host: CapsuleHost): SlotRead {
    const { placement, anchor } = host;
    if (placement.badge === "full") {
      return {
        slot: { kind: "full", anchor, position: ROW_POSITION[placement.slot] },
        markAnchor: false,
        unsized: false,
      };
    }
    const box = anchor.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (box.width === 0 || box.height === 0) {
      return { ...NO_SLOT, unsized: true };
    }
    const size = compactSize(box.width, box.height);
    if (size === undefined) {
      return NO_SLOT;
    }
    const position = doc.defaultView?.getComputedStyle(anchor).position ?? "";
    const markAnchor = !anchor.hasAttribute(ANCHOR_MARK) && !POSITIONED.has(position);
    return {
      slot: { kind: "compact", anchor, position: "beforeend", size },
      markAnchor,
      unsized: false,
    };
  }

  /** Draws a watched host again when its image box resizes, while that box is still its anchor. */
  function onSized(elements: readonly Element[]): void {
    for (const element of elements) {
      const record = unsized.get(element);
      if (record?.host.anchor === element) {
        queue(record);
      } else {
        unwatch(element);
      }
    }
  }

  function watch(record: HostRecord): void {
    const { anchor } = record.host;
    if (!unsized.has(anchor)) {
      sizeWatch ??= watchSize(onSized);
      unsized.set(anchor, record);
      sizeWatch.observe(anchor);
    }
  }

  function unwatch(anchor: Element): void {
    if (unsized.delete(anchor)) {
      sizeWatch?.unobserve(anchor);
    }
  }

  /** Lets go of the size watch, as on `pagehide`; a later draw starts a new one if it needs it. */
  function disconnect(): void {
    sizeWatch?.disconnect();
    sizeWatch = undefined;
    unsized = new WeakMap();
  }

  function drawQueued(): void {
    const batch = queued;
    queued = new Set();
    const draws: Draw[] = [];
    // Read phase: image boxes and computed positions, only for hosts that will show a badge.
    for (const record of batch) {
      const { host, verdicts, allowed, badged } = record;
      if (verdicts === undefined || !host.element.isConnected) {
        continue;
      }
      let shows = false;
      for (const kind of KINDS) {
        allowed[kind.id] = isAllowed(host.appId, kind.id);
        badged[kind.id] = isBadged(kind.id);
        shows ||= verdicts[kind.id].state === "disclosed" && !allowed[kind.id]
          && badged[kind.id];
      }
      const { slot, markAnchor, unsized: waits } = shows ? slotOf(host) : NO_SLOT;
      if (waits) {
        watch(record);
      } else if (slot !== undefined) {
        unwatch(slot.anchor);
      }
      draws.push({ record, verdicts, allowed, badged, slot, markAnchor });
    }
    // Write phase.
    for (const { record, verdicts, allowed, badged, slot, markAnchor } of draws) {
      if (markAnchor && slot !== undefined) {
        slot.anchor.setAttribute(ANCHOR_MARK, "");
      }
      const view = {
        host: record.host.element,
        verdicts,
        allowed,
        badged,
        maxChips: record.host.placement.maxChips,
        slot,
        hideable: record.host.placement.hideable,
      };
      for (const renderer of renderers) {
        renderer.render(view);
      }
    }
  }

  function queue(record: HostRecord): void {
    if (queued.size === 0) {
      frame(drawQueued);
    }
    queued.add(record);
  }

  async function detect(found: readonly HostRecord[]): Promise<void> {
    const verdicts = await detector.detect(found.map((record) => record.host.appId));
    for (const record of found) {
      record.verdicts = verdicts.get(record.host.appId);
      queue(record);
    }
  }

  doc.defaultView?.addEventListener("pagehide", disconnect);

  return {
    render(batch: ScanBatch) {
      for (const host of batch.changed) {
        const record = records.get(host.element);
        if (record !== undefined) {
          record.host = host;
          if (record.verdicts !== undefined) {
            queue(record);
          }
        }
      }
      const found: HostRecord[] = [];
      for (const host of batch.found) {
        const record: HostRecord = {
          host,
          verdicts: undefined,
          allowed: { ...NOT_ALLOWED },
          badged: { ...ALL_BADGED },
        };
        records.set(host.element, record);
        found.push(record);
      }
      if (found.length > 0) {
        void detect(found);
      }
    },

    refresh(ids) {
      for (const element of doc.querySelectorAll(`[${HOST_APPID}]`)) {
        const record = records.get(element);
        if (record?.verdicts !== undefined && (ids === undefined || ids.has(record.host.appId))) {
          queue(record);
        }
      }
    },

    stop() {
      disconnect();
      doc.defaultView?.removeEventListener("pagehide", disconnect);
    },
  };
}
```

`src/core/ui/host.ts`:

```ts
import type { KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import type { KindVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";

/** The tier of a compact badge, from the measured image box (see `compactSize`). */
export type CompactSize = "text" | "large";

/**
 * Where a host's badge goes. The placement picks the anchor and the position; for a compact badge
 * the scanner measures the image box in its batched read and passes the tier.
 */
export type BadgeSlot =
  | { readonly kind: "full"; readonly anchor: Element; readonly position: InsertPosition; }
  | {
    readonly kind: "compact";
    readonly anchor: Element;
    readonly position: InsertPosition;
    readonly size: CompactSize;
  };

/** What the renderers need to know about one capsule host. */
export interface HostView {
  readonly host: Element;
  readonly verdicts: KindVerdicts;
  /** Per kind: the game is on the allow-list, so nothing marks it, in lists or on badges. */
  readonly allowed: Readonly<Record<KindId, boolean>>;
  /** Per kind: the kind's badge shows, by its settings. Ignored games and other states aside. */
  readonly badged: Readonly<Record<KindId, boolean>>;
  /** How many chips the placement shows before the "+N" chip. */
  readonly maxChips: number;
  /** Where the badge goes; undefined when the placement shows none (a thumbnail too small). */
  readonly slot: BadgeSlot | undefined;
  /** False where hiding would break the list (virtualized, carousel); hide then dims. */
  readonly hideable: boolean;
}

/**
 * Draws one host. Idempotent: rendering the same view again keeps what is there, a new view
 * replaces it, and a badge a store re-render dropped is put back.
 */
export interface HostRenderer {
  render(view: HostView): void;
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { setBody } from "../../../tests/helpers/dom";
import { capturedVerdicts, pageVerdicts } from "../../../tests/helpers/fixture-verdicts";
import { englishI18n } from "../../../tests/helpers/i18n";

import { KIND_IDS, type KindId } from "../kinds/id";

import { createHoverCard, HOVER_CARD_ID, type HoverCard, placeCard } from "./hover-card";
import { adoptPageStyles } from "./styles";

const XSS = '<img src=x onerror="alert(1)"> art';
/** The id of a description the store already set on a link. */
const STORE_NOTE_ID = "store-note";

describe("placeCard", () => {
  const viewport = { width: 1000, height: 800 };
  const card = { width: 306, height: 200 };
  const trigger = { left: 100, top: 100, right: 220, bottom: 119 };

  it("puts the card one offset below the trigger, start edges aligned", () => {
    expect(placeCard(trigger, card, viewport, 8, "start")).toEqual({
      left: 100,
      top: 127,
      side: "below",
    });
  });

  it("aligns the end edges for a compact badge", () => {
    expect(placeCard({ ...trigger, left: 500, right: 700 }, card, viewport, 8, "end").left)
      .toBe(394);
  });

  it("flips above near the bottom edge, and stays below when above has no room either", () => {
    const low = { left: 100, top: 700, right: 220, bottom: 719 };
    expect(placeCard(low, card, viewport, 8, "start")).toMatchObject({ top: 492, side: "above" });
    const tall = { width: 306, height: 750 };
    expect(placeCard(low, tall, viewport, 8, "start").side).toBe("below");
  });

  it("keeps one offset inside the left and right edges", () => {
    expect(placeCard({ ...trigger, left: 900, right: 990 }, card, viewport, 8, "start").left)
      .toBe(686);
    expect(placeCard({ ...trigger, left: 2, right: 40 }, card, viewport, 8, "end").left).toBe(8);
  });
});

describe("createHoverCard", () => {
  const i18n = englishI18n();
  let timers: (() => void)[] = [];
  let overflowing = false;
  let card: HoverCard | undefined;

  function delay(callback: () => void): () => void {
    timers.push(callback);
    return () => {
      timers = timers.filter((timer) => timer !== callback);
    };
  }

  function flush(): void {
    const due = timers;
    timers = [];
    for (const timer of due) {
      timer();
    }
  }

  let frames: (() => void)[] = [];

  function start(): HoverCard {
    card = createHoverCard(document, i18n, {
      delay,
      overflows: () => overflowing,
      frame: (callback) => frames.push(callback),
    });
    return card;
  }

  function nextFrame(): void {
    const due = frames;
    frames = [];
    for (const callback of due) {
      callback();
    }
  }

  /** happy-dom has no layout: give the viewport and one element a box. */
  function layout(element: Element, top: number): void {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    Object.defineProperty(root, "clientWidth", { value: 1000, configurable: true });
    Object.defineProperty(root, "clientHeight", { value: 800, configurable: true });
    element.getBoundingClientRect = () => new DOMRect(100, top, 120, 19);
  }

  function page(): { link: HTMLAnchorElement; badge: HTMLElement; other: HTMLElement; } {
    const label = i18n.t("kind_ai_chip");
    setBody(`
      <a class="row" href="/app/10/"><span class="title">Game</span>
      <span class="sar-badge" data-sar-kind="ai">
      <span class="sar-badge-label">${label}</span></span></a>
      <a class="other" href="/app/20/">Other</a>`);
    const link = document.querySelector<HTMLAnchorElement>(".row");
    const badge = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-badge");
    const other = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".other");
    if (link === null || badge === null || other === null) {
      throw new TypeError();
    }
    return { link, badge, other };
  }

  function pointerOver(target: Element): void {
    target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("pointerover", { bubbles: true }));
  }

  function focusIn(target: Element): void {
    target.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent("focusin", { bubbles: true }));
  }

  function focusOut(target: Element): void {
    target.dispatchEvent(new FocusEvent("focusout", { bubbles: true }));
  }

  const shown = () => {
    const node = document.getElementById(HOVER_CARD_ID);
    return node?.hidden === false ? node : null;
  };

  beforeEach(() => {
    timers = [];
    frames = [];
    overflowing = false;
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    card?.stop();
    card = undefined;
    Reflect.deleteProperty(document.documentElement, "clientWidth");
    Reflect.deleteProperty(document.documentElement, "clientHeight");
  });

  it("opens after the pointer rests on a badge and quotes the notes verbatim", () => {
    const { badge } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [
      disclosedVerdict({ notes: "Line one\r\nLine two", service: "Midjourney" }),
    ]);
    pointerOver(badge.firstElementChild ?? badge);
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    flush();
    const node = shown();
    expect(node?.getAttribute("role")).toBe("tooltip");
    expect(node?.querySelector(".sar-hovercard-title")?.textContent)
      .toBe(i18n.t("kind_ai_heading"));
    expect(node?.lastElementChild?.className).toBe("sar-hovercard-source");
    expect(node?.lastElementChild?.textContent).toBe(i18n.t("badge_card_declared"));
    expect(node?.querySelector(".sar-hovercard-notes")?.textContent).toBe("Line one\nLine two");
    expect(node?.querySelector(".sar-hovercard-service")?.textContent)
      .toBe(`${i18n.t("badge_card_service_label")} Midjourney`);
    expect(node?.getAttribute("data-sar-side")).toBe("below");
  });

  it("shows the card in the top layer on every open, above store popovers opened before it", () => {
    const saved = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLElement.prototype, "showPopover");
    const showPopover = vi.fn();
    Object.defineProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, "showPopover", {
      value: showPopover,
      configurable: true,
    });
    try {
      const { badge, other } = page();
      const second = document.createElement("span");
      second.className = "sar-badge";
      other.append(second);
      const hover = start();
      hover.bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
      hover.bind(second, [disclosedVerdict()]);
      pointerOver(badge);
      flush();
      pointerOver(second);
      expect(shown()?.getAttribute("popover")).toBe("manual");
      expect(showPopover).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    } finally {
      if (saved === undefined) {
        Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, "showPopover");
      } else {
        Object.defineProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, "showPopover", saved);
      }
    }
  });

  it("keeps a closed card hidden through the reset, which unsets the popover's own rules", () => {
    adoptPageStyles(document);
    const { badge, other } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    const node = document.getElementById(HOVER_CARD_ID);
    const style = node === null ? undefined : getComputedStyle(node);
    expect([style?.display, style?.position]).toEqual(["flex", "fixed"]);
    pointerOver(other);
    flush();
    expect(node?.hidden).toBe(true);
    expect(node === null ? undefined : getComputedStyle(node).display).toBe("none");
  });

  it("marks the root while open, and the page CSS hides the store's game hover then", () => {
    adoptPageStyles(document);
    const { badge, other } = page();
    const storeHover = document.createElement("div");
    storeHover.id = "global_hover";
    document.body.append(storeHover);
    expect(getComputedStyle(storeHover).visibility).not.toBe("hidden");
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-sar-hovercard")).toBe("open");
    expect(getComputedStyle(storeHover).visibility).toBe("hidden");
    pointerOver(other);
    flush();
    expect(document.documentElement.hasAttribute("data-sar-hovercard")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("clears the root mark on Escape, on pagehide and on stop", () => {
    const { badge, other } = page();
    const hover = start();
    hover.bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    const marked = () => document.documentElement.hasAttribute("data-sar-hovercard");
    const reopen = () => {
      pointerOver(other);
      pointerOver(badge);
      flush();
      expect(marked()).toBe(true);
    };
    reopen();
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape" }));
    expect(marked()).toBe(false);
    reopen();
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("pagehide"));
    expect(marked()).toBe(false);
    reopen();
    hover.stop();
    expect(marked()).toBe(false);
  });

  it("renders notes with markup as plain text", () => {
    const { badge } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict({ notes: XSS, service: XSS })]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(shown()?.querySelector(".sar-hovercard-notes")?.textContent).toBe(XSS);
    expect(shown()?.querySelector(".sar-hovercard-service-name")?.textContent).toBe(XSS);
    expect(document.querySelector(".sar-hovercard img")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("leaves out the service line when the developer named none", () => {
    const { badge } = page();
    const { service: _service, ...unnamed } = disclosedVerdict();
    start().bind(badge, [unnamed]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(shown()?.querySelector(".sar-hovercard-service")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("points to the store page only when the clamp cuts a long note", () => {
    const { badge, other } = page();
    const hover = start();
    overflowing = true;
    hover.bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict({ notes: "word ".repeat(400) })]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    const more = shown()?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-hovercard-more");
    expect(more?.hidden).toBe(false);
    expect(more?.textContent).toBe(i18n.t("badge_card_more"));
    expect(shown()?.querySelector(".sar-hovercard-notes")?.textContent).toBe("word ".repeat(400));

    overflowing = false;
    const second = document.createElement("span");
    second.className = "sar-badge";
    other.append(second);
    hover.bind(second, [disclosedVerdict({ notes: "Short." })]);
    pointerOver(second);
    expect(shown()?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-hovercard-more")?.hidden).toBe(true);
  });

  it("opens for a focusable chip on the game's own page and closes when focus leaves", () => {
    const { badge, other } = page();
    badge.tabIndex = 0;
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()], true);
    focusIn(badge);
    expect(shown()).not.toBeNull();
    expect(badge.getAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(HOVER_CARD_ID);
    focusOut(badge);
    focusIn(other);
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    expect(badge.hasAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("leaves out the store page pointer on the game's own page", () => {
    const { badge, other } = page();
    const hover = start();
    overflowing = true;
    const verdict = disclosedVerdict({ notes: "word ".repeat(400) });
    hover.bind(badge, [verdict], true);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(shown()?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-hovercard-more")?.hidden).toBe(true);

    const capsule = document.createElement("span");
    capsule.className = "sar-compact";
    other.append(capsule);
    hover.bind(capsule, [verdict]);
    pointerOver(capsule);
    expect(shown()?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-hovercard-more")?.hidden).toBe(false);
  });

  it("adds six document listeners and none per badge, however many badges there are", () => {
    const add = vi.spyOn(Node.prototype, "addEventListener");
    setBody(Array.from({ length: 200 }, () => '<span class="sar-badge">AI</span>').join(""));
    const hover = start();
    for (const badge of document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge")) {
      hover.bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    }
    pointerOver(document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge")[150] ?? document.body);
    flush();
    expect(add.mock.contexts.filter((target) => target === document)).toHaveLength(6);
    expect(add.mock.contexts.filter((target) => target !== document)).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(document.querySelectorAll(".sar-hovercard")).toHaveLength(1);
    add.mockRestore();
  });

  it("stays open while the pointer crosses onto the card, and closes after leaving both", () => {
    const { badge, other } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    const node = shown();
    pointerOver(document.body);
    if (node !== null) {
      pointerOver(node);
    }
    flush();
    expect(shown()).not.toBeNull();
    pointerOver(other);
    expect(shown()).not.toBeNull();
    flush();
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
  });

  it("opens nothing when the pointer only passes over a badge", () => {
    const { badge, other } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    pointerOver(other);
    flush();
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
  });

  it("opens at once on focus of a link holding a badge, and describes the link", () => {
    const { link, other } = page();
    const badge = link.querySelector(".sar-badge");
    link.setAttribute("aria-describedby", STORE_NOTE_ID);
    if (badge !== null) {
      start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    }
    focusIn(link);
    expect(shown()).not.toBeNull();
    expect(link.getAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(`${STORE_NOTE_ID} ${HOVER_CARD_ID}`);
    focusOut(link);
    focusIn(other);
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    expect(link.getAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(STORE_NOTE_ID);
  });

  it("describes a focused link when the pointer opens the card over it, and lets go", () => {
    const { link, badge, other } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    link.focus();
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", bubbles: true }));
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    pointerOver(other);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(shown()).not.toBeNull();
    expect(link.getAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(HOVER_CARD_ID);
    pointerOver(other);
    flush();
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    expect(link.hasAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("describes nothing when the pointer opens the card and no link holds focus", () => {
    const { link, badge, other } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    other.focus();
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(shown()).not.toBeNull();
    expect(link.hasAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(false);
    expect(other.hasAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("closes on Escape and stays closed until the pointer leaves the badge", () => {
    const { badge, other } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", bubbles: true }));
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    pointerOver(badge.firstElementChild ?? badge);
    flush();
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    pointerOver(other);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(shown()).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("moves a focus-opened card with its link, once per frame, through a scroll", () => {
    const { link, badge } = page();
    layout(badge, 300);
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    focusIn(link);
    layout(badge, 100);
    const moved = vi.spyOn(badge, "getBoundingClientRect");
    document.dispatchEvent(new Event("scroll"));
    document.dispatchEvent(new Event("scroll"));
    document.dispatchEvent(new Event("scroll"));
    expect(frames).toHaveLength(1);
    nextFrame();
    expect(moved).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    // happy-dom resolves no tokens, so the offset is 0: the card sits at the badge's bottom.
    expect(shown()?.style.top).toBe("119px");
    expect(link.getAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(HOVER_CARD_ID);
  });

  it("closes a focus-opened card once its link leaves the viewport", () => {
    const { link, badge } = page();
    layout(badge, 300);
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    focusIn(link);
    layout(badge, -50);
    document.dispatchEvent(new Event("scroll"));
    nextFrame();
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    expect(link.hasAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("closes on a page scroll", () => {
    const { badge } = page();
    start().bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    document.dispatchEvent(new Event("scroll"));
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
  });

  it("opens nothing for an unbound element and removes the card on stop", () => {
    const { badge, other } = page();
    const hover = start();
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    hover.bind(badge, [disclosedVerdict()]);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    hover.stop();
    expect(document.getElementById(HOVER_CARD_ID)).toBeNull();
    pointerOver(other);
    pointerOver(badge);
    flush();
    expect(document.getElementById(HOVER_CARD_ID)).toBeNull();
  });

  describe("with several kinds", () => {
    /** Each entry's title and details, as the card shows them. */
    function entries(): string[][] {
      const node = shown();
      return Array.from(
        node?.querySelectorAll(".sar-hovercard-entry") ?? [],
        (entry) => Array.from(entry.children, (line) => line.textContent),
      );
    }

    function open(verdicts: readonly AnyDisclosed[], ownPage = false): void {
      const { badge } = page();
      start().bind(badge, verdicts, ownPage);
      pointerOver(badge);
      flush();
    }

    /** The disclosed verdicts of an app, in registry order. */
    function disclosedOf(verdicts: KindVerdicts): AnyDisclosed[] {
      return KIND_IDS.flatMap((id) => {
        const verdict = verdicts[id];
        return verdict.state === "disclosed" ? [verdict] : [];
      });
    }

    const heading = (id: KindId) => i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[id].messages.heading);

    function notesOf(verdicts: KindVerdicts): string {
      const { ai } = verdicts;
      return ai.state === "disclosed" ? ai.notes : "";
    }

    function eulaNames(verdicts: KindVerdicts): string[] {
      const { eula } = verdicts;
      return eula.state === "disclosed" ? eula.items.map((item) => item.name) : [];
    }

    it("lists every kind in the order given, then names the developer as the source", () => {
      open(disclosedOf(FULL_DISCLOSED));
      expect(entries().map(([title]) => title)).toEqual(KIND_IDS.map(heading));
      expect(shown()?.children).toHaveLength(KIND_IDS.length + 2);
      expect(shown()?.lastElementChild?.textContent).toBe(i18n.t("badge_card_declared"));
      expect(shown()?.querySelectorAll(".sar-hovercard-title")).toHaveLength(KIND_IDS.length);
    });

    it("marks each entry with its kind, so a custom color reaches its title", () => {
      open(disclosedOf(FULL_DISCLOSED));
      const kinds = [...(shown()?.querySelectorAll(".sar-hovercard-entry") ?? [])].map((entry) =>
        entry.getAttribute("data-sar-kind")
      );
      expect(kinds).toEqual([...KIND_IDS]);
      expect(shown()?.querySelector(".sar-hovercard-title")?.hasAttribute("style")).toBe(false);
    });

    // The details of each kind, from the batch captured for the tag kinds and from its pages.
    const CASES: readonly (readonly [string, KindVerdicts, readonly (readonly string[])[]])[] = [
      ["DRM, a linkable account and a EULA (3751950)", capturedVerdicts(3751950), [
        [heading("drm"), "Denuvo Anti-tamper"],
        [heading("account"), "Ubisoft Account", i18n.t("kind_account_links")],
        [heading("eula"), ...eulaNames(capturedVerdicts(3751950))],
      ]],
      [
        "kernel anti-cheat with boot protection and no vendor (2807960)",
        capturedVerdicts(2807960),
        [
          [heading("kernel"), i18n.t("kind_kernel_boot")],
          [heading("account"), "EA Account linking required", i18n.t("kind_account_links")],
          [heading("eula"), ...eulaNames(capturedVerdicts(2807960))],
          [heading("pvp"), i18n.t("kind_pvp_category_online")],
        ],
      ],
      [
        "AI notes, a named kernel anti-cheat that stays behind, PvP (1808500)",
        capturedVerdicts(1808500),
        [
          [heading("ai"), notesOf(capturedVerdicts(1808500))],
          [heading("kernel"), "Denuvo", i18n.t("kind_kernel_uninstall")],
          [heading("eula"), ...eulaNames(capturedVerdicts(1808500))],
          [heading("pvp"), i18n.t("kind_pvp_category_online")],
        ],
      ],
      ["a named anti-cheat that is not kernel level (730)", capturedVerdicts(730), [
        [heading("anticheat"), "VAC (Valve Anti-Cheat)"],
      ]],
      ["two EULAs (1245620)", capturedVerdicts(1245620), [
        [heading("eula"), ...eulaNames(capturedVerdicts(1245620))],
        [heading("pvp"), i18n.t("kind_pvp_category_online")],
      ]],
      [
        "a named kernel anti-cheat that stays behind, an account and a EULA (1172470)",
        capturedVerdicts(1172470),
        [
          [heading("kernel"), "Easy Anti-Cheat", i18n.t("kind_kernel_uninstall")],
          [heading("account"), "EA Account", i18n.t("kind_account_links")],
          [heading("eula"), ...eulaNames(capturedVerdicts(1172470))],
          [heading("pvp"), i18n.t("kind_pvp_category_online")],
        ],
      ],
      [
        "the AI notes read from a captured app page (5072580)",
        pageVerdicts("5072580-ai-first.html", 5072580),
        [[heading("ai"), notesOf(pageVerdicts("5072580-ai-first.html", 5072580))]],
      ],
    ];

    it.each(CASES)(
      "shows Steam's lines and the developer's text for %s",
      (_name, verdicts, lines) => {
        open(disclosedOf(verdicts));
        expect(entries()).toEqual(lines);
      },
    );

    it("sets the developer's text as text for every kind", () => {
      const markup = [
        { ...FULL_DISCLOSED.drm, text: XSS },
        { ...FULL_DISCLOSED.account, text: XSS },
        { ...FULL_DISCLOSED.eula, items: [{ name: XSS }] },
        { ...FULL_DISCLOSED.anticheat, name: XSS },
        { ...FULL_DISCLOSED.kernel, name: XSS },
      ];
      open(markup);
      expect(document.querySelector(".sar-hovercard img")).toBeNull();
      expect(entries().map((lines) => lines[1])).toEqual([XSS, XSS, XSS, XSS, XSS]);
    });

    it("leaves out the details the data does not carry", () => {
      const { name: _kernelName, bootProtection: _boot, ...kernel } = FULL_DISCLOSED.kernel;
      const { name: _anticheatName, ...anticheat } = FULL_DISCLOSED.anticheat;
      open([kernel, anticheat, { ...FULL_DISCLOSED.pvp, categoryIds: [1234] }]);
      expect(entries()).toEqual([[heading("kernel")], [heading("anticheat")], [heading("pvp")]]);
    });

    it("refills the card for other kinds and keeps it for the same verdicts", () => {
      const { badge, other } = page();
      const second = document.createElement("span");
      second.className = "sar-badge";
      other.append(second);
      const hover = start();
      const first = disclosedOf(FULL_DISCLOSED).slice(0, 2);
      hover.bind(badge, first);
      hover.bind(second, [...first]);
      pointerOver(badge);
      flush();
      const node = shown()?.firstElementChild;
      pointerOver(second);
      expect(shown()?.firstElementChild).toBe(node);
      hover.bind(second, disclosedOf(FULL_DISCLOSED).slice(2, 3));
      pointerOver(badge);
      pointerOver(second);
      expect(entries()).toEqual([[heading("anticheat"), FULL_DISCLOSED.anticheat.name]]);
    });

    it("opens nothing for a trigger bound to no kind", () => {
      open([]);
      expect(shown()).toBeNull();
    });

    it("shows the long-text line when any quote is clamped", () => {
      overflowing = true;
      open(disclosedOf(FULL_DISCLOSED));
      expect(shown()?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-hovercard-more")?.hidden).toBe(false);
    });
  });
});

```

`src/core/ui/hover-card.ts`:

```ts
import { KIND_BY_ID } from "../kinds/registry";
import { type AnyDisclosed, sameVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { MessageCatalog } from "../ports";
import { KIND_ATTRIBUTE } from "./kind-attributes";
import { type KindDetail, kindDetails } from "./kind-details";
import { normalizeBreaks } from "./notes";

/** The card's id, the target of `aria-describedby` while focus holds it open. */
export const HOVER_CARD_ID = "sar-hovercard";

/** Set to `open` on the root element while the card shows; page CSS hides the store's hover. */
const OPEN_MARK = "data-sar-hovercard";

/** Elements that can open the card. */
const TRIGGER_SELECTOR = ".sar-badge, .sar-compact";

/** A pointer at rest this long opens the card; a sweep across a grid opens nothing. */
const OPEN_DELAY = 150;
/** Grace after the pointer leaves, so it can cross the offset onto the card. */
const CLOSE_DELAY = 100;

const DESCRIBED_BY = "aria-describedby";
const ESCAPE = "Escape";

/** The token that sets the gap between trigger and card, and the card's viewport margin. */
const OFFSET_TOKEN = "--sar-hovercard-offset";

export interface Box {
  readonly left: number;
  readonly top: number;
  readonly right: number;
  readonly bottom: number;
}

export interface Size {
  readonly width: number;
  readonly height: number;
}

/** Which trigger edge the card lines up with: compact badges hang it back over the capsule. */
export type Align = "start" | "end";

export interface CardPosition {
  readonly left: number;
  readonly top: number;
  readonly side: "below" | "above";
}

/**
 * Where the card goes: `offset` below the trigger, or above it when it would cross the bottom
 * edge and fits there, and at least `offset` inside the left and right edges.
 */
export function placeCard(
  trigger: Box,
  card: Size,
  viewport: Size,
  offset: number,
  align: Align,
): CardPosition {
  const below = trigger.bottom + offset;
  const above = trigger.top - offset - card.height;
  const side = below + card.height + offset <= viewport.height || above < offset
    ? "below"
    : "above";
  const preferred = align === "start" ? trigger.left : trigger.right - card.width;
  const left = Math.max(offset, Math.min(preferred, viewport.width - offset - card.width));
  return { left, top: side === "below" ? below : above, side };
}

/** Elements register here as they render; the card looks them up when an event reaches them. */
export interface CardTriggers {
  /**
   * Makes the element open the card with these disclosed verdicts, one entry each, in the order
   * given. Sets nothing on it. `ownPage` marks a trigger on the game's own store page, where the
   * card does not point to that page.
   */
  bind(trigger: Element, entries: readonly AnyDisclosed[], ownPage?: boolean): void;
}

export interface HoverCard extends CardTriggers {
  /** Removes the listeners and the card. */
  stop(): void;
}

export interface HoverCardOptions {
  /** Runs a callback after a delay and returns its cancel; `setTimeout` by default. */
  readonly delay?: (callback: () => void, ms: number) => () => void;
  /** Whether the clamped notes hide text; compares scroll and client height by default. */
  readonly overflows?: (notes: HTMLElement) => boolean;
  /** Schedules the follow after a scroll; `requestAnimationFrame` by default. */
  readonly frame?: (callback: () => void) => void;
}

type Via = "pointer" | "focus";

interface Open {
  readonly trigger: Element;
  readonly via: Via;
}

interface Card {
  readonly root: HTMLElement;
  readonly more: HTMLElement;
  readonly source: HTMLElement;
}

/** What a follow reuses from the last placement, so it reads only the trigger's box. */
interface Placed {
  readonly size: Size;
  readonly offset: number;
  readonly align: Align;
}

interface Binding {
  readonly entries: readonly AnyDisclosed[];
  readonly ownPage: boolean;
}

interface Described {
  readonly element: Element;
  readonly previous: string | null;
}

function asElement(target: EventTarget | null): Element | undefined {
  return target instanceof Element ? target : undefined;
}

/**
 * Shows the card in the browser's top layer, above store popovers opened before it. Hiding and
 * showing again puts it last in the stack. Engines without the Popover API keep the z-index.
 */
function raise(root: HTMLElement): void {
  try {
    leaveTopLayer(root);
    root.showPopover();
  } catch {
    // No Popover API: the card stays in the page at its z-index.
  }
}

function leaveTopLayer(root: HTMLElement): void {
  try {
    if (root.matches(":popover-open")) {
      root.hidePopover();
    }
  } catch {
    // No Popover API.
  }
}

function defaultOverflows(notes: HTMLElement): boolean {
  return notes.scrollHeight > notes.clientHeight;
}

/**
 * The hover card: one panel per page, built like the store's game hover popup, that lists every
 * kind of the chip under the pointer or focus: Steam's line for the kind, its details and the
 * developer's own text, then a line that names the developer as the source.
 * Triggers register in a `WeakMap`; six delegated listeners on the document serve every trigger
 * on the page. The card closes on `pagehide`.
 */
export function createHoverCard(
  doc: Document,
  i18n: MessageCatalog,
  options: HoverCardOptions = {},
): HoverCard {
  const view = doc.defaultView;
  const delay = options.delay ?? ((callback: () => void, ms: number) => {
    if (view === null) {
      return () => undefined;
    }
    const id = view.setTimeout(callback, ms);
    return () => {
      view.clearTimeout(id);
    };
  });
  const overflows = options.overflows ?? defaultOverflows;
  const frame = options.frame ?? ((callback: () => void) => {
    if (view === null) {
      callback();
    } else {
      view.requestAnimationFrame(callback);
    }
  });
  const bindings = new WeakMap<Element, Binding>();

  let card: Card | undefined;
  let filled: readonly AnyDisclosed[] | undefined;
  /** The clamped quotes of the filled entries. */
  let quotes: HTMLElement[] = [];
  /** Whether the clamp hides part of a filled quote. */
  let clamped = false;
  let open: Open | undefined;
  let described: Described | undefined;
  /** The trigger a pending open is for, so moves inside it do not restart the delay. */
  let pending: Element | undefined;
  let cancel: (() => void) | undefined;
  /** Closed with Escape: stays closed until the pointer leaves it or focus moves. */
  let dismissed: Element | undefined;
  let placed: Placed | undefined;
  /** A follow is queued for the next frame. */
  let following = false;

  function line(className: string, text: string): HTMLElement {
    const node = doc.createElement("p");
    node.className = className;
    node.textContent = text;
    return node;
  }

  function ensureCard(): Card {
    if (card !== undefined) {
      if (!card.root.isConnected) {
        doc.body.append(card.root);
      }
      return card;
    }
    const root = doc.createElement("div");
    root.className = "sar-hovercard";
    root.id = HOVER_CARD_ID;
    root.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
    root.setAttribute("popover", "manual");
    root.hidden = true;
    const more = line("sar-hovercard-more", i18n.t("badge_card_more"));
    more.hidden = true;
    const source = line("sar-hovercard-source", i18n.t("badge_card_declared"));
    doc.body.append(root);
    card = { root, more, source };
    return card;
  }

  /** One line of an entry: catalog copy, or the developer's text through `textContent`. */
  function detailLine(detail: KindDetail): HTMLElement {
    switch (detail.kind) {
      case "message":
        return line("sar-hovercard-detail", i18n.t(detail.key));
      case "text":
        return line("sar-hovercard-detail", detail.text);
      case "quote": {
        const quote = line("sar-hovercard-notes", normalizeBreaks(detail.text));
        quotes.push(quote);
        return quote;
      }
      case "labeled": {
        const labeled = line("sar-hovercard-service", i18n.t(detail.key));
        const name = doc.createElement("span");
        name.className = "sar-hovercard-service-name";
        name.textContent = detail.text;
        labeled.append(" ", name);
        return labeled;
      }
    }
  }

  /** A kind's entry. A line that only repeats the heading, as PvP does, is left out. */
  function entry(verdict: AnyDisclosed): HTMLElement {
    const heading = i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[verdict.kind].messages.heading);
    const node = doc.createElement("div");
    node.className = "sar-hovercard-entry";
    node.setAttribute(KIND_ATTRIBUTE, verdict.kind);
    node.append(
      line("sar-hovercard-title", heading),
      ...kindDetails(verdict)
        .filter((detail) => !(detail.kind === "message" && i18n.t(detail.key) === heading))
        .map(detailLine),
    );
    return node;
  }

  /** Rebuilds the shown card for other verdicts; the same verdicts keep what is there. */
  function fill(target: Card, { entries, ownPage }: Binding): void {
    if (filled === undefined || !sameVerdicts(filled, entries)) {
      filled = entries;
      quotes = [];
      target.root.replaceChildren(...entries.map(entry), target.more, target.source);
      // Measured once per fill, on the shown card: the clamp depends on the text and the width.
      target.more.hidden = true;
      clamped = quotes.some(overflows);
    }
    target.more.hidden = ownPage || !clamped;
  }

  function release(): void {
    if (described === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    const { element, previous } = described;
    described = undefined;
    if (previous === null) {
      element.removeAttribute(DESCRIBED_BY);
    } else {
      element.setAttribute(DESCRIBED_BY, previous);
    }
  }

  function describe(element: Element): void {
    const previous = element.getAttribute(DESCRIBED_BY);
    described = { element, previous };
    element.setAttribute(
      DESCRIBED_BY,
      previous === null || previous === "" ? HOVER_CARD_ID : `${previous} ${HOVER_CARD_ID}`,
    );
  }

  function clearTimer(): void {
    cancel?.();
    cancel = undefined;
    pending = undefined;
  }

  function schedule(ms: number, callback: () => void): void {
    clearTimer();
    cancel = delay(() => {
      cancel = undefined;
      pending = undefined;
      callback();
    }, ms);
  }

  function close(): void {
    clearTimer();
    release();
    open = undefined;
    doc.documentElement.removeAttribute(OPEN_MARK);
    if (card !== undefined) {
      card.root.hidden = true;
      leaveTopLayer(card.root);
    }
  }

  /** The focused element that holds the trigger, when the pointer opens a card over a focus. */
  function focusedAround(trigger: Element): Element | undefined {
    const active = doc.activeElement;
    return active !== null && active !== doc.body && active.contains(trigger) ? active : undefined;
  }

  function show(trigger: Element, via: Via, focused?: Element): void {
    const binding = bindings.get(trigger);
    if (binding === undefined || binding.entries.length === 0 || !trigger.isConnected) {
      close();
      return;
    }
    clearTimer();
    release();
    const target = ensureCard();
    target.root.hidden = false;
    raise(target.root);
    fill(target, binding);
    const owner = focused ?? focusedAround(trigger);
    if (owner !== undefined) {
      describe(owner);
    }
    place(target, trigger);
    doc.documentElement.setAttribute(OPEN_MARK, "open");
    open = { trigger, via };
  }

  /** Puts the card next to its trigger: reads trigger, card, viewport and offset, then writes. */
  function place(target: Card, trigger: Element): void {
    const box = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
    const size = target.root.getBoundingClientRect();
    const token = Number.parseFloat(
      view?.getComputedStyle(target.root).getPropertyValue(OFFSET_TOKEN) ?? "",
    );
    placed = {
      size: { width: size.width, height: size.height },
      offset: Number.isFinite(token) ? token : 0,
      align: trigger.classList.contains("sar-compact") ? "end" : "start",
    };
    write(target, placeCard(box, placed.size, viewportSize(), placed.offset, placed.align));
  }

  function viewportSize(): Size {
    return { width: doc.documentElement.clientWidth, height: doc.documentElement.clientHeight };
  }

  function write(target: Card, position: CardPosition): void {
    target.root.style.left = `${position.left}px`;
    target.root.style.top = `${position.top}px`;
    target.root.setAttribute("data-sar-side", position.side);
  }

  /**
   * Moves a focus-opened card with its trigger, once per frame and with one read of the trigger's
   * box. A trigger that left the viewport closes the card.
   */
  function follow(): void {
    if (following) {
      return;
    }
    following = true;
    frame(() => {
      following = false;
      if (open?.via !== "focus" || card === undefined || placed === undefined) {
        return;
      }
      const box = open.trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewport = viewportSize();
      const outside = box.bottom <= 0 || box.top >= viewport.height || box.right <= 0
        || box.left >= viewport.width;
      if (!open.trigger.isConnected || outside) {
        close();
        return;
      }
      write(card, placeCard(box, placed.size, viewport, placed.offset, placed.align));
    });
  }

  /** The registered trigger at or around an element. */
  function triggerAt(element: Element): Element | undefined {
    const node = element.closest(TRIGGER_SELECTOR);
    return node !== null && bindings.has(node) ? node : undefined;
  }

  /** A focused store link that holds a badge: a search row or a capsule link. */
  function triggerIn(element: Element): Element | undefined {
    if (element.tagName !== "A") {
      return undefined;
    }
    for (const node of element.querySelectorAll(TRIGGER_SELECTOR)) {
      if (bindings.has(node)) {
        return node;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  function onPointerOver(event: Event): void {
    const element = asElement(event.target);
    if (element === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    if (card?.root.contains(element) === true) {
      if (open !== undefined) {
        clearTimer();
      }
      return;
    }
    const trigger = triggerAt(element);
    if (trigger === undefined) {
      dismissed = undefined;
      if (open === undefined) {
        clearTimer();
      } else if (open.via === "pointer" && pending === undefined && cancel === undefined) {
        schedule(CLOSE_DELAY, close);
      }
      return;
    }
    if (trigger === dismissed) {
      return;
    }
    dismissed = undefined;
    if (open?.trigger === trigger) {
      clearTimer();
    } else if (open !== undefined) {
      show(trigger, "pointer");
    } else if (pending !== trigger) {
      schedule(OPEN_DELAY, () => {
        show(trigger, "pointer");
      });
      pending = trigger;
    }
  }

  function onPointerOut(event: Event): void {
    if (!("relatedTarget" in event) || event.relatedTarget !== null) {
      return;
    }
    // The pointer left the window.
    dismissed = undefined;
    if (open?.via === "focus") {
      clearTimer();
    } else {
      close();
    }
  }

  function onFocusIn(event: Event): void {
    const element = asElement(event.target);
    if (element === undefined || card?.root.contains(element) === true) {
      return;
    }
    dismissed = undefined;
    const trigger = triggerAt(element) ?? triggerIn(element);
    if (trigger !== undefined) {
      show(trigger, "focus", element);
    } else if (open?.via === "focus") {
      close();
    }
  }

  function onFocusOut(event: Event): void {
    if (open?.via !== "focus") {
      return;
    }
    const next = "relatedTarget" in event ? event.relatedTarget : null;
    const element = next instanceof Element ? next : undefined;
    if (element === undefined || card?.root.contains(element) !== true) {
      close();
    }
  }

  function onKeyDown(event: Event): void {
    if (!("key" in event) || event.key !== ESCAPE) {
      return;
    }
    if (open !== undefined) {
      dismissed = open.trigger;
    }
    close();
  }

  function onScroll(event: Event): void {
    if (open === undefined && pending === undefined) {
      return;
    }
    const element = asElement(event.target);
    if (card !== undefined && element !== undefined && card.root.contains(element)) {
      return;
    }
    // Focus scrolls its target into view, so a focus-opened card follows it instead of closing.
    if (open?.via === "focus") {
      follow();
    } else {
      close();
    }
  }

  const listeners = [
    ["pointerover", onPointerOver],
    ["pointerout", onPointerOut],
    ["focusin", onFocusIn],
    ["focusout", onFocusOut],
    ["keydown", onKeyDown],
    ["scroll", onScroll],
  ] as const;
  const capture = { capture: true, passive: true } as const;
  for (const [type, listener] of listeners) {
    doc.addEventListener(type, listener, capture);
  }
  view?.addEventListener("pagehide", close);

  return {
    bind(trigger, entries, ownPage = false) {
      bindings.set(trigger, { entries, ownPage });
    },
    stop() {
      close();
      for (const [type, listener] of listeners) {
        doc.removeEventListener(type, listener, capture);
      }
      view?.removeEventListener("pagehide", close);
      card?.root.remove();
      card = undefined;
      filled = undefined;
      quotes = [];
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { clearRoot } from "../../../tests/helpers/dom";
import { toHexColor } from "../kinds/color";
import { KIND_IDS } from "../kinds/id";
import { DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS, type KindSettings } from "../kinds/kind-settings";
import { perKind } from "../kinds/registry";
import {
  applyKindSettings,
  colorProperty,
  filterAttribute,
  KIND_ATTRIBUTE,
  setColorOnce,
} from "./kind-attributes";

const root = () => document.documentElement;

/** The same settings for every kind, over the defaults. */
function settings(patch: Partial<KindSettings> = {}) {
  return perKind((kind) => ({ ...kind.defaults, enabled: true, ...patch }));
}

/** The defaults, except for the DRM kind. */
function withDrm(patch: Partial<KindSettings>) {
  return { ...settings(), drm: { ...DEFAULT_KIND_SETTINGS, ...patch } };
}

afterEach(() => {
  clearRoot();
});

describe("attribute names", () => {
  it("name the kind after a fixed prefix", () => {
    expect(filterAttribute("drm")).toBe("data-sar-filter-drm");
    expect(filterAttribute("pvp")).toBe("data-sar-filter-pvp");
    expect(KIND_ATTRIBUTE).toBe("data-sar-kind");
  });

  it("name the root custom property of a kind's color after a fixed prefix", () => {
    expect(colorProperty("drm")).toBe("--sar-kind-color-drm");
    expect(colorProperty("anticheat")).toBe("--sar-kind-color-anticheat");
  });
});

const colorOf = (id: "ai" | "drm") => root().style.getPropertyValue(colorProperty(id));

describe("the custom colors", () => {
  it("writes no property while no kind has a color", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings());
    for (const id of KIND_IDS) {
      expect(root().style.getPropertyValue(colorProperty(id))).toBe("");
    }
    expect(root().getAttribute("style")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("writes the color of one kind as #rrggbb and touches no other kind", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), withDrm({ color: toHexColor("F0A") }));
    expect(colorOf("drm")).toBe("#ff00aa");
    expect(colorOf("ai")).toBe("");
  });

  it("removes the property when the color is cleared", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), withDrm({ color: toHexColor("#123456") }));
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings());
    expect(colorOf("drm")).toBe("");
    expect(root().hasAttribute("style")).toBe(false);
  });

  it("changes the color in place, and writes nothing when nothing changed", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), withDrm({ color: toHexColor("#111111") }));
    const setProperty = vi.spyOn(root().style, "setProperty");
    const removeProperty = vi.spyOn(root().style, "removeProperty");
    applyKindSettings(root(), withDrm({ color: toHexColor("#111111") }));
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings());
    expect(setProperty).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(removeProperty).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    applyKindSettings(root(), withDrm({ color: toHexColor("#222222") }));
    expect(colorOf("drm")).toBe("#222222");
  });

  it("keeps the color of a disabled kind, which draws nothing anyway", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), withDrm({ enabled: false, color: toHexColor("#333333") }));
    expect(colorOf("drm")).toBe("#333333");
  });

  it("writes nothing for a color already there, on any element", () => {
    const element = document.createElement("div");
    setColorOnce(element, "ai", toHexColor("#444444"));
    const setProperty = vi.spyOn(element.style, "setProperty");
    setColorOnce(element, "ai", toHexColor("#444444"));
    expect(setProperty).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    setColorOnce(element, "ai", undefined);
    expect(element.style.getPropertyValue(colorProperty("ai"))).toBe("");
  });
});

describe("applyKindSettings", () => {
  it("writes a filter for every kind", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings({ filter: "dim" }));
    for (const id of KIND_IDS) {
      expect(root().getAttribute(filterAttribute(id))).toBe("dim");
    }
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings());
    for (const id of KIND_IDS) {
      expect(root().getAttribute(filterAttribute(id))).toBe("off");
    }
  });

  it("keeps each kind apart", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), withDrm({ filter: "hide" }));
    expect(root().getAttribute(filterAttribute("drm"))).toBe("hide");
    expect(root().getAttribute(filterAttribute("ai"))).toBe("off");
  });

  it("filters nothing for a disabled kind", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings({ enabled: false, filter: "hide" }));
    for (const id of KIND_IDS) {
      expect(root().getAttribute(filterAttribute(id))).toBe("off");
    }
  });

  it("writes no attribute for the badges, which the chips follow through their own draw", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings({ badge: false }));
    expect(root().getAttributeNames().filter((name) => name.includes("badges"))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("writes nothing when nothing changed", () => {
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings({ filter: "dim" }));
    const setAttribute = vi.spyOn(root(), "setAttribute");
    applyKindSettings(root(), settings({ filter: "dim" }));
    expect(setAttribute).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

`src/core/ui/kind-attributes.ts`:

```ts
import type { HexColor } from "../kinds/color";
import type { KindId } from "../kinds/id";
import { effectiveSettings, type KindSettings } from "../kinds/kind-settings";
import { KINDS } from "../kinds/registry";

/** On a chip: the id of the kind it shows. */
export const KIND_ATTRIBUTE = "data-sar-kind";

/** The root attribute that holds a kind's list filter: `off`, `dim` or `hide`. */
export function filterAttribute(id: KindId): string {
  return `data-sar-filter-${id}`;
}

/**
 * The root custom property that holds a kind's custom color. Unset, the rules fall back to the
 * default violet tokens.
 */
export function colorProperty(id: KindId): string {
  return `--sar-kind-color-${id}`;
}

/** Sets the attribute unless it holds the value already, so a repeated draw mutates nothing. */
export function setAttributeOnce(element: Element, name: string, value: string): void {
  if (element.getAttribute(name) !== value) {
    element.setAttribute(name, value);
  }
}

/**
 * Sets a custom property on the root element, or removes it for `undefined`, and writes nothing
 * when it holds the value already. Only a validated `HexColor` is ever passed in.
 */
export function setColorOnce(
  root: HTMLElement,
  id: KindId,
  color: HexColor | undefined,
): void {
  const name = colorProperty(id);
  if (color === undefined) {
    if (root.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== "") {
      root.style.removeProperty(name);
      if (root.getAttribute("style") === "") {
        root.removeAttribute("style");
      }
    }
  } else if (root.style.getPropertyValue(name) !== color) {
    root.style.setProperty(name, color);
  }
}

/**
 * Writes every kind's list filter and custom color on the root element. The filter comes from the
 * settings that take effect (a disabled kind filters nothing). The style rules match the
 * attributes and read the custom properties, so a setting change is one write per kind and
 * touches no host and no chip.
 */
export function applyKindSettings(
  root: HTMLElement,
  kinds: Readonly<Record<KindId, KindSettings>>,
): void {
  for (const kind of KINDS) {
    const shown = effectiveSettings(kinds[kind.id]);
    setAttributeOnce(root, filterAttribute(kind.id), shown.filter);
    setColorOnce(root, kind.id, kinds[kind.id].color);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

    expect(kindDetails(unnamed)).toEqual([]);

    ]);

    expect(kindDetails(unlimited)).toEqual([{ kind: "text", text: "Denuvo Anti-tamper" }]);
  });

    expect(kindDetails(account)).toEqual([
      { kind: "text", text: "Ubisoft Account" },
      { kind: "message", key: "kind_account_links" },
    ]);

      { kind: "text", text: "Ubisoft Account" },
    ]);

      { kind: "text", text: "Game EULA" },
      { kind: "text", text: "Publisher terms" },
    ]);
  });

      { kind: "message", key: "kind_pvp_category_split" },
      { kind: "message", key: "kind_pvp_category_pvp" },
    ]);
```

`src/core/ui/kind-details.ts`:

```ts
import type { BareMessageKey } from "../i18n/t";
import { pvpCategoryMessage } from "../kinds/pvp";
import type { AnyDisclosed } from "../kinds/verdicts";

/** One line of a kind's entry in the hover card or the banner, below its heading. */
export type KindDetail =
  /** Catalog copy: Steam's own words. */
  | { readonly kind: "message"; readonly key: BareMessageKey; }
  /** The developer's short text, set verbatim. */
  | { readonly kind: "text"; readonly text: string; }
  /** The developer's long text, set verbatim and clamped. */
  | { readonly kind: "quote"; readonly text: string; }
  /** A catalog label followed by the developer's text. */
  | { readonly kind: "labeled"; readonly key: BareMessageKey; readonly text: string; };

const message = (key: BareMessageKey): KindDetail => ({ kind: "message", key });
const text = (value: string): KindDetail => ({ kind: "text", text: value });
const quote = (value: string): KindDetail => ({ kind: "quote", text: value });
const labeled = (key: BareMessageKey, value: string): KindDetail => ({
  kind: "labeled",
  key,
  text: value,
});

function present(value: string | undefined): value is string {
  return value !== undefined && value !== "";
}

/** A line for the name when there is one. */
function named(name: string | undefined): readonly KindDetail[] {
  return present(name) ? [text(name)] : [];
}

/** The lines a surface shows under a disclosed kind's heading. A new kind adds a case here. */
export function kindDetails(verdict: AnyDisclosed): readonly KindDetail[] {
  switch (verdict.kind) {
    case "ai":
      return [
        quote(verdict.notes),
        ...(present(verdict.service) ? [labeled("badge_card_service_label", verdict.service)] : []),
      ];
    case "kernel":
      return [
        ...named(verdict.name),
        ...(verdict.uninstallsCompletely ? [] : [message("kind_kernel_uninstall")]),
        ...(verdict.bootProtection === undefined ? [] : [message("kind_kernel_boot")]),
      ];
    case "anticheat":
      return named(verdict.name);
    case "drm":
      return [text(verdict.text), ...named(verdict.activationLimit)];
    case "account":
      return [text(verdict.text), ...(verdict.linksToSteam ? [message("kind_account_links")] : [])];
    case "eula":
      return verdict.items.map((item) => text(item.name));
    case "pvp":
      return verdict.categoryIds.flatMap((id) => {
        const key = pvpCategoryMessage(id);
        return key === undefined ? [] : [message(key)];
      });
  }
}
```
