```ts
let mounts = 0;

/** A BCP 47 tag for a catalog locale code (`pt_BR` to `pt-BR`). */
function languageTag(locale: string): string {
  return locale.replaceAll("_", "-");
}

/** The locale's name in its own language, or the code when `Intl` does not know it. */
function autonym(locale: string): string {
  const tag = languageTag(locale);
  try {
    return new Intl.DisplayNames([tag], { type: "language" }).of(tag) ?? locale;
  } catch {
    return locale;
  }
}

function dateFormat(locale: string): Intl.DateTimeFormat {
  const tag = languageTag(locale);
  const supported = Intl.DateTimeFormat.supportedLocalesOf(tag).length > 0 ? tag : undefined;
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(supported, { dateStyle: "medium" });
}

/** The patch that sets some fields of one kind. */
function forKind(id: KindId, settings: Partial<KindSettings>): SettingsPatch {
  return { kinds: { [id]: settings } };
}

function errorKey(field: Field, kind?: KindId): string {
  return kind === undefined ? field : `${kind}:${field}`;
}

/**
 * Mounts the settings and the ignored games into `root`: the options page, the popup or the
 * userscript dialog. Each change is a patch of the stored settings, applied at once. One
 * delegated listener per event type on the root serves every control (rule 13).
 */
export async function mountSettingsForm(
  root: HTMLElement,
  deps: SettingsFormDeps,
): Promise<SettingsForm> {
  const { i18n, settings, allowList, context } = deps;
  const doc = root.ownerDocument;
  mounts += 1;
  const prefix = `sar-${String(mounts)}-`;
  const dates = dateFormat(i18n.locale);

  const scope = root.getRootNode();
  if (scope === doc) {
    adoptStyles(doc, TOKENS_CSS);
    adoptStyles(doc, SETTINGS_CSS);
  } else if (scope instanceof ShadowRoot) {
    adoptStyles(scope, SETTINGS_CSS);
  }

  function element<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(
    tag: K,
    className: string,
    text?: string,
  ): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K] {
    const node = doc.createElement(tag);
    if (className !== "") {
      node.className = className;
    }
    if (text !== undefined) {
      node.textContent = text;
    }
    return node;
  }

  function fieldError(): HTMLElement {
    const error = element("p", "sar-field-error", i18n.t("error_settings_save"));
    error.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    error.hidden = true;
    return error;
  }

  /** The title of a card; focus lands on it after a restore, so it takes focus but is no stop. */
  function cardTitle(title: string, id: string): HTMLElement {
    const heading = element("h2", "sar-card-title", title);
    heading.id = prefix + id;
    heading.tabIndex = -1;
    return heading;
  }

  function card(title: string, id: string): HTMLElement {
    const section = element("section", "sar-card");
    const heading = cardTitle(title, id);
    section.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", heading.id);
    section.append(heading);
    return section;
  }

  const sections = new Map<SectionId, HTMLDetailsElement>();
  /** The state each section is known to be in, so a toggle that changes nothing writes nothing. */
  const shown = new Map<SectionId, boolean>();

  /**
   * A card the user can close: a native `details` whose `summary` holds the title and the cue.
   * The browser gives it the disclosure role, the keyboard and the expanded state. The body goes
   * into the returned `details`; it starts open until the stored state says otherwise.
   */
  function collapsibleCard(
    title: string,
    id: SectionId,
    cue: HTMLElement,
  ): { readonly section: HTMLElement; readonly body: HTMLDetailsElement; } {
    const section = element("section", "sar-card");
    const heading = cardTitle(title, id);
    section.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", heading.id);
    const body = element("details", "sar-card-details");
    body.open = SECTION_DEFAULT_OPEN;
    body.setAttribute(SECTION_ATTRIBUTE, id);
    const summary = element("summary", "sar-card-summary");
    summary.append(heading, cue);
    body.append(summary);
    section.append(body);
    sections.set(id, body);
    shown.set(id, SECTION_DEFAULT_OPEN);
    return { section, body };
  }

  function header(info: SettingsHeader): HTMLElement {
    const node = element("header", "sar-options-header");
    if (info.iconUrl !== undefined) {
      const icon = element("img", "");
      icon.src = info.iconUrl;
      icon.alt = "";
      icon.width = ICON_SIZE;
      icon.height = ICON_SIZE;
      node.append(icon);
    }
    const text = element("div", "");
    text.append(
      element("h1", "sar-options-title", i18n.t("ext_name")),
      element("div", "sar-options-version", i18n.t("options_version", { version: info.version })),
    );
    node.append(text);
    return node;
  }

  const errors = new Map<string, HTMLElement>();
  const controls = new Map<KindId, KindControls>();

  function switchField(
    kind: KindId,
    field: SwitchField,
    label: BareMessageKey,
    help: string,
  ): { readonly row: HTMLElement; readonly input: HTMLInputElement; } {
    const row = element("label", "sar-field");
    const input = element("input", "sar-toggle");
    input.type = "checkbox";
    input.setAttribute("role", "switch");
    input.setAttribute("data-sar-setting", field);
    input.setAttribute("data-sar-for", kind);
    const error = fieldError();
    errors.set(errorKey(field, kind), error);
    row.append(
      element("span", "sar-field-label", i18n.t(label)),
      input,
      element("span", "sar-field-help", help),
      error,
    );
    return { row, input };
  }

  /** The list filter: a labelled fieldset of radios, with help that follows the choice. */
  function filterField(kind: TagKind): {
    readonly row: HTMLElement;
    readonly radios: ReadonlyMap<ListFilter, HTMLInputElement>;
    readonly help: HTMLElement;
  } {
    const row = element("div", "sar-field");
    row.setAttribute("data-sar-layout", "stacked");
    const label = element("span", "sar-field-label", i18n.t("options_filter_label"));
    label.id = `${prefix}${kind.id}-filter`;
    const segment = element("fieldset", "sar-segment");
    segment.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", label.id);
    const radios = new Map<ListFilter, HTMLInputElement>();
    for (const value of LIST_FILTERS) {
      const input = element("input", "");
      input.type = "radio";
      input.name = label.id;
      input.id = `${label.id}-${value}`;
      input.value = value;
      input.setAttribute("data-sar-setting", "filter");
      input.setAttribute("data-sar-for", kind.id);
      radios.set(value, input);
      const text = element("label", "", i18n.t(FILTER_LABELS[value]));
      text.htmlFor = input.id;
      segment.append(input, text);
    }
    const help = element("span", "sar-field-help");
    const error = fieldError();
    errors.set(errorKey("filter", kind.id), error);
    row.append(label, segment, help, error);
    return { row, radios, help };
  }

  /**
   * A tag's color field: a swatch, a text box for the hex code, and Reset. The swatch and the
   * words are redundant on purpose, so the color is never the only cue. The row carries the kind,
   * so the swatch reads the kind's color through the same style rules as the badges.
   */
  function colorField(kind: TagKind): {
    readonly row: HTMLElement;
    readonly controls: ColorControls;
  } {
    const row = element("div", "sar-field sar-color");
    row.setAttribute("data-sar-layout", "stacked");
    row.setAttribute(KIND_ATTRIBUTE, kind.id);
    const label = element("label", "sar-field-label", i18n.t("options_color_label"));
    const input = element("input", "sar-input");
    input.type = "text";
    input.id = `${prefix}${kind.id}-color`;
    input.autocomplete = "off";
    input.spellcheck = false;
    input.placeholder = i18n.t("options_color_placeholder");
    input.setAttribute("data-sar-setting", "color");
    input.setAttribute("data-sar-for", kind.id);
    label.htmlFor = input.id;
    const swatch = element("span", "sar-color-swatch");
    swatch.setAttribute("aria-hidden", String(true));
    const reset = element("button", "sar-button", i18n.t("options_color_reset"));
    reset.type = "button";
    reset.setAttribute(COLOR_RESET_ATTRIBUTE, kind.id);
    reset.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      i18n.t("options_color_reset_label", { heading: i18n.t(kind.messages.heading) }),
    );
    const entry = element("div", "sar-color-entry");
    entry.append(swatch, input, reset);
    const help = element("span", "sar-field-help", i18n.t("options_color_help"));
    help.id = `${input.id}-help`;
    const invalid = element("p", "sar-field-error", i18n.t("options_color_invalid"));
    invalid.id = `${input.id}-invalid`;
    invalid.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    invalid.hidden = true;
    input.setAttribute("aria-describedby", [help.id, invalid.id].join(" "));
    const error = fieldError();
    errors.set(errorKey("color", kind.id), error);
    row.append(label, entry, help, invalid, error);
    return { row, controls: { input, reset, invalid } };
  }

  /** One tag's section, titled with Steam's line for it: the master switch, then the rest. */
  function kindCard(kind: TagKind): HTMLElement {
    const state = element("span", "sar-card-state");
    const { section, body } = collapsibleCard(i18n.t(kind.messages.heading), kind.id, state);
    const enabled = switchField(
      kind.id,
      "enabled",
      "options_kind_enabled",
      i18n.t("options_kind_enabled_help"),
    );
    const badge = switchField(
      kind.id,
      "badge",
      context === "popup" ? "options_badges_short" : "options_badges",
      i18n.t("options_badges_help", { label: i18n.t(kind.messages.chip) }),
    );
    const banner = switchField(
      kind.id,
      "banner",
      "options_banner",
      i18n.t("options_banner_help"),
    );
    const filter = filterField(kind);
    const color = deps.colors ? colorField(kind) : undefined;
    const options = element("div", "sar-kind-options");
    options.append(badge.row, banner.row);
    if (color !== undefined) {
      options.append(color.row);
    }
    options.append(filter.row);
    body.append(enabled.row, options);
    controls.set(kind.id, {
      options,
      state,
      switches: { enabled: enabled.input, badge: badge.input, banner: banner.input },
      radios: filter.radios,
      filterHelp: filter.help,
      color: color?.controls,
    });
    return section;
  }

  const loadError = element("p", "sar-field-error", i18n.t("error_settings_load"));
  loadError.setAttribute("role", "alert");
  loadError.hidden = true;
  const kindCards = KINDS.map(kindCard);

  // Above the cards, so a closed section cannot hide it
  const cards: HTMLElement[] = deps.header === undefined
    ? [loadError, ...kindCards]
    : [header(deps.header), loadError, ...kindCards];

  // Language (page only)
  let picker: HTMLSelectElement | undefined;
  if (context === "page") {
    const language = card(i18n.t("options_section_language"), "language");
    const field = element("div", "sar-field");
    field.setAttribute("data-sar-layout", "stacked");
    const label = element("label", "sar-field-label", i18n.t("options_language_label"));
    picker = element("select", "sar-select");
    picker.id = `${prefix}locale`;
    picker.setAttribute("data-sar-setting", "locale");
    label.htmlFor = picker.id;
    const auto = element("option", "", i18n.t("options_language_auto"));
    auto.value = AUTO_LOCALE;
    picker.append(auto);
    for (const locale of deps.locales) {
      const option = element("option", "", autonym(locale));
      option.value = locale;
      option.lang = languageTag(locale);
      picker.append(option);
    }
    const error = fieldError();
    errors.set(errorKey("locale"), error);
    field.append(
      label,
      picker,
      element("span", "sar-field-help", i18n.t("options_language_help")),
      error,
    );
    language.append(field);
    cards.push(language);
  }

  // Games you ignored
  const allow = card(i18n.t("options_section_allow"), "allow");
  const allowBody = element("div", "");
  allow.append(allowBody);
  cards.push(allow);

  // Privacy (page only) and footer
  if (context === "page") {
    const privacy = card(i18n.t("options_section_privacy"), "privacy");
    const bullets = element("ul", "sar-privacy");
    const keys: readonly BareMessageKey[] = [
      "options_privacy_no_reports",
      "options_privacy_storage",
      "options_privacy_lookup",
      "options_privacy_nothing_sent",
    ];
    bullets.append(...keys.map((key) => element("li", "", i18n.t(key))));
    privacy.append(bullets);
    cards.push(privacy);
  }
  const footer = element("div", "sar-options-footer");
  if (context === "popup") {
    footer.append(element("p", "", i18n.t("options_privacy_no_reports")));
  }
  footer.append(
    element(
      "p",
      "",
      i18n.t(context === "popup" ? "options_unaffiliated_short" : "options_unaffiliated"),
    ),
  );
  if (deps.allSettingsUrl !== undefined) {
    const link = element("a", "", i18n.t("options_all_settings"));
    link.href = deps.allSettingsUrl;
    link.target = NEW_TAB;
    link.rel = NO_OPENER;
    const line = element("p", "");
    line.append(link);
    footer.append(line);
  }

  const live = element("div", "sar-vh");
  live.setAttribute("aria-live", POLITE);

  root.classList.add("sar-options");
  root.setAttribute("data-sar-context", context);
  root.replaceChildren(...cards, footer, live);

  /** Controls stay off while the load error shows, so no save puts defaults over v1 data. */
  const settingControls = root.querySelectorAll<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>(
    "[data-sar-setting]",
  );
  function allowChanges(allowed: boolean): void {
    for (const control of settingControls) {
      control.disabled = !allowed;
    }
  }

  /** The stored section states; a store that cannot be read leaves every section open. */
  async function readSections(): Promise<SectionStates> {
    try {
      return await deps.sectionState.read();
    } catch {
      return new Map();
    }
  }
  const storedSections = readSections();

  let current: Settings = DEFAULT_SETTINGS;
  let loadFailed = false;
  try {
    current = parseSettings(await settings.read());
  } catch {
    loadFailed = true;
    loadError.hidden = false;
    allowChanges(false);
  }

  /** Text the person is still fixing stays as typed; everything else shows what is stored. */
  function syncColor(id: KindId, own: ColorControls, color: HexColor | undefined): void {
    setColorOnce(root, id, color);
    own.reset.hidden = color === undefined;
    if (own.input.getAttribute("aria-invalid") !== "true") {
      own.input.value = color ?? "";
    }
  }

  function sync(): void {
    for (const [id, own] of controls) {
      const kind = current.kinds[id];
      own.switches.enabled.checked = kind.enabled;
      own.switches.badge.checked = kind.badge;
      own.switches.banner.checked = kind.banner;
      for (const [value, input] of own.radios) {
        input.checked = value === kind.filter;
      }
      own.filterHelp.textContent = i18n.t(FILTER_HELP[kind.filter]);
      if (own.color !== undefined) {
        syncColor(id, own.color, kind.color);
      }
      own.options.hidden = !kind.enabled;
      own.state.textContent = i18n.t(kind.enabled ? "options_state_on" : "options_state_off");
      own.state.toggleAttribute("data-sar-on", kind.enabled);
    }
    if (picker !== undefined) {
      picker.value = current.locale;
    }
  }

  /** The patch for a control's value; an invalid value becomes the default. */
  function patchFor(
    field: Exclude<Field, "color">,
    kind: TagKind | undefined,
    control: HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement,
  ): SettingsPatch | undefined {
    const checked = control instanceof HTMLInputElement && control.checked;
    if (field === "locale") {
      return { locale: v.parse(v.fallback(LocaleSchema, DEFAULT_SETTINGS.locale), control.value) };
    }
    if (kind === undefined) {
      return undefined;
    }
    switch (field) {
      case "enabled":
        return forKind(kind.id, { enabled: checked });
      case "badge":
        return forKind(kind.id, { badge: checked });
      case "banner":
        return forKind(kind.id, { banner: checked });
      case "filter":
        return forKind(kind.id, {
          filter: v.parse(
            v.fallback(v.picklist(LIST_FILTERS), kind.defaults.filter),
            control.value,
          ),
        });
    }
  }

  /** Marks the color text as a color or not, with the words that say so. */
  function showColorValidity(own: ColorControls, valid: boolean): void {
    own.invalid.hidden = valid;
    own.input.setAttribute("aria-invalid", String(!valid));
  }

  /**
   * Live while typing: the error shows at once, and a color that reads shows on the swatch and
   * the badge at once (the root's custom property), unsaved. Saving waits for `change`.
   */
  function onColorInput(kind: TagKind, own: ColorControls): void {
    const typed = readTypedColor(own.input.value);
    showColorValidity(own, typed.valid);
    if (typed.valid) {
      setColorOnce(root, kind.id, typed.color);
    }
  }

  /** The text is committed (Enter or leaving the field): a valid color is saved, normalized. */
  function onColorChange(kind: TagKind, own: ColorControls): void {
    const typed = readTypedColor(own.input.value);
    showColorValidity(own, typed.valid);
    if (typed.valid) {
      void save(forKind(kind.id, { color: typed.color }), errorKey("color", kind.id));
    }
  }

  async function save(patch: SettingsPatch, key: string): Promise<void> {
    const error = errors.get(key);
    try {
      current = await settings.patch(patch);
    } catch {
      sync();
      if (error !== undefined) {
        error.hidden = false;
      }
      return;
    }
    sync();
    if (error !== undefined) {
      error.hidden = true;
    }
    announce(doc, live, i18n.t("notice_settings_saved"));
  }

  function onChange(target: EventTarget | null): void {
    if (!(target instanceof HTMLInputElement || target instanceof HTMLSelectElement)) {
      return;
    }
    const field = v.safeParse(FieldSchema, target.getAttribute("data-sar-setting"));
    if (!field.success) {
      return;
    }
    if (loadFailed) {
      sync();
      return;
    }
    const id = v.safeParse(KindIdSchema, target.getAttribute("data-sar-for"));
    const kind = id.success ? KIND_BY_ID[id.output] : undefined;
    if (field.output === "color") {
      const own = kind === undefined ? undefined : controls.get(kind.id)?.color;
      if (kind !== undefined && own !== undefined) {
        onColorChange(kind, own);
      }
      return;
    }
    const patch = patchFor(field.output, kind, target);
    if (patch !== undefined) {
      void save(patch, errorKey(field.output, kind?.id));
    }
  }

  /** The name of a scope: Steam's line for a tag, or all tags. */
  function scopeName(of: AllowScope): string {
    return of === ALLOW_ALL
      ? i18n.t("options_allow_scope_all")
      : i18n.t(KIND_BY_ID[of].messages.heading);
  }

  function allowItem(of: AllowScope, id: AppId, entry: AllowEntry): HTMLElement {
    const item = element("li", "sar-allow-item");
    const text = element("div", "");
    const name = element("a", "sar-allow-name", entry.name);
    name.href = `${STORE_APP_URL}${String(id)}/`;
    const since = dates.format(new Date(entry.added));
    text.append(
      name,
      element("span", "sar-allow-meta", i18n.t("options_allow_since", { date: since })),
    );
    const restore = element("button", "sar-button", i18n.t("options_allow_restore"));
    restore.type = "button";
    restore.setAttribute("data-sar-restore", String(id));
    restore.setAttribute("data-sar-scope", of);
    restore.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      i18n.t("options_allow_restore_label", { name: entry.name, scope: scopeName(of) }),
    );
    const error = element("p", "sar-field-error", i18n.t("error_allow_list_save"));
    error.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    error.hidden = true;
    item.append(text, restore, error);
    return item;
  }

  /** One scope's games, newest first, under the scope's name. */
  function allowGroup(of: AllowScope, entries: ReadonlyMap<AppId, AllowEntry>): HTMLElement {
    const group = element("div", "sar-allow-group");
    const title = element("h3", "sar-allow-scope", scopeName(of));
    title.id = `${prefix}allow-${of}`;
    group.setAttribute("role", "group");
    group.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", title.id);
    const list = element("ul", "sar-allow-list");
    const newestFirst = [...entries].sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.added - a.added);
    list.append(...newestFirst.map(([id, entry]) => allowItem(of, id, entry)));
    group.append(title, list);
    return group;
  }

  function renderAllowList(entries: AllowEntries): void {
    const listed = ALLOW_SCOPES.filter((each) => entries[each].size > 0);
    // The popup has no room for an empty section; the full page keeps its empty state.
    allow.hidden = context === "popup" && listed.length === 0;
    if (listed.length === 0) {
      allowBody.replaceChildren(
        element(
          "p",
          "sar-empty",
          i18n.t("options_allow_empty", { action: i18n.t("banner_ignore") }),
        ),
      );
      return;
    }
    allowBody.replaceChildren(...listed.map((each) => allowGroup(each, entries[each])));
  }

  /** A list that cannot be read says so, in both contexts; the next refresh tries again. */
  function renderAllowError(): void {
    allow.hidden = false;
    const error = element("p", "sar-field-error", i18n.t("error_allow_list_load"));
    error.setAttribute("role", "alert");
    allowBody.replaceChildren(error);
  }

  async function refreshAllowList(): Promise<void> {
    let entries: AllowEntries;
    try {
      entries = await allowList.list();
    } catch {
      renderAllowError();
      return;
    }
    renderAllowList(entries);
  }

  /** The button that stops ignoring a game in a scope, once the list is drawn again. */
  function restoreButton(of: string | null, id: string | null): HTMLElement | undefined {
    return [...allowBody.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-sar-restore]")].find((button) =>
      button.getAttribute("data-sar-scope") === of && button.getAttribute("data-sar-restore") === id
    );
  }

  async function restore(button: HTMLElement, of: AllowScope, id: AppId): Promise<void> {
    const buttons = [...allowBody.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("[data-sar-restore]")];
    const at = buttons.indexOf(button);
    const neighbor = buttons[at + 1] ?? buttons[at - 1];
    const nextScope = neighbor?.getAttribute("data-sar-scope") ?? null;
    const nextId = neighbor?.getAttribute("data-sar-restore") ?? null;
    try {
      await allowList.remove(of, id);
    } catch {
      const error = button.closest(".sar-allow-item")?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
        ".sar-field-error",
      );
      if (error !== null && error !== undefined) {
        error.hidden = false;
      }
      return;
    }
    await refreshAllowList();
    // With the last game gone, the popup hides the section, so focus lands on the one above it
    const section = allow.hidden === true ? kindCards.at(-1) : allow;
    const focus = restoreButton(nextScope, nextId)
      ?? section?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(".sar-card-title");
    focus?.focus();
    announce(
      doc,
      live,
      of === ALLOW_ALL
        ? i18n.t("notice_marking_restored")
        : i18n.t("notice_marking_restored_kind", { heading: scopeName(of) }),
    );
  }

  function onInput(target: EventTarget | null): void {
    if (!(target instanceof HTMLInputElement) || loadFailed) {
      return;
    }
    const id = v.safeParse(KindIdSchema, target.getAttribute("data-sar-for"));
    const field = v.safeParse(FieldSchema, target.getAttribute("data-sar-setting"));
    const own = id.success ? controls.get(id.output)?.color : undefined;
    if (id.success && field.success && field.output === "color" && own !== undefined) {
      onColorInput(KIND_BY_ID[id.output], own);
    }
  }

  /** The Reset button of a color field: clears the color, whatever the text says. */
  function resetColor(button: HTMLElement): void {
    const id = v.safeParse(KindIdSchema, button.getAttribute(COLOR_RESET_ATTRIBUTE));
    const own = id.success ? controls.get(id.output)?.color : undefined;
    if (!id.success || own === undefined || loadFailed) {
      return;
    }
    showColorValidity(own, true);
    void save(forKind(id.output, { color: undefined }), errorKey("color", id.output)).then(() => {
      own.input.focus();
    });
  }

  function onClick(target: EventTarget | null): void {
    const reset = target instanceof Element
      ? target.closest<HTMLElement>(`[${COLOR_RESET_ATTRIBUTE}]`)
      : null;
    if (reset !== null) {
      resetColor(reset);
      return;
    }
    const button = target instanceof Element
      ? target.closest<HTMLElement>("[data-sar-restore]")
      : null;
    const id = button === null
      ? undefined
      : toAppId(Number(button.getAttribute("data-sar-restore")));
    const of = button === null ? undefined : toAllowScope(button.getAttribute("data-sar-scope"));
    if (button !== null && id !== undefined && of !== undefined) {
      void restore(button, of, id);
    }
  }

  /** Opens or closes the sections as stored. `shown` moves first, so the toggles it fires pass. */
  function applySections(states: SectionStates): void {
    for (const [id, details] of sections) {
      const open = isSectionOpen(states, id);
      shown.set(id, open);
      details.open = open;
    }
  }

  async function remember(id: SectionId, open: boolean): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await deps.sectionState.setOpen(id, open);
    } catch {
      // The section keeps the state on screen; only the memory of it is lost.
    }
  }

  function onToggle(target: EventTarget | null): void {
    if (!(target instanceof HTMLDetailsElement)) {
      return;
    }
    const id = v.safeParse(SectionIdSchema, target.getAttribute(SECTION_ATTRIBUTE));
    if (id.success && shown.get(id.output) !== target.open) {
      shown.set(id.output, target.open);
      void remember(id.output, target.open);
    }
  }

  function onEvent(event: Event): void {
    switch (event.type) {
      case "change":
        onChange(event.target);
        break;
      case "input":
        onInput(event.target);
        break;
      case "toggle":
        onToggle(event.target);
        break;
      default:
        onClick(event.target);
    }
  }

  sync();
  await refreshAllowList();
  applySections(await storedSections);
  root.addEventListener("change", onEvent);
  root.addEventListener("input", onEvent);
  root.addEventListener("click", onEvent);
  // A toggle does not bubble, so the one listener for it takes the capture phase
  root.addEventListener("toggle", onEvent, true);
  const unsubscribe = settings.subscribe((value) => {
    current = parseSettings(value);
    loadFailed = false;
    loadError.hidden = true;
    allowChanges(true);
    sync();
  });

  return {
    refreshAllowList,
    destroy() {
      unsubscribe();
      root.removeEventListener("change", onEvent);
      root.removeEventListener("input", onEvent);
      root.removeEventListener("click", onEvent);
      root.removeEventListener("toggle", onEvent, true);
      root.replaceChildren();
    },
  };
}

```

`src/core/ui/settings.css`:

```css
/*
 * Settings form rules: the options page, the toolbar popup and the userscript dialog. Lifted from
 * docs/design/reference.css (components.mdx sections 6 to 11). Tokens come from TOKENS_CSS on the
 * options page's root, or inherit from the store page's :root in the userscript dialog.
 */

@import "./shared.css";

.sar-options {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-inline-size: var(--sar-options-max-width);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-block: var(--sar-space-4);
  padding-inline: var(--sar-space-4);
  background: var(--sar-color-bg-panel);
```

```css
/* Visually hidden, still read: live regions */

  border: 0 !important;
}

/* A tag's custom color (experimental). Whatever carries data-sar-kind reads that kind's color
   from the root custom property the app writes, and derives every shade from it. With no color
   set, the property is empty and so is every shade, so each rule falls back to the violet tokens.
   The kinds are listed by hand because a custom property name cannot be built from an attribute;
   styles.test.ts fails for a kind missing here. */
[data-sar-kind="ai"] {
  --sar-kind-color: var(--sar-kind-color-ai);
}

[data-sar-kind="kernel"] {
  --sar-kind-color: var(--sar-kind-color-kernel);
}

[data-sar-kind="anticheat"] {
  --sar-kind-color: var(--sar-kind-color-anticheat);
}

[data-sar-kind="drm"] {
  --sar-kind-color: var(--sar-kind-color-drm);
}

[data-sar-kind="account"] {
  --sar-kind-color: var(--sar-kind-color-account);
}

[data-sar-kind="eula"] {
  --sar-kind-color: var(--sar-kind-color-eula);
}

[data-sar-kind="pvp"] {
  --sar-kind-color: var(--sar-kind-color-pvp);
}

[data-sar-kind] {
  --sar-tag-edge: var(--sar-kind-color);
  --sar-tag-tint: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--sar-kind-color) var(--sar-kind-mix-tint),
    transparent
  );
  --sar-tag-text: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sar-kind-color) var(--sar-kind-mix-text), white);
  --sar-tag-light: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sar-kind-color) var(--sar-kind-mix-light), white);
  --sar-tag-solid: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sar-kind-color) var(--sar-kind-mix-solid), black);
  --sar-tag-wash-start: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--sar-kind-color) var(--sar-kind-mix-wash-start), black) var(
      --sar-kind-mix-wash-alpha
    ),
    transparent
  );
  --sar-tag-wash-end: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--sar-kind-color) var(--sar-kind-mix-wash-end), black) var(
      --sar-kind-mix-wash-alpha
    ),

  );
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { KIND_IDS } from "../kinds/id";
import { PLACEMENTS } from "../scan/placements";
import { colorProperty } from "./kind-attributes";
import { adoptStyles, BANNER_CSS, DIALOG_CSS, PAGE_CSS, SETTINGS_CSS, TOKENS_CSS } from "./styles";

const RULES = { PAGE_CSS, BANNER_CSS, SETTINGS_CSS, DIALOG_CSS };

/** The custom properties a text declares. */
function declared(css: string): ReadonlySet<string | undefined> {
  return new Set([...css.matchAll(/(--sar-[a-z0-9-]+)\s*:/g)].map((match) => match[1]));
}

const DEFINED = declared(TOKENS_CSS);
/** What the app writes on the root element, so no stylesheet declares it. */
const WRITTEN = new Set(KIND_IDS.map(colorProperty));

describe("generated stylesheets", () => {
  // A name is defined by tokens.css, by the app (a tag's color) or by the sheet itself (the shades
  // it derives from that color). A fallback counts as a use.
  it.each(Object.entries(RULES))("%s uses only tokens that tokens.css defines", (_name, css) => {
    const own = declared(css);
    const used = [...css.matchAll(/var\((--sar-[a-z0-9-]+)[,)]/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
    expect(used.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(
      used.filter((name) => !DEFINED.has(name) && !own.has(name) && !WRITTEN.has(name ?? "")),
    ).toEqual([]);
  });

  it.each(Object.entries({ TOKENS_CSS, ...RULES }))("%s carries no comments", (_name, css) => {
    expect(css).not.toContain("/*");
  });

  it.each(Object.entries(RULES))("%s carries no copy", (_name, css) => {
    const contents = [...css.matchAll(/(?<![\w-])content:\s*([^;]+);/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
    expect(contents.every((value) => value === '""')).toBe(true);
  });

  it("inlines the shared rules", () => {
    // The dialog sits beside SETTINGS_CSS in its shadow root, which already carries them
    for (const css of [PAGE_CSS, BANNER_CSS, SETTINGS_CSS]) {
      expect(css).toContain(".sar-vh {");
      expect(css).not.toContain("@import");
    }
  });
});

/** One CSS rule: its selectors, whitespace squeezed, and its declarations. */
interface Rule {
  readonly selectors: readonly string[];
  readonly body: string;
}

function rulesOf(css: string): readonly Rule[] {
  return [...css.matchAll(/([^{}]+)\{([^{}]*)\}/g)].map(([, head = "", body = ""]) => ({
    // A comma inside parentheses, as in :is(:hover, :focus-within), does not end a selector.
    selectors: head.split(/,(?![^()]*\))/).map((selector) => selector.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " "))
      .filter((selector) => selector !== ""),
    body,
  }));
}

/** The filter selectors of the rules that declare `declaration`, in the order written. */
function filterSelectors(declaration: string): readonly string[] {
  return rulesOf(PAGE_CSS)
    .filter((rule) => rule.body.includes(declaration))
    .flatMap((rule) => rule.selectors)
    .filter((selector) => selector.startsWith("[data-sar-filter-"));
}

describe("the per-kind page rules", () => {
  // The rules list every kind, because no selector can join an attribute on the root element with
  // one on a host. A kind missing from a group fails here instead of silently never matching.
  const dim = (id: string) => `[data-sar-filter-${id}="dim"] [data-sar-kinds~="${id}"]`;
  const hold = (id: string) =>
    `[data-sar-filter-${id}="hide"] [data-sar-kinds~="${id}"][data-sar-hideable="false"]`;
  const hide = (id: string) =>
    `[data-sar-filter-${id}="hide"] [data-sar-kinds~="${id}"]:not([data-sar-hideable="false"])`;
  const HOVER = ":is(:hover, :focus-within)";

  const GROUPS = [
    {
      name: "dims a host",
      declaration: "filter: opacity(var(--sar-dim-opacity)) !important",
      selectors: (id: string) => [dim(id), hold(id)],
    },
    {
      name: "restores a hovered or focused host",
      declaration: "filter: none !important",
      selectors: (id: string) => [`${dim(id)}${HOVER}`, `${hold(id)}${HOVER}`],
    },
    {
      name: "hides a host",
      declaration: "display: none !important",
      selectors: (id: string) => [hide(id)],
    },
  ];

  it.each(KIND_IDS)("%s appears exactly once in each filter rule group", (id) => {
    for (const group of GROUPS) {
      const declared = filterSelectors(group.declaration);
      for (const selector of group.selectors(id)) {
        expect(declared.filter((each) => each === selector), `${group.name}: ${selector}`)
          .toHaveLength(1);
      }
    }
  });

  it("lists no kind twice and no kind outside the registry in a group", () => {
    for (const group of GROUPS) {
      const declared = filterSelectors(group.declaration);
      expect(new Set(declared).size).toBe(declared.length);
      expect(declared, group.name).toHaveLength(KIND_IDS.length * group.selectors("x").length);
    }
  });

  it("matches no global state, filter or badge attribute", () => {
    expect(PAGE_CSS).not.toContain("data-sar-state");
    expect(PAGE_CSS).not.toContain("data-sar-badges");
    expect(PAGE_CSS).not.toMatch(/data-sar-filter=/);
  });
});

describe("the tag color rules", () => {
```

`src/core/ui/styles.ts`:

```ts
import { PAGE_CSS, TOKENS_CSS } from "./styles.gen";

export { BANNER_CSS, DIALOG_CSS, PAGE_CSS, SETTINGS_CSS, TOKENS_CSS } from "./styles.gen";

/** The store page stylesheet for `AppDeps.addPageStyles`, where the platform does not load it. */
export function adoptPageStyles(doc: Document): void {
  adoptStyles(doc, TOKENS_CSS + PAGE_CSS);
}

/** One constructed sheet per document and CSS text, shared by every root that adopts it. */
const sheets = new WeakMap<Document, Map<string, CSSStyleSheet>>();
/** The CSS texts each root already carries. */
const adopted = new WeakMap<Document | ShadowRoot, Set<string>>();

function constructed(doc: Document, css: string): CSSStyleSheet | undefined {
  const view = doc.defaultView;
  if (view === null) {
    return undefined;
  }
  let byText = sheets.get(doc);
  if (byText === undefined) {
    byText = new Map();
    sheets.set(doc, byText);
  }
  let sheet = byText.get(css);
  if (sheet === undefined) {
    sheet = new view.CSSStyleSheet();
    sheet.replaceSync(css);
    byText.set(css, sheet);
  }
  return sheet;
}

/**
 * Adds the CSS to a document or a shadow root, once. A platform injector, when set, takes the
 * document's CSS first. Otherwise constructed sheets come first: one parsed sheet serves every
 * root of the document. Where they are unavailable or refused (an old engine, a sandboxed content
 * script), a `style` element carries the same text.
 */
export function adoptStyles(root: Document | ShadowRoot, css: string): void {
  const done = adopted.get(root) ?? new Set();
  if (done.has(css)) {
    return;
  }
  done.add(css);
  adopted.set(root, done);
  const doc = "host" in root ? root.ownerDocument : root;
  try {
    const sheet = constructed(doc, css);
    if (sheet !== undefined) {
      root.adoptedStyleSheets = [...root.adoptedStyleSheets, sheet];
      return;
    }
  } catch {
    // Fall through to a style element.
  }
  const style = doc.createElement("style");
  style.className = "sar-styles";
  style.textContent = css;
  ("host" in root ? root : root.head).append(style);
}
```

```ts
  it("follows the store's user tags block", () => {
    setBody(WITH_TAGS);
    createTagSection(document, i18n).render([ai]);
    expect(document.getElementById("tags")?.nextElementSibling).toBe(sections()[0]);
    expect(document.getElementById("publisher")?.nextElementSibling?.id).toBe("tags");
  });

  it("falls back to the row after Publisher when the page has no user tags block", () => {
    setBody(WITHOUT_TAGS);
    createTagSection(document, i18n).render([ai]);
    expect(document.getElementById("publisher")?.nextElementSibling).toBe(sections()[0]);
  });

  it("prefers the user tags block when both anchors are there", () => {
    setBody(WITH_TAGS);
    createTagSection(document, i18n).render([ai]);
    expect(document.getElementById("publisher")?.nextElementSibling?.id).toBe("tags");
  });

  it("draws nothing on a page with neither anchor", () => {
    setBody('<div id="other"></div>');
    createTagSection(document, i18n).render(all);
    expect(sections()).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(document.body.innerHTML).toBe('<div id="other"></div>');
  });

  it("draws nothing, label included, for no verdicts, and removes what was there", () => {
    setBody(WITH_TAGS);
    const section = createTagSection(document, i18n);
    section.render([]);
    expect(sections()).toHaveLength(0);
    section.render([ai, drm]);
    expect(sections()).toHaveLength(1);
    section.render([]);
    expect(sections()).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(document.querySelector(".sar-tag-section-label")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("changes nothing for the same verdicts and never doubles the section", () => {
    setBody(WITH_TAGS);
    const section = createTagSection(document, i18n);
    section.render([ai, drm]);
    const first = sections()[0];
    const html = document.body.innerHTML;
    section.render([ai, drm]);
    expect(sections()[0]).toBe(first);
    expect(document.body.innerHTML).toBe(html);
  });

  it("draws again when the verdicts change, and when the store dropped the section", () => {
    setBody(WITH_TAGS);
    const section = createTagSection(document, i18n);
    section.render([ai]);
    section.render([ai, drm]);
    expect(kinds()).toEqual(["ai", "drm"]);
    section.render([drm]);
    expect(kinds()).toEqual(["drm"]);
    sections()[0]?.remove();
    section.render([drm]);
    expect(sections()).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(kinds()).toEqual(["drm"]);
  });

  it("moves the section to the user tags block when the block appears later", () => {
    setBody(WITHOUT_TAGS);
    const section = createTagSection(document, i18n);
    section.render([ai]);
    const first = sections()[0];
    document.getElementById("publisher")?.insertAdjacentHTML("afterend", USER_TAGS);
    section.render([ai]);
    expect(sections()[0]).toBe(first);
    expect(document.getElementById("tags")?.nextElementSibling).toBe(first);
    expect(sections()).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it("binds the hover card to each chip with its own verdict, as on the game's own page", () => {
    setBody(WITH_TAGS);
    const { bound, card } = bindings();
    createTagSection(document, i18n, card).render([ai, kernel]);
    expect(chips().map((chip) => bound.get(chip))).toEqual([[ai], [kernel]]);
    expect(chips().every((chip) => chip instanceof HTMLElement && chip.tabIndex === 0)).toBe(true);
  });

  it("leaves the chips unfocusable when there is no card to open", () => {
    setBody(WITH_TAGS);
    createTagSection(document, i18n).render([ai]);
    expect(chips().every((chip) => !chip.hasAttribute("tabindex"))).toBe(true);
  });

  it("sets no listener and no link on the chips", () => {
    setBody(WITH_TAGS);
    createTagSection(document, i18n).render(all);
    expect(sections()[0]?.querySelector("a, [href], [onclick]")).toBeNull();
  });
});

```

`src/core/ui/tag-section.ts`:

```ts
import { KIND_BY_ID } from "../kinds/registry";
import { type AnyDisclosed, sameVerdicts } from "../kinds/verdicts";
import type { MessageCatalog } from "../ports";
import { createChip, createChipGroup } from "./badge";
import type { CardTriggers } from "./hover-card";

/**
 * Where the section goes, best first: right after the store's "Popular user-defined tags" block,
 * else after the last Developer or Publisher row of the summary box. The first selector that
 * matches wins, and the last match of it is the anchor.
 */
const ANCHORS = [".popular_tags_ctn", ".glance_ctn_responsive_left .dev_row"] as const;

/** The label's id, which the section's group points to for its name. */
const LABEL_ID = "sar-tag-section-label";

/** The tag section of the game's own page. */
export interface TagSection {
  /**
   * Shows one chip for each verdict, in the order given, or removes the section when there is
   * none. Idempotent: the same verdicts change nothing, and a section the store dropped returns.
   */
  render(verdicts: readonly AnyDisclosed[]): void;
}

interface Drawn {
  readonly element: HTMLElement;
  readonly verdicts: readonly AnyDisclosed[];
}

function anchorOf(doc: Document): Element | undefined {
  for (const selector of ANCHORS) {
    const found = doc.querySelectorAll(selector);
    if (found.length > 0) {
      return found.item(found.length - 1);
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

/**
 * The Tag Kit section under the store's user-defined tags: a muted label and one chip for each
 * verdict, all of them, wrapping to more rows. Each chip opens the hover card for its own kind
 * and takes focus when a card is given. The chips carry no listener: the card's delegated ones
 * serve them. A page with neither anchor gets no section.
 */
export function createTagSection(
  doc: Document,
  i18n: MessageCatalog,
  card?: CardTriggers,
): TagSection {
  let drawn: Drawn | undefined;

  function build(verdicts: readonly AnyDisclosed[]): HTMLElement {
    const element = doc.createElement("div");
    element.className = "sar-tag-section";
    element.setAttribute("role", "group");
    element.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", LABEL_ID);
    const label = doc.createElement("div");
    label.className = "sar-tag-section-label";
    label.id = LABEL_ID;
    label.textContent = i18n.t("badge_tags_title");
    const group = createChipGroup(doc, "full");
    for (const verdict of verdicts) {
      const chip = createChip(doc, i18n, KIND_BY_ID[verdict.kind]);
      if (card !== undefined) {
        chip.tabIndex = 0;
        card.bind(chip, [verdict], true);
      }
      group.append(chip);
    }
    element.append(label, group);
    return element;
  }

  function remove(): void {
    drawn?.element.remove();
    drawn = undefined;
  }

  return {
    render(verdicts) {
      if (verdicts.length === 0) {
        remove();
        return;
      }
      if (
        drawn === undefined || !drawn.element.isConnected || !sameVerdicts(drawn.verdicts, verdicts)
      ) {
        remove();
        drawn = { element: build(verdicts), verdicts };
      }
      const anchor = anchorOf(doc);
      if (anchor === undefined) {
        remove();
      } else if (anchor.nextElementSibling !== drawn.element) {
        anchor.after(drawn.element);
      }
    },
  };
}
```

```ts
// Dev-only composition root for injection smoke tests on live store pages (plan, "Development
// and debugging loop", layer 2). An agent pastes `dist/dev/inject.js` into a store page through
// the browser's JavaScript tool. The core runs on an in-memory store, plain `fetch` and verbose
// logging; nothing persists past the page. Never packaged (`check_bundle.py`).
import { type App, start } from "../../core/app";
import { createFetchHttp } from "../../core/http";
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE } from "../../core/i18n/catalog";
import { SHIPPED_CATALOGS } from "../../core/i18n/shipped";
import { createI18n } from "../../core/i18n/t";
import { createLogger } from "../../core/log";

import { createSettingsSource } from "../../core/settings/settings-source";

  interface Window {
    /** The running dev app; a second injection stops it first. */
    sarDev?: App;
  }
}

  new Map([[SETTINGS_KEY, encodeSettings({ ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, debug: true })]]),
);

  document,

  console,
  browserLang: navigator.language,
  addPageStyles: adoptPageStyles,
}).then(
  (app) => {

  },
  (problem: unknown) => {
```

`src/platform/dev/memory-store.ts`:

```ts
import type { JsonValue } from "../../core/json";
import type { KeyValueStore } from "../../core/ports";

/**
 * An in-memory `KeyValueStore`: the dev bundle's storage and the tests'. Values are cloned in and
 * out, like the browser storages.
 */
export function memoryStore(initial: ReadonlyMap<string, JsonValue> = new Map()): KeyValueStore {
  const values = new Map<string, JsonValue>();
  for (const [key, value] of initial) {
    values.set(key, structuredClone(value));
  }
  return {
    get(keys) {
      const found = new Map<string, unknown>();
      for (const key of keys) {
        const value = values.get(key);
        if (value !== undefined) {
          found.set(key, structuredClone(value));
        }
      }
      return Promise.resolve(found);
    },
    set(entries) {
      for (const [key, value] of entries) {
        values.set(key, structuredClone(value));
      }
      return Promise.resolve();
    },
    remove(keys) {
      for (const key of keys) {
        values.delete(key);
      }
      return Promise.resolve();
    },
    keys() {
      return Promise.resolve([...values.keys()]);
    },
  };
}
```

`src/platform/extension/ext.ts`:

```ts
import type { JsonValue } from "../../core/json";
import type { Unsubscribe } from "../../core/ports";

// The one module that names the WebExtension APIs. Everything else in the extension takes the
// narrow interfaces below, so tests pass typed fakes and the rest of the code never sees `chrome`
// or `browser`.

/**
 * Firefox's promise-based `browser`, else Chrome's `chrome`. `@types/chrome` declares `browser` as
 * always present, so the shorter `browser ?? chrome` would read as an unnecessary condition.
 */
const api: typeof chrome = "browser" in globalThis ? globalThis.browser : globalThis.chrome;

/**
 * The part of `storage.local` the store adapter uses. Reads stay `unknown`: the type argument of
 * `get<T>()` is never passed, since it would be an unchecked assertion (rule 10).
 */
export interface StorageArea {
  /** The stored items of `keys`, or every item for `null`. */
  get(keys: string[] | null): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>>;
  set(items: Readonly<Record<string, JsonValue>>): Promise<void>;
  remove(keys: string[]): Promise<void>;
}

/** One key's change, as `storage.onChanged` reports it. */
export interface StorageChange {
  readonly newValue?: unknown;
}

/** The changes of one `storage.onChanged` event in the `local` area, by key. */
export type LocalChanges = Readonly<Record<string, StorageChange>>;

/** Subscribes to changes in `storage.local`, from any context of this extension. */
export type OnLocalChanged = (listener: (changes: LocalChanges) => void) => Unsubscribe;

const LOCAL_AREA = "local";

export const localStorageArea: StorageArea = {
  get: (keys) => api.storage.local.get(keys),
  set: (items) => api.storage.local.set(items),
  remove: (keys) => api.storage.local.remove(keys),
};

export const onLocalChanged: OnLocalChanged = (listener) => {
  const relay = (changes: Readonly<Record<string, StorageChange>>, area: string): void => {
    if (area === LOCAL_AREA) {
      listener(changes);
    }
  };
  api.storage.onChanged.addListener(relay);
  return () => {
    api.storage.onChanged.removeListener(relay);
  };
};

/** The manifest version, which the build takes from `package.json` (rule 7). */
export function extensionVersion(): string {
  return api.runtime.getManifest().version;
}

/** The absolute URL of a file packaged with the extension. */
export function extensionUrl(path: string): string {
  return api.runtime.getURL(path);
}

```

`src/platform/extension/options.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { resolveLocale } from "../../core/i18n/locale";
import { SHIPPED_CATALOGS } from "../../core/i18n/shipped";
import { type BareMessageKey, createI18n, type I18n } from "../../core/i18n/t";
import { createAllowList } from "../../core/settings/allow-list";
import { AUTO_LOCALE, parseSettings } from "../../core/settings/settings";
import { ALLOW_KEY } from "../../core/storage-keys";
import { createSectionState } from "../../core/ui/section-state";
import { mountSettingsForm, type SettingsContext } from "../../core/ui/settings-form";
import { extensionUrl, extensionVersion, localStorageArea, onLocalChanged } from "./ext";
import { createExtensionSettings, createExtensionStore } from "./store";

// The options page and the toolbar popup: one page, options.html, which the manifest opens as
// `options.html?context=popup` from the toolbar button. It mounts core's settings form into the
// body; options.html itself holds no copy, only `data-i18n` keys (rule 9).

const OPTIONS_PAGE = "options.html";
const CONTEXT_PARAM = "context";
const ICONS: Readonly<Record<SettingsContext, string>> = {
  page: "icons/icon-48.png",
  popup: "icons/icon-32.png",
};

/** The catalog keys options.html may name in `data-i18n`. */
const PAGE_KEYS = ["ext_name"] as const satisfies readonly BareMessageKey[];
const PageKeySchema = v.picklist(PAGE_KEYS);

const ContextSchema = v.picklist(["page", "popup"]);

function pageContext(): SettingsContext {
  const requested = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get(CONTEXT_PARAM);
  const parsed = v.safeParse(ContextSchema, requested);
  return parsed.success ? parsed.output : "page";
}

function fillText(doc: Document, i18n: I18n): void {
  doc.documentElement.lang = i18n.locale.replaceAll("_", "-");
  for (const node of doc.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]")) {
    const key = v.safeParse(PageKeySchema, node.getAttribute("data-i18n"));
    if (key.success) {
      node.textContent = i18n.t(key.output);
    }
  }
}

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const context = pageContext();
  const store = createExtensionStore(localStorageArea);
  const settings = createExtensionSettings(store, onLocalChanged);
  const allowList = createAllowList(store, { now: () => Date.now() });
  const catalogs = SHIPPED_CATALOGS;

  let setting: string = AUTO_LOCALE;
  try {
    setting = parseSettings(await settings.read()).locale;
  } catch {
    // The form shows the load error; the page still renders in the browser language.
  }
  const locale = resolveLocale(
    { setting, browserLang: navigator.language },
    new Set(Object.keys(catalogs)),
  );
  const i18n = createI18n(catalogs, locale);
  fillText(document, i18n);

  const form = await mountSettingsForm(document.body, {
    i18n,
    settings,
    allowList,
    sectionState: createSectionState(store),
    context,
    colors: context === "page",
    locales: Object.keys(catalogs),
    header: { version: extensionVersion(), iconUrl: extensionUrl(ICONS[context]) },
    ...(context === "popup" ? { allSettingsUrl: extensionUrl(OPTIONS_PAGE) } : {}),
  });

  // The page's own copy follows a new language on the next load; reload now.
  settings.subscribe((value) => {
    if (parseSettings(value).locale !== setting) {
      location.reload();
    }
  });

  // A game stopped or marked again on a store page shows up here at once.
  onLocalChanged((changes) => {
    if (changes[ALLOW_KEY] !== undefined) {
      void form.refreshAllowList();
    }
  });
}

void main();

```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { keyValueStoreContract } from "../../../tests/contracts/key-value-store.contract";
import { migrationFaultContract } from "../../../tests/contracts/migration-faults.contract";
import { migrationContract } from "../../../tests/contracts/migration.contract";
import { fakeArea, faultyArea } from "../../../tests/helpers/fake-area";
import { withKind, writeSettings } from "../../../tests/helpers/settings";
import type { Unsubscribe } from "../../core/ports";
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, encodeSettings } from "../../core/settings/settings";
import { SETTINGS_KEY } from "../../core/storage-keys";
import type { LocalChanges } from "./ext";
import { createExtensionSettings, createExtensionStore } from "./store";

/** A fake `onChanged` that the test fires by hand. */
function fakeChanges() {
  const listeners = new Set<(changes: LocalChanges) => void>();
  return {
    subscribe: (listener: (changes: LocalChanges) => void): Unsubscribe => {
      listeners.add(listener);
      return () => {
        listeners.delete(listener);
      };
    },
    fire(changes: LocalChanges) {
      for (const listener of listeners) {
        listener(changes);
      }
    },
    get size() {
      return listeners.size;
    },
  };
}

keyValueStoreContract("extension storage.local", () => createExtensionStore(fakeArea()));
migrationContract("extension storage.local", () => createExtensionStore(fakeArea()));
migrationFaultContract(
  "extension storage.local",
  (faults) => createExtensionStore(faultyArea(faults)),
);

describe("createExtensionStore", () => {
  it("makes no storage call for empty batches", async () => {
    const area = fakeArea();
    const store = createExtensionStore(area);
    await store.get([]);
    await store.set(new Map());
    await store.remove([]);
    expect(area.calls).toStrictEqual([]);
  });
});

describe("createExtensionSettings", () => {
  it("relays settings changes from other contexts and ignores other keys", () => {
    const changes = fakeChanges();
    const settings = createExtensionSettings(createExtensionStore(fakeArea()), changes.subscribe);
    const seen: unknown[] = [];
    const unsubscribe = settings.subscribe((value) => {
      seen.push(value);
    });
    const hidden = encodeSettings(withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { filter: "hide" }));
    changes.fire({ "v2:allow": { newValue: {} } });
    changes.fire({ [SETTINGS_KEY]: { newValue: hidden } });
    expect(seen).toStrictEqual([hidden]);
    unsubscribe();
    expect(changes.size).toBe(0);
  });

  it("tells its own write once, although onChanged reports it too", async () => {
    const changes = fakeChanges();
    const settings = createExtensionSettings(createExtensionStore(fakeArea()), changes.subscribe);
    const seen: unknown[] = [];
    settings.subscribe((value) => {
      seen.push(value);
    });
    const next = withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { banner: false });
    await writeSettings(settings, next);
    changes.fire({ [SETTINGS_KEY]: { newValue: encodeSettings(next) } });
    expect(seen).toStrictEqual([encodeSettings(next)]);
  });
});
```

`src/platform/extension/store.ts`:

```ts
import type { JsonValue } from "../../core/json";
import type { KeyValueStore } from "../../core/ports";
import { createSettingsSource, type StoredSettings } from "../../core/settings/settings-source";
import { SETTINGS_KEY } from "../../core/storage-keys";
import type { OnLocalChanged, StorageArea } from "./ext";

/**
 * The `KeyValueStore` port over `storage.local`. The browser serializes values on the way in and
 * out, so they are copies on both sides. `keys()` reads every item, because `getKeys()` is not in
 * every supported browser; core calls it only for the daily cache sweep.
 */
export function createExtensionStore(area: StorageArea): KeyValueStore {
  return {
    async get(keys) {
      if (keys.length === 0) {
        return new Map();
      }
      const items = await area.get([...keys]);
      const found = new Map<string, unknown>();
      for (const key of keys) {
        if (Object.hasOwn(items, key)) {
          found.set(key, items[key]);
        }
      }
      return found;
    },
    async set(entries) {
      if (entries.size > 0) {
        const items: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};
        for (const [key, value] of entries) {
          items[key] = value;
        }
        await area.set(items);
      }
    },
    async remove(keys) {
      if (keys.length > 0) {
        await area.remove([...keys]);
      }
    },
    async keys() {
      return Object.keys(await area.get(null));
    },
  };
}

/** The stored settings, with changes from other tabs and the options page through `onChanged`. */
export function createExtensionSettings(
  store: KeyValueStore,
  onChanged: OnLocalChanged,
): StoredSettings {
  return createSettingsSource(store, (listener) =>
    onChanged((changes) => {
      const change = changes[SETTINGS_KEY];
      if (change !== undefined) {
        listener(change.newValue);
      }
    }));
}

```

```ts
    await seed();

    expect(gm.writes).toStrictEqual(["a", "b"]);

describe("createRemoteSettings", () => {
  it("is absent where the manager has no value change listener", () => {
    expect(createRemoteSettings(undefined)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("passes changes of the settings value on, until unsubscribed", () => {
    const watched: string[] = [];

    const watch: WatchValue = (key, onChange) => {
      watched.push(key);
      notify = onChange;
    };
```

`src/platform/userscript/gm-storage.ts`:

```ts
import type { JsonValue } from "../../core/json";
import type { KeyValueStore, Unsubscribe } from "../../core/ports";
import type { RemoteSettingsChanges } from "../../core/settings/settings-source";
import { SETTINGS_KEY } from "../../core/storage-keys";

/** The storage calls of the `GM` object, as the composition root hands them over. */
export interface GmStorage {
  getValue(name: string): Promise<unknown>;
  setValue(name: string, value: JsonValue): Promise<void>;
  deleteValue(name: string): Promise<void>;
  listValues(): Promise<readonly string[]>;
}

/**
 * The `KeyValueStore` over `GM.getValue`, `GM.setValue`, `GM.deleteValue` and `GM.listValues`. A
 * key the manager has no value for reads as `undefined` and is absent from the result; the manager
 * stores serialized values, so what goes in and out is copied.
 */
export function createGmStore(gm: GmStorage): KeyValueStore {
  return {
    async get(keys) {
      const values = await Promise.all(keys.map((key) => gm.getValue(key)));
      const found = new Map<string, unknown>();
      keys.forEach((key, index) => {
        const value = values[index];
        if (value !== undefined) {
          found.set(key, value);
        }
      });
      return found;
    },
    async set(entries) {
      await Promise.all([...entries].map(([key, value]) => gm.setValue(key, value)));
    },
    async remove(keys) {
      await Promise.all(keys.map((key) => gm.deleteValue(key)));
    },
    async keys() {
      return [...(await gm.listValues())];
    },
  };
}

/** Starts watching one stored value for changes made in any tab. */
export type WatchValue = (key: string, onChange: (value: unknown) => void) => void;

/**
 * Settings changes from other tabs through `GM_addValueChangeListener`. Managers without it give
 * `undefined`, and settings then apply on the next page load. The API has no removal in the
 * grants, so an unsubscribed listener stays registered and ignores what it hears.
 */
export function createRemoteSettings(
  watch: WatchValue | undefined,
): RemoteSettingsChanges | undefined {
  if (watch === undefined) {
    return undefined;
  }
  return (listener): Unsubscribe => {
    let active = true;
    watch(SETTINGS_KEY, (value) => {
      if (active) {
        listener(value);
      }
    });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  };
}

```

`src/platform/userscript/gm.d.ts`:

```ts
// The userscript manager APIs the build grants (`@grant` in the header, scripts/build.py) and
// nothing else. Signatures follow the Tampermonkey and Violentmonkey documentation. Storage reads
// are `unknown` until a schema validates them. A name the manager does not provide is `undefined`
// at run time, so the optional ones are declared that way and checked with `typeof`.
import type { JsonValue } from "../../core/json";

declare global {
  const GM: {
    getValue(name: string): Promise<unknown>;
    setValue(name: string, value: JsonValue): Promise<void>;
    deleteValue(name: string): Promise<void>;
    listValues(): Promise<readonly string[]>;
    registerMenuCommand?(caption: string, onClick: () => void): Promise<unknown>;
  };

  const GM_addStyle: ((css: string) => HTMLStyleElement) | undefined;

  const GM_addValueChangeListener:
    | ((
      name: string,
      listener: (name: string, oldValue: unknown, newValue: unknown, remote: boolean) => void,
    ) => number)
    | undefined;
}
```

```ts
import type { Catalogs } from "../../core/i18n/catalog";
import { resolveLocale } from "../../core/i18n/locale";
import { createI18n, type I18n } from "../../core/i18n/t";
import type { SettingsSource } from "../../core/ports";
import { DEFAULT_SETTINGS, parseSettings } from "../../core/settings/settings";

/**
 * The message lookup for the language the settings ask for right now: the menu caption and the
 * dialog follow a language change, while `start()` keeps the one it resolved at page load.
 */
export async function currentI18n(
  doc: Document,
  settings: SettingsSource,
  catalogs: Catalogs,
  browserLang: string | undefined,
): Promise<I18n> {
  let setting = DEFAULT_SETTINGS.locale;
  try {
    setting = parseSettings(await settings.read()).locale;
  } catch {
    // The default setting stands; the form reports a storage that cannot be read.
  }
  const pageLang = doc.documentElement.lang;
  const locale = resolveLocale(
    browserLang === undefined ? { setting, pageLang } : { setting, pageLang, browserLang },
    new Set(Object.keys(catalogs)),
  );
  return createI18n(catalogs, locale);
}
```

`src/platform/userscript/main.ts`:

```ts
// Composition root of the userscript: binds the `GM` globals the header grants and hands them to
// `startUserscript`. This file and the extension's content script are the only shipped roots.
import { startUserscript } from "./userscript";

void startUserscript({
  document,
  storage: {
    getValue: (name) => GM.getValue(name),
    setValue: (name, value) => GM.setValue(name, value),
    deleteValue: (name) => GM.deleteValue(name),
    listValues: () => GM.listValues(),
  },
  fetch: (url, init) => fetch(url, init),
  console,
  browserLang: navigator.language,
  addStyle: typeof GM_addStyle === "function" ? (css) => GM_addStyle(css) : undefined,
  watchValue: typeof GM_addValueChangeListener === "function"
    ? (key, onChange) => {
      GM_addValueChangeListener(key, (_name, _oldValue, newValue) => {
        onChange(newValue);
      });
    }
    : undefined,
  registerMenuCommand: typeof GM.registerMenuCommand === "function"
    ? (caption, run) => {
      void GM.registerMenuCommand?.(caption, run);
    }
    : undefined,
});
```

`src/platform/userscript/settings-dialog.ts`:

```ts
import type { Catalogs } from "../../core/i18n/catalog";
import type { I18n } from "../../core/i18n/t";
import type { AllowList } from "../../core/settings/allow-list";
import type { StoredSettings } from "../../core/settings/settings-source";
import type { SectionState } from "../../core/ui/section-state";
import { mountSettingsForm } from "../../core/ui/settings-form";
import { adoptStyles, DIALOG_CSS } from "../../core/ui/styles";

export interface SettingsDialogDeps {
  readonly document: Document;
  readonly i18n: I18n;
  readonly catalogs: Catalogs;
  readonly settings: StoredSettings;
  readonly allowList: AllowList;
  readonly sectionState: SectionState;
  /** False when the manager cannot tell other tabs about a change, so it applies on reload. */
  readonly live: boolean;
}

const HOST_CLASS = "sar-dialog-host";
const CLOSE_ATTRIBUTE = "data-sar-close";

/**
 * Opens the settings in a modal `dialog` inside a shadow root, so store CSS cannot reach it and
 * its CSS cannot leak. Escape, the close button and a click on the backdrop close it; focus goes
 * back to where it was. Opening it twice does nothing.
 */
export async function openSettingsDialog(deps: SettingsDialogDeps): Promise<void> {
  const { document: doc, i18n } = deps;
  if (doc.querySelector(`.${HOST_CLASS}`) !== null) {
    return;
  }
  const opener = doc.activeElement;

  const host = doc.createElement("div");
  host.className = HOST_CLASS;
  const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: "open" });
  adoptStyles(shadow, DIALOG_CSS);

  const dialog = doc.createElement("dialog");
  const title = doc.createElement("h1");
  title.className = "sar-dialog-title";
  title.id = "sar-dialog-title";
  title.textContent = i18n.t("ext_name");
  dialog.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", title.id);

  const close = doc.createElement("button");
  close.type = "button";
  close.className = "sar-button";
  close.setAttribute(CLOSE_ATTRIBUTE, "");
  close.textContent = i18n.t("userscript_close");

  const head = doc.createElement("div");
  head.className = "sar-dialog-head";
  head.append(title, close);

  const formRoot = doc.createElement("div");
  const body = doc.createElement("div");
  body.className = "sar-dialog-body";
  body.append(formRoot);
  dialog.append(head, body);
  if (!deps.live) {
    const note = doc.createElement("p");
    note.className = "sar-dialog-note";
    note.textContent = i18n.t("userscript_reload_note");
    dialog.append(note);
  }
  shadow.append(dialog);
  doc.body.append(host);

  const form = await mountSettingsForm(formRoot, {
    i18n,
    settings: deps.settings,
    allowList: deps.allowList,
    sectionState: deps.sectionState,
    context: "popup",
    colors: true,
    locales: Object.keys(deps.catalogs),
  });

  // The close button and the backdrop (a click on the dialog itself) share one listener
  dialog.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
    const target = event.target;
    const onClose = target instanceof Element && target.closest(`[${CLOSE_ATTRIBUTE}]`) !== null;
    if (onClose || target === dialog) {
      dialog.close();
    }
  });
  dialog.addEventListener("close", () => {
    form.destroy();
    host.remove();
    if (opener instanceof HTMLElement) {
      opener.focus();
    }
  });
  dialog.showModal();
  close.focus();
}

```

```ts
// @vitest-environment-options {"url":"https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=roguelike"}
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import searchItems from "../../../tests/fixtures/getitems/search-roguelike-50.json";

    await expect.poll(() => document.querySelectorAll(".sar-badge").length).toBe(1);

    expect(server.calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(server.calls[0]?.init.credentials).toBe("omit");

    expect(document.adoptedStyleSheets).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it("falls back to core's own page styles where addStyle throws", async () => {
    const { env } = setup({
      addStyle: () => {
        throw new TypeError();
      },
    });
    app = await startUserscript(env);

    expect(
      document.adoptedStyleSheets.length + document.querySelectorAll("style.sar-styles").length,
    )
      .toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it("registers the settings menu command, which opens the dialog", async () => {
    const { env, commands } = setup();
    app = await startUserscript(env);

    const caption = i18n.t("userscript_menu_settings");
    expect([...commands.keys()]).toStrictEqual([caption]);
    commands.get(caption)?.();
    await expect.poll(() => document.querySelector(".sar-dialog-host")).not.toBeNull();
    const dialog = document.querySelector(".sar-dialog-host")?.shadowRoot?.querySelector("dialog");
    expect(dialog?.open).toBe(true);
    // No value change listener here, so the dialog says settings apply on reload
    expect(dialog?.querySelector(".sar-dialog-note")).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("applies settings changed in another tab where the manager reports them", async () => {
    let notify: (value: unknown) => void = () => undefined;
    const { env } = setup({
      watchValue: (_key, onChange) => {
        notify = onChange;
      },
    });
    app = await startUserscript(env);
    expect(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("off");

    notify(encodeSettings(withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { filter: "hide" })));
    expect(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("hide");
    expect(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-sar-filter-drm")).toBe("off");
  });

  it("starts on stored settings", async () => {

    await gm.setValue(
      SETTINGS_KEY,
      encodeSettings(withKind(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, "ai", { filter: "dim" })),
    );
    app = await startUserscript(env);

    expect(document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-sar-filter-ai")).toBe("dim");
  });
});
```

`src/platform/userscript/userscript.ts`:

```ts
import { type App, start } from "../../core/app";
import { createFetchHttp, type Fetch } from "../../core/http";
import { SHIPPED_CATALOGS } from "../../core/i18n/shipped";
import { type ConsoleSink, createLogger } from "../../core/log";
import { createAllowList } from "../../core/settings/allow-list";
import { createSettingsSource } from "../../core/settings/settings-source";
import { createSectionState } from "../../core/ui/section-state";
import { adoptPageStyles, PAGE_CSS, TOKENS_CSS } from "../../core/ui/styles";
import { createGmStore, createRemoteSettings, type GmStorage, type WatchValue } from "./gm-storage";
import { currentI18n } from "./locale";
import { openSettingsDialog } from "./settings-dialog";

/** What the userscript manager gives the script; `main.ts` builds it from the `GM` globals. */
export interface UserscriptEnv {
  readonly document: Document;
  readonly storage: GmStorage;
  readonly fetch: Fetch;
  readonly console: ConsoleSink;
  readonly browserLang?: string;
  /** `GM_addStyle`; absent, CSS goes in through core's own `style` fallback. */
  readonly addStyle: ((css: string) => unknown) | undefined;
  /** `GM_addValueChangeListener`; absent, settings apply on the next page load. */
  readonly watchValue: WatchValue | undefined;
  /** `GM.registerMenuCommand`; absent, the settings dialog has no way to open. */
  readonly registerMenuCommand: ((caption: string, run: () => void) => void) | undefined;
}

/**
 * Wires the ports over the manager's APIs, registers the settings menu command and starts the app.
 * A failure is logged and ends the script quietly: it never breaks the store page.
 */
export async function startUserscript(env: UserscriptEnv): Promise<App | undefined> {
  const { document: doc, addStyle, browserLang } = env;
  const store = createGmStore(env.storage);
  const remote = createRemoteSettings(env.watchValue);
  const settings = createSettingsSource(store, remote);
  const clock = { now: () => Date.now() };
  const i18n = await currentI18n(doc, settings, SHIPPED_CATALOGS, browserLang);
  const logger = createLogger(i18n, env.console, false);

  // The page stylesheet goes in through GM_addStyle; core's own adoption is the fallback
  const addPageStyles = (page: Document): void => {
    try {
      if (addStyle === undefined) {
        adoptPageStyles(page);
      } else {
        addStyle(TOKENS_CSS + PAGE_CSS);
      }
    } catch {
      adoptPageStyles(page);
    }
  };

  env.registerMenuCommand?.(i18n.t("userscript_menu_settings"), () => {
    void (async () => {
      await openSettingsDialog({
        document: doc,
        i18n: await currentI18n(doc, settings, SHIPPED_CATALOGS, browserLang),
        catalogs: SHIPPED_CATALOGS,
        settings,
        allowList: createAllowList(store, clock),
        sectionState: createSectionState(store),
        live: remote !== undefined,
      });
    })().catch((problem: unknown) => {
      logger.error(problem);
    });
  });

  try {
    return await start({
      document: doc,
      http: createFetchHttp(env.fetch),
      store,
      settings,
      clock,
      console: env.console,
      addPageStyles,
      ...(browserLang === undefined ? {} : { browserLang }),
    });
  } catch (problem) {
    logger.error(problem);
    return undefined;
  }
}
```

`tests/catalog-wording.test.ts`:

```ts
import * as v from "valibot";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

// Rule 4: the product reports what developers disclosed and never judges a game. A catalog in
// any locale that says a game "uses AI", is "AI-free" or has "no AI" fails here, as it fails
// scripts/check_i18n.py.
const FORBIDDEN = /\buses AI\b|\bAI-free\b|\bno AI\b/i;

const CatalogSchema = v.record(v.string(), v.object({ message: v.string() }));

const catalogs = import.meta.glob("../src/locales/*/messages.json", {
  eager: true,
  import: "default",
});

function messages(path: string): readonly (readonly [string, string])[] {
  const catalog = v.parse(CatalogSchema, catalogs[path]);
  return Object.entries(catalog).map(([key, entry]) => [key, entry.message] as const);
}

describe("catalog wording", () => {
  it("finds the shipped catalogs", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(catalogs)).toContain("../src/locales/en/messages.json");
  });

  it.each(Object.keys(catalogs))(
    "%s never says a game uses AI, is AI-free or has no AI",
    (path) => {
      const offending = messages(path).filter(([, message]) => FORBIDDEN.test(message));
      expect(offending).toEqual([]);
    },
  );

  it.each(["This game uses AI.", "AI-free!", "Contains no AI"])("catches %j", (message) => {
    expect(FORBIDDEN.test(message)).toBe(true);
  });
});
```

`tests/contracts/detector.contract.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Detector } from "../../src/core/ports";
import { appIds as ids } from "../helpers/app-ids";

/**
 * The behavior every `Detector` must have, whatever its source answers: GetItems, the HTML
 * fallback, chains and decorators. `make` returns a new detector for each case.
 */
export function detectorContract(name: string, make: () => Detector): void {
  describe(`Detector contract: ${name}`, () => {
    it("answers an empty request with an empty map", async () => {
      expect(await make().detect([])).toStrictEqual(new Map());
    });

    it("gives exactly one verdict per distinct requested ID", async () => {
      const requested = ids(5072580, 413150, 99999999, 5072580);
      const verdicts = await make().detect(requested);
      expect([...verdicts.keys()].sort((a, b) => a - b)).toStrictEqual([413150, 5072580, 99999999]);
    });

    it("resolves with verdicts instead of rejecting", async () => {
      await expect(make().detect(ids(1, 2, 3))).resolves.toBeInstanceOf(Map);
    });
  });
}
```

`tests/contracts/http.contract.ts`:

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { Http, HttpResult } from "../../src/core/ports";
import type { Route } from "../helpers/fake-http";

const API = "https://api.steampowered.com/IStoreBrowseService/GetItems/v1?input_json=%7B%7D";
const PAGE = "https://store.steampowered.com/app/413150/?l=english";
const LOGIN = "https://store.steampowered.com/login/?redir=app%2F339800";

function response(result: HttpResult) {
  expect(result.kind).toBe("response");
  return result.kind === "response" ? result : undefined;
}

/**
 * The behavior every `Http` must have (src/core/AGENTS.md, "The contract-test rule"). `make`
 * builds the implementation over a server that answers from `routes`.
 */
export function httpContract(name: string, make: (routes: readonly Route[]) => Http): void {
  describe(`Http contract: ${name}`, () => {
    it("returns the status, final URL, headers and the whole body", async () => {
      const http = make([[API, { body: "{}", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }]]);
      const got = response(await http.get(API));
      expect(got?.status).toBe(200);
      expect(got?.url).toBe(API);
      expect(got?.headers.get("content-type")).toBe("application/json");
      expect(got?.body).toBe("{}");
    });

    it("names headers in lower case", async () => {
      const http = make([[API, { headers: { "X-EResult": "8" } }]]);
      const got = response(await http.get(API));
      expect(got?.headers.get("x-eresult")).toBe("8");
      expect([...(got?.headers.keys() ?? [])].every((key) => key === key.toLowerCase())).toBe(true);
    });

    it("reports the URL a redirect ended at", async () => {
      const http = make([[PAGE, { body: "<html></html>", url: LOGIN }]]);
      expect(response(await http.get(PAGE))?.url).toBe(LOGIN);
    });

    it("returns error statuses as responses, with their bodies", async () => {
      const http = make([
        [`${API}&s=400`, { status: 400, body: "Invalid input_json parameter" }],
        [`${API}&s=429`, { status: 429 }],
        [`${API}&s=503`, { status: 503 }],
      ]);
      const bad = response(await http.get(`${API}&s=400`));
      expect(bad?.status).toBe(400);
      expect(bad?.body).toBe("Invalid input_json parameter");
      expect(response(await http.get(`${API}&s=429`))?.status).toBe(429);
      expect(response(await http.get(`${API}&s=503`))?.status).toBe(503);
    });

    it("reports a request that gets no readable answer as failed, without rejecting", async () => {
      const http = make([[API, "network-error"]]);
      const got = await http.get(API);
      expect(got.kind).toBe("failed");
      expect(got.kind === "failed" ? got.cause : undefined).toBeInstanceOf(TypeError);
    });

    it("reports a body that cannot be read as failed", async () => {
      const http = make([[API, "body-error"]]);
      expect((await http.get(API)).kind).toBe("failed");
    });

    it("answers overlapping requests independently", async () => {
      const http = make([[API, { body: "api" }], [PAGE, { body: "page" }]]);
      const [api, page] = await Promise.all([http.get(API), http.get(PAGE)]);
      expect(response(api)?.body).toBe("api");
      expect(response(page)?.body).toBe("page");
    });
  });
}
```
